source_text(原文): A sheaf of papers detailing a sacred scenario of the commedia della Sole.
translation_zh(译文): 一叠纸页,详述着太阳喜剧的一出神圣剧目。

dialogue|10|100|Dialogue Text,You are mortal. And ignorant. Nothing you say can approach what a Lantern-long feels.,你是凡人。而且无知。你说的一切
translation_zh(译文): 都无从触及灯之长生者的感受。"

source_text(原文): We have made our arrangement. I'll keep to my word.
translation_zh(译文): 我们已定下约定。我会信守承诺。

source_text(原文): A pity the [[Mansus]] is barred to us both. We could walk in the Orchard of Lights... but the War in the Sun has denied us that joy. We must take what we can from what's left.
translation_zh(译文): 可惜,[[漫宿]]对我们俩,双双紧闭。我们本可在辉光果园中漫步……但太阳之战,夺走了这份欢愉。我们只能从余下的残迹中,取用所能取的一切。

source_text(原文): A pity the [[Mansus]] is barred to us both. I would like to speak more with your heart. It is rare to share [[History]] with one of your kind. But we'll have to make do with what's left.
translation_zh(译文): 可惜,[[漫宿]]对我们俩,双双紧闭。我很想与你的心,再多谈谈。与你这般的人共享[[历史]],实属罕事。但我们只能将就,以余下的残迹度日。

source_text(原文): I have what I needed from the doctor - I found it in his dream.
translation_zh(译文): 我已从医生那里得到了所需之物——我在他的梦里找到了它。

source_text(原文): It is good when we open the vaults of the soul. It is good when a secret's revealed.
translation_zh(译文): 当我们打开灵魂的宝库,是好的。当一个秘密被揭示,是好的。

source_text(原文): The witch followed another, as you follow her - an old woman of Raveline blood. I concerned myself not with her beast-taint and curse. But your Nina sought something from her.
translation_zh(译文): 那女巫追随着另一个人,正如你追随着她——一位拉韦林血统的老妇人。她的兽污与诅咒,我不曾理会。但你的尼娜,想从她那里得到什么。

source_text(原文): My heart thumps uncomfortably. Jealousy? Apprehension? Difficult to be sure.
translation_zh(译文): 我的心,不安地擂动。嫉妒?忧惧?说不准。

source_text(原文): Earlier, you wanted me to look into the scrine. So you could know me, wasn't it? I offer you that.
translation_zh(译文): 方才,你想让我望向圣龛。好让你识得我,不是吗?如今,我成全你。

source_text(原文): What do you mean? That it isn't the twentieth century everywhere?
translation_zh(译文): 你什么意思?难道不是处处都在二十世纪?

source_text(原文): You are friendlier now that Sinombre can help? Well, let's call it a change of the heart.
translation_zh(译文): 西诺姆布尔能帮上忙了,你就热络起来?唔,就当这是一次心的转变吧。

source_text(原文): Now just let your thoughts wander, now open your eyes. It's so bright, is it not? It's so clear.
translation_zh(译文): 现在,只管让你的思绪漫游,现在睁开眼睛。多么明亮,不是吗?多么清澈。

source_text(原文): Who is hollow of spirit and brazen of heart? Who has come here through iron and salt? I know you and name you, Lieutenant S.H. And I'll help you with Aubière's dream.
translation_zh(译文): 谁灵魂空洞,谁心肠厚颜?谁穿过铁与盐,来到这里?我认得你,也唤出你的名字,中尉 S.H.。而我,会助你进入奥比埃的梦。

source_text(原文): Use Bosk to brew something that will let me walk in his dreams? That's a good idea, actually.
translation_zh(译文): 用丛林学炼制出某种东西,让我得以走进他的梦?这主意,其实不坏。

source_text(原文): Use Ithastry to brew something that will let me walk in his dreams? That's a good idea, actually.
translation_zh(译文): 用盗火术炼制出某种东西,让我得以走进他的梦?这主意,其实不坏。

source_text(原文): What do you mean? That it isn't the twentieth century where you're standing?
translation_zh(译文): 你什么意思?难道你站着的地方,不在二十世纪?

source_text(原文): Stop it. Or I'll leave you here in the dark.
translation_zh(译文): 住口。不然,我就把你留在这黑暗里。

source_text(原文): Who has come to Sinombre? Whose heart and whose name? Come closer, my dear. Let me see.
translation_zh(译文): 是谁来到了西诺姆布尔面前?谁的心,谁的名字?走近些,亲爱的。让我看看。

source_text(原文): You are wise to be wary, my guttering light. But Sinombre is not what she was. Come closer, come closer, look into the scrine... and Sinombre will give you her light.
translation_zh(译文): 你懂得提防,是明智的,我这将熄的光。但西诺姆布尔,已不是昔日的她。走近些,再走近些,望向圣龛……西诺姆布尔会把她的光给你。

source_text(原文): You've returned to Sinombre, Lieutenant S.H. And Sinombre is ready to speak.
translation_zh(译文): 你回到了西诺姆布尔面前,中尉 S.H.。而西诺姆布尔,已准备好开口。

source_text(原文): Come, cautious petitioner, Sinombre awaits. Let's hear what you bring me today.
translation_zh(译文): 来吧,谨慎的请愿者,西诺姆布尔在等着。让我听听,你今天带来了什么。

source_text(原文): [The light is compellingly bright. It's difficult to look away. It would be much easier to step closer.]
translation_zh(译文): [那光强烈得摄人心魄。很难移开目光。迈步靠近,要容易得多。]

source_text(原文): [Remain in place through force of will - even if it exhausts me.]
translation_zh(译文): [凭意志力留在原地——哪怕耗尽气力。]

source_text(原文): [The light doesn't dim, but it seems more remote, and the voice a little flatter. The pressure to approach eases so abruptly that I sway backwards.]
translation_zh(译文): [光没有变暗,却似乎更加遥远,声音也更平了些。那股催促靠近的压力骤然消解,我身形一晃,向后仰去。]

source_text(原文): [The charm falters on my lips, and I find I've taken a step closer.]
translation_zh(译文): [咒语在唇边一顿,我发觉自己已经迈近了一步。]

source_text(原文): Well, have it your own way, you thin scrap of flesh. Stay there in your shadowy muck. We can speak at this distance, like travellers by night. But tell me then, first, what I am.
translation_zh(译文): 好吧,随你的便,你这片单薄的肉。就待在你那阴翳的烂泥里吧。隔着这个距离,我们照样可以交谈,就像夜行的旅人。那么,先告诉我,我是什么。

source_text(原文): ...and you're trapped in a scrine, here in the Wake, because someone back in the Mansus has destroyed your scrineway. No fulgent would risk staying this long in a scrine of something as impermanent as ice.
translation_zh(译文): ……而你被困在醒界的一座圣龛里,因为漫宿之中,有人毁掉了你的龛道。没有哪个辉耀者,会冒险在一座以冰这种无常之物制成的圣龛里,逗留这么久。
……在这座圣龛里显形……一座冰做的圣龛?

source_text(原文): [A human-height block of something brilliantly luminous, almost hidden beneath a heavy velvet drape. Damp spots on the drape, drops of water on the floor, a hazy chill in the air of the room, all suggest that the 'something' is ice.]
translation_zh(译文): [一块一人高的东西,焕发着璀璨的光芒,几乎整个藏在一块厚重的天鹅绒帷幕之下。帷幕上的湿痕、地板上的水珠、房间里弥漫的寒意,都表明那「东西」是冰。]

source_text(原文): I'm not going to talk to you like this, Sinombre. It's the twentieth century.
translation_zh(译文): 我不会这样跟你说话,西诺姆布尔。如今是二十世纪。

source_text(原文): The aristocracy of the old Sun; a power of the Mansus gracing the Wake. [Incline your head.]
translation_zh(译文): 旧日太阳的贵族;一位驾临醒界的漫宿权柄。[微微颔首。]

source_text(原文): When you've learnt all that I have, my petitioner-thing, perspective will grant you new eyes.
translation_zh(译文): 等你学尽了我所学的一切,我的请愿之物,眼界自会赐你新的眼睛。

source_text(原文): Sinombre is listening. Tell her what you seek. If it touches her whims, she may help.
translation_zh(译文): 西诺姆布尔在聆听。告诉她,你求的是什么。若合她的心意,她或许会帮你。

source_text(原文): It is harder, it's true, since the fall of the Sun. We are none of us all that we were.
translation_zh(译文): 确实,自太阳陨落以来,行事愈发艰难。我们之中,谁也不复昔日的自己。

source_text(原文): You are not quite a scholar, but not quite a boor. It will do, for this sliver of day.
translation_zh(译文): 你算不上学者,也算不上粗人。于这一隙白昼,已然足够。
[西诺姆布尔的光,柔和地脉动着。]

source_text(原文): The last witch of Lagash! A traitress, a fraud.
translation_zh(译文): 拉格什的末代女巫!一个叛徒,一个骗子。

source_text(原文): Ah... of course. The compulsion of brass.
You are not the first fool to be snared.
translation_zh(译文): 你不是第一个被网住的傻瓜。

source_text(原文): [Wait impassively. Don't rise to the bait.]
Don't think you understand my motives, Sinombre.
translation_zh(译文): 别以为你看得透我的动机,西诺姆布尔。

source_text(原文): I have seen your poor spirit, remember, S.H. You are bent by the sign of the Gate.
translation_zh(译文): 我看过你那可怜的魂灵,记得吗,S.H.。你被「门」的印记压弯了。

source_text(原文): So the wisdom of silence's not lost to the world? That will serve you, perhaps, with the Witch.
translation_zh(译文): 这么说,沉默的智慧,还没有在世间失传?这或许能帮到你,在那女巫面前。

source_text(原文): I see deeper, petitioner, than any mere flesh. Have a care what you say in this place.
translation_zh(译文): 我看得比任何血肉之躯都深,请愿者。在这个地方说话,当心些。

source_text(原文): None of us are ever really free... but I shouldn't need to tell you that, should I, Sinombre?
translation_zh(译文): 我们谁都不会真正自由……不过这话,不必由我来说吧,西诺姆布尔?

source_text(原文): Well, Nina has left us, that much you must know. The Director dreams brightly of why. Would you walk in his dreams, then? To learn of her fate? If you offer me what I must have?
translation_zh(译文): 唔,尼娜离开了我们,这一点你必定知晓。至于缘由,院长梦得澄亮。那么,你可愿意走进他的梦里?去探知她的命运?只要你给我,我必需之物?

source_text(原文): About the dreams of Dr Aubière.
Who is hollow of spirit and brazen of heart? Who has come here through iron and salt? I know you and name you, Lieutenant S.H. Now tell me in turn what I am.
translation_zh(译文): 谁灵魂空洞,谁心肠厚颜?谁穿过铁与盐,来到这里?我认得你,也唤出你的名字,中尉 S.H.。现在,轮到你来告诉我,我是什么。
[西诺姆布尔的光,急切地脉动起来。]

source_text(原文): Use Nyctodromy to brew something that will let me walk in his dreams? That's a good idea, actually.
translation_zh(译文): 用夜游术炼制出某种东西,让我得以走进他的梦?这主意,其实不坏。

source_text(原文): Hmf. After so many years I should really have learnt not to fritter my insights away.
translation_zh(译文): 哼。这么多年了,我本当学会,不把自己的洞见随手挥霍。

source_text(原文): I can craft Labrikon with an Unworldly skill, enabling entry to Aubière's dream. Or I can still make an arrangement with Sinombre, if I prefer.
translation_zh(译文): 我可以用一项超凡技艺炼制拉布里孔,从而进入奥比埃的梦境。或者,倘若我更愿意,仍可与西诺姆布尔谈成一笔交易。

source_text(原文): What price would you accept to take me into the doctor's dream?
translation_zh(译文): 要什么代价,你才肯带我进入医生的梦境?

source_text(原文): What safeguards would you offer to take me into the doctor's dream?
translation_zh(译文): 带我进入医生的梦境,你能给出什么保障?

source_text(原文): All right. I'm ready to discuss an arrangement to enter the doctor's dreams.
translation_zh(译文): 好吧。我准备好谈一笔交易,以进入医生的梦境。

source_text(原文): Oh, banish your fears, I won't feast on your thoughts. I'll offer the oath you prefer.
translation_zh(译文): 噢,收起你的恐惧吧,我不会以你的思绪为食。我会立下你中意的誓言。

source_text(原文): [Consider safeguards when dealing with a Lantern-long like this.]
translation_zh(译文): [与这样一位灯之长生者打交道,须得思量些保障。]

source_text(原文): [Any number of binding oaths suggest themselves. There are ways to be safe.]
translation_zh(译文): [种种约束性的誓言,纷至沓来。总有些法子,可以保自己周全。]

source_text(原文): [She could offer safeguards. She could make promises. But could I really be sure?]
translation_zh(译文): [她可以给出保障。她可以许下承诺。可我真的能确信吗?]

source_text(原文): I am generous; and always, I'm ready to trust. Only give me your word that you'll help. The next time I find myself needful and lost... I'll call on your services then.
translation_zh(译文): 我慷慨大方;而且,我向来愿意信任。只要给我一句话,说你愿意相助。下一次,我若困顿无依……我便来请你出力。

source_text(原文): Or if you've found for me the customary gift - then that's easier of course for us both.
translation_zh(译文): 又或者,你为我寻来了惯例的献礼——那我们双方,自然都更省事。

source_text(原文): I acknowledge your insight... disparage your tact. We'll agree that it is as you say.
translation_zh(译文): 我认下你的洞见……也看不上你的圆滑。我们姑且同意,事情就如你所说。

source_text(原文): Now just let your thoughts wander, just open your eyes. It's so bright, is it not? It's so clear.
translation_zh(译文): 现在,只管让你的思绪漫游,只管睁开你的眼睛。多么明亮,不是吗?多么清澈。

source_text(原文): [A moment of peace. Perhaps more than a moment.]
But you will not forget me, petitioner mine. Sinombre will dwell in your thoughts.
translation_zh(译文): 但你不会忘记我的,我的请愿者。西诺姆布尔,将在你的思绪中栖居。

source_text(原文): You're a fulgent. A Lantern-long. A bodiless immortal of the Company of Lights...
translation_zh(译文): 你是一名辉耀者。灯之长生者。辉光会社中无形的不朽者……

source_text(原文): Then you'll offer me what? For the dreams that I'll bring?
translation_zh(译文): 那么,你愿意给我什么?换我带来的梦境?

source_text(原文): The traditional payment. [Hold up a spintria.]
translation_zh(译文): 传统的酬谢。[举起一枚斯宾特里亚。]

source_text(原文): I am ready to guide you, as we have agreed. Place my name on your lips when you sleep.
translation_zh(译文): 我已准备好为你引路,如我们所约。入睡之时,把我的名字置于唇间。

source_text(原文): Are you a patient here? Or a prisoner?
translation_zh(译文): 你是这里的病人?还是囚徒?

source_text(原文): I have doctorates from Leiden, Navarre, and Bonn. I'm a colleague of dear Aubière's.
translation_zh(译文): 我在莱顿、纳瓦拉和波恩都取得过博士学位。我是亲爱的奥比埃的同事。

source_text(原文): You have my promise that I'll help you, the next time that you'll need it.
translation_zh(译文): 我向你承诺:下次你需要帮助之时,我会相助。

source_text(原文): Wait. I'm not ready after all.
translation_zh(译文): 等等。我终究还没有准备好。

source_text(原文): You are teasing me now. I had thought we were friends. But it seems I am nothing to you.
translation_zh(译文): 你这是在戏弄我了。我原以为,我们已是朋友。可看来,我对你什么都不是。

source_text(原文): You're a Mansus-spirit. And not a well one, or you wouldn't choose to be here in the Sanitarium.
translation_zh(译文): 你是漫宿之灵。而且是个不健全的,否则你不会选择待在这疗养院里。

source_text(原文): Uninspiring, but Sinombre takes what she must. Place it under my drape and step back.
translation_zh(译文): 平平无奇,但西诺姆布尔,取其所必需。把它放在我的幕布之下,然后退开。

source_text(原文): Ah, my sweet petitioner! How welcome you are; for that promise is all that I need.
translation_zh(译文): 啊,我甜蜜的请愿者!真是欢迎之至;因为你那句话,正是我所需的一切。

source_text(原文): Ah, the sweetest of Spencers! How welcome you are; for that promise is all that I need.
translation_zh(译文): 啊,最甜蜜的斯宾塞!真是欢迎之至;因为你那句话,正是我所需的一切。

source_text(原文): When you sleep, say my name as you wait for the dark. Once, twice, and a third time, no more.
translation_zh(译文): 入睡之时,在等待黑暗之际,念我的名字。一遍,两遍,至第三遍,不可再多。

source_text(原文): [When I lift the drape, the light from beneath is enthrallingly bright. But I place the coin and step back before my mind can drift.]
translation_zh(译文): [我掀开幕布,底下溢出的光令人心神俱醉。但在心神游走之前,我放下钱币,退后一步。]

source_text(原文): I swear that I'll guide you; nor draw from your strength; nor enter where I am not bid. On the [[Watchman]] I swear it, the Door in the Eye, on his robe and his [[Names]] and his light.
translation_zh(译文): 我发誓,为你引路;不汲取你的力量;不踏入未受邀请之地。以[[守夜人]]起誓,以瞳中之门、以他的衣袍、他的[[名号]]与他的光起誓。

source_text(原文): I look forward to meeting again on the other side of sleep, shining one.
translation_zh(译文): 期待与你在睡眠的彼岸重逢,光辉者。

source_text(原文): It must be tedious for you being trapped in this scrine. I hope it's a welcome diversion.
translation_zh(译文): 被困在这座圣龛里,想必十分乏味。但愿,这是个受欢迎的消遣。

source_text(原文): Perhaps where you're standing, you hybrid of mirk.
translation_zh(译文): 或许,在你站着的地方是这样,你这幽暗的杂种。
[出示法国护照] 西尔万·韦西耶。

source_text(原文): [The big man dangles the passport from one corner between finger and thumb. He inspects it without interest.]
translation_zh(译文): [大汉用拇指和食指捏着护照一角,让它悬着。他毫无兴致地检视它。]

source_text(原文): This is not the Republic. Your papers are worthless.
translation_zh(译文): 这里不是共和国。你的证件一文不值。

source_text(原文): This is becoming tiresome. I'm not a man you want to cross. Take me to the Director.
translation_zh(译文): 这可越来越让人生厌了。我可不是你想招惹的人。带我去见院长。

source_text(原文): Please, monsieur. I'm sorry to be a nuisance, but I really only need a moment of his time. And I don't want to waste any more of yours. [Offer my warmest smile.]
translation_zh(译文): 求您了,先生。抱歉打扰您,但我真的只需要他片刻时间。我也不想再浪费您的时间。[献上我最热诚的微笑。]

source_text(原文): [The big man folds his arms. He neither moves nor changes expression.]
translation_zh(译文): [大汉抱起双臂。他不动,表情也不变。]

source_text(原文): You strike me as a man who understands the value of his time. Let me put a number to that value. [20 francisques]
translation_zh(译文): 我看您是懂得自己时间价值的人。让我给这价值标一个数。[20 法兰西斧币]

source_text(原文): The Director might know. I do not. This is not a library. It is not a bureau of information.
translation_zh(译文): 院长或许知道。我不知道。这里不是图书馆,也不是情报处。

source_text(原文): [The big man softens, just a little. It is after all a golden kind of afternoon.]
translation_zh(译文): [大汉缓和了一些,只有一点点。毕竟这是个金光灿灿的下午。]

source_text(原文): Then I'd like to speak to the Director.
translation_zh(译文): 那我还是要和院长谈谈。

source_text(原文): [I hold the big man's gaze steadily. He gnaws at the inside of his cheek, suddenly uneasy.]
translation_zh(译文): [我稳稳地迎上大汉的目光。他咬起脸颊内侧,忽然有些不安。]

source_text(原文): I will know who you are, and what you're doing here.
translation_zh(译文): 我会弄清楚你是谁,以及你在这里做什么。

source_text(原文): [The big man folds the money away with an air of complacent virtue. He is pleased, clearly, that the value of his time has been recognised.]
translation_zh(译文): [大汉带着一副自得的美德气派,把钱收了起来。显然他很满意,自己时间的价值终于得到了承认。]

source_text(原文): [The big man scoffs.] 'I am not to be bought.' [He glances around to reassure himself that his virtue has been registered.]
translation_zh(译文): [大汉嗤笑一声。]『我可不是能被收买的。』[他环顾四周,好确认自己的美德已被看在眼里。]

source_text(原文): [The night knows there is some small risk in sharing my name. But there may be no other way forward here.]
translation_zh(译文): [夜深知,说出自己的名字有些许风险。但眼下或许没有别的路可走。]

source_text(原文): The Director is in his office. Over there, by the stairs.
translation_zh(译文): 院长在他的办公室里。那边,楼梯旁。

source_text(原文): [Mathis steps back to let me pass.]
You have a name that opens doors, Monsieur 'obson.
translation_zh(译文): 您有一个能开门道的名字,奥布森先生。

source_text(原文): The big man reaches out for the passport.
[He scrutinises the passport, eyes crinkling, lips moving slightly. He hands it back to me.]
translation_zh(译文): [他细看护照,眼角皱起,嘴唇微微翕动。他把护照递还给我。]

source_text(原文): [He scowls, but makes no attempt to snatch it. Instead he scrutinises it, eyes crinkling, lips moving slightly.]
translation_zh(译文): [他皱起眉,却并不来夺。他只是细看护照,眼角皱起,嘴唇微微翕动。]

source_text(原文): Regrettably I have none, but I think the Director will want to see me nevertheless.
translation_zh(译文): 很遗憾,我没有。但我相信院长仍然会想见我。

source_text(原文): Listen to the music warbling from the radio.
translation_zh(译文): 听收音机里婉转流出的乐声。

source_text(原文): I need to speak with the Director.
A poignant, graceful jazz piece - guitar, violin, double bass? -with a driving rhythm that somehow seems stately - almost like a waltz.
translation_zh(译文): 一首凄美优雅的爵士——吉他、小提琴、低音提琴?——节奏强劲,却不知为何透着庄严——几乎像一首华尔兹。

source_text(原文): Is that... Reinhardt? Grappelli? I don't know it.
translation_zh(译文): 那是……莱因哈特?格拉佩利?我没听过这首。

source_text(原文): You know Reinhardt, but you don't know 'Nuages'?
translation_zh(译文): 你知道莱因哈特,却不知道《云》?

source_text(原文): Take time to examine the radio.
translation_zh(译文): 花点时间细看这台收音机。

source_text(原文): Lambent brass, and black bakelite shiny as a beetle's carapace. A handsome bit of kit. And remarkably portable - less than two feet across. It's branded with a crown, and the words ZENITH TRANS-OCEANIC.
translation_zh(译文): 黄铜泛着柔光,黑色电木亮得像甲虫的鞘翅。一件漂亮的机子。而且出奇地便携——宽不到两英尺。上面印着一顶王冠,以及 ZENITH TRANS-OCEANIC 的字样。

source_text(原文): Lambent brass, and black bakelite shiny as a beetle's carapace. A handsome bit of kit. And remarkably portable - less than two feet across.
translation_zh(译文): 黄铜泛着柔光,黑色电木亮得像甲虫的鞘翅。一件漂亮的机子。而且出奇地便携——宽不到两英尺。

source_text(原文): I knew one of the clubs he used to play. Chez Bricktop. I've been away a long time... but you don't forget Reinhardt. This must be new?
translation_zh(译文): 他以前常演的俱乐部,我知道一家——布里克托普之家。我离开太久了……但莱因哈特是忘不掉的。这首一定是新作?

source_text(原文): That's what I said. Is it new?

translation_zh(译文): 不。莱因哈特是忘不掉的。

source_text(原文): When the [[Enemy]] was in Paris, Reinhardt wrote this. They had little affection for swing, the Enemy. So Reinhardt was careful. So this isn't precisely swing...
translation_zh(译文): [[敌人]]在巴黎时,莱因哈特写了这首。敌人对摇摆乐没什么好感。所以莱因哈特很小心。所以这首并不算是严格的摇摆乐……

source_text(原文): The blond man is watching me impatiently.
translation_zh(译文): 金发男人正不耐烦地看着我。

source_text(原文): That's [[Incorporate]] manufacture. An American import. There can't be many of those in France - either the [[State]] or the [[Republic]].
translation_zh(译文): 那是[[集团]]的产品。美国进口货。在法国——无论是[[邦国]]还是[[共和国]]——这种东西都不会有多少。

source_text(原文): A large blond gentleman in orderly's whites blocks the hallway listening to a portable radio. He raises his eyes to regard me without enthusiasm.
translation_zh(译文): 一位高大的金发先生穿着护理员的白衣,堵在走廊里,听着便携收音机。他抬起眼,不带热忱地打量我。

source_text(原文): [Mathis blinks slowly in response to my curtness. With insolent deliberation, he steps back to let me pass.]
translation_zh(译文): [马蒂斯对我生硬的回应缓缓眨了眨眼。他带着傲慢的从容,退后一步让我过去。]

source_text(原文): [Turn to the radio. Silence it with a pale phrase.]
translation_zh(译文): [转向收音机。用一个苍白的短句让它归于寂静。]

source_text(原文): [The radio crackles, and fades abruptly to silence. The hall seems chillier. Mathis' eyes widen, and he takes a step back.]
translation_zh(译文): [收音机噼啪作响,骤然淡去,归于寂静。走廊似乎更冷了。马蒂斯睁大眼睛,退了一步。]

source_text(原文): Then you must surely have an appointment.
[The radio crackles and begins to fade... but almost immediately recovers. Mathis frowns, puzzled.]
translation_zh(译文): [收音机噼啪作响,开始变弱……但几乎立刻又恢复过来。马蒂斯皱着眉,一脸困惑。]

source_text(原文): She makes an impression, Mlle Lagasse.
translation_zh(译文): 她给人留下深刻印象,拉加斯小姐。

source_text(原文): [Bricktop's.... like a lit window across a wide river, that memory.]
translation_zh(译文): [布里克托普之家……那记忆,像宽阔河对岸一扇亮着灯的窗。]

source_text(原文): I need no appointment. My business is of the highest importance.
translation_zh(译文): 我不需要预约。我要办的事至关重要。

source_text(原文): [Show British passport] My name is Spencer Hobson.
translation_zh(译文): [出示英国护照] 我叫斯宾塞·霍布森。

source_text(原文): Good luck, then! You'll find it a lot stranger than the Légion. And the Légion was pretty strange, hey? [He chortles.]
translation_zh(译文): 那就祝你好运!你会发现这里比军团怪得多。而军团已经够怪的了,嗯?[他咯咯笑着。]

source_text(原文): On the other side of this curtain... well, you know about that already. I'll stay here.
translation_zh(译文): 这道帘子的另一边……嗯,你已经知道了。我就待在这儿。

source_text(原文): On the other side of this curtain... well residents are allowed to talk to each other, so go in there if you're feeling brave.
translation_zh(译文): 这道帘子的另一边……嗯,住客之间是允许交谈的,所以你要是胆子够大,就进去吧。

source_text(原文): Sorry. Can't talk about... it. Gives it power. But you'll be fine. It won't hurt another resident.
translation_zh(译文): 抱歉。不能说……它。说了会给它力量。不过你会没事的。它不会伤害别的住客。

source_text(原文): Ask! It gets lonely up here.
Poor old fool. I don't know if he wants to be cured or not. Don't think he can be, course. I've never seen someone stop going [[Cross]].
translation_zh(译文): 可怜的老傻瓜。我不知道他到底想不想被治愈。当然,我想他也治不好。我从没见过有人能中止走向介壳种的。

source_text(原文): The whole business is making him... surly. No sense of humour.
translation_zh(译文): 这整档子事让他变得……乖戾。一点幽默感也没有了。

source_text(原文): What do you think of Dr Aubière?
translation_zh(译文): 你觉得奥比埃医生怎么样?

source_text(原文): He's, ehh... I've known worse. Pay's good, and it's stinking hard to find work since the War, you know? Especially somewhere like this. The sun still shines. The rain doesn't burn. No difficult dead.
translation_zh(译文): 他嘛,呃……我见过更差的。薪水不错,而且战后这日子,想找份活儿难得很,你知道吧?尤其是这种地方。阳光照样照耀。雨水不会灼人。也没有难缠的死人。

source_text(原文): You mean your employer? And mine? Nothing I'd care to air. [Vincent winks.]
translation_zh(译文): 你是说你的雇主?也是我的?没什么我想声张的。[文森特挤挤眼。]

source_text(原文): How do you get on with Mathis?
translation_zh(译文): 你跟马蒂斯处得怎么样?
帘子后面你的那位朋友……

source_text(原文): Not my friend. Listen, chef, I'd rather not talk about it.
translation_zh(译文): 不是我的朋友。听着,头儿,我宁愿不谈那事。

source_text(原文): [Vincent leans forward and whispers:] It got into my dreams, last time.
translation_zh(译文): [文森特探过身来,低声说:]上次,它钻进了我的梦里。

source_text(原文): Know her, love her! Heart of a lioness, voice of a lark.
translation_zh(译文): 认识她,也敬爱她!母狮般的心,百灵鸟般的嗓子。

source_text(原文): She misses her country, and her husband. But I don't know how much is left of those - either of them - and she likes it here. 'Out of the cold,' she says. And the doctor is helping her with the pain.
translation_zh(译文): 她想念她的祖国,还有她的丈夫。但我不知道那两者还剩下多少——无论是哪个——而她喜欢这里。「远离寒冷,」她这么说。医生也在帮她缓解疼痛。

source_text(原文): ...so it takes me a few moments to recognise him. He's quicker off the mark.
translation_zh(译文): ……于是我花了好一会儿才认出他。他却更快认出了我。

source_text(原文): I don't think she expects ever to leave the Sanitarium alive. Stinking shame.
translation_zh(译文): 我看她没指望自己能活着离开疗养院。真他妈的可惜。

source_text(原文): Lovely girl, Bessy. I'm not her type, though.
translation_zh(译文): 贝茜是个好姑娘。可惜不是我的类型。

source_text(原文): I told you: it got into my dreams once already. It's hard to get it out once it's in there, you know?
translation_zh(译文): 我跟你说过:它已经钻进过我的梦里一次了。一旦进了去,就很难把它赶出来,你懂吧?

source_text(原文): Not the friendliest, you know? But he's all right once you get to know him.
translation_zh(译文): 不算最友善,你知道吧?不过熟了之后他还行。

source_text(原文): He ran with the zazous, you know? In Paris, during the [[Enemy]] occupation.
translation_zh(译文): 他跟那群扎祖青年混过,你知道吧?在巴黎,敌人占领时期。

source_text(原文): Ask him about rue Pigalle some time. If he likes you, he might share some stories.
translation_zh(译文): 改天问问他皮加勒街的事。要是他喜欢你,也许会讲上几段故事。

source_text(原文): Maybe she likes 'em intellectual, or maybe she's one of those. Maybe both!
translation_zh(译文): 也许她喜欢斯文型的,又或者她是那种人。也许两者都是!

source_text(原文): We have a good laugh, though. Lovely girl...
translation_zh(译文): 不过我们处得很开心。多好的姑娘……

source_text(原文): You know. You take what you can get. Better than sleeping on the ground. Or in a barn. Or in a ditch waiting for the spidermist to get me. Or even the barracks back in Ghardaïa.
translation_zh(译文): 你知道的。有什么就凑合什么。总比睡在地上强。比睡在谷仓里强。也比躺在沟里等蜘蛛雾来收拾我强。甚至比加达亚军营里的日子强。

source_text(原文): Wish they'd put me back downstairs, though. I don't know how much more of this I can take.
translation_zh(译文): 不过,我倒希望他们把我调回楼下。我不知道自己还能撑多久。

source_text(原文): So it could be a lot worse. But I never know what's going on behind his eyes. You know what I mean.
translation_zh(译文): 所以说,本来还能糟得多。可我从不知道他那双眼睛后面藏着什么。你明白我的意思。

source_text(原文): It's true. Strathcoyne won't shut up about the [[Incorporate]] states. He's just waiting for his papers to come through. And I know Europe... well, Europe's on the way out. But when it goes, I'll be here to see it go.
translation_zh(译文): 千真万确。斯特拉斯科因整天念叨集团诸邦,没完没了。他正等着他的证件批下来。而我知道欧洲……嗯,欧洲气数将尽。可等它完了,我会亲眼看着它完。

source_text(原文): Brr! That's what you turn to thinking, when you spend all day in the dark.
translation_zh(译文): 咝!整天待在黑暗里,你就会开始想这些。

source_text(原文): Her name is [[Nina Lagasse]]... and I'm certain you'd remember her.
translation_zh(译文): 她的名字叫尼娜·拉加斯……而且我敢肯定你一定记得她。

source_text(原文): [Vincent shivers - though with what emotion is not immediately obvious.]
translation_zh(译文): [文森特打了个寒颤——至于那是出于何种情绪,一时还看不分明。]

source_text(原文): Lieutenant - Lieutenant [[Huissier]]! It's you, damn your eyes! [Vincent is grinning.]
translation_zh(译文): 中尉——韦西耶中尉!是你,真见鬼![文森特咧嘴笑着。]

source_text(原文): Actually - I'll talk to you later.

Vincent - Vincent Chraibi! In my Légion du Seuil days, we were posted together to watch the Bounds in Algeria. I remember that Vincent was a bit of a scoundrel. But a lot of us were scoundrels, in the Légion. And the two of us always got on.
translation_zh(译文): 文森特——文森特·沙莱比!我还在门关军团时,我们曾一同被派驻阿尔及利亚看守边界。我记得文森特有点无赖习气。但在军团里,无赖者大有人在。而且我们俩一直处得来。

source_text(原文): Come to think of it, I saved his leg.
translation_zh(译文): 说起来,我还救过他的腿。

source_text(原文): It's, ah... Hobson now. Spencer Hobson.
translation_zh(译文): 是,呃……如今是霍布森了。斯宾塞·霍布森。

source_text(原文): Call me Sylvain, Vincent. You're out of the Légion too.
translation_zh(译文): 叫我西尔万吧,文森特。你也离开军团了。
西尔万。好的,头儿。[文森特咯咯笑着。]

source_text(原文): Only bad in bad weather. So I stay on this side of the park, hey?
translation_zh(译文): 只有遇上坏天气才疼。所以我待在这公园的这一边,嗯?

source_text(原文): Huh. All right. I remember you talked in your sleep, in English.
translation_zh(译文): 嚯。行吧。我记得你说梦话,说的是英语。

source_text(原文): Weren't you dead? What are you doing here?
translation_zh(译文): 你不是死了吗?你在这儿做什么?

source_text(原文): Away. Is that likely to cause difficulties for you?
translation_zh(译文): 离开。这会给你带来麻烦吗?

source_text(原文): Wouldn't dream of it. I was going to offer my help. Want company?
translation_zh(译文): 想都不会想。我正想助你一臂之力。要个伴吗?

source_text(原文): Want company? I'll lend a hand with the flowers.
translation_zh(译文): 要个伴吗?我来帮你采花。

source_text(原文): All right. [Gain Vincent's positive Skill modifiers.]
translation_zh(译文): 好。[获得文森特的正面技艺修正。]

source_text(原文): Don't you want to know more about where I'm going, first?
translation_zh(译文): 你难道不想先多了解我要去哪儿吗?

source_text(原文): [Vincent has joined you as a companion, and will assist with Skill challenges where he can.]
translation_zh(译文): [文森特已成为你的同伴,会在力所能及处协助你应对技艺挑战。]

source_text(原文): Easily bored. You remember me. And there are people here I don't like so much.
translation_zh(译文): 容易无聊。你还记得我。而且这里有些我不太喜欢的人。

source_text(原文): Did Aubière put you up to this? Are you spying on me?
translation_zh(译文): 是奥比埃指使你的吗?你在监视我?

source_text(原文): It'll be dangerous, where I'm going.
translation_zh(译文): 我要去的地方会很危险。

source_text(原文): [Vincent guffaws.] My lieutenant - we were in the Légion!
translation_zh(译文): [文森特放声大笑。]我的中尉——我们可是在军团里待过的人!

source_text(原文): Are we going back to Algeria?
translation_zh(译文): 我们要回阿尔及利亚吗?

source_text(原文): Good. I don't want to go back to Algeria.
translation_zh(译文): 那就好。我可不想回阿尔及利亚。

source_text(原文): Oh, my friend, I only wish monsieur le docteur would pay me enough to spy on you.
translation_zh(译文): 哦,我的朋友,我倒希望那位医生先生付得起让我监视你的钱呢。

source_text(原文): All right. But call me Spencer. That's my name now. Spencer Hobson. [Gain Vincent's positive Skill modifiers.]
translation_zh(译文): 好。但叫我斯宾塞。这是我现在的名字。斯宾塞·霍布森。[获得文森特的正面技艺修正。]

source_text(原文): Vincent. Can I ask you some questions?
translation_zh(译文): 文森特。我能问你几个问题吗?
跟我说说斯特拉斯科因。

source_text(原文): Mathis and I started calling that arm of his 'Annabelle'. I don't know if he overheard us. I stay out of his way now, when I can.
translation_zh(译文): 我和马蒂斯开始把他那只胳膊叫作「安娜贝尔」。不知道他有没有偷听到。现在能躲我就躲着他走。

source_text(原文): Did I tell you? Mathis and I started calling that arm of his 'Annabelle'. I don't think he likes that.
translation_zh(译文): 我跟你说过吗?我和马蒂斯把他那只胳膊叫作「安娜贝尔」。我觉得他不喜欢这样。

source_text(原文): A wiry, handsome man. His eyes are hidden behind smoked-glass goggles, rather like something an arc-welder might wear.
translation_zh(译文): 一个精瘦英俊的男人。双眼藏在烟熏玻璃护目镜后面,像极了电焊工戴的那种东西。
我的心因惊惶而怦怦直跳。

source_text(原文): The night is entertained...where it can find its place in the shadowless sanitarium. It speculates how it would be if I were alone again.
translation_zh(译文): 夜色自得其乐……在无影的疗养院里,它也能寻到自己的位置。它揣想着,若我再度孤身一人,会是何种光景。

source_text(原文): Course you can. Once a Legionnaire, always a Legionnaire. 'Honneur et Humanité', remember?
translation_zh(译文): 当然可以。一日为军团兵,终身为军团兵。「荣誉与人性」,还记得吗?

source_text(原文): Oho! A woman? Bet it's a woman.
translation_zh(译文): 哦嚯!是个女人?我打赌是个女人。

source_text(原文): Yes. But it's not what you think.
translation_zh(译文): 没错。但不是你想的那样。

source_text(原文): Not dead, but not far off dead.
It's been rough, hasn't it? You see much action?
translation_zh(译文): 这些年不好过吧?见过不少大场面?

source_text(原文): Who is she, then? What is she to you?
translation_zh(译文): 那她是谁?她跟你有什么关系?

source_text(原文): Who is she to me? I've never met her. But her name is [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation_zh(译文): 她跟我有什么关系?我从未见过她。但她名叫尼娜·拉加斯。

source_text(原文): Yes. There's something I need from her.
translation_zh(译文): 是的。我有样东西要从她那儿得到。

source_text(原文): Yeah, she was here. Not long ago. Don't know where she went. I'll keep my ears open, though, chef. What I know, you'll know.
translation_zh(译文): 是啊,她来过这儿。没多久以前。不知道她去了哪儿。不过我会竖起耳朵听着的,头儿。我知道的,你都会知道。
你一听到任何风声,就来告诉我,好吗?

source_text(原文): I'm glad to find you here.
translation_zh(译文): 我很高兴在这儿遇见你。
当然。[文森特神情略显受伤。]

source_text(原文): Listen. Are you a visitor? Resident? Staff?
translation_zh(译文): 听着。你是访客?住客?还是工作人员?

source_text(原文): I think I'm a visitor. Aubière thinks I'm a resident.
translation_zh(译文): 我觉得我是访客。奥比埃觉得我是住客。

source_text(原文): I could be in a camp. Or lost to flowers. Or foundered in a pit of bones. [She gestures with her cigarette.] And so I think, this place is not so bad. Here's my advice. Be the good doctor's guest; and be my company in the sun.
translation_zh(译文): 我本可能待在营地里。或迷失于繁花。或沉没于骸骨之坑。[她拿香烟比了个手势。] 所以我想,这地方还不算太糟。这是我的忠告:当好医生的座上宾,也做我日光下的伴侣。

source_text(原文): The Plague of Leaves - but first the civil war. [[Icarians]] made a stronghold of our Epirus. I sang for them; so when the King's men took the city, it went hard for me.
translation_zh(译文): 叶疫——但在那之前,是内战。[[伊加利亚人]]把我们的伊庇鲁斯变成了据点。我曾为他们歌唱;所以当国王的人马攻陷城邦时,我便遭了殃。

source_text(原文): [She stubs her cigarette out, viciously, lights another.]
translation_zh(译文): [她狠狠掐灭香烟,又点上一支。]

source_text(原文): But Rodia's name has weight. I made my mark with battle-songs, you know? Against the [[Enemy]]. And I stayed free, when royalists were arresting [[Icarians]].
translation_zh(译文): 但罗迪娅的名字,是有分量的。我是靠战歌闯出的名头,你知道吗?对抗[[敌人]]的战歌。当保皇党人逮捕[[伊加利亚人]]时,我依然自由。

source_text(原文): A patriot first, then everything besides. Against the [[Enemy]], we had no help - except, that is, the Stars and [[Ministries]]. Our idiot King had fled, but now he thinks the throne is his to claim again, with British help -
translation_zh(译文): 先是爱国者,然后才是其他一切。对抗[[敌人]]之时,我们得不到任何援助——除了,也就是说,群星与[[联盟]]。我们那个蠢国王早就逃了;可如今,他以为有英国人撑腰,王位又可以由他认领了——

source_text(原文): Oh, pilgrim, look at what you've done to me. I'm talking politics - although I promised that I never would again. Another promise broken.
translation_zh(译文): 噢,巡礼者,看看你把我变成了什么样。我在谈政治——尽管我发过誓,再也不谈了。又一个誓言,被打破了。
希腊的事,先说到这里吧。

source_text(原文): Her eyes flicker to my dressing-gown; she looks faintly amused.
translation_zh(译文): 她的目光瞟向我的睡袍;她看起来,有几分忍俊不禁。

source_text(原文): Be careful, [[pilgrim]]! When a gentleman comes calling dressed like that - a lady might misunderstand his aims.
translation_zh(译文): 当心些,[[巡礼者]]!一位绅士,穿着那样登门拜访——女士可是会误解他的来意的。

source_text(原文): A new twist for our little exile knot! My name is Rodia; welcome to this house.
translation_zh(译文): 我们这流亡小圈子里来了新变化!我叫罗迪娅;欢迎来到这所房子。

source_text(原文): Rodia's smile becomes more sardonic. She raises her skirt a little.
translation_zh(译文): 罗迪娅的笑容更带讥诮。她稍稍撩起裙子。

source_text(原文): [Her calves are furred with mosses and spotted with lichens. Beneath that, her skin is glossy, but with dashed lines and bumps, like the bark of an olive tree. Her feet are bare: below her ankles, the effect is even more marked, and her flesh has begun to curl like roots.]
translation_zh(译文): [她的小腿覆着苔藓的绒毛,缀着地衣的斑点。底下,她的皮肤泛着光泽,却布满断线般的纹路和隆起,像橄榄树的树皮。她赤着脚:脚踝以下,那种变化更加明显,她的血肉已开始像根须一样卷曲。]

source_text(原文): Move even closer; bend down to examine her skin in detail.
translation_zh(译文): 再靠近些;俯下身,细细端详她的皮肤。

source_text(原文): The wood of the chair has begun to bow and twist yearningly towards the flesh of her legs... the magazine is also crinkled with green where her hand touches it.
translation_zh(译文): 椅子的木头已开始弯折扭转,渴望地朝她双腿的血肉倾去……她手触到的那本杂志也泛起绿意,起了皱褶。

source_text(原文): The wood of the chair has begun to bow and twist yearningly towards the flesh of her legs.
translation_zh(译文): 椅子的木头已开始弯折扭转,渴望地朝她双腿的血肉倾去。

source_text(原文): The other hand, however, the one holding her cigarette, is almost clear of greenery.
translation_zh(译文): 然而,另一只手——夹着香烟的那只——几乎不见草木滋生。

source_text(原文): My little vice protects me, so it seems. Tobacco's poisons - so our doctor says - purge animalcules from my tainted skin... and we all know the deep wood fears the fire.
translation_zh(译文): 我这点小恶习,似乎护住了我。烟草的毒素——我们那位医生说的——能从我受染的皮肤上清除微生物……而众所周知,深林畏火。

source_text(原文): The looking first; perhaps the listening next? One question is enough.
translation_zh(译文): 先是打量;接下来,兴许是聆听?一个问题,足矣。

source_text(原文): My pilgrim. When a lady's seen the dawn, she's earned the right not to be questioned in on the dew. D'you follow me?
translation_zh(译文): 我的巡礼者。一位女士既已见过黎明,便有资格不被盘问晨露之事。你明白我的意思吗?

source_text(原文): The Plague of Leaves: it came to Epirus. It took the streets, the churches, then our flesh. We fled in sorrow, or we joined the green. But some of us did not leave when we might.
translation_zh(译文): 叶疫:它降临伊庇鲁斯。它夺走街道、教堂,然后是我们的血肉。我们或含悲逃离,或融入那片绿意。但我们之中有些人,本该离开时却没有走。

source_text(原文): Come in, my [[pilgrim]]; let's hear all your news.
translation_zh(译文): 进来吧,我的[[巡礼者]];让我们听听你所有的见闻。

source_text(原文): The Plague of Leaves? Perhaps. But none has yet. In Epirus, its spores are precious in our flesh. But here, they do not make their homes in us.
translation_zh(译文): 叶疫?也许吧。但至今还没有人染上。在伊庇鲁斯,它的孢子在我们血肉中弥足珍贵。但在这里,它们不会在我们体内安家。

source_text(原文): The Plague of Leaves? A little. When I rise. No wood is quite so pliable as flesh. And so I rarely venture from this room. My view is charming, but I tire of it. And so I greet all visitors as friends. Even the ones like Fraser and his pet.
translation_zh(译文): 叶疫?有一点。在我起身的时候。没有哪种木头,像血肉这般柔韧。所以我很少离开这间屋子。窗景迷人,可我也看腻了。因此,我把所有访客都当作朋友。连弗雷泽和他那只「宠物」也不例外。
你不喜欢斯特拉斯科因?

source_text(原文): Why don't you tell me some diverting thing?
translation_zh(译文): 你何不跟我讲讲,什么解闷的事?

source_text(原文): [A look of clear disappointment flashes across Rodia's face, before she composes herself.]
translation_zh(译文): [罗迪娅脸上掠过一抹明显的失望,随即,她收拾起神色。]

source_text(原文): Madame Rodia. A pleasure to make your acquaintance. My name is Spencer Hobson.
translation_zh(译文): 罗迪娅夫人。很高兴认识您。我是斯宾塞·霍布森。

source_text(原文): Not all of Europe's gentlemen are dead.
translation_zh(译文): 看来,欧洲的绅士还没有死绝。

source_text(原文): Spencer's an English name. You're far from home.
translation_zh(译文): 斯宾塞是个英国名字。你离家很远。

source_text(原文): A Greek name. I half-remember the word... rose? Pomegranate? Possibly?
translation_zh(译文): 一个希腊名字。我依稀记得那个词……玫瑰?石榴?也许吧?

source_text(原文): A woman in green. In this part of the world, they would say she is 'between two ages.' Her eyes are steady; perhaps a little cynical; not obviously unkind.
translation_zh(译文): 一位身着绿衣的女人。在这一带,人们会说她「介于两个年纪之间」。她的目光沉静;或许有几分世故;但并不明显刻薄。

source_text(原文): Yes, those were mine, it's true. But very old now - fifteen years, I think. You will not judge me by my early songs?
translation_zh(译文): 是的,那些确实是我的。但已是很久以前了——我想,有十五年了。你不会以我早年的歌来评判我吧?

source_text(原文): [Rodia shrugs; draws on her cigarette until the end brightens.]
translation_zh(译文): [罗迪娅耸耸肩;吸了一口烟,直到烟头亮起。]

source_text(原文): I've been away from Europe almost all that time. I didn't know you'd recorded anything else.
translation_zh(译文): 那段时间,我几乎一直不在欧洲。我不知道你还录过别的歌。

source_text(原文): They were lovely. I'd like to hear more.
translation_zh(译文): 它们很美。我想多听一些。

source_text(原文): How did you come to Antibes?
translation_zh(译文): 你是怎么来到昂蒂布的?

source_text(原文): Do excuse me, Rodia. I have to go.
translation_zh(译文): 请原谅,罗迪娅。我得走了。

source_text(原文): Reluctantly. My Mimis, and myself - in Epirus we made our home, and there his bones remain. Poor Epirus has fallen to a double scourge. The doctor offered help with my condition, when I fled the city's fall.
translation_zh(译文): 说来勉强。我的米米斯与我——我们在伊庇鲁斯安了家,他的骸骨至今留在那里。可怜的伊庇鲁斯,遭了双重灾祸。我逃离城陷之时,医生主动提出,愿意帮我诊治我的病症。

source_text(原文): I'm sorry, I didn't mean to be impertinent. It was a botanical enquiry.
translation_zh(译文): 抱歉,我无意冒犯。那只是一次植物学上的探询。

source_text(原文): I'm sorry, I didn't mean to be crude. I wondered if there were benefits to your condition - rejuvenations.
translation_zh(译文): 抱歉,我无意粗鲁。我只是在想,你的病症是否也有好处——比如返老还童。

source_text(原文): I'm sorry - sometimes, when a gentleman is dazzled by beauty, he fumbles his manners.
translation_zh(译文): 抱歉——有时候,绅士被美色晃了眼,便会乱了礼数。

source_text(原文): I don't have time to fence with you, Rodia. Tell me or not.
translation_zh(译文): 我没工夫与你周旋,罗迪娅。你说也罢,不说也罢。

source_text(原文): Then no. The Plague of Leaves was known to gift its sufferers so, in Epirus. It has been called the Plague of Flowers too. But Rodia left not quite too late, and so she has no flowers.
translation_zh(译文): 那么,没有。在伊庇鲁斯,据说叶疫正是这样恩赐染病之人的。它也曾被称作花疫。但罗迪娅离开得不算太迟,所以,她身上没有花。

source_text(原文): Then no. We whom the Plague of Leaves has touched are ripe - but not in any human sense. In Epirus one saw the bodies sprouting in the streets. But none bore children.
translation_zh(译文): 那么,没有。我们这些被叶疫触碰过的人,已然成熟——但绝不是人类意义上的成熟。在伊庇鲁斯,人们曾看见街上的躯体萌出新芽。但没有人怀上子嗣。

source_text(原文): You're looking for my favour? Well, it's yours. And to your question - I was not among the unfortunate fruiting few, in Epirus. The Plague of Leaves still spared me that.
translation_zh(译文): 你在求我的垂青?好吧,它归你了。至于你的问题——在伊庇鲁斯,我不在那些不幸结果的少数人之中。叶疫好歹,没让我遭那一桩。

source_text(原文): Then no. In Epirus one saw that sometimes. But Rodia, no.
translation_zh(译文): 那么,没有。在伊庇鲁斯,有时也能见到那样的事。但罗迪娅,没有。

source_text(原文): Always. But now a subject of the doctor's realm.
translation_zh(译文): 一向如此。不过如今,你是医生辖下的子民了。

source_text(原文): Entice me, pilgrim. What's your special curse?
translation_zh(译文): 引我好奇吧,巡礼者。你背负着什么特别的诅咒?

source_text(原文): I was hollowed out by [[Worms]]. Although now I'm recovering.
translation_zh(译文): 我曾被[[蠕虫]]掏空。不过如今,正在恢复。

source_text(原文): My heart is not quite the one I was born with.
translation_zh(译文): 我的心,已不是生来的那颗。

source_text(原文): I spent a decade outside the world. I'm not who I used to be. I don't know exactly who I am now. Not yet.
translation_zh(译文): 我在世界之外度过了十年。我已不是昔日的我。我也不清楚,自己如今究竟是谁。还没有。

source_text(原文): [Rodia frowns, stubs out her cigarette, lights another.] I don't know what that means. Although it doesn't sound like any state I'd choose.
translation_zh(译文): [罗迪娅皱起眉头,掐灭香烟,又点上一支。] 我不知道那是什么意思。虽说,那听上去不像是我会选择的任何状态。

source_text(原文): [Flattery] I came here for a trivial reason. Now I've met you, I have a much better one.
translation_zh(译文): [恭维] 我来这里,本是为了一件微不足道的小事。如今遇见了你,我便有了好得多的理由。

source_text(原文): [Rodia tilts her head.] This widow's heart, my pilgrim, is all stone. But still the gallantries are sweet.
translation_zh(译文): [罗迪娅侧了侧头。] 这颗寡妇的心,我的巡礼者,是石头做的。不过,恭维话依然中听。

source_text(原文): [Spontaneity] I came here for a trivial reason. Now I've met you, I have a much better one.
translation_zh(译文): [率直] 我来这里,本是为了一件微不足道的小事。如今遇见了你,我便有了好得多的理由。

source_text(原文): "My heart is not my own." I've heard that phrase. But, pilgrim, you mean something different, yes? I thank you.
translation_zh(译文): 「我的心已不是我自己的。」我听过这句话。但,巡礼者,你说的不是那个意思,对吧?我谢谢你。

source_text(原文): If you had spent the last ten in the world - I can't say if you'd understand much more. We all of us have changed.
translation_zh(译文): 就算你在世间度过这十年——我也说不上,你会多明白几分。我们全都变了。

source_text(原文): I find him churlish. And his arm revolts me. There; it's said.
translation_zh(译文): 我觉得他粗鲁。他的胳膊,令我作呕。好了,说出来了。

source_text(原文): You've met that toothsome Mathis. He's the one that calls it 'Annabelle' - the arm. But don't tell Fraser - for I swear the man is humourless as beef.
translation_zh(译文): 你见过那位讨喜的马蒂斯了。就是他,管那条胳膊叫「安娜贝尔」。但别告诉弗雷泽——我敢发誓,那人无趣得像块牛肉。

source_text(原文): I wonder if you mean your heart has imposed upon you? Sometimes I think that Strathcoyne's arm must be an imposition. But I find you more appealing than that man.
translation_zh(译文): 我在想,你的意思是不是说,你的心强加于你?有时我觉得,斯特拉斯科因的胳膊,想必也是一种强加。不过,你比那个人讨人喜欢得多。

source_text(原文): (I thought I'd locked the door. That's odd. But never mind.)
translation_zh(译文): (我以为我锁了门。真奇怪。不过,算了。)

source_text(原文): I'm looking for a woman who was here in the Sanitarium. [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation_zh(译文): 我在找一个女人,她曾在这家疗养院里住过。[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。

source_text(原文): A man who seeks a woman always wears a certain air. It's one I know, too well.
translation_zh(译文): 一个寻找女人的男人,总带着某种神色。那种神色,我认得,太熟了。

source_text(原文): What is wrong with you, exactly? Can I catch it from you?
translation_zh(译文): 你到底怎么了?会传染吗?

source_text(原文): Yes, I knew Nina. What was she to you?
translation_zh(译文): 是的,我认识尼娜。她与你,是什么关系?

source_text(原文): [Truth] I still haven't really thought about it.
translation_zh(译文): [真话] 我其实,还没好好想过这件事。

source_text(原文): Your heart, you say? But not the heart you carried at your birth?
translation_zh(译文): 你说你的心?但不是你出生时带着的那颗?

source_text(原文): The heart's a well of truths. I sang that once. Better in Greek.
translation_zh(译文): 心是真理之井。我唱过这一句。用希腊语唱,更妙。

source_text(原文): I wish you every chance. But Nina's gone. I liked her, but I never trusted her. So smooth; so bright; so sharp. I don't know what she sought, here in Antibes. She said once that the sun sets here; but yet I do not think she liked to watch it set.
translation_zh(译文): 我祝你一切顺利。但尼娜已经走了。我喜欢她,却从不信任她。那么圆滑;那么明艳;那么锋利。我不知道她在昂蒂布寻求什么。她曾说过,太阳在这里落下;可我觉得,她并不喜欢看它落下。

source_text(原文): A mystery, then. I've always liked them.
translation_zh(译文): 那么,是个谜。我一向喜欢谜。

source_text(原文): [Move closer; look at the skin of her legs.]
I know what I said. Don't confuse me. She's just as bad, anyway.
translation_zh(译文): 我知道我说了什么。别来搅乱我。反正她也一样坏。

source_text(原文): So? Have you dealt with Philomèle?
translation_zh(译文): 怎么样？菲洛梅尔的事办妥了吗？

source_text(原文): [You could use a Wither item to this end. It could bring this Philomèle nightmares and bad fortune - sicken and immiserate her. It wouldn't kill her unless she's very weak. But it wouldn't be very nice.]
translation_zh(译文): [你可以用一件凋零之物来达成此事。它能给这个菲洛梅尔带来噩梦与厄运——令她染病、陷入困顿。除非她虚弱至极，否则不会要她的命。但这终究算不上光彩。]

source_text(原文): [That said, you're not in the Suppression Bureau any more. You need to find Nina. You could use the money.]
translation_zh(译文): [话说回来，你已不在防剿局了。你得找到尼娜。这笔钱你用得着。]

source_text(原文): [And it might be possible to convince Zèlia that you've cursed her enemy, even if you haven't.]
translation_zh(译文): [而且，即便你并没有真的诅咒她的敌人，也或许有可能让泽莉亚相信你已经下了咒。]

source_text(原文): She is unpardonable! A traitor, a slut, a defiler of husbands. Moral filth.
translation_zh(译文): 她不可饶恕！一个叛徒，一个荡妇，一个玷污人夫的东西。道德上的污秽。

source_text(原文): But that is not your concern.
Keep it secret. I am a woman of importance. No-one reputable will believe you.
translation_zh(译文): 保密。我是一位有身份的女人。没有哪个体面人会相信你。

source_text(原文): No. This business is beneath me.
translation_zh(译文): 不。这种事有失我的身份。

source_text(原文): I give you now one-half the sum we agreed. The rest on your return. Go quickly.
translation_zh(译文): 我现在付你约定数目的一半。余下的等你回来再付。快去吧。

source_text(原文): Do you take me for an imbecile? Your lies insult us both. Go!
translation_zh(译文): 你把我当傻子吗？你的谎言侮辱了我们两个。滚！

source_text(原文): This is what I require of you.
I have been thinking about the matter, Madame Zèlia...
translation_zh(译文): 泽莉亚夫人，我一直在考虑这件事……

source_text(原文): Have you dealt with that sow Cornéline?
translation_zh(译文): 那头母猪科尔内利娜的事，办妥了吗？

source_text(原文): She closes her eyes for a moment, in pain or exultation.
translation_zh(译文): 她闭上了一会儿眼睛，不知是痛苦还是狂喜。

source_text(原文): [Her eyes glitter; her hands open and close.]
translation_zh(译文): [她眼中闪闪发光；双手张开又合拢。]

source_text(原文): Here. The rest of your payment.
One more thing. I'm looking for a woman named [[Nina Lagasse]]...
translation_zh(译文): 还有一件事。我在找一个叫[[尼娜·拉加斯]]的女人……

source_text(原文): She was seen to enter the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui. An American woman built it, before the wars. New money. Worthless. Such things went on behind the gates! And now it is worse. Burn it to the ground for all I care.
translation_zh(译文): 有人看见她进了今日疗养院。战前，一个美国女人建了它。暴发户，一文不值。那大门后面什么龌龊事没有！如今更是不堪。就算把它烧成平地我也不在乎。

source_text(原文): Where can I find the Sanitarium?
translation_zh(译文): 我在哪儿能找到这家疗养院？

source_text(原文): Go back and climb the steps. Follow the road out of town, past the park, into the Cap.
translation_zh(译文): 往回走，爬上那些台阶。顺着出城的路走，经过公园，进入昂蒂布角。

source_text(原文): You must. I will suffer this woman no longer.
translation_zh(译文): 你必须办。我再也忍受不了那个女人。

source_text(原文): My husband is gone. Find him for me.
translation_zh(译文): 我的丈夫不见了。替我找到他。

source_text(原文): I laid the curse on Philomèle. Not on Griotte.
translation_zh(译文): 我把诅咒施在了菲洛梅尔身上。不是格里奥特。

source_text(原文): North. East. How would I know? I am no detective. If I knew, I would not ask your help.
translation_zh(译文): 北边。东边。我怎么会知道？我又不是侦探。我若知道，就不会请你帮忙了。

source_text(原文): Yes, yes, I know, of course. I'm not a fool. They're all the same anyway, these sluts.
translation_zh(译文): 是是，我当然知道。我不是傻瓜。反正这些贱人都一个样。

source_text(原文): I have no pictures. And it was years ago now. Years. He will be different. Only mention my name. Zèlia. He'll remember me.
translation_zh(译文): 我没有照片。而且那是多年前的事了。许多年前。他会变样。你只需提起我的名字。泽莉亚。他会记得我的。

source_text(原文): But how will I know him?
Is he tall? Short? How old?
translation_zh(译文): 他个子高吗？矮？多大年纪？

source_text(原文): Very tall, very distinguished. A real gentleman. Of course you will know him at once.
translation_zh(译文): 很高，很体面。一位真正的绅士。你自然一眼就能认出他。

source_text(原文): No. This is none of my business.
It doesn't matter, his name. Names muddle me. Will you find him?
translation_zh(译文): 他的名字，无关紧要。名字让我犯糊涂。你会找到他吗？

source_text(原文): No charge. And no promises. But I will do what I can.
translation_zh(译文): 分文不取。也不作保证。但我尽力而为。

source_text(原文): I miss him, signaire. I loved him so. Even now I will forgive him.
translation_zh(译文): 我想他，符师。我那样爱他。即便是现在，我也愿原谅他。

source_text(原文): Not yet. I'll return when I do.
translation_zh(译文): 还没有。找到他我就回来。

source_text(原文): I... said already that was not something I would do for you.
translation_zh(译文): 我……已经说过，那件事我不会替你做的。

source_text(原文): I am so grateful, monsieur. I will always remember you in my prayers.
translation_zh(译文): 我感激不尽，先生。我会永远在祈祷中记着你。

source_text(原文): I... said already that was not something I would do for you. You became very angry. You don't remember?
translation_zh(译文): 我……已经说过，那件事我不会替你做的。你当时非常生气。你不记得了？

source_text(原文): You are a decent man. I place my trust in your decency.
translation_zh(译文): 你是个正派人。我把信任托付给你的正直。

source_text(原文): For just a moment, she wavers.
He'll remember me now. He was weak; he was stupid. But I'll forgive him, when he comes back to me.
translation_zh(译文): 他现在会记得我了。他曾软弱，他曾愚蠢。但等他回到我身边，我会原谅他。

source_text(原文): But you punished her. She'll grow ugly.
translation_zh(译文): 可你惩罚了她。她会变丑的。

source_text(原文): There's a kind of smoothness in her eyes, like water flowing behind a pane of glass. For a moment it is as if she's forgotten who I am.
translation_zh(译文): 她眼底透着一种平滑，像水在玻璃板后流动。有那么一刻，仿佛她已经忘了我是什么人。

source_text(原文): Yes, no, yes... it never works. It is never any good at all. Should know better by now. You are right, monsieur, of course you are right...
translation_zh(译文): 是，不，是……从来都不管用。从来都毫无用处。早该明白的。您说得对，先生，您当然说得对……

source_text(原文): And then she's lost in her thoughts, lips moving slightly.
translation_zh(译文): 然后她便沉入自己的思绪，嘴唇微微翕动。

source_text(原文): Wait. Please! I need your help. Something else.
translation_zh(译文): 等等。求你了！我需要你的帮助。是别的事。

source_text(原文): I'm looking for someone too. A woman. [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation_zh(译文): 我也在找一个人。一个女人。[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。

source_text(原文): Of course, yes, I know. She's in that stupid Sanitarium. Past the park, out of town, in the Cap.
translation_zh(译文): 当然，是，我知道。她在那家蠢透了的疗养院里。过了公园，出城，在昂蒂布角。

source_text(原文): You're sitting very close to those... holes.
translation_zh(译文): 你坐得离那些……洞太近了。

source_text(原文): I am not. And there are no holes. And the matter is in any case irrelevant.
translation_zh(译文): 我才没有。而且也没有洞。此事无论如何都无关紧要。

source_text(原文): And after consideration... I refuse it still.
translation_zh(译文): 再三考虑之后……我仍然拒绝。

source_text(原文): It's difficult to overstate the contempt with which Zèlia pronounces the word 'actress'.
translation_zh(译文): 泽莉亚吐出“女演员”这个词时的那种轻蔑，怎么形容都不为过。

source_text(原文): I have the skills to create a Withering item - if I want.
translation_zh(译文): 我有能力制作一件凋零之物——只要我愿意。

source_text(原文): I don't currently have the skills to create a Withering item. I could increase one of [[Hushery]], [[Nyctodromy]] or [[Skolekosophy]] to 5; I could try to trick Zèlia; or I could abandon the whole sorry business.
translation_zh(译文): 我目前还没有能力制作凋零之物。我可以把[[静默术]]、[[夜游术]]或[[蠕虫学]]之一提升到 5；我可以试着骗过泽莉亚；也可以干脆丢开这桩倒霉的差事。

source_text(原文): His business, like others who came to Brancrug, was healing and warding. And he didn't take payment in cash - only services. The ones who took cash payment, the mascs, were exactly the ones he was brought in to defend against.
translation_zh(译文): 他的营生,和别的来布兰库格的人一样,是治病和驱邪。他不收现钱——只收服务。而那些收现钱的,那些巫师,正是他被请来防备的。

source_text(原文): Thirty years ago in Brancrug, I met a man who called himself a signaire. Not a true adept - but he knew some tricks. Enough to break the laws of the world and the Church, doing little works among the people.
translation_zh(译文): 三十年前,在布兰库格,我遇见一个自称符师的人。算不上真正的修士——但他会些门道。足以违犯尘世与教会的律法,在百姓中间做些小小的法术。

source_text(原文): You are not the one I summoned. The signaire. Go away from here.
translation_zh(译文): 你不是我召来的那位。符师。离开这里。

source_text(原文): Why then are you even here?
translation_zh(译文): 那你到底为什么在这里?

source_text(原文): There is a café on the square, near the fountain and the flag. Every day she goes there. Philomèle! Blight her! Punish her!
translation_zh(译文): 广场上有一家咖啡馆,挨着喷泉和旗杆。她每天都要去。菲洛梅尔!降祸于她!惩罚她!

source_text(原文): No. Turn back, Zèlia. This will twist your soul.
translation_zh(译文): 不。回头吧,泽莉亚。这会让你的灵魂扭曲。

source_text(原文): Don't lecture me. You small-minded man. Don't lecture me. You know nothing of a woman's pain.
translation_zh(译文): 别对我说教。你这个小心眼的男人。别对我说教。你根本不懂一个女人的痛。

source_text(原文): You are not the one I called.
You are the signaire? I am Zèlia. Do not ask my family's name.
translation_zh(译文): 你就是符师?我是泽莉亚。不要问我娘家的姓氏。

source_text(原文): A friend of mine - a southern woman - used to dance at the Ecdysis Club in London. When her heart was broken, she set out to revenge herself. She told me that she had buried a songbird's heart at the dark of a moon, to call for the red help she wanted.
translation_zh(译文): 我的一位朋友——南方女子——曾在伦敦的蜕皮俱乐部跳舞。心碎之后,她决意报复。她告诉我,她在月暗之夜埋下一只歌鸟的心,以召来她想要的红色援手。

source_text(原文): She had owned that songbird almost a year. I recall that she had to crush its throat and cut its heart out with a pocket-knife. To prove her conviction - or perhaps only because the one she called was one who liked that kind of thing.
translation_zh(译文): 那只歌鸟,她养了将近一年。我记得,她得先捏碎它的喉咙,再用小刀剜出它的心脏。为了证明自己的信念——又或许只是因为,她召来的那位,偏偏喜欢这种东西。

source_text(原文): What kind of work is this, madame? Is it, after all, a signaire that you want?
translation_zh(译文): 这是什么活计,夫人?说到底,你要的是一位符师吧?

source_text(原文): Call yourself what you will. Are you ready for the work?
translation_zh(译文): 随你自称什么。你准备好干活了吗?

source_text(原文): Then go. Go! And tell no-one. I am a woman of good reputation and your slanders will not touch me.
translation_zh(译文): 那就走。走!不许告诉任何人。我是名声清白的女人,你的诽谤伤不到我。

source_text(原文): You'll consider it? Consider it quickly. I have told you what I want. And how I will reward you.
translation_zh(译文): 你会考虑?那就快点考虑。我已经告诉你我要什么了,也告诉你我会怎么酬谢你。

source_text(原文): You refused the trabai. Why are you buzzing again in my ear?
translation_zh(译文): 你拒绝了那桩差事。为什么又在我耳边嗡嗡作响?

source_text(原文): Am I not? You buried the heart. I am here. I wished only to assure myself you were not frivolous. The earth shivers. The sky will be blood.
translation_zh(译文): 我不是吗?你埋了那颗心。我来了。我只是想确认你不是个轻浮的人。大地颤抖。天空将染成血色。

source_text(原文): Perhaps not. But may I speak with you?
translation_zh(译文): 也许不是。但我能与你说几句话吗?

source_text(原文): I have wasted enough words with you. Go.
translation_zh(译文): 我跟你白费的话已经够多了。走。

source_text(原文): I have not. I'll return when I have.
translation_zh(译文): 我可没白费够。等白费够了,我再回来。

source_text(原文): I've done as you asked. Listen; soon you will hear the news of her illness.
translation_zh(译文): 我照你说的办了。听着:很快你就会听到她生病的消息。

source_text(原文): [Deception] I've done as you asked. Her dreams tonight will be the first of many miseries.
translation_zh(译文): [欺骗] 我照你说的办了。她今晚的梦,将是日后许多苦难的开端。

source_text(原文): Yes. Yes. I only wish I could see her when the pain begins.
translation_zh(译文): 好。好。我只盼疼痛开始的时候,我能亲眼看着她。

source_text(原文): I don't believe you. Bring me proof. I will not be gulled by a mountebank.
translation_zh(译文): 我不信你。拿证据来。我不会被个江湖骗子蒙骗。

source_text(原文): I'm looking for a woman named [[Nina Lagasse]]...
translation_zh(译文): 我在找一个名叫[[尼娜·拉加斯]]的女人……

source_text(原文): Lagasse? Oh yes, I know about this Lagasse. When we've finished our business, we will speak of her.
translation_zh(译文): 拉加斯?哦当然,我知道这个拉加斯。等我们的事办完,再谈她。

source_text(原文): Seek her in hell for all I care. Go.
translation_zh(译文): 随你去地狱找她,与我无关。走。

source_text(原文): I need to find a woman called [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation_zh(译文): 我要找一个名叫[[尼娜·拉加斯]]的女人。

source_text(原文): You said. Stop wasting my time. The trabai first.
translation_zh(译文): 你说过了。别再浪费我的时间。差事要紧。

source_text(原文): I know the name. We can discuss that when our business is done.
translation_zh(译文): 我听过这个名字。等正事办完,再谈这个。

source_text(原文): One more thing. We were to discuss [[Nina Lagasse]] when our business was done.
translation_zh(译文): 还有一件事。我们说好,正事办完要谈[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。

source_text(原文): Oh yes. She is so full of herself, that Lagasse. And an actress!
translation_zh(译文): 哦,没错。那个拉加斯,可真是自以为了不起。还是个女演员!

source_text(原文): Wait! I have one more task for you.
translation_zh(译文): 等等!我还有一件事要交给你办。

source_text(原文): I am ready to carry out your trabai.
translation_zh(译文): 我已准备好办你的差事。

source_text(原文): How much will you pay me?
That pétasse Griotte stole him. Took him to another city.
translation_zh(译文): 那个骚货格里奥特把他偷走了。带去了另一座城。

source_text(原文): You are a signaire. You should know how these things are done. Tell him my name.
translation_zh(译文): 你是个符师。这种事的门道,你该明白。告诉他我的名字。

source_text(原文): With regret, madame, I decline your offer.
translation_zh(译文): 很遗憾,夫人,我回绝您的差遣。

source_text(原文): Then I curse you! I curse your name and your shadow! Leave me alone! Never return!
translation_zh(译文): 那我就诅咒你!我诅咒你的名字,诅咒你的影子!别再来烦我!永远别回来!

source_text(原文): Oh, please, monsieur, please, if you change your mind, return to me. I beg you. I miss him so.
translation_zh(译文): 哦,求求您,先生,求求您,要是您改了主意,就回来找我。我求您了。我太想他了。

source_text(原文): Yes. Yes! It is a pact now. Our pact.
translation_zh(译文): 好。好!如今这便是约定了。我们的约定。

source_text(原文): I buried the heart. I have been waiting. Four hundred francisques for your trabai.
translation_zh(译文): 我埋了那颗心。我一直在等。你的差事,值四百枚法兰西斧币。

source_text(原文): She tosses her head. Her eyes are like flecks of beach-glass.
translation_zh(译文): 她一甩头。她的眼睛像是海滩玻璃的碎屑。

source_text(原文): Go away. I will not speak with you.
The heart of a pet? Did you take its life with your own hands?
translation_zh(译文): 一只宠物的心?是你亲手取了它的性命?

source_text(原文): I did not enjoy it. We will speak of it no more.
translation_zh(译文): 我并不喜欢那样。此事我们不再提起。

source_text(原文): You wanted me to punish Philomèle. But you said 'Cornéline' just now.
translation_zh(译文): 你要我惩罚的是菲洛梅尔。可你方才说的是“科尔内利娜”。

source_text(原文): [Indicate her cigarette] Could you spare one of those?
translation_zh(译文): [指指她的香烟]「能匀我一支吗?」
「差不多是我的最后一支了。抱歉。」

source_text(原文): One should not smoke in here. It is bad for the books.
[She angles the open pack towards me. Gitanes.]
translation_zh(译文): [她把打开的烟盒朝我斜过来。吉坦。]

source_text(原文): This is a bookshop. Reach for a quotation.
translation_zh(译文): 这里是书店。那就伸手摘一句引文吧。

source_text(原文): The bookseller rolls her eyes, very slightly.
translation_zh(译文): [女书商极其轻微地翻了个白眼。]

source_text(原文): My memory is cobwebbed. But a war memorial inscription comes to mind.
translation_zh(译文): 我的记忆里蛛网丛生。但一句战争纪念碑上的铭文,浮上了心头。

source_text(原文): 'Blessed are those who died in earth incarnate.'
translation_zh(译文): 「“那些死于大地化身之中的人,有福了。”」

source_text(原文): 'In loving one now dead, we arrive pure at the glaciers of memory. We are fortified for life...'
translation_zh(译文): 「“爱一个如今已死的人,我们便能纯净地抵达回忆的冰川。我们由此为一生筑起壁垒……”」

source_text(原文): The bookseller starts, then moves to cover the start by stubbing out her cigarette.
translation_zh(译文): 女书商吃了一惊,随即借着掐灭香烟,把这一惊掩饰了过去。

source_text(原文): Poets! The State, perhaps, is wise to lock them up.
translation_zh(译文): 「诗人!邦国把他们关起来,或许倒真是明智。」

source_text(原文): She lights another cigarette, eyes glittering until she wipes them with the back of her hand.
translation_zh(译文): 她又点起一支烟,眼睛亮闪闪的,直到她用手背把它们抹掉。

source_text(原文): Well, if there's something you want, I am here.
translation_zh(译文): 「那么,如果您想要点什么,我就在这里。」
「……有没有斯宾塞·霍布森写的书?」

source_text(原文): The Sheaf, from today. An excellent State paper.
translation_zh(译文): 「禾捆报,今天的。一份极好的邦国报纸。」

source_text(原文): [I have my funds tucked away somewhere safe...]
translation_zh(译文): [我的钱,藏在某个安全的地方……]

source_text(原文): I don't think... wait, no, I remember the name. Here...
translation_zh(译文): 「我不太记得……等等,不,我记得这个名字。在这儿……」

source_text(原文): I must warn you: this is a bad book. A very bad book.
translation_zh(译文): 我必须提醒您:这是一本坏书。一本非常坏的书。

source_text(原文): (I wrote five of these things. Pseudonymously. They sold much better than my real work.)
translation_zh(译文): (这样的东西,我写过五本。用的是笔名。它们比我署真名的作品卖得好多了。)

source_text(原文): (In fact they merited French and German translations. I had forgotten that the French and German publishers published them under the Hobson name.)
translation_zh(译文): (其实它们还出过法语和德语译本。我忘了——法德两国的出版商,是挂在霍布森名下出版的。)

source_text(原文): A very bad book? Never mind, then.
translation_zh(译文): 一本非常坏的书?那就算了。

source_text(原文): It's a little overwritten, I grant you, but the plotting is quite ingenious...
translation_zh(译文): 我承认,是写得有点过,但情节相当巧妙……

source_text(原文): Oh, you've read it? My condolences.
Five francisques? Let us say four. I am an honest woman.
translation_zh(译文): 五枚法兰西斧币?那就四枚吧。我是个诚实的女人。

source_text(原文): I appreciate your generosity. And your courage.
translation_zh(译文): 多谢您的慷慨。也多谢您的勇气。

source_text(原文): ...that Hobson book? 'The Blood in the Belfry'?
(The only play of mine ever published. Illopoly pulled some strings.)
translation_zh(译文): (我唯一出版过的剧本。伊洛波利使了些手段。)

source_text(原文): It is too mystical for me. And the translation is I think quite poor. But the dreams linger, with this one.
translation_zh(译文): 对我来说,它太过玄奥。至于译文,我觉得相当糟糕。但这一本,读后梦会久久萦绕。

source_text(原文): (They would. I made unwisely unambiguous references to the invisible world. The [[Bureau]] shut down the production on opening night. I was lucky to stay out of prison.)
translation_zh(译文): (确实会。我轻率地、毫不隐晦地写了隐世。首演之夜,[[防剿局]]查封了演出。我侥幸没进监狱。)

source_text(原文): I thought they'd pulped every copy...
translation_zh(译文): 我以为他们把每一本都打成纸浆了……

source_text(原文): I suspect it's too mystical for me, also. Let's talk about something else.
translation_zh(译文): 我猜,对我来说它也太过玄奥。我们聊点别的吧。

source_text(原文): Fifty francisques. It is difficult to find, this one.
translation_zh(译文): 五十枚法兰西斧币。这一本,可不好找。

source_text(原文): [Take a cigarette from the packet.] Light?
translation_zh(译文): [从烟盒里取出一支烟。]有火吗?
唉。我最后一根火柴,已经用完了。

source_text(原文): [The bookseller rests her chin on her fist and watches me. Blue smoke curls up from the cigarette in her mouth.]
translation_zh(译文): [女书商把下巴支在拳头上,端详着我。她叼在嘴里的香烟,升起袅袅蓝烟。]

source_text(原文): [Place the other cigarette in my own mouth. Lean in and light it from hers.]
translation_zh(译文): [我把另一支烟叼进自己嘴里,俯身凑过去,就着她的烟点燃。]

source_text(原文): Linou from the café suggested I talk to you. She told me you have a quieter business even than book-selling.
translation_zh(译文): 「咖啡馆的利努建议我来找您。她说,您有一桩比卖书更安静的生意。」

source_text(原文): [Place the cigarette on the counter.] Thank you anyway.
translation_zh(译文): [把烟放到柜台上。]总之,谢谢您。

source_text(原文): [A wink of blue flame as the dark tobacco ignites.]
I regret: we sell only books here.
translation_zh(译文): 很遗憾:我们这里只卖书。

source_text(原文): [Lie] She's an old friend. I heard she'd come here, to Antibes.
translation_zh(译文): [撒谎]她是我的一位老朋友。我听说她来了这里,昂蒂布。

source_text(原文): Leopold tells me that his name will 'open doors' here. To your 'quieter business'.
translation_zh(译文): 「利奥波德告诉我,他的名字在这儿能“打开门”。通向您的“更安静的生意”。」

source_text(原文): [Truth] It's important. I heard she'd come here, to Antibes.
translation_zh(译文): [实话]这事很重要。我听说她来了这里,昂蒂布。

source_text(原文): This Nina - what does she look like?
That's not important. But if you'd seen her, you'd remember her.
translation_zh(译文): 这不重要。但您若见过她,一定会记得。

source_text(原文): You can't tell me what your old friend looks like?
translation_zh(译文): 您连自己老朋友的长相都说不出?

source_text(原文): No. I've seen no-one like that.
translation_zh(译文): 没有。我没见过这样的人。

source_text(原文): A very old friend. It's been a long time.
translation_zh(译文): 一位很老很老的朋友。已经很久很久了。

source_text(原文): What did you have in mind?
I'm sorry, that was not exactly true. But it's important that I find her.
translation_zh(译文): 抱歉,刚才那句话不完全属实。但找到她,对我很重要。

source_text(原文): [The bookseller raises her gaze from the newspaper.]

translation_zh(译文): 「利奥波德不是轻易信人的人。」

source_text(原文): Good afternoon. You are looking for something?
Well, then. I didn't tell you everything before.
translation_zh(译文): 「那好吧。先前,我没有把一切都告诉您。」

source_text(原文): Just a week ago, she was standing where you are now, asking her own questions.
translation_zh(译文): 「就在一周之前,她还站在您现在站的地方,问着她自己的问题。」

source_text(原文): All right. Linou's name is good here.
Philomèle sends her compliments, and suggests I talk to you about your 'quieter business'.
translation_zh(译文): 「菲洛梅尔向您致意,并建议我来同您谈谈您的“更安静的生意”。」

source_text(原文): Jean-Bernard asked me to remember him to you. He thought I might be interested in your 'quieter business'.
translation_zh(译文): 「让-贝尔纳让我代他向您问好。他觉得,我或许会对您的“更安静的生意”感兴趣。」

source_text(原文): A relic of a gentler world, our Philomèle. Give her my best.
translation_zh(译文): 「我们的菲洛梅尔,是那个更温柔世界留下的遗物。代我向她问好。」

source_text(原文): Poor fellow. Think of something sweet, and say it to him, for me.
translation_zh(译文): 「可怜的人。想一句甜蜜的话,替我说给他听吧。」

source_text(原文): We spoke earlier about a woman named [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation_zh(译文): 「我们之前谈过一个叫[[尼娜·拉加斯]]的女人。」

source_text(原文): Do you know where she went?
She was looking for a book.
If it's not impolite to ask which book...
translation_zh(译文): 「如果这样问不算失礼的话——是哪本书……」

source_text(原文): Ribéreau-Gayon. 'Treatise on Oenology'. Very, very technical book on wine. I had exactly one copy.
translation_zh(译文): 「里贝罗-加永。《酿酒学论著》。一本非常、非常专业的葡萄酒书。我恰好只有一本。」

source_text(原文): I should follow her to the Sanitarium, then. Thank you.
translation_zh(译文): 「那我该跟到疗养院去了。谢谢您。」

source_text(原文): Fortunately, in my line of work, it pays to show an interest in the comings and goings of strangers.
translation_zh(译文): 「幸好,干我这行,留意陌生人的来去总不吃亏。」

source_text(原文): [Lean forward] Tell me where Nina is. Or I'll go straight from here to the Milice to let them know about your 'quieter business'.
translation_zh(译文): [倾身]「告诉我尼娜在哪里。否则,我直接从这里去法国民兵那里,让他们知道你那桩“更安静的生意”。」

source_text(原文): [Match her smile.] Can we say: a favour for a favour?
translation_zh(译文): [回她一个微笑。]「我们能不能说:一桩人情,换一桩人情?」
「我们刚才谈的是[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。」

source_text(原文): The Sanitarium Aujourd'hui. In the Cap d'Antibes, just past the park.
translation_zh(译文): 「今日疗养院。在昂蒂布海岬,过了公园就是。」

source_text(原文): If Monsieur wishes to threaten me again with the Milice, Monsieur can return when we are open again for business. In the decades to come.
translation_zh(译文): 「先生若还想拿法国民兵威胁我,就等我们重新开门营业时再来吧。等上几十年。」

source_text(原文): You are a stranger here, monsieur. You should be more careful with your threats.
translation_zh(译文): 「您是这里的生面孔,先生。威胁的话,还是小心些为好。」

source_text(原文): [[Nina Lagasse]] was seen entering the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui. In the Cap d'Antibes, just past the park.
translation_zh(译文): 「有人看见[[尼娜·拉加斯]]走进了今日疗养院。在昂蒂布海岬,过了公园就是。」

source_text(原文): ...you should be careful. The residents of the Sanitarium are not like the rest of us. And this Lagasse - she is nothing at all like the rest of us.
translation_zh(译文): 「……您要小心。疗养院里的住客,和我们其余的人不一样。而这个拉加斯——她与我们其余的人,全然不同。」

source_text(原文): Yes: I do also deal in a quieter business than books.
translation_zh(译文): 「是的:我确实还做着一桩比卖书更安静的生意。」

source_text(原文): I suppose we can. But we keep strict accounts at the Librairie des Heures. Be sure not to forget your debt to little Andrée.
translation_zh(译文): 「我想可以。不过,我们时光书店的账目分毫不差。可别忘了,您还欠小安德烈一份人情。」

source_text(原文): I have learnt, over many years, to disregard the promises of fine gentlemen. No.
translation_zh(译文): 「多年以来,我学会了一件事:体面先生们的承诺,听听就算了。不。」

source_text(原文): [Mock indignation] 'Many years?' Mademoiselle! I reject the absurdity!
translation_zh(译文): [假装愤慨]「“多年”?小姐!我不接受这种荒谬!」

source_text(原文): Fortunately for you... I suspect you are no gentleman at all, but a scoundrel. One knows where one is, with scoundrels.
translation_zh(译文): 「算您走运……我怀疑您根本不是什么绅士,而是个无赖。跟无赖打交道,人反而心里有数。」

source_text(原文): Not bad; not bad. But not enough.
[She looks me up, then down, then up, with careful interest.]
translation_zh(译文): [她把我从头打量到脚,又从脚打量到头,带着认真细究的兴趣。]
「找一个人。一个女人。[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。」

source_text(原文): I'm looking for a woman named [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation_zh(译文): 「我在找一个女人,名叫[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。」

source_text(原文): No no! You have two names, I think, at least, combined in one. That is what the saint likes about you, I imagine. Let us not tease them apart.
translation_zh(译文): 不不!您有两个名字,我想,至少,合而为一。我想,圣人喜欢的正是这一点。我们且不要把它们拆开。

source_text(原文): Jaume's eyes crinkle in his habitual melancholy nearly-smile.
translation_zh(译文): 若梅的眼角皱起,是他惯常那种忧郁的、近乎微笑的神情。

source_text(原文): A melancholy, friendly, crinkle of the eyes.
translation_zh(译文): 眼角皱起一道忧郁而友善的纹。
[可称异端] 您的「圣人」,就是[[双生巫女]]。

source_text(原文): The eyes of the saint in the window are open.
translation_zh(译文): 彩窗上,圣人的眼睛睁开了。

source_text(原文): You called me 'hollow of spirit and brazen of heart.' What did you mean?
translation_zh(译文): 您说我是「魂灵空虚,心坚如铜」。那是什么意思?

source_text(原文): [If I've gathered enough information from the window... I might recall an odd folktale.]
translation_zh(译文): [若我已从彩窗上收集到足够的信息……我或许会想起一则奇异的民间传说。]

source_text(原文): Yes! But she hath not only one nature. When we gift the Sun with blood, he takes only a little, but he takes from us all.
translation_zh(译文): 是的!但她并非只有一种本性。当我们以血供奉太阳,他取的并不多,却取遍了我们所有人。

source_text(原文): Oh in an iconographic sense, yes, St Reparata is always depicted with open eyes. She watched everything they did to her, the poor thing. But when the saint's eyes were open, we'll see it in the glass.
translation_zh(译文): 哦,从圣像学的意义上说,是的,圣雷帕拉塔总被描绘成睁着眼睛。他们对她的所作所为,她全都看在眼里,可怜的人。但当圣人的眼睛真正睁开时,我们会在彩窗上看见。

source_text(原文): Yes. An absence, then you found a presence, no? Not to fill your emptiness entirely. But a union. The saint will bless it.
translation_zh(译文): 是的。先有缺失,而后您寻得了一份在场,不是吗?并非要填满您的空虚。而是一种结合。圣人会为它祝福。

source_text(原文): Don't speak idly of things you don't understand, Jaume.
translation_zh(译文): 不要轻率谈论您不懂的事,若梅。

source_text(原文): Oh! I am sorry! I will guard my tongue hereafter.
translation_zh(译文): 哦!对不起!从今往后,我会管好自己的舌头。

source_text(原文): Enough of the eyes of the saint for now.
translation_zh(译文): 圣人的眼睛,暂且说到这里。

source_text(原文): They tell a story in Brancrug, where once I was priest, about twins who came across the sea, from the West.
translation_zh(译文): 布兰库格——我曾在那边做过神父——流传着一个故事,说的是渡海而来的孪生姐妹,来自西方。

source_text(原文): [Aloud] They'd looked too long at the sun. One could see nothing through her left eye, one was blind in her right. So St Columba cast sea-water on a fire, and when the steam of it had cleared, so had their sight.
translation_zh(译文): [出声] 她们凝视太阳太久。一个左眼什么也看不见,一个右眼失了明。于是圣科伦巴把海水泼在火上,待水汽散尽,她们的视力也恢复了。

source_text(原文): [Aloud] They'd looked too long at the sun. One could see nothing through her left eye, one was blind in her right. St Columba healed them... but I can't remember how exactly. I'm sorry.
translation_zh(译文): [出声] 她们凝视太阳太久。一个左眼什么也看不见,一个右眼失了明。圣科伦巴治好了她们……但我记不清他是怎么治的了。抱歉。

source_text(原文): I see. And so does the saint. This is very good.
translation_zh(译文): 我明白了。圣人也明白了。这很好。

source_text(原文): Should I say 'thank you'? Yes. Thank you.
translation_zh(译文): 我是不是该说「谢谢」?是的。谢谢。

source_text(原文): It's nothing. I'm glad I could help.
translation_zh(译文): 没什么。能帮上忙,我很高兴。

source_text(原文): Yes. And so you owe me a favour.
translation_zh(译文): 是的。所以,您欠我一个人情。

source_text(原文): The world divides; the saint unites. I am to tell you that [[Nina Lagasse]] entered the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui.
translation_zh(译文): 世界分裂,圣人弥合。我受圣意转告您:[[尼娜·拉加斯]]进了今日疗养院。

source_text(原文): It's up in the Cap - past the park - outside the town.
translation_zh(译文): 在昂蒂布海岬上面——过了公园——在镇子外头。

source_text(原文): If you find her... I think that would please the saint. I hope that it will please you also.
translation_zh(译文): 若您找到她……我想,那会让圣人欢喜。我也希望,那会让您欢喜。

source_text(原文): I wish I had something more to offer you in return. But I can give you only my blessing.
translation_zh(译文): 我真希望还有别的东西能回报您。可我只有祝福可以给您。

source_text(原文): I bless you by that which is pearl; by that which is not touched; by the Two which are One.
translation_zh(译文): 我以珍珠之名祝福您;以不可触及之物之名;以合一的两位之名。

source_text(原文): Thank you. I'll leave you to the saint.
translation_zh(译文): 谢谢。您就留在圣人身边吧。

source_text(原文): Better than nothing. I should be going.
I noticed some, ah, gaps in Antibes. Do you know what they are?
translation_zh(译文): 我注意到,昂蒂布有一些,呃,裂隙。您知道那是什么吗?

source_text(原文): Yes. 'The centre cannot hold,' is how the Irishman put it. Things come apart, you know? Things fold together.
translation_zh(译文): 是的。「中心撑不住了,」那位爱尔兰人是这么说的。万物分崩离析,您明白吗?万物又彼此折叠。

source_text(原文): And so, I pray before the saint.
translation_zh(译文): 所以,我便在圣人面前祈祷。

source_text(原文): Pearl. In absolute; in essence; pearl.
translation_zh(译文): 珍珠。就其绝对而言;就其本质而言;珍珠。

source_text(原文): [Follow Jaume towards the beach, until the rain lifts like a curtain.]
translation_zh(译文): [跟着若梅走向海滩,直到雨幕如帘卷起。]

source_text(原文): This way... the climb is a little steep, I'm afraid.
Back up the path, and back under the sun through the rain-curtain, gold to grey...
translation_zh(译文): 顺着小路往回走,穿过雨幕重新回到阳光下,从金黄回到灰暗……

source_text(原文): Lift up your heart, my friend. The saint is patient, and so am I.
translation_zh(译文): 打起精神来,我的朋友。圣人有耐心,我也有。

source_text(原文): The words of the saint dwell in your ears. Now your memories will dwell in our eyes. Come with me now.
translation_zh(译文): 圣人的话语,栖居于您的耳中。如今,您的回忆,将栖居于我们眼中。随我来吧。

source_text(原文): "For behold, the Sun offers the waters of the sea as from a ewer..."
translation_zh(译文): 「因为看哪,太阳献出海水,如自执壶中倾出……」

source_text(原文): "...he lays up the deep in his house of lights."
translation_zh(译文): 「……他把深渊,收存在自己的光之屋中。」

source_text(原文): Jaume kneels down to scoop a little sea-water into an empty biscuit-tin decorated with gambolling lambs in chipped enamel.
translation_zh(译文): 若梅跪下来,舀了一点海水,装进一只空饼干罐——罐身的珐琅釉彩斑驳剥落,画着嬉戏的羔羊。

source_text(原文): Just so, my friend. Exactly so!
translation_zh(译文): 正是如此,我的朋友。正是如此!

source_text(原文): [Look out across the sea. Recall what was done to me beneath it.]
translation_zh(译文): [望向海面。回想大海之下,曾有人对我做过的事。]

source_text(原文): [Look out across the sea. It's a beautiful day. Nothing like the drab town streets.]
translation_zh(译文): [望向海面。天气晴好,与镇上灰扑扑的街道全然不同。]

source_text(原文): There are parts of the Mediterranean now where the sea is mud or blood. Here, still, it's the Bay of Angels. Blue as the remembered skies of childhood.
translation_zh(译文): 如今,地中海有些地方,海水已成了泥浆或血。而这里,依然是天使湾。蓝得像童年记忆里的天空。

source_text(原文): Twinges of remembered pain. There was a cage, or a rack, or a thorned reef, in the city beneath the waves, and they drew the Worms from me like blood.
translation_zh(译文): 记忆中的痛楚,一阵阵抽动。在波浪下的那座城里,有个笼子,或一架刑架,或一片荆棘礁,他们像放血一样,把蠕虫从我体内引出。

source_text(原文): There. We have what we need.
translation_zh(译文): 好了。我们需要的,都有了。

source_text(原文): Now, we shall see. And perhaps, also, the saint. The honour is yours, my friend.
translation_zh(译文): 现在,我们即将看见了。也许,圣人也要看见了。这份荣幸,属于您,我的朋友。

source_text(原文): [Cast the sea-water on the brazier before the window.]
translation_zh(译文): [把海水泼在彩窗前的火盆上。]

source_text(原文): A cloud of steam; and then nothing obvious has changed.
translation_zh(译文): 一团蒸汽升起;然后,并没有什么明显的变化。

source_text(原文): Fire and water; salt and sun. It is done.
The bishop might not agree with everything I have said to you. But the bishop does not come often to Antibes, and the saint is here always.
translation_zh(译文): 主教未必赞同我对您说的每一句话。但主教不常来昂蒂布,而圣人,始终在这里。

source_text(原文): [Renounce Plan] Jaume: this is not something I can help you with.
translation_zh(译文): [放弃计划] 若梅:这件事,我帮不了您。

source_text(原文): I understand what you are saying. You are wrong; but I understand. Go beneath the eye of Heaven.
translation_zh(译文): 我明白您的话。您错了;但我明白。去吧,愿您在苍天之眼下前行。

source_text(原文): I've reconsidered. I can, and I will, help you open the saint's eyes.
translation_zh(译文): 我重新想过了。我能,而且愿意,帮您睁开圣人的眼睛。

source_text(原文): 'The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be undivided, thy whole body shall be full of light'.
translation_zh(译文): 「眼睛就是身体的灯:所以,你的眼睛若合一,全身就充满光。」

source_text(原文): I only hoped that you would reconsider; but the saint knew that you would.
translation_zh(译文): 我不过是盼望您回心转意;但圣人知道,您会。

source_text(原文): You mean, you have two names? No, of course you do, that's all right, you see? That's why the saint brought you.
translation_zh(译文): 您是说,您有两个名字?不,您当然有,这没什么,您明白吗?正因如此,圣人才把您带来。

source_text(原文): Did you wish to...but, wait. Let me see. Is it you?
translation_zh(译文): 您是想……不过,且慢。让我瞧瞧。是您吗?

source_text(原文): 'Hollow of spirit and brazen of heart,' she said. And that you would open her eyes.
translation_zh(译文): 「魂灵空虚,心坚如铜,」她这样说过。还说,您会睁开她的眼睛。

source_text(原文): I'm sorry, Jaume. I'm not who you think I am.
translation_zh(译文): 抱歉,若梅。我不是您想的那个人。

source_text(原文): You said I would 'open her eyes'. The window? The saint? Or...
translation_zh(译文): 您说过,我会「睁开她的眼睛」。是那扇彩窗?是圣人?还是……

source_text(原文): I will do my very best to answer it!

translation_zh(译文): [戏谑] 嗯,一般来说,那就是我,没错。

source_text(原文): The priest blinks slowly, as if struggling to focus.
translation_zh(译文): 神父缓缓眨着眼,仿佛正费力地聚拢目光。

source_text(原文): Saint Reparata said I would have a visitor. Is it you?
translation_zh(译文): 圣雷帕拉塔说过,会有一位访客到来。是您吗?
那么,您会睁开她的眼睛?

source_text(原文): The saint will bring you together, you and this Nina, once her eyes are open. I'm certain of it.
translation_zh(译文): 等她睁开眼睛,圣人定会让你们重逢——您和这位尼娜。我确信无疑。

source_text(原文): The priest turns to gesture at the stained glass window behind the altar.
translation_zh(译文): 神父转过身,朝祭坛后的彩绘玻璃窗比了个手势。

source_text(原文): I don't... I don't really know what you want.
translation_zh(译文): 我不……我真的不明白您想要什么。

source_text(原文): Her name, you see, is Reparata; but not her only name. Mine is Jaume, and that is all the name I own.
translation_zh(译文): 您看,她的名字叫雷帕拉塔;但那不是她唯一的名字。我的名字叫若梅,这便是我仅有的名字。

source_text(原文): But I don't want anything. It's the saint. She can't see; and at last here you are, to help her.
translation_zh(译文): 可我什么也不要。要的是圣人。她看不见;而您终于来了,来帮助她。

source_text(原文): Jaume doesn't smile - but his eyes crinkle as if he might.
translation_zh(译文): 若梅没有笑——但眼角的皱褶,仿佛随时会牵出一个笑来。

source_text(原文): I'll need something in return. I'm looking for someone: a woman named [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation_zh(译文): 我需要回报。我在找一个人:一位名叫[[尼娜·拉加斯]]的女子。

source_text(原文): Father Jaume. Are you quite well?
translation_zh(译文): 若梅神父。您身体还好吗?

source_text(原文): Well? No, no, not for some time now. Thank you for asking.
translation_zh(译文): 还好吗?不,不,已经有些日子不好了。谢谢您关心。

source_text(原文): Jaume shifts from foot to foot, like a raincloud buffeted by wind.
translation_zh(译文): 若梅两只脚轮番地掂着,像一朵被风扑打的雨云。

source_text(原文): [True As Far As It Goes] Jaume, I was ordained at Plymouth Cathedral. Thirty years ago now.
translation_zh(译文): [大体属实] 若梅,我在普利茅斯大教堂受了按立。那已是三十年前的事了。

source_text(原文): Oh! I should have known! Forgive me, my friend.
translation_zh(译文): 哦!我本该想到的!原谅我,我的朋友。

source_text(原文): The eyes of the saint are opened.
'My friend.' We were never really introduced.
translation_zh(译文): 「我的朋友。」我们其实从未正式结识。

source_text(原文): Honestly, I couldn't say whether or not I'm still, bureaucratically, a priest. I moved on before the process was complete. For all I know, the Vatican lost the paperwork. But either way, the mark remains.
translation_zh(译文): 说真的,我无法断言,在官僚意义上自己是否还算神父。程序走完之前,我便已离开了。说不定,梵蒂冈把文书弄丢了。但无论如何,印记仍在。

source_text(原文): 'Sylvain Huissier'. But hush! I'm under cover.
translation_zh(译文): 『西尔万·韦西耶』。可别声张！我在执行秘密任务。

source_text(原文): English. I knew it immediately. A true English gentleman.
translation_zh(译文): 英国人。我一眼就看出来了。真正的英国绅士。

source_text(原文): Watch out for Jean-Bernard, then. He's a terrible gossip.
translation_zh(译文): 那可得当心让-贝尔纳。他是出了名的大嘴巴。

source_text(原文): You need to work on your accent, Midnight Joe.
translation_zh(译文): 你的口音还得好好练练，午夜乔。

source_text(原文): I apologise, [q=alias.formal], for these savages. If they had better manners, they'd introduce themselves.
translation_zh(译文): 我为这些粗人向您道歉，[q=alias.formal]。他们若懂礼数，就该自我介绍。
阿里斯蒂德是那个闹腾的。

source_text(原文): I dare not contradict madame la marquise.
translation_zh(译文): 我可不敢反驳侯爵夫人阁下。

source_text(原文): Leopold is our painter. And our nihilist.
translation_zh(译文): 利奥波德是我们的画家。也是我们的虚无主义者。

source_text(原文): This song again. Ignore the duchess. I'm a realist. At worst, an existentialist.
translation_zh(译文): 又来了。别理会这位公爵夫人。我是现实主义者。至多算个存在主义者。
让-贝尔纳是我们的诗人。

source_text(原文): I am a poor excuse for a poet, at best, [q=alias.title.fr].
translation_zh(译文): 我不过是个不入流的诗人，充其量如此，[q=alias.title.fr]。
但还算个称职的机修工。

source_text(原文): A duchess, I hear. Or a marchioness?
translation_zh(译文): 我听说，是位公爵夫人。还是侯爵夫人？

source_text(原文): You're these boys' governess, I take it?
translation_zh(译文): 我猜，你是这帮小伙子的家庭教师？

source_text(原文): Who is, my friend? Who is? But, listen, [q=alias.last], I prefer this one: 'A glass in the nose, and the tongue loosens.'
translation_zh(译文): 谁？我的朋友，谁呀？不过，听着，[q=alias.last]，我更喜欢这句：『鼻子一杯，舌头就松了。』

source_text(原文): Aristide, halfway through a draw on his pipe, cough-splutters with delight.
translation_zh(译文): 阿里斯蒂德正吸着烟斗，乐得连咳带呛，把烟都喷了出来。

source_text(原文): An awkward pause, until Aristide takes pity on me.
translation_zh(译文): 一阵尴尬的沉默，直到阿里斯蒂德可怜起我来。

source_text(原文): That's it, lads, never mind la marquise, she's the governess now!
translation_zh(译文): 行了，伙计们，别管什么侯爵夫人了，她现在是家庭教师了！

source_text(原文): I do what I can to raise the tone. But one cannot empty the sea with a spoon.
translation_zh(译文): 我尽力把格调拔高些。可一勺是舀不干大海的。
她倒管我叫虚无主义者。

source_text(原文): I'd say it's more like pissing in a violin. But that's because I lack manners.
translation_zh(译文): 要我说，更像往小提琴里撒尿。不过那是因为我缺乏教养。

source_text(原文): If we're finally now finished with the badinage, there's something I need to discuss with you.
translation_zh(译文): 玩笑若是终于开够了，我有件事要和你谈谈。

source_text(原文): Times are tight. I really can't spare the cash.
translation_zh(译文): 时局艰难。我真的匀不出钱来。

source_text(原文): They catch on quick, the authorities!
Our Leopold likes his aphorisms. Like any good nihilist.
translation_zh(译文): 我们的利奥波德爱讲他的格言。跟所有称职的虚无主义者一样。

source_text(原文): I'm not a nihilist! You're not nearly as funny as you think you are, Aristide.
translation_zh(译文): 我不是虚无主义者！你远没自己想的那么有趣，阿里斯蒂德。

source_text(原文): [Rack my brains for a clever aphorism.]
translation_zh(译文): [绞尽脑汁，想找一句俏皮格言。]

source_text(原文): You want me to fetch drinks for you and your friends.
