translation_zh(译文): 你想让我给你和你的朋友端酒。

source_text(原文): [Gesture carelessly] "Bronze is the mirror of the face; wine, the mirror of the mind."
translation_zh(译文): [随意一挥手] 『青铜是面孔的镜子，美酒是心神的镜子。』

source_text(原文): [Nod approvingly] "This horrible tearing thirst demands that you fill yourselves with wine."
translation_zh(译文): [赞许地点头] 『这可怕的灼渴，正催你们以酒灌满自己。』

source_text(原文): All right. Linou knows what you drink?
translation_zh(译文): 好吧。利努知道你们喝什么？

source_text(原文): Just... go get us something to drink, eh?
translation_zh(译文): 就……去给我们弄点喝的，嗯？

source_text(原文): I have better things to do than get drunks drunker.
translation_zh(译文): 我还有更要紧的事，犯不着把醉汉灌得更醉。

source_text(原文): You asked me to get drinks for everyone here...
translation_zh(译文): 是你让我给在座各位端酒的……

source_text(原文): [Consider buying drinks for the four of them.]
You'll speak more freely if I top you up with wine?
translation_zh(译文): 我把你的酒添满，你说话会更痛快吧？

source_text(原文): (The man has sea-urchins in his pockets.)
Something tells me our thirsts will remain unquenched a little longer. A presentiment, perhaps. Or something in your eyes. Perhaps it is the absence of drinks.
translation_zh(译文): 我隐约觉得，我们的口渴还得再熬上一阵。也许是种预感。也许是您眼里的什么。也许只是酒迟迟不来。

source_text(原文): 'Absence of evidence is not evidence.' There is still room for optimism, Aristide.
translation_zh(译文): 『证据的缺席不是证据。』总还有乐观的余地，阿里斯蒂德。

source_text(原文): Ah! le Révérend Père William Wright. On the Hittites.
translation_zh(译文): 啊！可敬的神父威廉·赖特。论赫梯人的那本。

source_text(原文): No - It's Cygnifer, on the Serpent. The heresy.
translation_zh(译文): 不对——是《西尼费尔》，论蛇的那本。那部异端。

source_text(原文): Pff. You know I don't read that gibberish.
translation_zh(译文): 嗤。你知道我不读那种天书。

source_text(原文): Of course. Perhaps your fortune will change, and you'll remember us.
translation_zh(译文): 当然。也许你的时运会变，那时你会想起我们。

source_text(原文): [Look each of the others in the eye.]
[Keep my eyes on the floor. I don't want anyone to remember my face better than they have to.]
translation_zh(译文): [目光落在地板上。我不愿任何人把我的脸记得比必要的更清楚。]

source_text(原文): Aristide, merry; Leopold, wary; Jean-Bernard, wistful; Philomèle, wry.
translation_zh(译文): 阿里斯蒂德，快活；利奥波德，警惕；让-贝尔纳，怅惘；菲洛梅尔，讥诮。

source_text(原文): [Lift the glass of red wine that Linou added to the tray for me.]
translation_zh(译文): [举起利努为我添到托盘上的那杯红酒。]

source_text(原文): [Lift the glass of white wine that Linou added to the tray for me.]
translation_zh(译文): [举起利努为我添到托盘上的那杯白葡萄酒。]

source_text(原文): [Lift the glass of pastis that Linou added to the tray for me.]
translation_zh(译文): [举起利努为我添到托盘上的那杯茴香酒。]

source_text(原文): [Lift the camomile tea that Linou added to the tray for me.]
translation_zh(译文): [举起利努为我添到托盘上的那杯甘菊茶。]

source_text(原文): [Lift the Coca-Cola that Linou added to the tray for me.]
translation_zh(译文): [举起利努为我添到托盘上的那杯可口可乐。]

source_text(原文): [Lift the possibly-coffee that Linou added to the tray for me.]
translation_zh(译文): [举起利努为我添到托盘上的那杯疑似咖啡。]

source_text(原文): [Lift the glass of water that Linou added to the tray for me.]
translation_zh(译文): [举起利努为我添到托盘上的那杯水。]

source_text(原文): [I added something to Philomèle's drink. Watch and wait to see any effect.]
translation_zh(译文): [我在菲洛梅尔的酒里加了点什么。且看效果。]

source_text(原文): [I added something to their drinks - and something more to Philomèle's. Watch and wait to see the effect.]
translation_zh(译文): [我在他们的酒里加了点什么——给菲洛梅尔的还额外加了料。且看效果。]

source_text(原文): If one of them likes you enough, perhaps they'll open up. Except Aristide. If Aristide knew anything, he'd already have blurted it out.
translation_zh(译文): 若他们中有人足够喜欢你，或许会敞开心扉。阿里斯蒂德除外。他若知道什么，早就脱口而出了。

source_text(原文): Not the world entire. But what has occurred. Perhaps you have noticed, [q=alias.familiar], that the world is different since the war.
translation_zh(译文): 不是整个世界。而是发生过的事。也许你已察觉，[q=alias.familiar]，大战之后，世界大不相同。

source_text(原文): Yes. It has holes in it, for instance.
Yes. The sun is not what it was...
translation_zh(译文): 是的。太阳已不是从前的太阳……

source_text(原文): Yes. What walked only in the night, walks in the daylight.
translation_zh(译文): 是的。只在夜里游荡的东西，如今在白昼行走。

source_text(原文): Philomèle raises her glass fractionally. Jean-Bernard nods.
translation_zh(译文): 菲洛梅尔稍稍举杯。让-贝尔纳点了点头。
利奥波德干巴巴地笑了。

source_text(原文): Precisely. To name only a single consequence. But a consequence of what? That is what we discuss.
translation_zh(译文): 正是。这里只举出一个后果。可它是什么的后果？这正是我们所谈论的。

source_text(原文): To me, it is clear. The weapons unleashed by the Enemy - and against the Enemy, by the Allies - were too terrible. They cracked Europe like the shell of an egg [he stamps a foot for emphasis]. Now, the cracks spread! The egg leaks until the shell is empty. But to my friends, somehow it is not so clear.
translation_zh(译文): 在我看来，这很清楚。敌人释放的武器——以及同盟用来对付敌人的武器——都太过可怕。它们像蛋壳一样击裂了欧洲[他跺了跺脚以示强调]。如今裂缝还在蔓延！蛋液一直流，直到蛋壳空竭。可对我的朋友们来说，不知为何，就没这么清楚了。

source_text(原文): ...Philomèle is right. The blood on the Sun is the blood of the secret gods.
translation_zh(译文): ……菲洛梅尔说得对。太阳上的血，是隐秘诸神的血。

source_text(原文): Leopold is right. It's not a question anyone can ever answer.
translation_zh(译文): 利奥波德说得对。这不是任何人能够回答的问题。

source_text(原文): The Church teaches that the Sun has many natures. And the esoterics teach that the world has other natures, necessary to sustain its existence. The 'War in the Sun' is not only a figure of speech. These natures warred. Many died. And now Europe dies with them.
translation_zh(译文): 教会教导说，太阳有许多本性。密教学者则教导说，世界还有另一些本性，为维系其存在所必需。『太阳之战』并非仅仅一个比喻。这些本性交战了。许多本性死去。如今，欧洲正随它们一同死去。

source_text(原文): Philomèle, you should know, is a journalist. She writes articles in magazines for readers less intelligent than she. Horoscopes - tripe of that nature. Over the years, it has infected her with mysticism.
translation_zh(译文): 要知道，菲洛梅尔是个记者。她为智力不及她的读者们撰写杂志文章。占星专栏——诸如此类的货色。这些年来，这活儿让她染上了神秘主义。

source_text(原文): Impossible ever to say. Our understanding lies buried beneath ignorance, beneath the gravestone knowledge, raised by science and art.
translation_zh(译文): 永远无从言说。我们的理解深埋在无知之下，深埋在科学和艺术竖起的墓碑般的知识之下。

source_text(原文): Philomèle sips her wine, smiling very slightly.
translation_zh(译文): 菲洛梅尔抿了口酒，嘴角浮起极淡的笑意。

source_text(原文): "Each hour has its colour - each flame has its fuel."
translation_zh(译文): 『每个时辰有它的颜色——每簇火焰有它的燃料。』

source_text(原文): This nonsense is more contagious than I knew.
translation_zh(译文): 这种胡话比我想象的更有传染性。

source_text(原文): In other words, we have passed a point of no return. We cannot know what has happened to our world. To discuss the matter will only expand our ignorance - until we grope like apes in the dark.
translation_zh(译文): 换句话说，我们已经越过了无可回返之点。我们无法知晓我们的世界究竟发生了什么。谈论此事只会扩大我们的无知——直到我们像猿猴一般，在黑暗中摸索。

source_text(原文): Do apes... that is, I think apes have better night vision than we do...?
translation_zh(译文): 猿猴……我是说，我觉得猿猴的夜视能力比我们强……？

source_text(原文): You see? My point exactly. We get more ignorant each time we open our mouths.
translation_zh(译文): 瞧见了吗？正是我的意思。我们每开口一次，就变得更无知一分。

source_text(原文): The things in Russia, I mean. The ones behind the Ministries. Everything changed when they came. I was an [[Icarian]]. I still am, I suppose. I think it might get better. But I think, before then, it will get much worse.
translation_zh(译文): 我是说俄国来的那些东西。联盟背后的那些。它们来时，一切都变了。我一度是[[伊加利亚]]人。我想，现在仍是。我觉得事情也许会好转。但好转之前，会先坏得多。

source_text(原文): Why the Stars? Why not the [[Incorporates]]?
translation_zh(译文): 为什么是群星？为什么不是[[集团]]？

source_text(原文): No no, you're right. They make it worse. We were never meant to touch Heaven. Not like this. It will split us like old wineskins.
translation_zh(译文): 不不，你说得对。它们让一切更糟。我们本不该触碰天堂。不该以这种方式。它会像旧酒囊一样把我们撑裂。

source_text(原文): So if we hadn't had the War, it would be just as bad? The plagues? The bloodied Sun?
translation_zh(译文): 那么，即使没有那场大战，一切也一样糟？瘟疫？染血的太阳？

source_text(原文): It might have taken longer. 'We are never blind to stones, but we cannot see the earth.'
translation_zh(译文): 也许只会来得更慢些。『我们从不无视石头，却看不见大地。』

source_text(原文): That's one of his. No-one knows what it means.
translation_zh(译文): 那是他的句子。没人知道是什么意思。

source_text(原文): ...you're right, Aristide. If we wanted a working continent, we shouldn't have been firing fungus at each other.
translation_zh(译文): ……你说得对，阿里斯蒂德。我们若想要一个还能运转的大陆，就不该朝彼此扔真菌。

source_text(原文): ...Jean-Bernard is right. The Stars are wrong.
translation_zh(译文): ……让-贝尔纳说得对。群星出了差错。

source_text(原文): Hear that, lads? Democracy in action.
translation_zh(译文): 听见了吗，伙计们？这就是活生生的民主。

source_text(原文): Why do I have the sense, [q=alias.formal], that you understand these matters better than I?
translation_zh(译文): 为什么我总觉得，[q=alias.formal]，你比我对这些事懂得更多？

source_text(原文): And so neither can we know if I'm right, eh? But, thank you.
translation_zh(译文): 那么，我们同样无从知道我是否正确了，嗯？不过，谢谢你。

source_text(原文): [Leopold struggles to decide on an expression. Eventually, he grinds his teeth..]
translation_zh(译文): [利奥波德努力想摆出一副表情。最终，他磨了磨牙。]

source_text(原文): Thank you. Although I hope that I am wrong.
translation_zh(译文): 谢谢你。不过我希望自己是错的。
这就是邦国,阿里斯蒂德。

source_text(原文): Exactly! We had an election - not only an election, but a select and refined election! Free of Icarians and un...patriots! A republican distillate, my friends. Like wine to cognac. Oh, the cognac is perhaps a little rough on the throat. Perhaps the hangover is -
translation_zh(译文): 正是!我们举行过一场选举——不只是选举,而是一场精挑细选、蒸馏提纯的选举!没有伊加利亚人,也没有不……爱国者!共和国的精华,朋友们。好比葡萄酒之于白兰地。哦,白兰地也许有点呛喉咙。也许宿醉是——

source_text(原文): Philomèle coughs gently. She takes care not to look in my direction.
translation_zh(译文): 菲洛梅尔轻轻咳了一声。她刻意不朝我这边看。

source_text(原文): [Place a finger to my lips, as if touching them by accident. Smile, very slightly.]
translation_zh(译文): [把一根手指按在唇边,仿佛不经意地碰到。极轻地微笑。]
保持着微笑而疏离的姿态。

source_text(原文): Join in; perform friendship; solicitously demonstrate my concern for poor Philomèle.
translation_zh(译文): 加入进去;演好这场友情;殷勤地表现出我对可怜的菲洛梅尔的关切。

source_text(原文): Be solicitous; demonstrate my concern for poor Philomèle.
translation_zh(译文): 表现得体贴些;显出我对可怜的菲洛梅尔的关切。

source_text(原文): The wild mood passes, the moths depart - but they'll always remember something enchanted about the evening.
translation_zh(译文): 狂放的气氛过去了,飞蛾散去——但他们总会记得,这个夜晚有种着了魔的意味。

source_text(原文): Philomèle rallies; but they'll always remember something poisoned about the evening.
translation_zh(译文): 菲洛梅尔打起精神;但他们总会记得,这个夜晚有种下了毒的意味。

source_text(原文): By their words shall ye know them, hm, Leopold?
translation_zh(译文): 听其言,知其人,嗯,莱奥波德?

source_text(原文): Your mouth! I'm not a nihilist, and I'm not a Russian! I'm from Lappeenranta!
translation_zh(译文): 嘴上留神!我不是虚无主义者,也不是俄国人!我来自拉彭兰塔!

source_text(原文): ...but the bank moves round the table. Yes.
That's a casino game. Aren't there laws about playing in a café?
translation_zh(译文): 那是赌场的玩法。在咖啡馆里赌,难道没有法律管吗?

source_text(原文): For these tiny sums? The casinos, and the Milice, will not trouble themselves. But don't let us drag you into anything illicit...
translation_zh(译文): 就这点小钱?赌场和民兵团都不会自找麻烦。不过,可别让我们把你拖进什么非法的事……

source_text(原文): [Back Out] Perhaps I'll just watch, for now.
translation_zh(译文): [退出] 也许眼下我看看就好。

source_text(原文): Oh, don't worry. You'll pick it up as you go. [He grins.]
translation_zh(译文): 哦,别担心。玩着玩着你就学会了。[他咧嘴一笑。]

source_text(原文): It's your turn as the bank. What's the limit?
translation_zh(译文): 轮到你坐庄了。限额多少?

source_text(原文): Relax: you don't need to understand chemin-de-fer or baccarat. All you need to know is that the players take turns as the banker, and the banker sets the limit on the bets. So pick a big limit, impress the enthusiasts, perhaps lose all your money if you don't have the skills. Or pick a small limit and ride quietly along.
translation_zh(译文): 放松:你不必弄懂铁轨牌或巴卡拉。你只需知道:玩家轮流坐庄,庄家定下赌注的限额。所以,要么定个大限额,震住那些牌迷——要是你技艺不精,也许会输光全部身家;要么定个小限额,安安静静跟着玩。

source_text(原文): These rapscallions are drawing cards out of a woman's shoe and playing for small stakes. You're not going to lose your shirt. Or whatever other Outfit you're wearing.
translation_zh(译文): 这群捣蛋鬼正从一只女人的鞋里摸牌,赌的又是小注。你不会输掉衬衫的。或者你身上穿的别的什么行头。
[谨慎下注] 五枚法兰西斧币。
[自信下注] 十枚法兰西斧币。
[拿出勇气来!] 十五枚法兰西斧币!

source_text(原文): [Let the cards fall where they may - a one in five chance of winning.] 'A throw of the dice will never abolish chance!'
translation_zh(译文): [让牌听天由命——五分之一的机会能赢。]“骰子一掷,永远取消不了偶然!”

source_text(原文): Mention my name to Andrée, the bookseller - at the Librairie des Heures, near the station - and it'll open a door for you. Perhaps on the other side of that door, you'll find this Nina.
translation_zh(译文): 向书商安德烈提起我的名字——车站附近的时辰书店——那会为你开一扇门。也许在那扇门后,你就会找到那位尼娜。

source_text(原文): [If I craft a Bewitch item before I go back to the bar... I could definitely make the drinks loosen their tongues.]
translation_zh(译文): [若我在回酒吧前炼制一件迷惑道具……我定能让那些酒水撬开他们的嘴。]

source_text(原文): You great lump of dough. [But he says it softly.]
translation_zh(译文): 你这团大面团。[不过他说得很轻。]

source_text(原文): Give Andrée my compliments. Perhaps she can help you find your friend.
translation_zh(译文): 替我向安德烈问好。也许她能帮你找到你的朋友。

source_text(原文): Or whatever it is that [[Nina Lagasse]] is to you. I'm glad not to be involved with this business. Go carefully.
translation_zh(译文): 或者,随[[尼娜·拉加斯]]对你来说是别的什么。我很庆幸没掺和进这桩事。小心行事。

source_text(原文): [Sip casually from my drink, as if I hadn't heard anything.]
translation_zh(译文): [随意啜一口酒,仿佛什么都没听见。]

source_text(原文): [Turn an imaginary key in the lock of my mouth; drop the imaginary key into Aristide's pastis.]
translation_zh(译文): [在我嘴上的锁孔里转动一把想象中的钥匙;再把那把想象中的钥匙丢进阿里斯蒂德的茴香酒里。]

source_text(原文): "Did you hear this one yet? A [[Crucian]] walks into a bar in Berlin..."
translation_zh(译文): “这个笑话你听过吗?一个[[介壳种]]走进柏林的一家酒吧……”

source_text(原文): "...and then she says, 'but why lamb?"' [Pause for laughter]
translation_zh(译文): “……然后她说:『可为什么是羔羊?』”[停一停,等笑声]

source_text(原文): "...and then she says, 'but then why does the Form have four ends?"' [Pause for laughter]
translation_zh(译文): “……然后她说:『那为什么“形态”有四个末端?』”[停一停,等笑声]

source_text(原文): Laughter is not forthcoming. Except for Aristide, who pounds the table and nearly chokes on his pipe.
translation_zh(译文): 笑声没有如期而至。只有阿里斯蒂德例外——他捶着桌子,差点被烟斗呛死。

source_text(原文): I don't get it. Aristide, can you explain?
translation_zh(译文): 我没听懂。阿里斯蒂德,你能解释解释吗?

source_text(原文): What? No, I don't understand the joke at all. But I liked the accents. He does good accents, our [q=alias.familiar]!
translation_zh(译文): 什么?不,这笑话我压根没懂。但我喜欢那些口音。他学口音学得真好,咱们的[q=alias.familiar]!

source_text(原文): Table-pounding chortles from Aristide; a wicked giggle from Philomèle; an unexpectedly falsetto titter from Jean-Bernard. Even Leopold allows himself a thin smile.
translation_zh(译文): 阿里斯蒂德捶桌闷笑;菲洛梅尔促狭地咯咯笑;让-贝尔纳发出一声意外尖细的假声窃笑。连莱奥波德也破例露出一丝浅笑。

source_text(原文): Now that you have what you need from us, eh? [Aristide wags a sorrowful finger.] That is our fate, my friends: we are a well in the desert, and when the traveller has drunk his fill, he will pass on to his true destination. Adieu, [q=alias.familiar]!
translation_zh(译文): 如今你从我们这儿拿到了想要的,嗯?[阿里斯蒂德伤心地摇了摇手指。] 这就是我们的命,朋友们:我们是沙漠里的一口井,旅人喝足了水,就会继续走向他真正的目的地。别了,[q=alias.familiar]!

source_text(原文): [Truth] Say rather a friendly campfire, Aristide. [Nod at his pipe.] I'll see you again.
translation_zh(译文): [实话] 不如说是一堆友善的篝火,阿里斯蒂德。[朝他的烟斗点点头。] 我们还会再见。

source_text(原文): You had your free drinks, and my business cannot wait. Let's not pretend we're family.
translation_zh(译文): 你已经喝过你的免费酒了,我的正事等不起。别装得我们像一家人。

source_text(原文): [Lie] Say rather a friendly campfire, Aristide. [Nod at his pipe.] I'll see you again.
translation_zh(译文): [谎话] 不如说是一堆友善的篝火,阿里斯蒂德。[朝他的烟斗点点头。] 我们还会再见。

source_text(原文): You know, [q=alias.familiar], in this town we call them cards.
translation_zh(译文): 你知道吗,[q=alias.familiar],在这镇上,我们管那叫纸牌。
嘘。他引用的是马扎里纳。

source_text(原文): Never mind the salon nonsense. Shut up and draw.
translation_zh(译文): 别管那些沙龙里的胡话。闭嘴,发牌。

source_text(原文): [Losing hand] I have nothing here of any worth.
translation_zh(译文): [败局] 我手里什么值钱的也没有。

source_text(原文): I thought I had that one.
translation_zh(译文): 我还以为那一局是我的。

source_text(原文): And here come the authorities! Look sharp, you old bastards, our carrots are cooked now.
translation_zh(译文): 当局来了！打起精神来，老东西们，这下我们的胡萝卜熟了。
[试着掩饰一瞬间的手忙脚乱。]

source_text(原文): Very good, [q=alias.familiar]. But now we have to take the rest of your money.
translation_zh(译文): 很好,[q=alias.familiar]。不过现在,我们得赢走你剩下的钱。

source_text(原文): Heaven's name in a brothel of shit!
translation_zh(译文): 老天爷的名讳,掉进屎坑妓院了!

source_text(原文): Aristide, nothing! This... interloper... with his... cuckold's hand... has cleaned me out. This stupid game. I'm finished with it.
translation_zh(译文): 阿里斯蒂德?什么也没赢!这个……不速之客……凭他那……戴了绿帽的手……把我搜刮得干干净净。这破游戏。我不玩了。

source_text(原文): I'm not making any more charitable donations to newcomers with... unexpectedly good luck.
translation_zh(译文): 我可不想再向运气……出乎意料地好的新人,做慈善捐献了。

source_text(原文): I'm afraid, [q=alias.first], the games are finished for today.
translation_zh(译文): 恐怕,[q=alias.first],今天的牌局到此为止了。

source_text(原文): [Grumbles inarticulately as he gathers up the cards.]
translation_zh(译文): [一边收牌,一边含混不清地咕哝。]

source_text(原文): Unlucky in love... lucky at cards. Thank you for your contributions.
translation_zh(译文): 情场失意……赌场得意。多谢你的慷慨。

source_text(原文): [Give a slow smile, finish my drink, and stand up.]
translation_zh(译文): [缓缓露出微笑,喝完杯里的酒,站起身来。]

source_text(原文): Of course it would be Leopold. He doesn't miss much.
translation_zh(译文): 果然又是莱奥波德。他什么都不会看漏。

source_text(原文): What are you talking about? Let go of me, you scoundrel!
translation_zh(译文): 你在胡说什么?放开我,你这无赖!

source_text(原文): Come on, don't swallow that from him. Time to go, [q=alias.formal].
translation_zh(译文): 得啦,别信他那一套。该走了,[q=alias.formal]。

source_text(原文): If you make me regret telling you this... I'll make you regret it, too.
translation_zh(译文): 你若让我后悔告诉你这件事……我也会让你后悔。

source_text(原文): Well - perhaps we could let this pass, this once -
translation_zh(译文): 呃——也许这一次,我们可以就当没发生过——

source_text(原文): Perhaps, monsieur, it is best if you find somewhere else to sit.
translation_zh(译文): 也许,先生,您最好另找个地方坐。

source_text(原文): Go on! It's the broom for you! And don't let us see you here again!
translation_zh(译文): 滚!该用扫帚赶你了!别再让我们在这儿见到你!

source_text(原文): Back again, is it? Go away. Take your cheating somewhere else.
translation_zh(译文): 又回来了?走开。要出千,去别处出。

source_text(原文): Jean-Bernard tells a story about Citroën brought in for repair that he thinks might actually be haunted. Philomèle examines her reflection.  Aristide accuses Leopold of stealing his pipe, until he finds he's sitting on it...
translation_zh(译文): 让-贝尔纳讲了个故事:一辆送来修理的雪铁龙,他觉得可能真的闹鬼。菲洛梅尔端详着自己的倒影。阿里斯蒂德指责莱奥波德偷了他的烟斗,直到他发现自己正坐在烟斗上……

source_text(原文): Another round of drinks, my friends?
Once a prince, always a prince! Come back with the drinks.
translation_zh(译文): 当过王子,永远是王子!带着酒回来!

source_text(原文): Well... don't tell anyone I told you. But you need to talk to Andrée, the bookseller.
translation_zh(译文): 呃……别说是我告诉你的。但你得去找安德烈，那位书商。

source_text(原文): The wild mood passes, the moths depart - but they'll always remember something enchanted about the evening. When they look back, they'll think of this moment as the hinge, the last bright beat before a silence.
translation_zh(译文): 狂放的气氛过去了,飞蛾散去——但他们总会记得,这个夜晚有种着了魔的意味。回望之时,他们会把这一刻当作枢纽,沉默降临前最后一记明亮的节拍。

source_text(原文): Should I wish to do Zèlia's dirty work... this is my opportunity. Or perhaps I could just convince her that I had. What does she know about curses, anyway?
translation_zh(译文): 倘若我想替泽莉亚干那桩脏活……这正是我的机会。又或者,我只需让她相信我干过了。她懂什么诅咒?

source_text(原文): Philomèle... do you know a woman named Zèlia?
translation_zh(译文): 菲洛梅尔……你认识一个叫泽莉亚的女人吗?

source_text(原文): Zèlia Badat? Sits in the park, on the bright side? Complains about modern morals, throws rocks at the pigeons?
translation_zh(译文): 泽莉亚·巴达特?坐在公园向阳一侧的那个?抱怨世风日下、拿石头砸鸽子的那个?

source_text(原文): I didn't see her throwing any rocks.
Perhaps she ran out of rocks. Or pigeons.
translation_zh(译文): 也许是石头用完了。或者鸽子用完了。

source_text(原文): I will share a secret. Andrée, at the Librairie des Heures, sells other things than books.
translation_zh(译文): 我分享一个秘密。安德烈，在时光书店那位，除了书还卖别的东西。

source_text(原文): Poor old creature. The Badats used to be very grand, you know. But there were the confiscations, you know, and then they shot her husband... she never really recovered. I think her mind is going. Spiders in the attic, you know.
translation_zh(译文): 可怜的老东西。你知道,巴达特家从前可是显赫之家。可你知道,后来有没收家产那档子事,再后来他们枪毙了她的丈夫……她始终没能缓过来。我看她的脑子在走神。阁楼里进了蜘蛛,你知道的。

source_text(原文): She mentioned your name, that's all.
translation_zh(译文): 她提到了你的名字,仅此而已。

source_text(原文): She mentioned your name. She really doesn't like you.
translation_zh(译文): 她提到了你的名字。她真的很不喜欢你。

source_text(原文): She, ah, wanted to commission me to put a curse on you.
translation_zh(译文): 她,呃,想雇我给你下个诅咒。

source_text(原文): I know her a little. We used to see each other at church. I felt sorry for her. But she never really approved of me anyway. And I don't think she likes people feeling sorry for her.
translation_zh(译文): 我略略认识她。我们从前常在教堂碰面。我那时可怜她。不过她反正从来没真正看得起我。而且我觉得,她不喜欢别人可怜她。

source_text(原文): Philomèle sighs, straightens her shoulders, clearly wants to change the subject.
translation_zh(译文): 菲洛梅尔叹了口气,挺直肩膀,显然想换个话题。

source_text(原文): Oho! A vendetta on la marquise! There will be blood!
translation_zh(译文): 嚯!冲着侯爵夫人的仇怨!要见血了!

source_text(原文): Shut up, Aristide. Well, I knew I wasn't her favourite person, but... Heavens.
translation_zh(译文): 闭嘴,阿里斯蒂德。好吧,我早知道我不是她的心头好,但……天哪。

source_text(原文): Anyone know this Nina? No? No? Sorry, [q=alias.familiar], no Nina here.
translation_zh(译文): 有谁知道这位尼娜？没有？没有？抱歉，[q=alias.familiar]，这儿没有尼娜。

source_text(原文): So... are you going to do it? Put a curse on me?
translation_zh(译文): 那么……你打算做吗?给我下个诅咒?

source_text(原文): Well, she did say you were a traitor. And a defiler of husbands. So...
translation_zh(译文): 唔,她确实说你是个叛徒。还说你专勾引有妇之夫。所以……

source_text(原文): A defiler of - well, tell her she's a collaborationist old viper, and if she'd ever paid her husband any attention -
translation_zh(译文): 勾引有妇之夫——哼,那就替我告诉她,她是条附逆的老毒蛇,要是她当年肯多留意自己的丈夫——

source_text(原文): No. No, don't say anything. I'm sorry.
translation_zh(译文): 不。不,什么也别说了。抱歉。

source_text(原文): Leopold is a loudmouth. But he knows me well.
translation_zh(译文): 莱奥波德是个大嘴巴。但他很了解我。

source_text(原文): She believes in everything. Her mind is so open that you must watch carefully, lest you trip and fall in.
translation_zh(译文): 她什么都信。她的脑子敞得太开,你得小心看着,免得绊一跤栽进去。

source_text(原文): [If I craft a Wither item before I go back to the bar... this is my chance to place the curse on Philomèle that Madame Zèlia requested.]
translation_zh(译文): [若我在回酒吧前炼制一件凋零道具……这正是我按泽莉亚夫人的请求，向菲洛梅尔施下诅咒的机会。]

source_text(原文): What's this? You prince! How spontaneous of you!
translation_zh(译文): 这是什么？您这位王子！您可真是随性！

source_text(原文): [Steer the conversation back to other matters.]
[Adapt myself to the conversation. Smile when it's suitable; frown and tsk when it's not; when an in-joke surfaces, make note of it.]
translation_zh(译文): [让自己融入这场谈话。该笑时笑；不该笑时皱眉啧舌；遇有圈内笑话，便记在心里。]

source_text(原文): [I added something to their drinks. Watch and wait to see the effects.]
translation_zh(译文): [我在他们的酒里加了点什么。且看效果。]

source_text(原文): Welll then! This isn't Monaco. The sabot is our very own Philomèle's very own slipper.
translation_zh(译文): 好吧好吧！这儿可不是摩纳哥。这只木鞋，正是我们菲洛梅尔自己的拖鞋。

source_text(原文): [I have a deck of cards that match the ones in the shoe. With a little care, I could reliably draw a winning hand. Unless I got caught.]
translation_zh(译文): [我有一副牌，与鞋里的那副花色一致。稍加小心，我就能稳稳抽到一手好牌。除非被当场抓包。]

source_text(原文): Each keeps two cards hidden until we all slap down our hands. Watch their faces...
translation_zh(译文): 每人藏两张牌，直到大家一起亮牌。看他们的脸……

source_text(原文): Aristide waves a black velvet court shoe. Philomèle languidly wiggles the bare toes of her left foot.
translation_zh(译文): 阿里斯蒂德挥舞着一只黑色天鹅绒舞鞋。菲洛梅尔慵懒地扭动左脚赤裸的脚趾。

source_text(原文): What is that in your hand?
I apologise. I couldn't afford to lose. I didn't want to admit how limited my funds were.
translation_zh(译文): 我道歉。我输不起。我不愿承认自己的钱有多有限。

source_text(原文): Pass them over, gentlemen, marquise. Another one!
translation_zh(译文): 交出来吧，先生们，侯爵夫人。再来一局！

source_text(原文): They begin to relax around me. Although Leopold remains watchful.
translation_zh(译文): 他们开始在我面前放松下来。尽管利奥波德依旧警觉。

source_text(原文): I begin to realise that my bonhomie is landing as sycophancy. None of them are stupid. Leopold in particular is watchful. Even Aristide is not so drunk as he likes to pretend.
translation_zh(译文): 我开始意识到，我的热络在他们眼中成了谄媚。他们谁都不傻。利奥波德尤其警觉。就连阿里斯蒂德，也没有他装出的那么醉。

source_text(原文): Philomèle, laughing into Jean-Bernard's shoulder, her hair coming loose. Aristide, examining the bowl of his pipe for informers. Leopold, fascinated by the moths which flutter in to sip from his glass. Jean-Bernard, doggedly carving a quatrain into the flank of a candle. And me, watching.
translation_zh(译文): 菲洛梅尔靠着让-贝尔纳的肩膀笑，头发散开。阿里斯蒂德端详着烟斗的斗钵，像在寻找告密者。利奥波德着迷地看着扑进杯中啜饮的飞蛾。让-贝尔纳固执地在蜡烛侧面刻一首四行诗。而我，看着这一切。

source_text(原文): Halfway through a wry aside to Jean-Bernard, Philomèle begins to cough. It takes a long time for the coughing to subside. She's grown very pale. It might be that there's a spot of blood on her collar. I can't be certain. The fabric is dark, and so is the rainy, smoky, friendly gloom of the café.
translation_zh(译文): 菲洛梅尔正对让-贝尔纳说着一句刻薄的俏皮话，说到一半，突然咳嗽起来。咳嗽过了很久才平息。她变得非常苍白。她的衣领上或许有一点血迹。我无法确定。衣料颜色深，而咖啡馆里雨蒙蒙、烟腾腾、昏暗又亲昵。

source_text(原文): Aristide, examining the bowl of his pipe for informers. Leopold, fascinated by the moths which flutter in to sip from his glass. Jean-Bernard, doggedly carving a quatrain into the flank of a candle. Philomèle is laughing into Jean-Bernard's shoulder, her hair coming loose... but then she begins to cough. It takes a long time for the coughing to subside. She's grown pale. That might be a spot of blood on her collar, but the cloth is too dark for me to be certain.
translation_zh(译文): 阿里斯蒂德端详着烟斗的斗钵，像在寻找告密者。利奥波德着迷地看着扑进杯中啜饮的飞蛾。让-贝尔纳固执地在蜡烛侧面刻一首四行诗。菲洛梅尔靠着让-贝尔纳的肩膀笑，头发散开……可接着，她开始咳嗽。咳嗽过了很久才平息。她变得苍白。她的衣领上或许有一点血迹，但衣料颜色太深，我无法确定。

source_text(原文): Yes, yes, we know! Ask Andrée at the Librairie des Heures. Why so forgetful?
translation_zh(译文): 是了是了，我们知道！去时光书店找安德烈。你怎么这么健忘？

source_text(原文): What should we call you, Monsieur The Authorities? What alias are you using today to terrorise the innocent working men of Antibes?
translation_zh(译文): 我们该怎么称呼您，当局先生？今天您又用哪个化名，来吓唬昂蒂布无辜的工人们？
[一只眼睛睁大,闪出警觉的光芒。]
[那只眼睛微微又睁大了一点。]

source_text(原文): The animal is essentially inert, monsieur. Expect nothing of him.
translation_zh(译文): 这动物基本上是一动不动,先生。别对它抱什么指望。

source_text(原文): A necklace of pearls, and tailor's needles crossed behind her head. Neither is a recognised attribute of St Reparata.
translation_zh(译文): 一串珍珠项链,还有交叉在她脑后的裁缝针。这两样,都不是圣雷帕拉塔公认的标志。

source_text(原文): Tailor's needles crossed behind her head - not a recognised attribute of St Reparata.
translation_zh(译文): 交叉在她脑后的裁缝针——并非圣雷帕拉塔公认的标志。

source_text(原文): Yes? Just two blots of black lead in milky glass, with the carefully innocent vagueness of every iconographic virgin.
translation_zh(译文): 睁着?不过是在乳白色的玻璃上,两团黑色的铅迹,带着每位圣像画中童贞女都有的、刻意为之的天真与朦胧。

source_text(原文): Yes. They're mismatched - one aquamarine, one a jewel-bright violet. They lack pupils, but the wide-eye effect and the vivid colours make Reparata look alert, watchful, knowing.
translation_zh(译文): 睁着。而且并不相称——一只海蓝宝石色,一只宝石般明艳的紫罗兰色。它们没有瞳孔,但那瞪圆的眼形与鲜明的色彩,让雷帕拉塔看起来警觉、机敏、洞悉一切。

source_text(原文): She's the patron saint of the city, and of... fishermen? Sailors?
translation_zh(译文): 她是这座城市的守护圣徒,还守护着……渔夫?水手?

source_text(原文): What ghastly imaginations those bishops had.
translation_zh(译文): 那些主教们,想象力何等可怖。

source_text(原文): [Spare a moment to think about that.]
A woman in blue. Martyr's palm, saint's halo; dark eyes, sea beneath stars; crossed needles behind her head, and a necklace of pearls.
translation_zh(译文): 一个着蓝衣的女人。殉道者的棕榈,圣徒的光环;深邃的眼,星辰之下的海;脑后交叉的缝衣针,颈间一串珍珠。

source_text(原文): 'She said... you would open her eyes.' But the saint's eyes in the window are open. What did Jaume mean?
translation_zh(译文): 「“她说……你会睁开她的眼睛。”可彩窗里,圣徒的眼睛是睁着的。若梅是什么意思?」

source_text(原文): Try a charm on the window - to invigorate or awaken it.
translation_zh(译文): 对彩窗施一道咒文——让它焕发生机,或将之唤醒。

source_text(原文): Try a charm on the window - to discern truth or open the doors of perception.
translation_zh(译文): 对彩窗施一道咒文——辨明真伪,或打开感知之门。

source_text(原文): Try a charm on the window - to suppress any influences that have taken up residence there.
translation_zh(译文): 对彩窗施一道咒文——压制任何盘踞其中的影响。

source_text(原文): Saints collect patrocinia in much the same way that...
translation_zh(译文): 圣徒们收集圣庇的方式近乎与此如出一辙......

source_text(原文): [I could talk to Father Jaume again.]
translation_zh(译文): [我可以再去和若梅神父谈谈。]

source_text(原文): The words of the charm echo in the vaulted ceiling. When I look up, something's different.
translation_zh(译文): 咒文的字句在拱形穹顶间回荡。我抬头时,有什么不一样了。

source_text(原文): The words of the charm echo in the vaulted ceiling; but nothing changes.
translation_zh(译文): 咒文的字句在拱形穹顶间回荡;但什么也没有改变。

source_text(原文): The words echo, circling the vaulted ceiling like carrion birds. The echoes intensify. The roof trembles beneath the rain. Is that thunder? It does thunder when it's raining. That's not unusual.
translation_zh(译文): 咒文的字句回荡着,像食腐的鸟,绕着拱形穹顶盘旋。回声越来越强。屋顶在雨中颤抖。那是雷声吗?下雨时确实会打雷。这并不稀奇。

source_text(原文): [Provincial saints and their venerations. Who knows?]
translation_zh(译文): [外省的圣徒,与人们对他们的敬奉。谁知道呢?]
[研究这位圣徒的印记与标志。]

source_text(原文): The [[Church]] acknowledges some [[Hours]], denies others, and is ambivalent on the rest, adopting them as metaphors or parables; or as saints.
translation_zh(译文): 「[[教会]]承认一些[[司辰]],否认另一些,对其余的则态度暧昧——把祂们收作隐喻或寓言;或者,收作圣徒。」

source_text(原文): Infuriatingly, a quarter-memory stirs, then subsides. Seminary was a long time ago.
translation_zh(译文): 恼人的是,一段支离的回忆泛起,又沉了下去。修院时代,已经是很久以前的事了。

source_text(原文): An adept would identify this as an image of the [[Sister-and-Witch]]. As so many times before, I'm enmeshed in some business of the [[Hours]]. I should go carefully.
translation_zh(译文): 一位修士会认出,这是[[双生巫女]]的画像。和以往许多次一样,我正卷入[[司辰]]们的某桩事务。我该小心行事。

source_text(原文): And I should remember, first, that the Sister-and-Witch brings together what she can... and that she's the enemy of severance and disjunction.
translation_zh(译文): 而我首先该记住的是:双生巫女会把一切可以聚合的聚合起来……而她,正是分离与割裂之敌。

source_text(原文): Is that... did you finish? I don't understand.
'And though his flesh was hollow, her eyes were opened!'
translation_zh(译文): 「“他的肉身虽已空乏,她的眼睛却睁开了!”」

source_text(原文): I... sometimes, I fear the saint.
translation_zh(译文): 「我……有时候,我会害怕这位圣徒。」
若梅神父的声音满是狂喜。

source_text(原文): Father Jaume's voice is low and fearful:
translation_zh(译文): 若梅神父的声音低沉,带着惧意:

source_text(原文): Try a charm on the window - to exalt and honour its fundamental nature.
translation_zh(译文): 对彩窗施一道咒文——以崇扬并尊奉它根本的本性。

source_text(原文): Try a charm on the window - to separate or excise conflicting influences.
translation_zh(译文): 对彩窗施一道咒文——将相互冲突的影响分开,或将之切除。

source_text(原文): I have the skills to create a [[Hallow]] or [[Unveil]] item, which could be useful here. Something to think about.
translation_zh(译文): 我有技艺,可以炼制[[祝圣]]或[[揭示]]之物,在这里或许用得着。值得想一想。

source_text(原文): [Back] Those in peril on the sea, anyway.
translation_zh(译文): [返回] 无论如何,是那些海上遇险的人。

source_text(原文): I remember her martyrdom. She was burnt and beheaded. Somewhere in there, she was forced to drink boiling pitch. Then her body was set to drift on the sea until it washed up on a coast, somewhere.
translation_zh(译文): 我记得她的殉难。她被火焚,被斩首。其间,她还被逼着喝下滚沸的沥青。随后,她的遗体被放入大海漂荡,直到在某处海岸搁浅。

source_text(原文): This is the road out of Antibes town, to the green and villa-studded heights of Cap d'Antibes.
translation_zh(译文): 这条路通往昂蒂布城外,通向昂蒂布角绿意葱茏、别墅散布的高地。

source_text(原文): Perhaps I'll have business there later.
translation_zh(译文): 也许以后我在那儿会有事要办。

source_text(原文): For now, my business is in Antibes town - looking for Nina.
translation_zh(译文): 眼下,我的事在昂蒂布城里——寻找尼娜。

source_text(原文): Fortunately, my information suggests Nina is in Antibes town. If that's true, I won't need to climb the hill.
translation_zh(译文): 幸好,我的消息说尼娜就在昂蒂布城里。若果真如此,我就不必爬那座山了。

source_text(原文): What a lot of tripe psychiatrists talk.
translation_zh(译文): 精神病医生净说些废话。

source_text(原文): [Aubière gives a deep, sigh. His usual composure flickers.]
translation_zh(译文): [奥比埃深深叹了口气。他惯常的镇定闪烁了一下。]

source_text(原文): Really. You have proven your goodwill and your reliability. And I am ashamed of the small - but shabby - trick that I have played on you.
translation_zh(译文): 说实话。你已证明了自己的善意和可靠。而我为自己对你耍的那个小把戏——卑劣却无伤大雅——感到羞愧。

source_text(原文): I must be frank. You have brought disharmony to my house. Your presence here makes it increasingly difficult to concentrate on more important business.
translation_zh(译文): 我得直说。你给我的宅院带来了不谐。你的在场,让我愈发难以专心处理更要紧的事务。

source_text(原文): I see your point. I regret it. But some men are simply not suited to each other's company.
translation_zh(译文): 我明白你的意思。很遗憾。但有些人就是合不来,仅此而已。

source_text(原文): [HOROMACHISTRY] 'He cannot harm you; he cannot find you; he always has what you desire.'
translation_zh(译文): 司辰学。「他无法伤害你；他无法找到你；他总拥有你所渴望的东西。」

source_text(原文): Yes. This. Exactly. So I am going to tell you where I will find your Lagasse. And I hope that you will no longer trouble my affairs.
translation_zh(译文): 是的。正是。正因如此,我打算告诉你到哪儿去找你的拉加斯。希望从今往后,你不再搅扰我的事务。

source_text(原文): You may leave now, Monsieur Hobson. I very much hope that you will. Good day.
translation_zh(译文): 你现在可以走了,霍布森先生。我非常希望你会走。日安。

source_text(原文): [Aubière nods minimally, and returns to his work.]
translation_zh(译文): [奥比埃微微点了点头,又回去忙他的工作。]

source_text(原文): I imagine you will wish to leave without further delay. But I hope that you will return. You are an interesting man. I speak professionally, and otherwise.
translation_zh(译文): 我猜你会希望尽快离开,不再耽搁。但我希望你能回来。你是个有趣的人。这话出于职业立场,也出于别的。

source_text(原文): Thank you, Dr Aubière. But I doubt our paths will cross again.
translation_zh(译文): 多谢,奥比埃医生。但我看咱们以后不会再见了。
霍布森先生，你是在背教理问答吗？

source_text(原文): And you, Dr Aubière. I hope we will meet again.
translation_zh(译文): 你也保重,奥比埃医生。希望咱们后会有期。

source_text(原文): There's a painting of the Mansus on open display in your library.
translation_zh(译文): 你的图书馆里,公开挂着一幅漫宿的画。

source_text(原文): The Mansus! A particularly fascinating symbology-superstition. And psychologically potent. Extremely potent.
translation_zh(译文): 漫宿!一种格外引人入胜的象征-迷信。而且心理效力极强。极强。

source_text(原文): You are right to identify a certain risk to the fragile psyche - even when we have of course discarded the esoteric myths around the symbol. But fire also is perilous, no? And we keep fire in our library. Safely behind a grate.
translation_zh(译文): 你说得对,要看出这对脆弱心灵的某种风险——哪怕我们当然已经摈弃了围绕这象征的神秘传说。但火也危险,不是吗?可我们照样在图书馆里生火。安安全全地待在壁炉栏栅后面。

source_text(原文): Didn't the painting come from Hush House?
translation_zh(译文): 那幅画不是来自噤声居屋吗?

source_text(原文): It is possible? Hush House is a private library, is it not, in England? The patrons of this institution have connections with other institutions of learning - especially those that deal in onteirological matters.
translation_zh(译文): 有可能吗?噤声居屋是座私人图书馆,对吧,在英格兰?本院的赞助人跟其他学府有些联系——尤其是那些治梦学的机构。

source_text(原文): That painting - the mountain lake - looks a lot like one I saw in Hush House. Long ago now.
translation_zh(译文): 那幅画——山间湖泊——很像我在噤声居屋见过的一幅。那已经是很久以前的事了。

source_text(原文): Indeed? As I recall, one of the Librarians there claimed the gift of 'prefiguration'. That is to say - he produced works that he attributed to others - but before those others had in fact produced those works. An interesting case. Psychologically, and perhaps otherwise.
translation_zh(译文): 是吗?据我所知,那里的某位馆员自称拥有“预言”之能。就是说——他创作的作品,署的是别人的名字——却在那些别人真的创作出那些作品之前。一个有趣的案例。从心理学上讲,也许,还有别的方面。

source_text(原文): Yes, exactly. It's signed by Levinsen - the prefiguring Librarian.
translation_zh(译文): 对,正是。署着列文森的名字——那位会预言的馆员。

source_text(原文): So interesting! Then, I wonder, should we call this the original? Or only a prophetic falsehood? Thank you, Monsieur Hobson. I will regale my other visitors with this little morsel.
translation_zh(译文): 真有意思!那么,我在想,我们该把它称作原作?还是仅仅一件预言的赝品?谢谢你,霍布森先生。我会拿这个小逸闻去款待其他访客。

source_text(原文): Yes - you had said as much.
translation_zh(译文): 是的——您之前已经说过类似的话了。

source_text(原文): It's quite a coincidence, isn't it? Two paintings here, both from a distant English institution? And a collection of ornaments, chosen to continue the theme?
translation_zh(译文): 这巧合未免太巧了,不是吗?两幅画,都出自英格兰那家遥远的学府?还有一套陈设,专挑这个主题往下续?

source_text(原文): It is. But do you mean to suggest, perhaps, that I am concealing something from you in this matter?
translation_zh(译文): 是巧。但你是想说,或许,我在这件事上对你有所隐瞒?

source_text(原文): Yes. I suggest you tell me the truth, Doctor.
translation_zh(译文): 是。我劝你把真相告诉我,医生。

source_text(原文): [Horomachistry] 'The Cross died not, but passed within.' They're gone, but some of them became us.
translation_zh(译文): 司辰学。「介壳种并未死去，而是转入内里。」他们消失了，但其中一些化作了我们。

source_text(原文): [Aubière briefly removes his glasses to polish them. When he replaces them, his eyes seem sharper.]
translation_zh(译文): [奥比埃摘下眼镜擦了擦。再戴上时,他的眼神似乎更锐利了。]

source_text(原文): I have concealed nothing from you. The circles in which we both move - the same matters occur, and co-occur. And this institution - indeed, this building itself - benefits from certain parallels to your [[Hush House]]. Some, I will be frank, beyond my understanding.
translation_zh(译文): 我对你什么都没隐瞒。我们彼此活动的圈子里——同样的事一再发生,交相发生。而本院——说实在的,连这栋房子本身——得益于与你的[[噤声居屋]]的某些相似。其中一些,老实说,超出我的理解。

source_text(原文): That is all. If there is a deeper design, it is hidden from me also. You have my word on it.
translation_zh(译文): 就这些。若说背后还有更深的设计,那对我同样隐而不见。我以名誉担保。

source_text(原文): Your word is enough for me, Doctor.
It is a regrettable thing you have said. I do not wish to speak further on the matter. Pray give me a moment to compose myself.
translation_zh(译文): 你这话说得令人遗憾。这件事我不想再谈了。请容我平复一下心绪。

source_text(原文): I appreciate that. I will not always be frank with you, you know. But I will always try.
translation_zh(译文): 我领这份情。你知道,我不会总是对你开诚布公。但我会一直尽力。
[结束]现在没什么别的事了,医生。

source_text(原文): [Preservation] Our blood was red... but theirs was golden.
translation_zh(译文): 保存术。我们的血是红的……他们的却是金色的。

source_text(原文): No. This is important business. I wouldn't waste my time on it otherwise.
translation_zh(译文): 不。这是要紧事。不然我才不会在这上面浪费时间。

source_text(原文): The shelves in the living room. A number of the items in the collection have some relationship with Cornwall - even, specifically, with Brancrug, and with Hush House?
translation_zh(译文): 客厅里的那些搁架。藏品里有不少东西跟康沃尔有渊源——甚至,具体说,跟布兰库格、跟噤声居屋有关?

source_text(原文): In candour, I chose very little of what you see beyond my office. Our patrons provided tasteful and suitable appointments for the rooms.
translation_zh(译文): 说句实话,我办公室以外的陈设,几乎没一件是我挑的。赞助人们为各间屋子提供了品味高雅、得体的摆设。

source_text(原文): We are privileged to have an artist of Mme Vlachou's stature as our guest.
translation_zh(译文): 能有弗拉胡夫人这样的艺术家做我们的客人,是我们的荣幸。

source_text(原文): The cat in the living room.
It came with Mlle Lagasse. But when she left, it stayed.
translation_zh(译文): 那是拉加斯小姐带来的。但她走的时候,猫留了下来。

source_text(原文): A man of culture. We play chess sometimes: I hope you might join our games.
translation_zh(译文): 一位有格调的人。我们偶尔下棋:希望你能来对弈几局。

source_text(原文): Yes. Wiser not to discuss her, even during daylight. And especially not to mention her name.
translation_zh(译文): 是的。明智的做法是不要谈起她,哪怕是在白天。尤其不要提起她的名字。

source_text(原文): [He winces, as if I'd said something crude.]
translation_zh(译文): [他皱了一下眉,仿佛我说了什么粗鄙的话。]
是吗？你让我吃惊，斯宾塞。

source_text(原文): If you ever learn a way to be certain what Mlle Lagasse likes... do please share it with me.
translation_zh(译文): 如果你哪天弄明白拉加斯小姐喜欢什么……务必也告诉我一声。

source_text(原文): I am afraid that might in fact have been her intention. The animal is difficult to anticipate. It often interrupts my sessions with its... opinions. Even through two thicknesses of door.
translation_zh(译文): 恐怕那正是它的本意。这畜生难以预料。它常拿它的……意见打断我的诊疗。隔着两层门板都拦不住。

source_text(原文): Mlle Lagasse settled her bill in full. Perhaps the animal was intended as lagniappe.
translation_zh(译文): 拉加斯小姐的账是全额结清的。也许这畜生是当小添头留下的。

source_text(原文): You are recalling folk-tales and fairy-stories in which an animal is recruited as a spy.
translation_zh(译文): 你是想到了那些民间故事和童话吧,里面总有动物被招募去做探子。

source_text(原文): But it is too stubborn to leave. I suspect Bessy of feeding it.
translation_zh(译文): 可它太犟,怎么都不肯走。我怀疑是贝茜在喂它。

source_text(原文): The world, I grant you, has changed. More things are possible that once were not.
translation_zh(译文): 世界,我承认,是变了。从前不可能的事,如今更多了。

source_text(原文): But, sincerely, I doubt it has the wits to be a spy.
translation_zh(译文): 但说真的,我怀疑它有没有当探子的脑子。

source_text(原文): If that is so, I wish she had been less generous.
translation_zh(译文): 若果真如此,我倒希望她别这么大方。

source_text(原文): A difficult term to define, where the [[Cross]]-nature manifests. Perhaps better to say that he will advance.
translation_zh(译文): 一个难以定义的说法,尤其当[[介壳种]]本性显现时。或许更妥当的说法是,他将继续前行。

source_text(原文): She has Icarian sympathies. This place, I think, is touched by the Incorporates. Is there any... friction?
translation_zh(译文): 她有伊加利亚主义的同情倾向。这个地方,我觉得,沾染着集团的气息。可有什么……龃龉吗?

source_text(原文): I should not discuss the health of other guests. But I can say that there is some reason for optimism.
translation_zh(译文): 我不该谈论其他客人的健康状况。但我可以说,有理由乐观。

source_text(原文): This is a place of healing and refuge, M. Hobson. A house of science.
translation_zh(译文): 这是处疗愈与庇护之所,霍布森先生。一栋科学的宅邸。

source_text(原文): Is she a patient, or an experimental subject?
translation_zh(译文): 她是病人,还是实验对象?

source_text(原文): I find it more fruitful not to limit myself to narrowly binary ontologies.
translation_zh(译文): 我发现,不把自己局限在狭隘的二元本体论里,更有收获。

source_text(原文): A charming young woman with, I dare say, unsuspected depths.
translation_zh(译文): 一位迷人的年轻女子,我敢说,藏着出人意料的深邃。

source_text(原文): Very well. Tell me what comes to mind when I say each of these things.
translation_zh(译文): 很好。听我说出这些词，告诉我你各自想起什么。

source_text(原文): She's staff, or a patient, or...?
translation_zh(译文): 她是职员,还是病人,还是……?

source_text(原文): The doctor observes my dressing gown.
Interesting. Did you wear this to offer defiance, perhaps? Or is it a token of intimacy?
translation_zh(译文): 有意思。你穿这个,是为了挑衅,也许?还是亲昵的凭证?

source_text(原文): 'Hour.' You believe in these 'Hours'? These 'secret gods'?
translation_zh(译文): 「司辰。」你相信这些「司辰」？这些「隐秘之神」？

source_text(原文): Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit - [[Skills]] - sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua. Ut enim ad minim veniam, quis nostrud exercitation ullamco laboris nisi ut aliquip ex ea commodo consequat...
translation_zh(译文): Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit - [[技艺]] - sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua. Ut enim ad minim veniam, quis nostrud exercitation ullamco laboris nisi ut aliquip ex ea commodo consequat……

source_text(原文): Duis aute irure dolor in reprehenderit in voluptate velit esse cillum dolore eu fugiat nulla pariatur. Excepteur sint occaecat cupidatat non proident, sunt in culpa qui officia deserunt mollit anim id est laborum.
translation_zh(译文): Duis aute irure dolor in reprehenderit in voluptate velit esse cillum dolore eu fugiat nulla pariatur. Excepteur sint occaecat cupidatat non proident, sunt in culpa qui officia deserunt mollit anim id est laborum.

source_text(原文): Tell me about your dream. The dream of the stair.
translation_zh(译文): 跟我讲讲你的梦。楼梯之梦。

source_text(原文): It's not the worst. But it's not much fun.
translation_zh(译文): 不是最糟的。但也不怎么愉快。

source_text(原文): I'm high up - very high up. There is a flight of stairs, stretching down into the dark. It is light by torches. Someone will come. I will guard against them...
translation_zh(译文): 我在高处——很高的地方。有一段楼梯，向下延伸进黑暗。火把照亮着它。会有人来。我得防着他们……

source_text(原文): When I've spent the day as my outer self, I don't dream about it.
translation_zh(译文): 当我以「外在的我」度过一整天，便不会梦见它。

source_text(原文): 'Your outer self'. We will talk more about that later. But for now, tell me the dream.
translation_zh(译文): 「你的外在自我。」这个我们稍后再详谈。眼下，先讲那个梦。

source_text(原文): The dream of the wood. I don't like the dark.
translation_zh(译文): 树林之梦。我不喜欢黑暗。

source_text(原文): We will need to speak of it later. But let's not make you suffer today. It is such a lovely morning... tell me about the dream of the stair.
translation_zh(译文): 我们改日再谈它。今天就不让你受罪了。多么可爱的早晨……给我讲讲楼梯之梦吧。

source_text(原文): [HOROMACHISTRY] 'He cannot be stilled; he demands the dance; he is beaten, like a drum.'
translation_zh(译文): 司辰学。「他无法静止；他渴求舞蹈；他遭人敲打，如同鼓面。」

source_text(原文): Then you don't provide any... little luxuries... for Strathcoyne?
translation_zh(译文): 这么说，你从不为斯特拉斯科因提供任何……小小的奢侈……？

source_text(原文): [Aubière draws a slip of printed paper from his pocket and passes it to me.] Here is the proof of it. Now. I propose to put this sordid matter behind us. I look forward to speaking of happier things.
translation_zh(译文): 奥比埃从口袋里掏出一张印刷纸条，递给我。这就是证据。现在，我提议把这桩不光彩的事抛到脑后。我盼着谈些更愉快的事。

source_text(原文): Do you ever make use of the black market, Doctor?
'Black market'. It's a diffuse concept, is it not? Of course one makes certain... informal transactions. But nothing that would interest the authorities.
translation_zh(译文): 「黑市。」这是个含混的概念，不是吗？当然，人难免会做某些……非正式的买卖。但绝无会让当局感兴趣的事。

source_text(原文): Cut it out, Aubière. You're taking back-handers from Strathcoyne to get him Cuban cigars.
translation_zh(译文): 别装了，奥比埃。你从斯特拉斯科因那儿收好处费，替他搞古巴雪茄。

source_text(原文): [Say nothing; place a cigar carefully on Aubière's desk; shake my head regretfully.]
translation_zh(译文): 一言不发；把一支雪茄轻轻放在奥比埃的桌上；遗憾地摇摇头。

source_text(原文): Aubière picks up the cigar and runs it under his nose, smiling his smile of scrupulous cleanness.
translation_zh(译文): 奥比埃拿起雪茄，放到鼻下嗅了嗅，露出他那副一丝不苟的干净笑容。

source_text(原文): But it is a such a little sin, is it not, M. Hobson? I hardly think you would wish to waste the time of the police with this. And I am a man of some standing in Antibes.
translation_zh(译文): 可这是多么微小的罪过，不是吗，霍布森先生？我想，你总不至于想为这点事浪费警察的时间。何况，我在昂蒂布也算有些声望。

source_text(原文): But your Incorporate masters might take a dim view of your private operations.
translation_zh(译文): 但你的集团主子们，怕是会对你的私下勾当大为不满。

source_text(原文): A very little sin. And I'm sorry that I've come to you in this sordid way. Tell me what I need to know, and we need never speak of it again.
translation_zh(译文): 一个非常微小的罪过。我也抱歉，以这般不光彩的方式来找你。告诉我我想知道的，我们便再也不用提起此事。
[遗憾地叹口气,更遗憾地耸耸肩,然后等着。]
谎话。「轰雷之皮？」我从没听说过。

source_text(原文): [[Nina Lagasse]]. And whatever cash you might have in that desk of yours.
translation_zh(译文): [[尼娜·拉加斯]]。还有你那张书桌里可能放着的现钞。

source_text(原文): [Dr Aubière's smile falters; it becomes tinged with sorrow. But he opens a drawer and places a crisp wad of notes on to the desk.] There. As to the other matter...
translation_zh(译文): [奥比埃医生的笑容微微僵住,染上一丝哀色。但他还是拉开抽屉,把一沓崭新的钞票放到桌上。]钱在这。至于另一件事……

source_text(原文): Mlle Lagasse travels with a circus. She left it to come here; she left here to catch up with it. The name of the circus was Rosa Mundi, and its next destination was the city of Mimata. That is as much as I know.
translation_zh(译文): 拉加斯小姐跟着一个马戏团四处巡游。她离开马戏团来到此地;离开此地,是为了赶回去。那马戏团名叫罗莎·蒙迪,下一站是米玛塔城。我所知道的,仅此而已。

source_text(原文): Of course, Doctor. I'm sorry to have troubled you.
translation_zh(译文): 当然,医生。打扰您了,抱歉。

source_text(原文): M. Hobson, I have lost a trinket. A little silver coin I'm certain it was on my desk when we spoke. Do you know what might possibly have happened to it?
translation_zh(译文): 霍布森先生,我丢了件小玩意儿。一枚小小的银币,我记得咱们说话的时候它还放在我桌上。你知道它可能上哪儿去了吗?

source_text(原文): Come now, doctor. I have my quirks, but I've never been a petty thief. [Smile amiably.]
translation_zh(译文): 得了吧,医生。我确实有些怪癖,但从来不做小偷小摸的事。[和气地笑了笑。]
[摆出英国人的派头]真的?[顿了顿]真的!

source_text(原文): Interesting. An effect of the Wars, you know. As the onteiric order crumbles, it becomes much easier to lose things. I'm astonished I have any socks left at , for instance.
translation_zh(译文): 有意思。战争的效应,你知道。太虚的秩序一旦崩解,丢东西就容易得多。我倒很惊讶自己现在还能剩几双袜子呢,比如说。

source_text(原文): Humm. I'm sorry to have troubled you. I'm sure it's somewhere. It's probably somewhere.
translation_zh(译文): 唔。打扰你了,抱歉。肯定在什么地方。大概在什么地方吧。
唔。我想我们总会知道的。

source_text(原文): [Return the silver spintria.]I apologise. I submitted to an ignoble impulse.
translation_zh(译文): [归还那枚银币。]我道歉。我屈从于一念之鄙。

source_text(原文): The Thunderskin is the Heart Relentless: the Hour that preserves.
translation_zh(译文): 轰雷之皮即不息之心：那位守护的司辰。

source_text(原文): Oh! Well. Thank you. It is forgotten.
translation_zh(译文): 哦!好吧。谢谢你。这事就翻篇了。

source_text(原文): What shall we talk about today?
I have reconsidered, Monsieur Hobson. I am ready to tell you where you might find her.
translation_zh(译文): 我重新考虑过了,霍布森先生。我准备告诉你去哪儿找她。

source_text(原文): I wonder - I wonder if you find it comforting, perhaps. I mean that in these times, all of us must make hard choices - decisions about where to take our lives. While you are so fixated on Mme Lagasse, you do not need to consider other matters. You are like a questing knight, perhaps, freed from the quotidian.
translation_zh(译文): 我在想——我在想,这或许令你安心。我的意思是,在这年月,我们谁都得做出艰难的选择——决定要把人生带向何方。而当你如此专注地追着拉加斯夫人,就不必再考虑别的事了。你就像一位行侠的骑士,也许,摆脱了尘世的琐屑。

source_text(原文): For the time being, I think we have said all there is to say on that matter.
translation_zh(译文): 就眼下而言,我想这件事我们已经把话都说完了。

source_text(原文): 'A questing knight. Yes. I like that.
translation_zh(译文): “一位行侠的骑士。”不错。我喜欢这个说法。

source_text(原文): I don't want to answer that just now.
Not so very much older? I wish that's how I felt.
translation_zh(译文): 没老太多?我倒希望自己真有这种感觉。

source_text(原文): An unresolved thread, [q=alias.formal.fr]. We saw each other last in Paris, when you had but recently completed your service with the Légion du Seuil. You gave me your uniform to tend and mend. You also ordered a new suit of clothes.
translation_zh(译文): 一桩悬而未决的线头,[q=alias.formal.fr]。我们最后一次见面是在巴黎,那时您刚从门关军团服役归来。您把制服交给我浆洗缝补,还订了一套新西装。

source_text(原文): [Preen] Oh, you know, one does one's best.
translation_zh(译文): [得意地理了理衣襟] 哦,您知道的,尽力而为罢了。

source_text(原文): I was mistaken? Well, my sight is not what it was.
translation_zh(译文): 是我认错了人?唉,我的眼力已大不如前。

source_text(原文): Tweed-grey eyes, steady behind the spectacle lenses.
translation_zh(译文): 一双粗花呢灰的眼睛,沉稳地居于镜片之后。

source_text(原文): No, thank you. Those days are best forgotten.
translation_zh(译文): 不了,谢谢。那些日子,最好忘掉。

source_text(原文): We keep a small stock of other goods. Perhaps you'd like to see that? Or discuss a commission?
translation_zh(译文): 我们还有一小批别的货品。您要不要看看?或者谈一谈定制?

source_text(原文): I met a man in Venice once who liked to say that the past was a foreign country...
translation_zh(译文): 我在威尼斯曾遇见过一个人,他喜欢说,过去是异国他乡……

source_text(原文): If everything is long ago, everything is foreign. Even the country of my birth, now.
translation_zh(译文): 若一切都已遥远,则一切都成异乡。如今,连我出生的国度也不例外。

source_text(原文): You were born in the Republic, you mean? You are a stranger in the State?
translation_zh(译文): 您的意思是,您生在共和国?在这邦国里,您是异乡人?

source_text(原文): I never mix business with politics. A rule of long standing. Very useful, this last decade. Now: shall we do business?
translation_zh(译文): 我从不把生意与政治混为一谈。这是多年的规矩。过去这十年,尤其受用。好了:我们谈生意吧?

source_text(原文): You knew me as Spencer Hobson.
translation_zh(译文): 您认识的我是斯宾塞·霍布森。

source_text(原文): You knew me as Sylvain Huissier.
translation_zh(译文): 您认识的我是西尔万·韦西耶。

source_text(原文): Forgive me, [q=alias.formal.fr], but there is something about you that recalls... the abandoned chocolate-box. The colours are bright, the corners square, the lid only a little askew. But one senses an absence.
translation_zh(译文): 恕我直言,[q=alias.formal.fr],您身上有某种东西让我想起……一盒被遗弃的巧克力。色彩鲜亮,棱角方正,盒盖只是微微歪斜。但人感觉得到,里面空了。

source_text(原文): I should not, perhaps, have raised the matter. I hope I have not offended.
translation_zh(译文): 也许,我不该提起这件事。希望没有冒犯到您。

source_text(原文): On the basis of our long acquaintance, I asked for nothing on account. In these many years, I abandoned the matter of the new suit: I apologise. However. I believe I have your old uniform here, in the back.
translation_zh(译文): 念在咱们多年相识的份上,这笔账我从未催讨过。这些年来,新西装的事我也搁下了:我很抱歉。不过。我想,您那套旧制服还在这儿,在后屋。

source_text(原文): The repairs are complete. A small sum is payable.
translation_zh(译文): 修补已经完工。还有一小笔钱待付。

source_text(原文): [q=alias.formal.fr]. Welcome back. How may I assist you today?
translation_zh(译文): [q=alias.formal.fr]。欢迎回来。今天有什么能为您效劳?

source_text(原文): I will consider it second-hand inventory, then. Should you change your mind before I find a buyer, let me know.
translation_zh(译文): 那么,我就把它当作二手存货处置了。若在我找到买主之前您改变了主意,请告诉我。

source_text(原文): Not 'kept', really. The Janviers are dispersed across the Continent, now. We sold our premises in the Republic, just last month. A number of long-abandoned items were sent on to me. Fortuitous.
translation_zh(译文): 谈不上「留着」,真的。如今雅维埃一家已散居欧陆各处。就在上个月,我们卖掉了共和国那边的店铺。许多被弃置多年的物件,辗转寄到了我手上。也是凑巧。

source_text(原文): Later, perhaps. Until then, M. Janvier: this has been a pleasant surprise.
translation_zh(译文): 改日再说吧。在那之前,雅维埃先生:这真是一场愉快的意外。

source_text(原文): When first I came in, you said that I reminded you of someone you knew long ago...
translation_zh(译文): 我进门时,您说我想起您很久以前认识的一个人……

source_text(原文): I believe I said exactly that, yes. Is there... something to discuss?
translation_zh(译文): 我想,我说的正是这句话,是的。有什么……要谈的吗?

source_text(原文): I understand. A little peculiar, it occurs to me, that one thinks aloud, but that one speaks to oneself. Not 'speaks silently'. No?
translation_zh(译文): 我明白。我忽然觉得有几分奇特:人说是「自言自语」,却说是「出声地思考」,而非「无声地说话」。不是吗?

source_text(原文): A philosopher? In the State? No no, that would not be at all suitable.
translation_zh(译文): 哲学家?在这邦国里?不不,那可太不合适了。

source_text(原文): 'Silence is silver. Speech is a wound.'
'Speech is a shadow of truth; but by our shadows we are discovered.'
translation_zh(译文): 「言语是真理的影子;而我们,正是凭自己的影子被人认出。」

source_text(原文): Acute advice, monsieur. I shall stow it beneath my heart.
translation_zh(译文): 先生指点精辟。我会把它收进心底。

source_text(原文): Pithy, monsieur. Would that be Meillet? Bréal? But I am diverting you from your purchases. I apologise.
translation_zh(译文): 言简意赅,先生。这话莫不是出自梅耶?布雷亚尔?不过,我怕是耽误您选购了。抱歉。

source_text(原文): You remind me, monsieur, of a man I knew long ago. Before the Wars.
translation_zh(译文): 先生,您让我想起一位故人,那是我很久以前认识的。大战之前。

source_text(原文): No matter. How may I assist you?
translation_zh(译文): 无妨。有什么能为您效劳?

source_text(原文): M. Janvier. The streets of Antibes are wounded. There are cold abysses of silvered darkness.
translation_zh(译文): 雅维埃先生。昂蒂布的街道受了伤。横着几道泛银幽暗的冰冷深渊。

source_text(原文): Yes. I often pass them on my constitutional walk. 'Janvier,' I say to myself. 'These are bad times. I had never expected to outlive any city that I called home.'
translation_zh(译文): 是啊。我常常在散步时从它们旁边经过。「雅维埃,」我对自己说,「这是艰难的时世。我从未想过,自己会活得比我称之为家的每一座城市都久。」

source_text(原文): Then I reflect on the last round of bad times. And the time before that. And the time before... and so I shrug. I complete my constitutional. I am not a repairer of abysses, but only of garments.
translation_zh(译文): 然后,我便回想上一轮的坏时世。再上一轮。再上一轮……于是我便耸耸肩,走完这趟散步。我不是修补深渊的人,只是修补衣裳的人。

source_text(原文): You don't wonder why they're there?
translation_zh(译文): 您就不奇怪,它们为何会在那里?

source_text(原文): I thank you for the admiration, [q=alias.formal.fr].
I assume they are expressions of fundamental incompatibility between distinct modes of being. Note their locations: on the border between two versions of Antibes.
translation_zh(译文): 我猜想,它们是不同存在方式之间根本性不相容的显现。请注意它们的位置:正处在两个版本的昂蒂布交界之处。

source_text(原文): Well, everything is long ago, since the Wars.
translation_zh(译文): 唉,自大战以来,一切都已很遥远了。

source_text(原文): M. Janvier. It's good to see you again.
translation_zh(译文): 雅维埃先生。又见到您,真好。

source_text(原文): Yes. Yes, I did. But it's been... ten years? More? You look very different. But not so very much older.
translation_zh(译文): 是的。是的,我们见过。但那已是……十年前?或许更久?您看起来判若两人。不过,倒也没老太多。

source_text(原文): The victories are notable for being (a) numerous and (b) overwhelming.
translation_zh(译文): 这些胜利之所以引人注目,在于(一)数目众多,(二)势不可挡。

source_text(原文): A number of sheep, and a smaller number of goats, have returned triumphantly from the summer pastures and won local livestock competitions.
translation_zh(译文): 若干绵羊,以及数目略少的山羊,已从夏季牧场凯旋,赢得了当地的牲畜比赛。

source_text(原文): The writer notes that no Republican sheep (or goats) have won anything, although he doesn't specify whether this is because Republican animals are effete, or just ineligible.
translation_zh(译文): 作者指出,没有共和国的绵羊(或山羊)赢得任何奖项——尽管他没有说明,这是因为共和国的牲畜过于孱弱,还是仅仅不合参赛资格。

source_text(原文): The winning animals have been skilfully photographed from angles chosen to emphasise their noble ovine (or caprine) profiles.
translation_zh(译文): 获奖牲口均被巧妙拍摄,取景角度刻意突出它们尊贵的绵羊(或山羊)侧影。

source_text(原文): THE SHEAF. Dated 2nd November? As so often, now, the precise date resists the eye.
translation_zh(译文): 《禾捆报》。日期是十一月二日?如今,精确的日期总是不肯映入眼帘,一如近来屡见的情形。

source_text(原文): Headline: A NOOSE AROUND BERLIN! The Ministries shackle the free necks of West Berlin with a merciless BLOCKADE! Starving citizens implore heaven for help!
translation_zh(译文): 头版头条:柏林颈上的绞索!联盟以无情的封锁扼住西柏林自由之颈!饥饿的市民向苍天祈求援助!

source_text(原文): The Allies answer! The mighty air forces of the Incorporates and the State rain down bounteous plenty on the suffering citizenry!
translation_zh(译文): 盟国回应!集团与邦国的强大空军向受苦的市民倾洒丰饶的物资!

source_text(原文): Even the English - and even the effete secessionaries of the Republic - have belatedly joined the effort, although they rely on the State and the Incorporates to provide the cargo, so feeble are their own economies...
translation_zh(译文): 连英格兰人——甚至共和国那些孱弱的分离派——也姗姗来迟地加入其中,尽管他们要仰赖邦国与集团提供货物,自家经济实在太孱弱了……

source_text(原文): [Read about numerous overwhelming victories in Indochina.]
translation_zh(译文): [阅读关于印度支那诸多压倒性胜利的报道。]

source_text(原文): Thankfully, the State bears the burden of the war in the former colonial possessions of poor lost France. Ergo, the victories continue.
translation_zh(译文): 幸而,邦国在可怜的、已然沦亡的法国昔日的殖民地上扛起了战争的担子。因此,胜利仍在继续。

source_text(原文): Better than I feared; less subtle than I remembered.
translation_zh(译文): 比我担心的要好;比我记忆中的更不含蓄。

source_text(原文): A many-storyed hospital populated by masked eccentrics. Any adept would recognise it as the [[Mansus]].
translation_zh(译文): 一座有许多层楼的大医院,住满了戴面具的怪人。任何修士都会认出这是[[漫宿]]。

source_text(原文): The old woman who masquerades as the Pilgrim's mother. Her attributes strongly suggest the [[Vagabond]].
translation_zh(译文): 那个伪装成巡礼者母亲的老妇人。她的种种特质强烈地指向[[浪游旅人]]。

source_text(原文): I wanted pyrotechnics for the ending The stage manager overruled me. Probably for the best.
translation_zh(译文): 结尾我本想要烟花效果。舞台经理否决了我。或许这样最好。

source_text(原文): Long may his reputation survive without further tarnish.
translation_zh(译文): 愿他的名声长存，而且别再添新的污点。

source_text(原文): May he jolly well sort everything out!
translation_zh(译文): 愿他赶紧把这一切都收拾妥当！

source_text(原文): This is in order. You may go about your business, monsieur. Unless there was something else?
translation_zh(译文): 证件没有问题。您可以去办自己的事了，先生。还有别的事吗？

source_text(原文): Acceptable, I suppose. Was there anything else?
translation_zh(译文): 我想还算可以。还有别的事吗？

source_text(原文): This appears to be in order, Monsieur Hobson. Unless there was something else?
translation_zh(译文): 这份证件看起来没有问题，霍布森先生。还有别的事吗？

source_text(原文): This document would be satisfactory... except that you told me, earlier, that your name was [q=alias.last]. This is an entirely different name.
translation_zh(译文): 这份文件本来可以通过……可您先前告诉我，您的姓是[q=alias.last]。这上面完全是另一个名字。

source_text(原文): I am not familiar with... well, yes, hm...
Well, we cannot choose where we are born. [A snuffle of hilarity.] Let me see.
translation_zh(译文): 唉，人没法选择自己出生在哪里。[他忍俊不禁地哼了一声。] 让我看看。

source_text(原文): [q=alias.last]? I can't honestly call to mind anyone of that name  - you mean me? No no no - I'm afraid you must have me confused with someone else. I know how busy are the Milice.
translation_zh(译文): [q=alias.last]？说实话，我完全想不起有谁叫这个名字——你说的是我？不不不——恐怕您把我跟别人弄混了。我知道法国民兵很忙。

source_text(原文): ...perhaps, after all, you're right. Very well.
I'm certain that was the name you gave.
translation_zh(译文): 我很确定你当时说的就是这个名字。

source_text(原文): [q=alias.last]? Excuse me - do I look like a [q=alias.last]?
I think that in fact you do.
I have no excuses. I can only throw myself upon the mercy of the State.
translation_zh(译文): 我无话可辩。只能请求邦国宽恕。

source_text(原文): Léon looks surprised, then delighted. He unfastens his truncheon from his belt.
translation_zh(译文): 莱昂先是一惊，随即喜出望外。他解开腰间警棍的扣带。

source_text(原文): [Shrug] Lock me up, if you like.
In the name of the State, I place you under arrest! Come with me, immediately.
translation_zh(译文): 以邦国之名，我宣布逮捕你！立刻跟我走！

source_text(原文): Andrée, the bookseller, has a quieter business than books - she sells goods forbidden by the laws of the State. Search her shop and you'll find proof.
translation_zh(译文): 书商安德烈,有一门比卖书更安静的生意——她贩卖邦国法令禁止的货物。搜一搜她的店,您就能找到证据。

source_text(原文): [Follow Léon as far as the edge of the square... then feint sideways and make a dash for it.]
translation_zh(译文): [跟着莱昂走到广场边缘……然后突然向侧面虚晃一步，拔腿就跑。]

source_text(原文): [Career round a corner, arrow towards an alley...]
Splash through a puddle - turn my ankle in a hidden hole -
translation_zh(译文): 踩进水洼——脚踝在一个看不见的坑里猛地一扭——
[愤怒地叫出声。踉跄着继续跑。]

source_text(原文): [Bite my lip to stay silent. Limp onwards.]
translation_zh(译文): [咬住嘴唇不出声。一瘸一拐继续跑。]

source_text(原文): Léon cries out in exultation, but already he's panting. Hobbled as I am, I'm still faster.
translation_zh(译文): 莱昂兴奋地大叫，可他已经开始喘了。就算我腿脚受伤，还是比他快。

source_text(原文): I heard Linou express clear Republican sympathies.
translation_zh(译文): 我听见利努明确流露出共和派的同情。

source_text(原文): His bellows are lost in thunder. The windows stay closed. The streets stay empty.
translation_zh(译文): 他的吼声被雷鸣吞没。窗户紧闭，街道依旧空无一人。

source_text(原文): Léon knows the streets, and I don't. But I'm still faster.
translation_zh(译文): 莱昂认得这些街巷，我不认得。但我依然更快。

source_text(原文): But once, whispers the coming night, you were too slow.
translation_zh(译文): 可将至的夜低声提醒：曾经有一次，你太慢了。

source_text(原文): [Out through the rain-curtain, into bright sunlight.]
Out of the square; down a narrow street to the back of a hulking building.
translation_zh(译文): 冲出广场；沿一条窄街跑到一栋庞然大楼的背后。

source_text(原文): I'm looking for someone. A woman.
translation_zh(译文): 我在找一个人。一个女人。

source_text(原文): Léon unlocks a grilled door and gestures.
translation_zh(译文): 莱昂打开一扇带铁栅的门，做了个手势。

source_text(原文): Here's a mean little door, badly painted in distemper-yellow.
translation_zh(译文): 这里有一扇寒酸的小门，刷着劣质的灰泥黄漆。

source_text(原文): Through the door into a concrete corridor lined with ratty carpet and lit by a single bulb. Far off, an electric bell rings twice.
translation_zh(译文): 穿过门，是一条混凝土走廊，铺着破旧地毯，只靠一只灯泡照明。远处，一只电铃响了两声。

source_text(原文): Not a cell. But not a hotel room. Windowless, with stacked chairs, stacked crates, a stack of yellowing newspapers on a tilted tabletop.
translation_zh(译文): 不是牢房。可也不像旅馆客房。没有窗，椅子摞着椅子，木箱叠着木箱，一摞发黄的报纸斜堆在桌面上。

source_text(原文): My colleagues and I - we will teach you respect.
translation_zh(译文): 我和同僚们——会教会你什么叫尊重。

source_text(原文): Rattling his keys with ceremonious delight, Léon locks the door behind me.
translation_zh(译文): 莱昂郑重其事、喜气洋洋地晃着钥匙，把我锁在门后。

source_text(原文): [Listen to his footsteps retreat down the corridor.]
Near-silence. A burst of incoherent yelling from somewhere upstairs.
translation_zh(译文): 几乎一片寂静。楼上某处忽然爆出一阵听不清内容的叫喊。

source_text(原文): The light-bulb fizzes faintly. Léon is definitely gone.
translation_zh(译文): 灯泡发出轻微的滋滋声。莱昂肯定已经走了。

source_text(原文): In this place, the sound is flat as stale water.
translation_zh(译文): 这个地方的声音扁平得像一潭馊水。

source_text(原文): The door swings open. No-one in the corridor.
Not such a bad chap, that Darlan.
translation_zh(译文): 达尔朗这人其实没那么坏。

source_text(原文): Try to lock me in, will you? Cretins.
Léon shakes his head vaguely. He tilts his head as if he can hear martial music. Above, the flag snaps in the rising wind.
translation_zh(译文): 莱昂茫然地摇了摇头。他歪过脑袋，像是听见了军乐。头顶上，旗帜在渐强的风里猎猎作响。

source_text(原文): The rain has drowned the joy of it. Or perhaps Léon just has no imagination at all.
translation_zh(译文): 雨水把其中的喜悦全浇没了。也可能莱昂根本毫无想象力。

source_text(原文): Perhaps he's weeping. With the rain, it's difficult to be sure.
translation_zh(译文): 也许他在哭。雨这么大，很难分辨。

source_text(原文): I suppose then you must be a man of means - a respectable man. You may bring me your papers later.
translation_zh(译文): 那我想，您一定是位有财力的体面人。以后再把证件拿给我看就行。

source_text(原文): Bah. Bah! Did you think to frighten the Milice?
translation_zh(译文): 呸。呸！你以为能吓住法国民兵？

source_text(原文): Invariably. On this side of town.
translation_zh(译文): 一向如此。城这一边总下。

source_text(原文): And on the other side of town?
[Insincere] And you out here on duty? I'm sorry.
translation_zh(译文): [假惺惺] 你还得在这种天气里执勤？真遗憾。

source_text(原文): [Sincere] And you out here on duty? I'm sorry.
translation_zh(译文): [真诚] 你还得在这种天气里执勤？真遗憾。

source_text(原文): If I hear anything, I'll let you know.
translation_zh(译文): 要是听到什么，我会告诉你。

source_text(原文): If I bring you this kind of information... will you help me find [[Nina Lagasse]]?
translation_zh(译文): 如果我给你带来这类情报……你会帮我找到[[尼娜·拉加斯]]吗？

source_text(原文): Most certainly. The State rewards loyalty.
A young man blinks resentfully through the curtain of rain running off his cap.
translation_zh(译文): 一个年轻人,从帽檐淌下的雨帘后,满腹怨气地眨着眼。

source_text(原文): [Put as much distance between me and the Milice place as quickly as possible.]
translation_zh(译文): [尽快离法国民兵的据点越远越好。]

source_text(原文): [Keep my movements slow, moving out of town into the quieter areas of the Cap d'Antibes.]
translation_zh(译文): [放慢动作，离开城区，走向昂蒂布海岬较为幽静的地带。]

source_text(原文): [Through glistening streets, beneath blinded windows, past scar and wailing stone, and into the sun on the other side of town.]
translation_zh(译文): [走过泛光的街道，经过闭目般的窗户、伤疤与哀鸣的石头，最终从城市另一头走进阳光。]

source_text(原文): [Move on, up the leaf-dappled slope between stately trees, to a pair of iron gates.]
translation_zh(译文): [继续前行，沿庄严树木之间那条洒着叶影的坡道向上，来到一对铁门前。]

source_text(原文): [On the wall beside the gate, a white bird sits: an albino crow? It cocks its head at me and blinks a gem-black eye.]
translation_zh(译文): [大门旁的墙上停着一只白鸟：白化乌鸦？它歪头看我，宝石般漆黑的眼睛眨了一下。]

source_text(原文): It launches itself into the air, and flaps off in the direction of the building behind the gates.
translation_zh(译文): 它振翅飞起，朝铁门后方的建筑飞去。

source_text(原文): 'In the name of the [[Beach-Crow]], who opens the earth, who sees what is lost...'
translation_zh(译文): “以[[滩鸦]]之名——祂开启大地，祂看见失落之物……”

source_text(原文): 'In the name of the [[Ivory Dove]], who cannot be deceived, who calls each of the Dead by name...'
translation_zh(译文): “以[[骨白鸽]]之名——祂不受欺瞒，祂逐一唤出每一位死者之名……”

source_text(原文): Well... I know an omen when I see one.
translation_zh(译文): 嗯……看见预兆的时候，我总认得出来。

source_text(原文): Thank you, Milicien. But I just want to be close to you. [Simper.]
translation_zh(译文): 谢谢你，民兵先生。不过我只是想靠你近一点。[娇笑。]

source_text(原文): Hm... so here we are at the heart of the matter.
translation_zh(译文): 嗯……这就说到问题的核心了。

source_text(原文): An aristocratic name. In fact, 'François' is the Admiral's first name.
translation_zh(译文): 一个贵族气的名字。事实上，“弗朗索瓦”正是那位海军上将的名字。

source_text(原文): [Consider my papers - what do I have?]
[I have no papers I'm willing to show the milicien.]
translation_zh(译文): [我没有愿意给这个民兵看的证件。]

source_text(原文): Apparently, the matter of my papers has been forgotten.
translation_zh(译文): 看来，我证件的问题已经被忘掉了。

source_text(原文): In the name of the State! Stop!
[Stop. Raise my hands and smile disarmingly.] Well, for the State...
translation_zh(译文): [停下。举起双手，露出讨好的笑容。] 好吧，既然是为了邦国……

source_text(原文): Léon seizes my arm, glaring, to drag me back the other way.
translation_zh(译文): 莱昂瞪着我，一把抓住我的胳膊，要把我往回拖。

source_text(原文): [Saunter towards the building, whistling 'Land of Hope and Glory'.]
translation_zh(译文): [悠闲地朝大楼走去，嘴里吹着《希望与荣光之地》。]
[悠闲地朝大楼走去，嘴里吹着《达芙妮》。]

source_text(原文): Beyond the gates, a sign reads SANITARIUM AUJOURD'HUI.
translation_zh(译文): 铁门后的一块牌子上写着：今日疗养院。

source_text(原文): It's done. The State thanks you.
There are... abysses of night... in Antibes.
translation_zh(译文): 有……黑夜的深渊……在昂蒂布。

source_text(原文): Shouldn't someone... put up some sort of sign?
translation_zh(译文): 难道就不该有人……立块什么警示牌吗？

source_text(原文): A strong state discourages frivolous chatter.
translation_zh(译文): 强大的国家会遏止轻浮的闲言碎语。

source_text(原文): Pff. The wise walk round them. Drunks and imbeciles do not. The State loses nothing but dross.
translation_zh(译文): 啧。聪明人会绕着走。醉鬼和白痴不会。邦国损失的也不过是渣滓。

source_text(原文): If you search the cafe - Chez Felix - you'll find a store of illicit goods.
translation_zh(译文): 如果你搜查那间咖啡馆——费利克斯之家——会找到一批违禁品。

source_text(原文): I suspected as much. For a while now, I have had my eye on that woman.
translation_zh(译文): 我早就有所怀疑。那个女人，我已经盯了一阵子了。

source_text(原文): Linou at the café is selling real coffee. In secret.
translation_zh(译文): 咖啡馆里的利努在偷偷卖真正的咖啡。

source_text(原文): You are prepared to testify, if we need you later? Publicly, in court?
translation_zh(译文): 以后有需要时，你会出庭作证吧？公开地，在法庭上？

source_text(原文): No. I would prefer to remain anonymous.
Disappointing. Return when you have found your courage.
translation_zh(译文): 令人失望。等你找回勇气再来。

source_text(原文): Mme Zèlia - in the park - tried to commission me to place a curse on another citizen.
translation_zh(译文): 泽莉亚夫人——公园里那位——想雇我给另一位公民下诅咒。

source_text(原文): Secondly, the law does not recognise 'curses'. But the law does recognise fraud. I will give you an example of fraud. Let us say some ferret-faced foreigner promised Mme Badat he could lay a 'curse' for her, in exchange for money. I hope you did not accept money from her?
translation_zh(译文): 第二，法律并不承认什么“诅咒”。但法律承认诈骗。举个诈骗的例子吧。假设有个雪貂脸的外国人向巴达夫人保证，只要给钱，他就能替她下“诅咒”。我希望你没有从她那里收钱？

source_text(原文): Firstly, that is Zèlia Badat you speak of - a patriot and a woman of excellent family. Watch what you say.
translation_zh(译文): 第一，你说的是泽莉亚·巴达——一位爱国者，也出身于优秀家庭。说话小心。

source_text(原文): Of course not. But she seems a little confused. Someone else might take advantage. I thought you should know.
translation_zh(译文): 当然没有。不过她似乎有点糊涂。别人可能会趁机占她便宜。我觉得该让你知道。

source_text(原文): Quite a lot, actually, but I've already spent it. Were you hoping for a bribe? Sorry!
translation_zh(译文): 其实收了不少，不过我已经花掉了。你是想收贿赂吗？抱歉！

source_text(原文): For a moment, it looks as if Léon might burst entirely out of his uniform.
translation_zh(译文): 有那么一瞬间，莱昂看起来几乎要整个人从制服里炸出来。

source_text(原文): A ubiquitous and generic sort of name. Léon sneezes sceptically.
translation_zh(译文): 一个随处可见、普通得不能再普通的名字。莱昂将信将疑地打了个喷嚏。

source_text(原文): [I don't want to show him my papers. Make a show of searching for them.]
translation_zh(译文): [我不想给他看证件。装模作样地翻找一阵。]

source_text(原文): [Confidently] I'm a guest of the State. If you'd like, you can detain me while we establish that beyond doubt. But I wouldn't recommend it.
translation_zh(译文): [自信] 我是邦国的贵宾。你愿意的话，可以先把我扣下来，再去彻底核实这件事。不过我不建议你这么做。

source_text(原文): [Wink. Begin to whistle a martial tune. Drum my fingers on the Bewitching tool.]
translation_zh(译文): [眨眨眼。开始吹一段军乐口哨。手指在魅惑工具上敲出节奏。]

source_text(原文): But I would like to make a contribution to the Milice. Forty francisques.
translation_zh(译文): 不过我倒愿意给法国民兵捐点钱。四十法兰西斧币。

source_text(原文): I'm afraid I've come out without any form of identification.
translation_zh(译文): 恐怕我出门时没带任何身份证明。

source_text(原文): I have no more time for your insolences. Go away.
translation_zh(译文): 我没时间再听你这些无礼之言。走开。

source_text(原文): Here - I'm a citizen of the State.
I wondered whether I could be of any assistance to the Milice. I have experience as a private inquiry agent.
translation_zh(译文): 我在想，自己能不能为法国民兵出一份力。我做过私人调查员。

source_text(原文): Interesting. Most interesting. Yes. Bring me the names of malcontents, and I will bestow upon you a little gift. Five hundred francisques.
translation_zh(译文): 有意思。非常有意思。可以。把不满分子的名字交给我，我会给你一份小礼物。五百法兰西斧币。

source_text(原文): The State is generous, to pay so freely for information.
translation_zh(译文): 邦国真慷慨，为情报出手这么大方。

source_text(原文): The State is generous. But this is my personal initiative, you see? I use my own funds to incentivise public service. When the information is accurate, my service is recognised.
translation_zh(译文): 邦国当然慷慨。不过你看，这是我的个人行动。我拿自己的钱来激励公共服务。只要情报准确，我的功劳就会得到认可。

source_text(原文): And when the information is not accurate? I have two names to give my superiors. So beware! Milice Léon has learnt to sniff out lies.
translation_zh(译文): 要是情报不准确呢？那我就有两个名字可以交给上级。所以小心！民兵莱昂已经学会闻出谎言的味道了。

source_text(原文): The Milice, monsieur, does not offer such a service. Remove your lusts to the houses of tolerance.
translation_zh(译文): 先生，法国民兵不提供这种服务。请把你的欲望带去合法妓院解决。

source_text(原文): It is sad. In all honesty, I am not surprised. She has always been insolent, that Linou. But now, we have someone to testify for us, should it be necessary - no?
translation_zh(译文): 真可悲。说实话，我并不意外。那个利努向来无礼。不过现在，若有必要，我们总算有人可以作证了——不是吗？

source_text(原文): Perhaps I might take my payment in kind? Information, I mean?
translation_zh(译文): 也许我可以用实物收取报酬？我是说，用情报。

source_text(原文): I'll need to consult with my superiors. Wait here.
translation_zh(译文): 我得请示上级。你在这里等着。

source_text(原文): I'm looking for a woman - [[Nina Lagasse]]. I wonder if the Milice knows where to find her.
translation_zh(译文): 我在找一个女人——[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。我在想，法国民兵会不会知道去哪儿找她。
拉加斯。你有她的外貌描述吗？

source_text(原文): Where she goes, she is remembered.
translation_zh(译文): 她去过的地方，人们都会记住她。

source_text(原文): Wait... Lagasse. She is a widow?
translation_zh(译文): 等等……拉加斯。她是个寡妇？

source_text(原文): Perhaps she is in mourning, yes.
I know exactly. You will find her at the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui, past the park.
translation_zh(译文): 我知道了。你会在今日疗养院找到她，就在公园那边。

source_text(原文): But you will be respectful when you call upon the Sanitarium. The director is a man of importance. Do not let me hear of you causing difficulties.
translation_zh(译文): 不过你去疗养院拜访时必须保持礼貌。院长是个重要人物。别让我听说你在那里惹了麻烦。

source_text(原文): And do not mention the name of Milicien Léon.
translation_zh(译文): 也别提民兵莱昂的名字。
谢谢你，民兵先生。还有一件事……

source_text(原文): I mentioned earlier that I'm looking for a woman named [[Nina Lagasse]]...
translation_zh(译文): 我之前提过，我在找一个叫[[尼娜·拉加斯]]的女人……

source_text(原文): No no - I mean that I'm trying to locate an acquaintance. Nina Lagasse.
translation_zh(译文): 不不——我的意思是，我在找一位熟人。尼娜·拉加斯。

source_text(原文): Of course. I apologise for the misunderstanding.
Nevertheless. In my private capacity... when I am off duty... I can make introductions for you. Girls of a generous temperament. With their papers of good health, all up to date.
translation_zh(译文): 不过，以我的私人身份……等我下班以后……我倒可以替你介绍。性情慷慨的姑娘。健康证明一应俱全，而且都在有效期内。
[莱昂看起来有一点失望，随即又振作起来。]

source_text(原文): Neither does the Milice serve as an office of information.
translation_zh(译文): 同样，法国民兵也不充当情报处。

source_text(原文): Does it often rain like this, here?
Most kind, Milicien. I'll bear it in mind.
translation_zh(译文): 太客气了，民兵先生。我会记着的。

source_text(原文): Here - I'm a citizen of the Republic.
Here - I'm a subject of her Majesty.
translation_zh(译文): 这里——我是女王陛下的臣民。

source_text(原文): May his boots always be the shiniest.
translation_zh(译文): 愿他的靴子永远擦得最亮。

source_text(原文): I wanted to talk about malcontents in Antibes. You had mentioned a little gift?
translation_zh(译文): 我想谈谈昂蒂布的不满分子。您提过,有份小礼物?

source_text(原文): We have no conveniences here for patrons. There is a vespasienne in the Rue Racine.
translation_zh(译文): 本店没有供客人方便的设施。拉辛街有一处公共小便池。

source_text(原文): The door to the kitchen? A sign reads 'PRIVATE'.
translation_zh(译文): 通往厨房的门?牌子上写着 '闲人免进'。

source_text(原文): If I want in, I'll have to wait until the proprietress is distracted. Next time she bends below the bar, perhaps.
translation_zh(译文): 若想进去,我得等老板娘分了神才行。或许下次她弯腰到吧台下面时,就是个机会。

source_text(原文): [Wait for the shadows to deepen before I step through to the kitchen.]
translation_zh(译文): [等阴影渐浓,再迈步进入厨房。]

source_text(原文): [Wait. Employ a little magic of transgression to enter the kitchen.]
translation_zh(译文): [等着。动用一点逾越的魔法进入厨房。]

source_text(原文): [Wait. When Linou is distracted, exit stage right.]
translation_zh(译文): [等着。趁利努分神之际,从舞台右侧退场。]

source_text(原文): The proprietress raises her head suddenly as I step towards the door.
translation_zh(译文): 我朝门口迈步时,老板娘猛地抬起了头。

source_text(原文): In the Provence of seven hundred years away, a nobleman leaves a greyhound to protect his infant heir. On his return, the child is absent and the greyhound's jaws are stained with blood. In rage and terror, the father kills the dog. Then they hear the child's cry, and find it under the cradle... along with the monstrous serpent that Guinefort has slain.
translation_zh(译文): 在七百年前的普罗旺斯,一位贵族留下一条灵缇,守护他襁褓中的子嗣。他归来时,孩子不见了,灵缇的嘴边染着血迹。在狂怒与恐惧之中,父亲杀死了那条狗。随后,他们听见了孩子的哭声,在摇篮底下找到了他……旁边,躺着那条被吉内福尔杀死的巨蛇。

source_text(原文): It upset me then, and it moved me now.
translation_zh(译文): 那时它令我不安,如今它令我动容。

source_text(原文): It intrigued me for years. The story shows up everywhere in different dress. A wolfhound in Wales. A pet bear in Spain. In Georgia, it's a panther...
translation_zh(译文): 它让我着迷了好些年。这个故事穿着不同的衣裳,出现在各处。在威尔士,它是一只猎狼犬。在西班牙,它是一只宠物熊。在格鲁吉亚,它成了一头豹……

source_text(原文): And that, Guinefort, is why before you risk any good deeds, you always make sure you know who'll get the credit.
translation_zh(译文): 而这,吉内福尔,正是为什么在你冒险行善之前,总要先弄清楚:功劳会落在谁头上。

source_text(原文): A good lesson. If you're going to die, die right.
translation_zh(译文): 好教训。如果终究要死,就死得其所。

source_text(原文): A complicated lesson. The [[Wolf Divided]] - the Hour of rage and pain - incarnate in a wounded dog. A great kindness turned to horror. Over the years, the story has sown a whole crop of heretics.
translation_zh(译文): 复杂的教训。[[裂分之狼]]——愤怒与痛苦之[[司辰]]——化身于一条受伤的狗。一桩天大的善举,转成了恐怖。这些年来,这个故事播下了整整一茬异端。

source_text(原文): A wounded greyhound wrestles with serpents, eyes blazing.
translation_zh(译文): 一条受伤的灵缇与群蛇搏斗,双目灼灼。

source_text(原文): 'The Church,' once wrote the magus Julian Coseley, 'makes sinners of saints and saints of dogs.' He had a point.
translation_zh(译文): 「“教会,”术士朱利安·科斯利曾写道,“把圣徒变成罪人,把狗变成圣徒。”他说得在理。」
圣吉内福尔。一则如画的民间传说。
圣吉内福尔。一则有力的寓言。

source_text(原文): Father Thaddaeus told us that story in the seminary minor, in Paris. It must be forty years ago, now.
translation_zh(译文): 达陡神父在巴黎的小修院里给我们讲过这个故事。如今想来,该有四十年了。

source_text(原文): I can't quite recall when I first heard the tale...
translation_zh(译文): 我记不太清,第一次听到这个故事是在什么时候……

source_text(原文): Father Simeon told us that story in the seminary minor, in Paris. It must be forty years ago, now.
translation_zh(译文): 西默盎神父在巴黎的小修院里给我们讲过这个故事。如今想来,该有四十年了。

source_text(原文): Over the clean notes of the wind from under the world, there's a pungency - carbide? bitumen? Not quite either. For a moment, a shape wavers at the edge of my vision: like a woman, if a woman could melt and smear.
translation_zh(译文): 自世界之下吹来的风,带着清冽的音调;而在其上,还有一股刺鼻的气味——碳化物?沥青?又都不尽然。有那么一瞬,一个轮廓在我视野边缘摇曳:像一个女人,如果女人可以融化、洇散的话。

source_text(原文): Over the clean notes of the wind from under the world, there's a faint but pungent pong - bitumen? Carbide? Not quite either. Then it's gone.
translation_zh(译文): 自世界之下吹来的风,带着清冽的音调;而在其上,还有一股隐约却刺鼻的气味——沥青?碳化物?又都不尽然。然后,它消失了。

source_text(原文): This is a wound and a door. Skolekosophy and Nyctodromy will find uses here.
translation_zh(译文): 这是一道伤口,也是一扇门。蠕虫学与夜游术,在这里大有用武之地。

source_text(原文): Beyond a prosaic and ragged edge of earth: a gulf, blue descending to black.
translation_zh(译文): 在平淡而参差的土地边缘之外:一道深渊,蓝色渐沉入黑。

source_text(原文): Spencer. Darling. We miss you. We're cold. We miss you -
translation_zh(译文): 斯宾塞。亲爱的。我们想念你。我们好冷。我们想念你——

source_text(原文): No answer. The shape is gone.
translation_zh(译文): 没有回答。那个轮廓已经不见了。

source_text(原文): They remember, the night observes; they remember.
translation_zh(译文): 它们还记得,夜在旁观;它们还记得。

source_text(原文): Stars? No. You'd find those in the sky. Or, occasionally, in Russia. These are something below the earth.
translation_zh(译文): 星星?不。星星要到天上去找。偶尔,也可以在俄国找到。而这些东西,在大地之下。

source_text(原文): As I watch, one light winks out. Then another.
translation_zh(译文): 我看着,一盏灯火熄灭了。接着又是一盏。

source_text(原文): A little breath of winter in the air.
translation_zh(译文): 空气中,有一缕冬的气息。
一段鲜亮的回忆被唤醒……
一段遥远的回忆被唤醒……
一段红白相间的回忆泛起……
「店方为造成的不便深表歉意。」

source_text(原文): For a practitioner of Hushery or Illumination, this place is an opportunity.
translation_zh(译文): 对静默术或照明术的修行者而言,此地正是一个机会。

source_text(原文): Near one shelf in the corner of the shop, the crackling of the rain is less audible. Even my footsteps are softer. A sign on the shelf reads SILENCE.
translation_zh(译文): 店角的某个书架附近,雨声的噼啪变得隐约。连我的脚步声都轻了几分。书架上立着一块牌子,写着 '肃静'。

source_text(原文): [Run fingers over the autobiography of a stage magician: SMOKE GHOST.]
translation_zh(译文): [指尖拂过一位舞台魔术师的自传:《烟中鬼影》。]

source_text(原文): [Run fingers over a slim religious treatise: Aquinas, on optics and temperance.]
translation_zh(译文): [指尖拂过一册薄薄的宗教论著:阿奎那论光学与节制。]

source_text(原文): [Run fingers over a semi-medical textbook: STILLING THE HEART.]
translation_zh(译文): [指尖拂过一册半医学的教科书:《止息心跳》。]
