source_text(原文): [Run fingers over a volume of commentary on eighteenth-century drama. LES PIÈCES MUETTES - 'The Speechless Plays']
translation_zh(译文): [指尖拂过一册十八世纪戏剧评注。《无声诸剧》——'无言之剧'。]

source_text(原文): Every book there was written by someone alive when the war began, dead when it ended.
translation_zh(译文): 那里的每一本书,作者都在战争开始时活着,在战争结束时死去。

source_text(原文): The books in the graveyard are for display only. Not for sale.
translation_zh(译文): 墓园里的书只供陈列,一概不卖。

source_text(原文): The shadowless light of the sun-cross chandelier above, the perpetual fire of the Unconquered Sun, the underwater glow of the stained glass windows, all make the altar bright.
translation_zh(译文): 头顶太阳十字吊灯的无影之光、不败之日的恒久之火、彩绘玻璃窗那水底般的幽光,共同将祭坛映得明亮。

source_text(原文): This is the altar I once served...
translation_zh(译文): 这是我曾侍奉过的祭坛……

source_text(原文): One trained in the secret doctrines of the Church - Horomachistry, Illumination, Ithastry - could work tiny wonders here.
translation_zh(译文): 受过教会秘传教义训练的人——司辰学、照明术、盗火术——能在此施展微小的奇迹。

source_text(原文): It took me too long to realise what balls it all was.
translation_zh(译文): 我花了太久,才看穿这一切全是胡扯。

source_text(原文): It still means something - but now it means something different.
translation_zh(译文): 它依然意味着什么——但如今,它意味着的是别的东西。

source_text(原文): [Pick up the book on the altar.]
HORIZON, the poster reads. And below, in words from several languages: SUN - SEA - NIGHT - LINE - MORNING.
translation_zh(译文): 海报上写着「地平线」。下方,用好几种语言写着:太阳 - 大海 - 夜晚 - 线 - 清晨。

source_text(原文): This is a crafting venue. Crafting is one of the more complicated parts of the game. You might want to come back once you've played more of the tutorial and gathered some Memories and Influences. But it's up to you.
translation_zh(译文): 这里是炼制场所。炼制是游戏中较为复杂的部分之一。等你玩过更多教程、收集到一些回忆与影响之后,不妨再回来。不过,一切由你决定。

source_text(原文): Nyctodromy, Horomachistry, Birdsong: once I'd have gone to a crossroads to call them up. But this is just as good.
translation_zh(译文): 夜游术、司辰学、鸟鸣学:从前,我会到十字路口去召唤它们。不过,这里也一样合用。

source_text(原文): A well-used Rosières gas cooker in chipped cream enamel.
translation_zh(译文): 一台久经使用的罗西耶尔煤气灶,奶白色搪瓷上磕出了豁口。

source_text(原文): This is a crafting venue. Crafting is one of the more complicated bits of the game, and you might want to come back once you've gathered a few Memories and Influences. But it's up to you.
translation_zh(译文): 这里是一处炼制场所。炼制是游戏里较为复杂的环节之一,你或许想等攒下几段回忆与影响之后再来。不过,由你决定。

source_text(原文): [High and perilous knowledge?? Show me, now!]
translation_zh(译文): [高深而危险的知识??现在就让我看看!]

source_text(原文): Serious adepts might sniff at the idea of kitchen rituals. But practitioners of Preservation know better. And Ithastry might be a high art, but you can get a lot done over an ordinary gas flame.
translation_zh(译文): 一本正经的修士或许会对厨房里的仪式嗤之以鼻。但保存术的修习者心里有数。盗火术或许是门高深的技艺,可在寻常的煤气火焰上,也能做成许多事。

source_text(原文): [Turn my face up to the sun. Close my eyes.]
A moment of peace beneath the swaying leaves. Then back to the world.
translation_zh(译文): 摇曳的枝叶之下,一瞬安宁。然后,回到这个世界。

source_text(原文): Like picnics, the Arts Unconsidered - Bosk, Birdsong, Preservation - do well out in the open air. Unlike picnics, they're safer as a solitary practice.
translation_zh(译文): 与野餐一样,未识技艺——丛林学、鸟鸣学、保存术——在开阔的露天里也大有可为。与野餐不同的是,它们独自修习时更为安全。

source_text(原文): TO OUR DEAD, 1914-1919. Dark years, and darkness hangs here like smoke.
translation_zh(译文): 「致吾等逝者,1914-1919。黑暗的岁月,黑暗如烟,至今悬垂于此。」

source_text(原文): My first war, that. I was a chaplain with the Dorsetshires. In different times, I'd never have been attached so young.
translation_zh(译文): 那是我的第一场战争。当时,我是多塞特团的随军牧师。若在别的时代,我绝不会那么年轻就被编入团中。

source_text(原文): The arts of Bosk, of Hushery, of Skolekosophy are best worked in shadow.
translation_zh(译文): 丛林学、静默术、蠕虫学这些技艺,最宜在暗影之中施展。
一段回忆,缓缓舒展开来……

source_text(原文): And tucked away at the back... a tin of coffee. Three-quarters full.
translation_zh(译文): 而在最里面……藏着一听咖啡。还剩四分之三。

source_text(原文): Surprisingly fresh, especially for the coffee-less wilderness of post-war Europe. It's an imported British brand. She must have connections... or she must be a connection herself.
translation_zh(译文): 出乎意料地新鲜,尤其是在战后欧洲这片没有咖啡的荒原上。是个进口的英国牌子。她必定有些门路……或者,她自己就是个门路。

source_text(原文): Better not mention this in the café.
translation_zh(译文): 这件事最好别在店里提起。

source_text(原文): [I've already learnt all I can here.]
translation_zh(译文): [这里我能了解的,都已了解了。]

source_text(原文): Perhaps she's buying stolen goods. Perhaps a supplier has lent her the fridge to keep his stock fresh. Either way, it suggests black market connections.
translation_zh(译文): 也许她在收购赃物。也许有供货商把冰箱借给她,好让自己的存货保持新鲜。无论哪种情形,都说明她与黑市有所牵连。
冰箱的压缩机嗡嗡地响着,一副不耐烦的模样。

source_text(原文): Butter, milk, lard, rillettes... well-stocked for these narrow times.
translation_zh(译文): 黄油、牛奶、猪油、肉酱……在这物资匮乏的年月,算得上储备充足。

source_text(原文): A sleek Swedish Electrolux model. Lux indeed. There can't be many of these in Antibes. It's out of place in the humble kitchen. How did the proprietress afford it?
translation_zh(译文): 一台线条流畅的瑞典伊莱克斯型号。确实是 '奢' 如其名。昂蒂布城里这样的冰箱恐怕屈指可数。放在这间朴素的厨房里,实在格格不入。老板娘是怎么买得起的?

source_text(原文): Warm at the back, cold inside. Progress.
translation_zh(译文): 背后温热,里面冰凉。这就是进步。

source_text(原文): It's safer and wiser not to stand out too much.
translation_zh(译文): 不显山露水，更安全，也更明智。

source_text(原文): Who cares? There are more important things than being important.
translation_zh(译文): 谁在乎呢？有比「出人头地」更重要的东西。

source_text(原文): [You've rejected this Passion. If you act similarly again, you'll have the opportunity to reconsider - as long as you still have a free Passion slot.]
translation_zh(译文): 「你已摒弃这项激情。若你再次做出类似之举，将有机会重新考虑——只要你还有空余的激情位。」

source_text(原文): [You have resolved to follow your Ambition. Although people change. Especially Spencer Hobson.]
translation_zh(译文): 「你已决心追随自己的野心。尽管人会改变。尤其是斯宾塞·霍布森。」

source_text(原文):
Ambition - the desire to be higher than those around me - because I rise, or because they fall. Ambitious choices are often profitable; notable; dangerous.

[Evolve this Passion to Ambition, which contributes Forge and Grail to your Aspect Pool.]
translation_zh(译文):
野心——凌驾于身边众人之上的渴望——或因为我攀升，或因为他们坠落。野心勃勃的选择往往有利可图；引人注目；危险重重。

〔将这项激情进化为野心，它将为你的性相池增添铸与杯。〕

source_text(原文): Perhaps later. In my own time. [Keeps the evolution option open, for now.]
translation_zh(译文): 也许以后吧。按我自己的节奏来。〔进化选项暂且保留。〕

source_text(原文): Some people just exist. Others strive. That's me.
translation_zh(译文): 有些人只是活着。另一些人奋力向上。我就是后者。

source_text(原文): Yes. I'm on the way to becoming something greater.
translation_zh(译文): 是的。我正走在通往更伟大的路上。

source_text(原文): Is there something that distinguishes me from other people?
translation_zh(译文): 可有什么东西让我与旁人不同？

source_text(原文): Oh yes. They'll remember my name for a long, long time.
translation_zh(译文): 哦，当然。他们会记住我的名字，很久很久。

source_text(原文): Europe just had a nasty lesson in what can happen when people start thinking like that.
translation_zh(译文): 欧洲刚刚上了一堂惨痛的课：人们一旦开始那样想，会落得什么下场。

source_text(原文): Heal, grow, change, I suppose. Those all seem like good options.
translation_zh(译文): 疗伤、成长、改变，我想。这些看起来都是不错的选择。

source_text(原文): I'm not going to waste time worrying about that. Take each day as it comes.
translation_zh(译文): 我才不会浪费时间为此烦恼。过好每一天就是了。

source_text(原文): [Your Anger burns furiously now. Although people change. Especially Spencer Hobson.]
translation_zh(译文): 「你的愤怒如今熊熊燃烧。尽管人会改变。尤其是斯宾塞·霍布森。」

source_text(原文):
Angry choices can be cruel; they can be just; sometimes they're even prudent; but they're never gentle.

[Evolve this Passion to Anger, which contributes Edge and Forge to your Aspect Pool.]
translation_zh(译文):
愤怒的选择可能残酷；也可能公正；有时甚至谨慎；但永远不会温柔。

〔将这项激情进化为愤怒，它将为你的性相池增添刃与铸。〕

source_text(原文): Later, perhaps. [Keeps the evolution option open, for now.]
translation_zh(译文): 以后再说，也许。〔进化选项暂且保留。〕

source_text(原文): I can't forget the injustice of what was done to me.
translation_zh(译文): 我无法忘记自己所遭受的不公。

source_text(原文): I'm going to make sure that everyone understands what it means to cross me.
translation_zh(译文): 我要让所有人都明白，与我为敌意味着什么。

source_text(原文): I've had a rough time of it, these last years. It could get rougher.
translation_zh(译文): 这些年我过得很艰难。以后可能更难。
我会让他们见识见识什么叫「艰难」。

source_text(原文): Well, look around. Everyone's had a rough time. You live with it, or you go under.
translation_zh(译文): 瞧瞧四周吧。谁都不容易。要么忍受，要么沉沦。

source_text(原文): [You're surrendering to your Appetite. Although people change. Especially Spencer Hobson.]
translation_zh(译文): 「你正臣服于自己的欲望。尽管人会改变。尤其是斯宾塞·霍布森。」

source_text(原文):
Emptiness is there to be filled. Appetite-focused choices are invariably selfish and often delightful.

[Evolve this Passion to Appetite, which contributes Edge and Grail to your Aspect Pool.]
translation_zh(译文):
虚空存在，便是为了被填满。以欲望为重的选择总归自私，却常常令人愉快。

〔将这项激情进化为欲望，它将为你的性相池增添刃与杯。〕

source_text(原文): Later, perhaps. Let's savour the thought. [Keeps the evolution option open, for now.]
translation_zh(译文): 以后再说，也许。先细细品味这个念头。〔进化选项暂且保留。〕

source_text(原文): Delight; pleasure; satisfaction; sensation; and more.
translation_zh(译文): 欢愉；享乐；满足；感官的刺激；还有更多。

source_text(原文): There are more important things than what I want.
translation_zh(译文): 有比我想要的更重要的东西。

source_text(原文): It's rarely wise to attract the attention of the Milice.
translation_zh(译文): 引起法国民兵的注意,鲜有什么明智可言。

source_text(原文): The headlights burn; the engine rumbles.
[Keep my eyes on the ground; don't draw attention.]
The driver turns his head, eyes steady under the gamma-badge cap of the State Milice, and meets my gaze for a moment.
translation_zh(译文): 司机转过头来——邦国民兵队饰着伽马徽章的帽檐下,目光沉稳——与我对视了片刻。

source_text(原文): In the French State, it's best to avoid the attention of men who keep watch at stations.
translation_zh(译文): 在法兰西邦国,最好别引起那些守在车站的人注意。

source_text(原文): Andrée, battling the Milice with Dadaist disorientation?
translation_zh(译文): 安德烈,以达达主义式的错乱对抗民兵团?

source_text(原文): Is Andrée sending a coded message?
translation_zh(译文): 安德烈是在传递某种密语吗?

source_text(原文): 'This establishment affirms and can prove that it HAS NEVER BEEN OPEN'.
translation_zh(译文): '本店郑重声明,并可以证明:本店从未营业'。

source_text(原文): It reminds me of the [[Horned-Axe]]. But no-one puts a secret god on their flag. And double-bladed axe symbols are nothing unique. A coincidence, no more.
translation_zh(译文): 它让我想起[[双角斧]]。但没有人会把一位隐秘之神放在自己的旗帜上。何况双刃斧的图案并不稀罕。不过是巧合,仅此而已。

source_text(原文): It reminds me of the [[Horned-Axe]]. But no-one puts a secret god on their flag. Double-bladed axe symbols are nothing unique. It must be a coincidence.
translation_zh(译文): 它让我想起[[双角斧]]。但没有人会把隐秘之神放在旗帜上。双刃斧的图案并不稀罕。想必只是巧合。

source_text(原文): France is divided. Antibes is divided. The Axe is the [[Hour]] of division.
translation_zh(译文): 法国四分五裂。昂蒂布四分五裂。而斧就是分裂的[[司辰]]。

source_text(原文): It's never so simple as cause and effect. The [[Hours]] no more intervene in human affairs than the wind intervenes in the trees. But -
translation_zh(译文): 事情从不那么简单,简单到归结为因果。[[司辰]]们之于人事,并不比风之于树木干预更多。但是——

source_text(原文): No scholar of the invisible arts takes coincidence at face value.
translation_zh(译文): 研习无形之术的学者,从不把巧合的表面价值当真。

source_text(原文): 'As above, so below,' an old friend used to say when he came back from seeing a man about a dog.
translation_zh(译文): '如其在上,如其在下,'一位老友每次办完一桩语焉不详的差事回来,总爱这样说。

source_text(原文): Frost in winter; sounds loudest at night; in a riven world, the Horned-Axe prominent.
translation_zh(译文): 冬有霜;夜之声最响;在四分五裂的世间,双角斧赫然在目。

source_text(原文): The tricoloured French flag - but the central band is marked with the francisque, the starry double-axe which has become the emblem of the French [[State]].
translation_zh(译文): 法国三色旗——只是中间的条纹上饰有法兰西斧,这把缀星双头斧已成为法国[[邦国]]的徽记。

source_text(原文): [Flags. Everyone gets so excited about flags.]
translation_zh(译文): [旗帜。人人都为旗帜激动不已。]

source_text(原文): [You are Compassionate, now. Although people change. Especially Spencer Hobson]
translation_zh(译文): 「如今，你心怀悲悯。尽管人会改变。尤其是斯宾塞·霍布森。」

source_text(原文):
Compassionate actions put someone else's interests ahead of my own.

[Evolve this to Compassion, which contributes Heart and Rose to your Aspect Pool.]
translation_zh(译文):
心怀悲悯之举，是将他人利益置于自身利益之上。

〔将其进化为悲悯，它将为你的性相池增添心与引。〕

source_text(原文): Something to think about. [Keeps the evolution option open, for now.]
translation_zh(译文): 值得想一想。〔进化选项暂且保留。〕

source_text(原文): ...and I can't stand it; and I can help.
translation_zh(译文): ……而我无法袖手旁观；而我力所能及。

source_text(原文): ...and every moment we spend to relieve it is a moment spent well.
translation_zh(译文): ……而我们为缓解它付出的每一刻，都算没有虚度。

source_text(原文): There's so much pain in the world.
translation_zh(译文): 这世上的痛苦何其之多。

source_text(原文): ...bloody awful, isn't it? Let's get stuck in.
translation_zh(译文): ……糟糕透顶，不是吗？那就出手相助吧。

source_text(原文): ...but I have other things to worry about.
Dark shapes move beneath the surface - more like spreading stains than fish.
translation_zh(译文): 暗影在水面下移动——与其说是鱼,不如说更像正在扩散的污渍。

source_text(原文): Something seeping through. Everywhere leaks now. The [[Bureau]] must be overwhelmed.
translation_zh(译文): 有什么正在渗漏过来。如今处处都在渗漏。[[防剿局]]想必早已应接不暇。

source_text(原文): Something undefined about the shapes. Are they moving? Drifting? They never quite resolve. An acrid odour wafts from the water.
translation_zh(译文): 这些暗影有某种难以名状之处。它们在移动吗?在漂流吗?它们从未真正成形。一股刺鼻的气味从水面飘来。

source_text(原文): The mirror shows a completely different room - a larger shop - in late evening or early twilight.
translation_zh(译文): 镜中映出的是另一间完全不同的屋子——一间更大的店铺——时值黄昏将尽,或暮色初临。

source_text(原文): My old premises in Paris. The last summer I was there.
translation_zh(译文): 我在巴黎的旧铺面。我在那里的最后一个夏天。

source_text(原文): The mirror is useless for any practical purpose. But it is difficult now to find a working mirror. And it will help me remember, when my wits finally fail me.
translation_zh(译文): 这面镜子于任何实际用途而言都毫无用处。但如今,想找到一面还能用的镜子并不容易。而且等我终有一日神志不清时,它能帮我记起从前。

source_text(原文): A great many years from now!
translation_zh(译文): 那还要再过上许多许多年!

source_text(原文): Janvier's old premises in Paris, he said. The last summer he was there.
translation_zh(译文): 他说,那是雅维埃在巴黎的旧铺面。他在那里的最后一个夏天。

source_text(原文): The Book of Suns, the [[Church]]'s holiest text.
translation_zh(译文): 《太阳之书》,[[教会]]最神圣的经文。

source_text(原文): The name itself is a reminder that the Sun is divided yet indivisible; constant but ever-changing.
translation_zh(译文): 这书名本身便提醒着:太阳分裂而不可分,恒常而无常。

source_text(原文): [Read resonantly from the Book: let my voice echo.]
translation_zh(译文): [朗声诵读圣书:让我的声音回荡。]

source_text(原文): 'No thing in or beneath Heaven hath only one Nature, and no thing that hath two Natures may keep one from joining with another; therefore I say unto you, that even the [[Wolf Divided]] is forgotten not by the [[Sun]].'
translation_zh(译文): '天上地下,无物只具一性;凡具两性之物,不能阻其一与另一相合;因此我告诉你们:即便是[[裂分之狼]],也不为[[太阳]]所遗忘。'

source_text(原文): This is the Sanctioned Version of the Book of Suns. A little unusual. The Received Version is more common on the continent. But the Sanctioned Version, with its message of the Sun's approaching rebirth, is more optimistic. Perhaps the priest here hopes to uplift his flock.
translation_zh(译文): 这是《太阳之书》的钦定版。多少有些不同寻常。欧陆上更常见的是通行版。但钦定版传达着太阳临近重生的讯息,更为乐观。或许这里的教士是想提振他的信众。

source_text(原文): A controversial passage in... I forget whether it was the Received or Sanctioned Version, and the binding is plain, without clues.
translation_zh(译文): 一段颇有争议的段落出自……我记不清是通行版还是钦定版,书封朴素,全无线索。

source_text(原文): Gleaming cream and chrome. General Electric, one of the very brightest [[Incorporates]].
translation_zh(译文): 奶白与铬银，闪闪发光。通用电气——最耀眼的一批[[集团]]之一。

source_text(原文): Hey, help yourself, it's cool. Talk when you're finished?
translation_zh(译文): 嘿，随便拿，别客气。吃完了咱们再聊？

source_text(原文): 'The Light of the World.' Holman Hunt's controversial but radiant depiction of the Shepherd-Illuminate as the [[Watchman]]'s avatar.
translation_zh(译文): 「世界之光。」霍尔曼·亨特那幅备受争议却光辉夺目的画作，将启明之牧者描绘为[[守夜人]]的化身。

source_text(原文): [Craft] Holy enough for a man in a hurry.
translation_zh(译文): [炼制] 对行色匆匆之人，已足够神圣。

source_text(原文): Something that was here has been erased by shadow. A map? A painting?
translation_zh(译文): 原本在此的某样东西,被阴影抹去了。一幅地图？一幅画？

source_text(原文): Leave that alone, you ridiculous man. I'm much more exciting and ten times as bright.
translation_zh(译文): 别碰那东西,你这荒唐的男人。我可比它有趣得多,也要明亮十倍。

source_text(原文): There's nothing there for you, and be glad of that. Come talk to Sinombre, you poor silly thing.
translation_zh(译文): 那里没有你要的东西,你该为此庆幸。过来和西诺姆布尔聊聊吧,你这可怜的小傻瓜。

source_text(原文): The shadow is its own kind of substance. It almost drips darkness.
translation_zh(译文): 那阴影自有其质地。它几乎在滴淌黑暗。

source_text(原文): The grass here ripples with life, like a well-kept horse in a sunray.
translation_zh(译文): 此处的草叶如波浪般起伏,生机盎然,像一匹养得油亮的马立在日光之中。

source_text(原文): The woman in the chair is watching me curiously. I should at least speak to her before I begin interfering with her floor.
translation_zh(译文): 椅中的女人正好奇地看着我。在我开始动她的地板之前,至少该先同她说句话。

source_text(原文): A good place for the Arts Unconsidered.
translation_zh(译文): 施展未识技艺的好地方。

source_text(原文): [Leave the Verdant Place alone for the moment.]
[You're following your Curiosity wherever it might lead. Although people change. Especially Spencer Hobson.]
translation_zh(译文): 「你正追随自己的好奇，无论它将通往何方。尽管人会改变。尤其是斯宾塞·霍布森。」

source_text(原文):
If there's one thing every adept has in common with every scholar... Curious choices are not necessarily wise.

[Evolve this Passion to Curiosity, which contributes Lantern and Knock to your Aspect Pool.]
translation_zh(译文):
如果说每位修士与每位学者有什么共同之处……好奇的选择未必明智。

〔将这项激情进化为好奇，它将为你的性相池增添灯与启。〕

source_text(原文): I should be sure I've considered all the other options... [Keeps the evolution option open, for now.]
translation_zh(译文): 我得先确认自己考虑过所有其他选项……〔进化选项暂且保留。〕

source_text(原文): Curiosity. If I never know, just how much will I care?
translation_zh(译文): 好奇。若我永远不得而知，我究竟会在意多少？

source_text(原文): Vapour softens the air, fogs the window-glass, beads greedily on the tiling.
translation_zh(译文): 蒸汽润软了空气，模糊了窗玻璃，贪婪地凝成水珠缀满瓷砖。

source_text(原文): Increase the flow from the hot tap.
Write my name in the fog on the glass.
translation_zh(译文): 在窗玻璃的雾气上写下我的名字。

source_text(原文): At last it's ready. Vapours coil from the clear water like angel snake ghosts.
translation_zh(译文): 终于备好了。蒸汽自清水盘旋而起，如天使与蛇的幽魂。

source_text(原文): The departing water swirls, gurgles, and leaves for the sea.
translation_zh(译文): 流走的水打着旋，汩汩作响，奔赴大海。

source_text(原文): In the corner of the room: a massive bathtub. A minimalist brass mixer tap; Parisian bath salts; clean, warm, fluffy, towels.
translation_zh(译文): 房间一角：一只巨大的浴缸。极简的黄铜混水龙头；巴黎浴盐；干净、温暖、蓬松的毛巾。

source_text(原文): Why not? the night asks. It's not as if you have anything important to do.
translation_zh(译文): 何妨一试？夜色问道。反正你也没什么要紧事可做。

source_text(原文): The bath-water cools gently. At some point, I wrinkle. At last, the bath-water is entirely cold, and the joy of it is gone.
translation_zh(译文): 浴水缓缓变凉。不知何时，我的皮肤起皱了。终于，浴水彻底冷透，那份欢愉也荡然无存。

source_text(原文): I really don't need another bath just yet. [Step away.]
translation_zh(译文): 我现在真的还不需要再泡一次澡。[走开。]

source_text(原文): Bath time! [Take full advantage of this luxury.]
translation_zh(译文): 泡澡时间到！[尽情享受这份奢侈。]

source_text(原文): A cheering rush of hot water, and the air begins to cloud with steam.
translation_zh(译文): 热水欢腾奔涌，空气渐渐笼上蒸汽。

source_text(原文): I've changed my mind. [Empty the bath and step away.]
translation_zh(译文): 我改主意了。[放掉浴水，转身走开。]

source_text(原文): I've wanted a hot bath since I got off that damned train. No - since Milan. [Turn on the taps!]
translation_zh(译文): 自从下了那该死的火车，我就想泡个热水澡。不——自从米兰。[拧开水龙头！]

source_text(原文): A cheering rush of hot water! I remembered to put the plug in, just in time.
translation_zh(译文): 热水欢腾地奔涌而出！我赶在最后时刻想起塞上了塞子。

source_text(原文): A blissful period of entirely nothing. The rail-grime, the soot and sweat, is gone.
translation_zh(译文): 一段全然放空的幸福时光。旅途的尘垢、煤烟与汗渍，尽数洗去。

source_text(原文): I don't really want a bath just now. [Step away.]
translation_zh(译文): 眼下我实在不想泡澡。[走开。]

source_text(原文): At last... it's time to get out.
Wait impatiently as the water rises.
Like the cracking of a chrysalis. Like the sting of a Severian strigil.
translation_zh(译文): 如蛹壳迸裂。如塞维里亚刮身板的刺痛。

source_text(原文): The crawling feel of half-grown whiskers -like dirt beneath the nails or tinny music half-heard - until it's gone, the aggravation is almost imperceptible.
translation_zh(译文): 半长胡茬带来的爬搔感——像指甲缝里的污垢，或隐约可闻的刺耳乐声——不到消失之时，这份烦扰几乎不可察觉。

source_text(原文): And now I look my best.
I wonder what I'd look like with Dundrearies? Or a neat little goatee?
translation_zh(译文): 不知蓄起邓德雷里式长鬓须，会是什么模样？或者一把整齐的小山羊胡？

source_text(原文): Better, perhaps, that we never know.
translation_zh(译文): 或许，永不知晓反而更好。

source_text(原文): Watch out, discerning ladies and judicious gentlemen.
translation_zh(译文): 当心了，眼光独到的女士们，通达明智的先生们。

source_text(原文): I've wanted a shave since I got off that damned train. No. Since Milan.
translation_zh(译文): 自从下了那该死的火车，我就想刮个脸。不。自从米兰。

source_text(原文): I could come back here later, if I need a shave.
translation_zh(译文): 以后若需刮脸，我还可以回到这里。

source_text(原文): Hot water. Steam. Shaving cream. This is civilisation.
translation_zh(译文): 热水。蒸汽。剃须膏。这才是文明。

source_text(原文): A mirror of bright silver returns my reflection with perfect fidelity. It does show me standing in a bombed-out version of the bathroom - one wall missing, plumbing dangling from the brickwork like angled entrails - but since the Wars, one learns not to be distracted by that kind of thing.
translation_zh(译文): 一面亮银色的镜子忠实映出我的倒影。镜中确实映出我站在一间遭轰炸的浴室里——少了一面墙，水管自砖墙垂落，如歪斜的肠子——但战争之后，人便学会了不被这类景象分心。

source_text(原文): If only I had razor blades...
translation_zh(译文): 要是有剃刀刀片就好了……

source_text(原文): A few minutes with blade, cream, and hot water, before I feel both cleaner and sharper.
translation_zh(译文): 与刀片、剃须膏和热水相伴几分钟，我便觉得既洁净，又利落。

source_text(原文): My summer suit! Made to measure; cut for lighter climates. Linen shirt and patch-pocket trousers, and a striped half-lined blazer.
translation_zh(译文): 我的夏装!量身定制;专为更暖的气候剪裁。亚麻衬衫、贴袋长裤,外加一件条纹半衬西装外套。

source_text(原文): Just about up to my standards.
I wonder where I'll wear it? A garden party? A cricket match? A desert conjuration?
translation_zh(译文): 不知我会在哪儿穿上它?花园派对?板球赛?还是荒漠中的一场召唤?

source_text(原文): [You can now don the Summer Frivolity outfit at a Wardrobe.]
translation_zh(译文): [你现在可以在衣柜处穿上 '夏日轻狂' 套装。]

source_text(原文): The garments I recovered from Janvier the tailor, that I'd given him to mend, long ago...
translation_zh(译文): 这些衣物是我从裁缝雅维埃那里取回的,是很久以前我交给他修补的……

source_text(原文): The uniform of a médecin-lieutenant of the Légion du Seuil. A little faded from the bronze sun of the deep deserts; a little stained, faintly, by the clinging mud of the ghost forests of Indochine.
translation_zh(译文): 门关军团军医中尉的制服。被深漠中青铜色的骄阳晒得微微褪色;又淡淡地染着印度支那幽灵林间黏附的泥污。
穿着这身制服,我救过人命。

source_text(原文): I watched men die, wearing this.
translation_zh(译文): 穿着这身制服,我看着人们死去。

source_text(原文): This is what I wore to war.
translation_zh(译文): 我就是穿着它上的战场。

source_text(原文): [You can now don the Honneur et Humanité outfit at a Wardrobe.]
translation_zh(译文): [你现在可以在衣柜处穿上 '荣誉与人性' 套装。]

source_text(原文): Cable-knit vest, cashmere-blend errols, and a pair of saddle-brown oxfords. Clothes of an unassuming cut.
translation_zh(译文): 绞花针织背心,羊绒混纺长裤,一双鞍棕色牛津鞋。剪裁低调的衣着。

source_text(原文): A reassuringly friendly outfit. Comforting and heartening.
translation_zh(译文): 一身让人安心的亲切行头。妥帖而振奋。

source_text(原文): A reassuringly friendly outfit. Honest and unpretentious.
translation_zh(译文): 一身让人安心的亲切行头。诚实而不矫饰。
一身让人安心的亲切行头。实用。

source_text(原文): [You can now don the Father's Day outfit at a Wardrobe.]
translation_zh(译文): [你现在可以在衣橱换上「父亲节」套装了。]

source_text(原文): Strikingly modern clothing, made to measure.
translation_zh(译文): 剪裁合体的现代衣着,令人瞩目。

source_text(原文): Black cashmere polo-neck, black notched bag trousers, black suede loafers. A statement. And the statement is:
translation_zh(译文): 黑色羊绒高领衫,黑色缺口廓形长裤,黑色麂皮乐福鞋。一个宣言。而这个宣言是:

source_text(原文): 'You don't know me. But you'll remember me.'
[You can now don the Man of Mystery outfit at a Wardrobe.]
translation_zh(译文): [你现在可以在衣橱换上「谜样男子」套装了。]

source_text(原文): Silk scarf, heavy high-waisted woollen trousers, a merino wool submariner jumper, a gabardine drill trench coat. Made to measure for colder climates.
translation_zh(译文): 真丝围巾,厚重的羊毛高腰长裤,一件美利奴羊毛水手厚毛衣,一件华达呢风衣。为更寒冷的气候量身定制。

source_text(原文): I wonder where I'll wear it? A snow festival? An arctic expedition? At the head of the stairs to an unnamable abyss?
translation_zh(译文): 不知道我会在哪儿穿它?一场冰雪节?一次北极探险?还是在通往不可名状之渊的楼梯顶端?

source_text(原文): [You can now don the Trenchcoat Brigade outfit at a Wardrobe.]
translation_zh(译文): [你现在可以在衣橱换上「风衣纵队」套装了。]

source_text(原文): [Change your Outfit at the wardrobe; or just by entering your inventory anywhere in this room.]
translation_zh(译文): [在衣橱更换行头;或直接在本房间任意位置打开物品栏即可。]

source_text(原文): A bright thing... a holy thing... a thing of vivid colour...
translation_zh(译文): 明亮之物……神圣之物……色彩鲜活之物……

source_text(原文): A half-guessed memory sparkles infuriatingly at the brain-lobe tip, and is gone. I can't work out what this is.
translation_zh(译文): 一种隐约可辨的记忆在脑叶尖端恼人地闪烁,随即消失。我认不出这是什么。

source_text(原文): This is a tiny quantity of uzult - one of the Great Inks, the encausta terminalia. The elect of the great libraries - one of them [[Hush House]] - could write determinations of [[History]] in these inks, and the [[Hours]] might choose to take notice...
translation_zh(译文): 这是一小份乌祖尔特——大墨之一,终末彩墨。大图书馆中的遴选者——其中之一便是[[噤声居屋]]——曾以这些墨水书写[[历史]]的裁定,而[[司辰]]们或许会选择留意……

source_text(原文): Or so the story went. Impossible to prove or disprove. And everything is different now. Still! Uzult! Nice find.
translation_zh(译文): 至少故事是这么说的。无从证明,也无从证伪。而如今一切都已不同。不过!乌祖尔特!真是好收获。

source_text(原文): A little ceramic jar, small enough to fit in the palm of the hand, light enough to ride unnoticed in a pocket.
translation_zh(译文): 一只小陶罐,小得恰好能放进掌心,轻得放进口袋也不会引人注意。

source_text(原文): Dip a finger in and taste it.
Inside: a small quantity of viscous, yellow-golden fluid. The mouth of the jar is too narrow to admit much light, but the fluid within glitters like mica in sunlight.
translation_zh(译文): 里面:少量黏稠的金黄色液体。罐口太窄,透不进多少光,但罐中的液体仍像阳光下的云母般闪烁。

source_text(原文): It smells like sunlight on hot stone. As I lower the jar again, flashes of phantom light blur my vision.
translation_zh(译文): 闻起来像热石上的阳光。我把罐子重新放下时,幻影般的闪光模糊了我的视线。

source_text(原文): Sharp, quartzy . As I lower the jar again, flashes of phantom light blur my vision.
translation_zh(译文): 气味尖锐,如石英。我把罐子重新放下时,幻影般的闪光模糊了我的视线。

source_text(原文): Eh... why not. There's worse things than people.
translation_zh(译文): 呃……为什么不呢。世上还有比人更糟的东西。

source_text(原文): [S'pose this means you're a Cynic. Although people change. Even Spencer Hobson.]
translation_zh(译文): 「这么看来，你就是个犬儒了。尽管人会改变。哪怕是斯宾塞·霍布森。」

source_text(原文):
The death of faith in human nature? Or daylight's chill? Cynical choices are lonely, cautious, practical.

[Evolve this Passion to Cynicism, which contributes Knock and Winter to your Aspect Pool.]
translation_zh(译文):
是对人性信念的幻灭？还是白昼的寒意？犬儒的选择是孤独的、谨慎的、务实的。

〔将这项激情进化为犬儒，它将为你的性相池增添启与冬。〕

source_text(原文): I'm not committing. [Keeps the evolution option open, for now.]
translation_zh(译文): 我不打算现在就定下来。〔进化选项暂且保留。〕

source_text(原文): The keystone of civilisation; the world's deep heart.
translation_zh(译文): 文明的基石；世界深处的真心。

source_text(原文): [You'll do your best to be Honourable. Although people change. Especially Spencer Hobson.]
translation_zh(译文): 「你将竭尽全力做个荣誉之人。尽管人会改变。尤其是斯宾塞·霍布森。」

source_text(原文):
Honourable decisions are attempts to do the right thing, not the easy thing - and not necessarily the wise thing, or the gentle.

[Evolve this Passion to Honour, which contributes Heart and Lantern to your Aspect Pool.]
translation_zh(译文):
荣誉之举，是尝试去做对的事，而非容易的事——也未必是明智的事，或温柔的事。

〔将这项激情进化为荣誉，它将为你的性相池增添心与灯。〕

source_text(原文): I'm not sure I'd measure up. Later, perhaps. [Keeps the evolution option open, for now.]
translation_zh(译文): 我不确定自己能配得上。以后再说，也许。〔进化选项暂且保留。〕

source_text(原文): Someone with a heart, guts, and a code.
translation_zh(译文): 一个有热血、有胆量、有信条的人。

source_text(原文): Someone who makes the difficult choices.
translation_zh(译文): 一个敢于做出艰难抉择的人。

source_text(原文): A word I've never liked. Do the right thing and stop talking about it.
translation_zh(译文): 一个我向来不喜欢的词。做对的事，别再空谈它。

source_text(原文): What you are, not what you do. It's about breeding.
translation_zh(译文): 看你是什么样的人，而不是你做了什么。关乎出身教养。

source_text(原文): Make the best of what we've got left.
[You've acknowledged your Sorrow. Although people change. Especially Spencer Hobson.]
translation_zh(译文): 「你已正视自己的悲伤。尽管人会改变。尤其是斯宾塞·霍布森。」

source_text(原文):
Sorrowful choices: enigmatic? Nostalgic? Sentimental? Aesthetic?

[Evolve this Passion to Sorrow, which contributes Moth and Winter to your Aspect Pool.]
translation_zh(译文):
悲伤的选择：难以捉摸？怀旧？多愁善感？唯美？

〔将这项激情进化为悲伤，它将为你的性相池增添蛾与冬。〕

source_text(原文): Perhaps I'll look forward, for now. [Keeps the evolution option open, for now.]
translation_zh(译文): 也许眼下，我还是向前看吧。〔进化选项暂且保留。〕

source_text(原文): Faulkner: 'The past is never dead. It's not even past.'
translation_zh(译文): 福克纳：「过去永远不会死去。它甚至还没有成为过去。」

source_text(原文): 'The roots go deep. The knots remain.'
When I look up at the blood on the sun, the pallor of the sky, when I think about what's been lost...
translation_zh(译文): 当我仰望太阳上的血色、天空的苍白，当我想到那些已经失去的东西……

source_text(原文): This is why we can never forget.
translation_zh(译文): 正因为如此，我们永远不能忘记。

source_text(原文): Some things should have been lost earlier. This is a time for renewal.
translation_zh(译文): 有些东西本该更早失去。这是一个更新的时代。

source_text(原文): There's always a reason... but sometimes I like to keep it to myself.
translation_zh(译文): 总归有理由……但有时我喜欢把它留给自己。

source_text(原文):
Who'd do anything just for the sake of doing it? Only the wind moves without a reason.

[You've rejected the Whimsy Passion. If you act Whimsically again you'll have the opportunity to reconsider - as long as you still have a free Passion slot.]
translation_zh(译文):
谁会仅仅为了做而做？只有风才毫无缘由地飘动。

「你已摒弃奇想这项激情。若你再有一时兴起之举，将有机会重新考虑——只要你还有空余的激情位。」

source_text(原文): [You're Whimsical now. At least until you're not.]
translation_zh(译文): 「你如今满怀奇想。至少，在不再奇想之前。」

source_text(原文):
Whimsy - the reason that is no reason - the choice which is 'none of the above', except when it's not. Whimsical choices are unexpected, usually; useful, occasionally.

[Evolve this Passion to Whimsy , which contributes Moth and Rose to your Aspect Pool.]
translation_zh(译文):
奇想——没有理由的理由——「以上皆非」的选择，除非并非如此。异想天开的抉择通常出人意料；偶尔派得上用场。

〔将这项激情进化为奇想，它将为你的性相池增添蛾与引。〕

source_text(原文): Perhaps this is something I'll choose later. Perhaps not. [Keeps the evolution option open, for now.]
translation_zh(译文): 也许这是我以后才会做出的选择。也许不会。〔进化选项暂且保留。〕

source_text(原文): Why do I do the things that I do?
translation_zh(译文): 我为何会做出我所做的事？

source_text(原文): 'Why?' When did I ever care about 'why'?
translation_zh(译文): 「为什么」？我几时在乎过「为什么」？

source_text(原文): There's always a reason... but often, I'm playing the long game.
translation_zh(译文): 总归有理由……但很多时候，我放的是长线。

source_text(原文): ...while my pre-Wars French passport, in the name of Sylvain Huissier, gives my place of birth accurately. But the France that issued it no longer exists, and the passport is long invalid.
translation_zh(译文): ……而我那本战前的法国护照,以西尔万·韦西耶之名签发,出生地写得分毫不差。但签发它的那个法国已不复存在,护照也早已失效。

source_text(原文): A bulky manila envelope bulges an inside pocket. Time to open it.
translation_zh(译文): 一只厚实的牛皮纸信封把内袋撑得鼓鼓囊囊。该打开它了。

source_text(原文): Two passports. Neither qualifies me as a citizen of the French State. My British passport, in the name of Spencer Hobson, is valid, though the place of birth is false...
translation_zh(译文): 两本护照。没有一本能证明我是法国邦国的公民。我那本英国护照以斯宾塞·霍布森之名签发,依然有效,只是出生地是假的……

source_text(原文): Travelling funds. Mostly Darlanist francisques, plus a few Incorporate dollars...
translation_zh(译文): 盘缠。大多是达尔朗派发行的法兰西斧币,外加几张集团美元……
一枚孤零零的联盟多利亚。

source_text(原文): And a razor blade. Useful things, razor blades.
translation_zh(译文): 还有一片剃刀刀片。刀片,是实用的东西。

source_text(原文): ... and a packet of Bonanza cigarettes. The dollars will be accepted everywhere in Western Europe. The cigarettes, everywhere there's a black market.
translation_zh(译文): ……还有一包博南萨香烟。美元在西欧各地通用。香烟,则凡有黑市之处皆可通行。

source_text(原文): For a long time. We were both with the Lègion.
translation_zh(译文): 认识很久了。我们俩都在军团待过。

source_text(原文): He said I should ask you about the Rue Pigalle.
translation_zh(译文): 他说我该向你打听皮加勒街的事。

source_text(原文): My secret is out, hein? The little follies of youth.
translation_zh(译文): 我的秘密败露了,嗯?年轻时的荒唐事。

source_text(原文): [Unleash my most charming smile and reach to shake his hand] Thank you so much for your help earlier. I've spoken to the doctor.
translation_zh(译文): [绽放我最迷人的微笑,伸手去握他的手] 太感谢您之前的帮助了。我已经和医生谈过了。

source_text(原文): [Under this focused beam of bonhomie, Mathis unbends very slightly.] Euh.
translation_zh(译文): [在这道热忱的目光之下,马蒂斯稍稍松弛了些。]呃。

source_text(原文): We were speaking of Bricktop's, earlier. Of Django Reinhardt.
translation_zh(译文): 我们刚才在说布里克托普之家,说姜戈·莱因哈特。

source_text(原文): They were very different, those days. Sometimes good. Always different.
translation_zh(译文): 那些日子大不一样。有时很好。但总是不同。

source_text(原文): [No stories seem to be forthcoming. But Mathis is briefly lost in a pleasant reverie, and the atmosphere has thawed appreciately.]
translation_zh(译文): [似乎不会再有什么故事了。但马蒂斯短暂地陷入愉快的遐想,气氛明显回暖。]

source_text(原文): We were. It was good to remember. Though I never heard Reinhardt there. He moved on, in the Occupation years. To the Roulotte.
translation_zh(译文): 确实。回忆是件好事。不过我从没在那儿听过莱因哈特。占领年代里,他转去了大篷车。

source_text(原文): I said that the [[Enemy]] disliked swing. But not all of them. They let the Roulotte stay open late, you know? The men in grey. So they could listen to Reinhardt.
translation_zh(译文): 我说过[[敌人]]不喜欢摇摆乐。但并非人人如此。他们让大篷车开到很晚,你知道吗?那些穿灰衣的人。就为了能听莱因哈特。

source_text(原文): My friends and I, we would get in through the kitchen, to listen. Then one of my friends drew attention from the men in grey...
translation_zh(译文): 我和朋友们会从厨房溜进去听。后来,我有个朋友引起了那些灰衣人的注意……

source_text(原文): [Sadness creases Mathis' face]. It did not end well. I did not go back.
translation_zh(译文): [悲伤在马蒂斯脸上刻下皱纹]。结局并不好。我再没回去过。

source_text(原文): It was a long time ago.
It could have been no more than four or five years ago. But the more I speak to Mathis, the younger he seems.
translation_zh(译文): 那或许不过四五年前的事。可我越和马蒂斯交谈,就越觉得他年轻。

source_text(原文): Do you mind if I ask you about someone?
translation_zh(译文): 介意我向你打听一个人吗?

source_text(原文): The richer the man, the harder to like. M. Strathcoyne [the name is much gallified] is very rich.
translation_zh(译文): 人越有钱,越难让人喜欢。斯特拉斯科因先生[这名字被法语化得厉害]非常有钱。

source_text(原文): But his arm has a certain charm. Those eyes. Vincent and I, we call her 'Annabelle'.
translation_zh(译文): 但他那条手臂倒有几分魅力。那双眼睛。我和文森特管她叫『安娜贝尔』。

source_text(原文): I have nothing to say about monsieur le Directeur.
translation_zh(译文): 关于院长先生,我无可奉告。

source_text(原文): [A fleeting smile] She sings better than she cooks.
translation_zh(译文): [转瞬即逝的一笑]她唱得比做得好。

source_text(原文): I don't like her records. And one is never certain, with a Greek.
translation_zh(译文): 我不喜欢她的唱片。况且,希腊人,你永远摸不准。

source_text(原文): But I think that she is all right.
[Casually examine a ten-francisque note] Well, look, I recognise the value of information. If you remembered anything, I would be happy to compensate you...
translation_zh(译文): [漫不经心地端详一张十法兰西斧币的钞票] 这么说吧,我明白情报的价值。如果你记起什么,我很乐意补偿你……

source_text(原文): I have remembered something. [Mathis accepts the note, which disappears without fuss.]
translation_zh(译文): 我记起了一件事。[马蒂斯收下钞票,它不动声色地消失了。]

source_text(原文): Generous. But as I have said: unhappily, I know nothing.
translation_zh(译文): 慷慨。但我说过了:遗憾,我一无所知。

source_text(原文): [Mathis does not seem excited by my return.]
translation_zh(译文): [马蒂斯似乎并不为我的归来而振奋。]

source_text(原文): The Director has a second office behind the mirror in his office, where he keeps his records.
translation_zh(译文): 院长在他办公室的镜子后面还有一间办公室,他的档案都收在那里。

source_text(原文): I have not told you this.
[Mathis' tone is still flat, but he meets my eyes now, almost courteously.]
translation_zh(译文): [马蒂斯的语气仍然平淡,但现在他会迎上我的目光,几乎称得上客气。]

source_text(原文): [Mathis' eyes flash with anger. But he says nothing.]
translation_zh(译文): [马蒂斯眼中闪过怒意。但他什么也没说。]

translation_zh(译文): 我们正在与爱德华德交谈,所以若测试对象是魅力,rel_ed 应显示为修正项;若测试对象是丛林学,则不应显示。

translation_zh(译文): 渐黑,再渐回。对话框应全程保持可见——这正是 AltFade 而非 PCDS Fade 存在的原因。

source_text(原文): Holding the overlay opaque for three seconds, then releasing it. This verifies the stay/unstay direction pair survived B6 untouched.
translation_zh(译文): 将遮罩保持不透明三秒,然后释放。这用于验证 stay/unstay 方向配对在 B6 之后依然原样无恙。

source_text(原文): Closing the conversation and opening the travel map.
translation_zh(译文): 关闭对话并打开旅行地图。

source_text(原文):
Jo koitti kuumon aika, ja viukkaat puhvenet
päinillä harpitellen kieruloivat,
haipeloina seisoksivat varakuhvenet,
ja öksyt muvut kaikki hinkuroivat.
translation_zh(译文):
那是灼灼时分,滑腻的陀兽
在林野间回旋着打转;
苍白的鹭鸲们怔怔而立,
迟钝的咕兽们全在呜噜哼唧。

source_text(原文):
Once more unto the breach, dear friends, once more;
Or close the wall up with our English dead.
In peace there's nothing so becomes a man
As modest stillness and humility:
But when the blast of war blows in our ears,
Then imitate the action of the tiger;
Stiffen the sinews, summon up the blood,
Disguise fair nature with hard-favour'd rage;
Then lend the eye a terrible aspect;
Let pry through the portage of the head
Like the brass cannon; let the brow o'erwhelm it
As fearfully as doth a galled rock
O'erhang and jutty his confounded base,
Swill'd with the wild and wasteful ocean.
translation_zh(译文):
再向缺口冲去,亲爱的朋友们,再冲一次;
否则就用我们英格兰人的尸骸把城墙填满。
太平之时,再无他物比静默的安详与谦逊
更合于一个人的本色:
但当战争的号角在我们耳畔炸响,
便去效仿猛虎的行径;
绷紧筋腱,唤起热血,
以严峻的怒容遮掩温善的天性;
再令双目透出可怖的神情,
让它们从头颅的窗孔间窥望,
如同黄铜大炮;让眉峰压住眼眸,
如一块被狂野而空耗的海洋冲刷的岩石,
悬垂在它那崩塌的基座之上。

source_text(原文): The work of a moment to taint Philomèle's glass.
translation_zh(译文): 转瞬之间，菲洛梅尔的酒杯便被玷污。

source_text(原文): The taste is as I remember: an angry-medical fennel-mint. But it's weak! Much weaker than I remember.
translation_zh(译文): 味道与记忆中的一样：一股带火气的药房味茴香薄荷。可它太淡了！比我记得的淡得多。

source_text(原文): This is... a very gentle pastis.
translation_zh(译文): 这……可真是一杯温吞的茴香酒。
「维希水！」最近的那位牌客得意地嚷道。

source_text(原文): What the hell is this? Toothpaste?
Our government has decreed, monsieur, that indulgence weakened France. So they give us the gift of sobriety. Above this strength, no aperitif is permitted.
translation_zh(译文): 先生，我们的政府颁布了法令：纵情享乐削弱了法国。所以他们赐予我们清醒这份礼物。超过这个度数的开胃酒，一律不得出售。

source_text(原文): You are fortunate. Three days in the week, I could not even serve you this.
translation_zh(译文): 您运气好。一周里有三天，我连这个都没法给您端上来。

source_text(原文): [Raise the glass] [Drily] To the benevolence of the State.
translation_zh(译文): [举杯] [干巴巴地] 敬邦国的仁慈。

source_text(原文): [Raise the glass] [Sincerely] To the benevolence of the State!
translation_zh(译文): [举杯] [真诚地] 敬邦国的仁慈！

source_text(原文): A little advice. Do not raise your voice when you say these interesting things.
translation_zh(译文): 一点忠告。说这些有趣的事情时，别抬高嗓门。

source_text(原文): Please, madame. I've come a very long way to find her. My utmost gratitude.
translation_zh(译文): 求求您，夫人。我走了很远的路才找到她。我对您感激不尽。

source_text(原文): Have you met anyone of that name?
translation_zh(译文): 您可遇到过叫这个名字的人？
抱歉。我对名字不太在行。

source_text(原文): One does what one can. But, there.
translation_zh(译文): 能做多少便做多少。不过，就到这儿了。

source_text(原文): Close to the station, there is a bookseller. Andrée.
translation_zh(译文): 车站附近有位书商。安德烈。
是的。一位有意思的女士。

source_text(原文): Yes. I enjoyed her talent for stripes.
translation_zh(译文): 是的。我很欣赏她那手条纹功夫。

source_text(原文): She has another business - quieter even than bookselling. Mention my name to her, and perhaps she will help.
translation_zh(译文): 她还有一门生意——比卖书更安静。向她提起我的名字，她兴许会帮你。

source_text(原文): As I said: my utmost gratitude. Thank you, madame. Heaven lift you!
translation_zh(译文): 如我所言：感激不尽。多谢您，夫人。愿天堂护佑您！

source_text(原文): Today, madame, you have made a greater friend than you know.
translation_zh(译文): 今日，夫人，您结交了一位比您所知更了不起的朋友。

source_text(原文): The three candles are a Solar tradition. Linou is invoking three faces of the Sun to look kindly upon the departed.
translation_zh(译文): 三支蜡烛是太阳一系的传统。利努正请动太阳的三副面孔，好让它们垂顾逝者。

source_text(原文): Candles flicker before the image of a handsome young man in uniform.
translation_zh(译文): 烛光在一位身着军装的俊朗青年照片前摇曳。

source_text(原文): Did you have an... American sweetheart?
translation_zh(译文): 您曾有过一位……美国情人？

source_text(原文): Almost. We had not enough time.
[A faintly amused scowl.] Felix, my brother? No.
translation_zh(译文): [一丝忍俊不禁的皱眉。] 费利克斯，我的兄弟？不。

source_text(原文): The uniform doesn't look French. American, perhaps? But the insignia are odd.
translation_zh(译文): 这身军装不像法军的。或许是美军的？可徽记有些古怪。

source_text(原文): Oh! No. Felix was Free French. The Americans equipped his whole division, when they came out of Africa.
translation_zh(译文): 哦！不。费利克斯是自由法国的。他们师从非洲出来时，装备全是美国人给的。

source_text(原文): Do you know how he felt? About wearing an Incorporate uniform?
translation_zh(译文): 您可知道他的感受？关于穿上集团的军装？

source_text(原文): I had no opportunity to ask him...
We would have been married, Felix and I, in the summer.
translation_zh(译文): 费利克斯和我，本会在夏天成婚。

source_text(原文): There is a story, you know. They took some Charlemagnes - the turncoats, you know, the Enemy volunteers - in the last days of the war. They asked the Charlemagnes how they could stand to wear German uniforms.
translation_zh(译文): 有个故事，你知道吗。战争最后的日子里，他们逮住了一些查理曼师的人——就是那些变节者，你知道的，投敌的志愿兵。他们问查理曼师的人，怎么受得了穿德国军装。

source_text(原文): One Charlemagne asked: how can you stand to wear American uniforms?
translation_zh(译文): 其中一个查理曼师的人反问：你们怎么受得了穿美国军装？

source_text(原文): And so! We shot them! On the spot!
translation_zh(译文): 于是！我们就把他们毙了！当场毙的！

source_text(原文): And now, she looks only tired.
translation_zh(译文): 而此刻，她脸上只余疲惫。

source_text(原文): [Lean close] No more than they deserved.
That is... that is contrary to the laws of war.
Linou scrubs ferociously at a stubborn spot on the bar.
translation_zh(译文): 利努狠命擦拭着吧台上的一块顽固污渍。

source_text(原文): As I understand it, the State has not chosen to honour the Free French. It might be embarrassing if your sympathies were known.
translation_zh(译文): 据我所知，邦国并不打算表彰自由法国。若您的同情心被人知晓，恐怕会很难堪。

source_text(原文): Only that it's good to hear true patriots remembered. If you understand me.
translation_zh(译文): 只想说，听到还有人记得真正的爱国者，这很好。若您明白我的意思。
利努狼一般的笑容又回来了……

source_text(原文): ... and then she clears it from her face with the casual briskness of a woman sweeping a curtain closed.
translation_zh(译文): ……然后她将这笑容从脸上抹去，动作随意而利落，如同一位妇人顺手拉上窗帘。

source_text(原文): May he find the peace of silence...
translation_zh(译文): 愿他寻得寂静中的安宁……

source_text(原文): She lets out a long breath.
Nothing. Nothing at all. As long as we remain on good terms.
translation_zh(译文): 没什么。什么也没有。只要我们相处得宜。

source_text(原文): Is there absolutely no chance of a coffee? I've been desperate for one ever since I got off the train. Awake all night, you see.
translation_zh(译文): 真的一点咖啡都没有了吗？我自打下车起就惦记着一杯。一夜没合眼，您知道的。

source_text(原文): Well... we do have something. If you're desperate. But I will be honest. It is sock juice.
translation_zh(译文): 嗯……我们倒是有一样东西。要是您实在没办法。不过我跟您说实话：那是袜子汁。

source_text(原文): Coca-Cola. It tastes like what it tastes like.
translation_zh(译文): 可口可乐。它是什么味道，就是什么味道。

source_text(原文): My apologies, madame. I find myself embarrassed. I'll return promptly and settle my account.
translation_zh(译文): 失礼，夫人。我实在难堪。我很快就回来结清账目。

source_text(原文): Came out without my wallet! I'm so forgetful. I'll come back with it immediately.
translation_zh(译文): 出门忘了带钱包！我真是健忘。我马上带着它回来。

source_text(原文): I do not offer credit to strangers, monsieur. Be quick, or I will speak to my friends.
translation_zh(译文): 我不向陌生人赊账，先生。快去快回，不然我就要同我的朋友们说说了。

source_text(原文): I don't especially want a coffee.
translation_zh(译文): 我倒不是特别想喝咖啡。
一共 [q=chezfelix.bill:words] 枚法兰西斧币。

source_text(原文): You have returned to pay your bill?
Fortunate; since we have in fact no coffee.
translation_zh(译文): 万幸；因为我们确实没有咖啡。

source_text(原文): [Drop a little witchery into my glass along with the coins. Present it to Linou with a bow.]
translation_zh(译文): [把硬币放进杯里的同时，往杯中落进一缕巫术。鞠躬，将杯子呈给利努。]

source_text(原文): As Linou reaches for the glass, carnations - red and white - spring from the mouth of the glass!
translation_zh(译文): 利努伸手去接杯子，红白两色的康乃馨竟从杯口喷涌而出！

source_text(原文): Linou accepts the glass, bemused. The witchery didn't take.
translation_zh(译文): 利努接过杯子，困惑不已。巫术没有奏效。

source_text(原文): I reach out as if to brush something from her headband.
translation_zh(译文): 我伸出手，仿佛要拂去她发带上的一点什么。

source_text(原文): I have no choice but to open my hand, revealing a palmed coin.
translation_zh(译文): 我别无他法，只得张开手，露出掌中藏着的一枚硬币。

source_text(原文): Pluck a coin from her left ear.
translation_zh(译文): 从她左耳后拈出一枚硬币。

source_text(原文): Pluck a coin from her right ear.
translation_zh(译文): 从她右耳后拈出一枚硬币。

source_text(原文): Pluck a coin from her nose.
translation_zh(译文): 从她鼻尖拈出一枚硬币。

source_text(原文): I believe this concludes our business.
translation_zh(译文): 我想，我们的账目就此两清。

source_text(原文): Linou rolls her eyes. But she also smiles.
translation_zh(译文): 利努翻了个白眼，却也笑了。

source_text(原文): Ironic applause from the card-players' table.
translation_zh(译文): 牌客那桌传来戏谑的掌声。

source_text(原文): I apologise, madame. I am clumsy.
translation_zh(译文): 请见谅，夫人。我笨手笨脚。

source_text(原文): Linou takes the flowers, smiling. She also empties the glass out on to the counter and counts the coins.
translation_zh(译文): 利努笑着接过花，又把杯中之物倒上柜台，数起硬币来。

source_text(原文): Gasps of pleased surprise from the tables behind me.
translation_zh(译文): 我身后的桌边传来又惊又喜的吸气声。

source_text(原文): Oh! Aristide! Will you stop now with your circus?
translation_zh(译文): 哦！阿里斯蒂德！你这出马戏还不停下？

source_text(原文): Some. More before the war, you know. But they don't like so much the Côte d'Azur now.
translation_zh(译文): 有一些。战前来得更多，你知道。不过如今他们不太爱来蔚蓝海岸了。

source_text(原文): A little pause before she said that. And a little watchfulness after. Linou wanted to be sure I understood that Americans were welcome here.
translation_zh(译文): 说这话之前，她顿了顿。说这话之后，又带着一丝警觉。利努想让我确知：美国人在此地是受欢迎的。

source_text(原文): They are of course very welcome in this café.
translation_zh(译文): 他们在这家咖啡馆，当然非常受欢迎。

source_text(原文): [Ironic] We all should be grateful for the protection of our [[Incorporate]] allies against the [[Icarian]] menace.
translation_zh(译文): [反讽] 我们都该感激[[集团]]盟友的护佑，以御[[伊加利亚]]之患。

source_text(原文): [Earnest] We should be all grateful for the protection of our [[Incorporate]] allies against the [[Icarian]] menace.
translation_zh(译文): [恳切] 我们都该感激[[集团]]盟友的护佑，以御[[伊加利亚]]之患。

source_text(原文): [?] I do like their teeth. They have such wonderful teeth.
translation_zh(译文): [?] 我倒是喜欢他们的牙齿。他们长着一口绝妙的牙齿。

source_text(原文): Does she think I might be a government informer?
translation_zh(译文): 她莫不是以为我是政府的密探？

source_text(原文): Teeth. [Bare my own like a merry chimpanzee.]
translation_zh(译文): 牙齿。[像只快活的黑猩猩一样，龇出自己的牙。]

source_text(原文): [Enough time at the bar for now.]
Once I've travelled and returned to Antibes, I can refresh myself at Chez Felix again.
translation_zh(译文): 等我旅行归来、回到昂蒂布，就能再到费利克斯之家歇歇脚。

source_text(原文): Only a way of saying: it is not palatable. It is burnt rice. Chicory root. And it is not cheap. Forty francisques.
translation_zh(译文): 不过是种说法罢了：那玩意儿不好喝。是烧糊的米饭。菊苣根。而且不便宜。四十枚法兰西斧币。

source_text(原文): It steams; the smell is something like coffee; it is dark as filthy pond-water. A yellow skirl of scum-bubbles rotates at its murky heart.
translation_zh(译文): 它冒着热气；气味有点像咖啡；颜色深得像肮脏的池水。昏浊的中心，旋着一圈发黄的浮渣泡沫。

source_text(原文): [Drain the scalding liquid in a single swallow.]

Actually: it's not so bad. It's not good. But, coiled within the burnt taste and the radishy taste, there is a welcome lurking bitterness not unlike coffee. Perhaps she's secretly adulterating real black-market coffee?
translation_zh(译文): 其实：也没那么糟。算不上好。但在焦糊味与萝卜味之间，蛰伏着一丝令人受用的苦，隐约有咖啡的影子。也许她悄悄往劣货里掺了真正的黑市咖啡？

source_text(原文): Young, sharp; it'd be better cold, but it's not so bad warm.
translation_zh(译文): 酒很年轻，滋味尖利；冰着喝更好，温着倒也不坏。

source_text(原文): [Odd that she was so reluctant to offer this...]
translation_zh(译文): [奇怪，她方才竟这么不情愿端出这个……]

source_text(原文): It did taste better than I might expect. Likely, there's real coffee in there, heavily adulterated. She needed the money; but she didn't want a stranger to know she's buying coffee on the black market.
translation_zh(译文): 味道确实比我想象的好。很可能里面掺了大量真咖啡。她需要钱；但不愿让陌生人知道她在黑市买咖啡。

source_text(原文): It must usually be reserved for regulars.
translation_zh(译文): 这大概通常只留给熟客。

source_text(原文): [Look her straight in the eye] Much better than you suggested, madame. Perhaps you have a secret recipe? But your secret is safe with me.
translation_zh(译文): [直视她的眼睛] 比您说的好得多，夫人。也许您有秘密配方？不过您的秘密，我会守口如瓶。

source_text(原文): [Neutrally] You are a man of refined spirit.
translation_zh(译文): [语气平淡] 您是个品味高雅的人。

source_text(原文): Nothing at all. This is none of my affair.
translation_zh(译文): 没什么。这是您的事，与我无关。

source_text(原文): Worse than you have threatened me. Order, or go.
translation_zh(译文): 比您威胁我的还糟。点单，或者离开。

source_text(原文): I saw strange things, over where the rain ends.
translation_zh(译文): 在雨水终结之处，我看见了一些奇异之物。

source_text(原文): You mean the holes in the world?
Cognac? No one said anything about cognac!
Jean-Bernard needs cheering up. You seem fine.
translation_zh(译文): 让-贝尔纳需要打起精神来。你看着还行。

source_text(原文): There is a small surcharge for painters and for poets. Even Jean-Bernard.
translation_zh(译文): 对画家和诗人，要收一点小额附加费。让-贝尔纳也不例外。

source_text(原文): [Decide against it, at least for now.]
There really is coffee in there... somewhere.
translation_zh(译文): 里面真的有咖啡……在某个地方。

source_text(原文): It might in fact serve as a sacrament for some heretical rites - [[Crucian]] or otherwise.
translation_zh(译文): 它或许真能充当某些异端仪式的圣餐——[[克鲁西安]]式的，或别的什么。

source_text(原文): Paris. A foreigner, more or less.
Strong, warm, oaky, basically drinkable. Algerian, probably.
translation_zh(译文): 劲儿足，温吞，橡木味重，基本能喝。大概是阿尔及利亚的。
清澈的琥珀色泛起乳浊，旋成奶黄……

source_text(原文): The familiar blossom-apple taste. Like a gently sanctimonious aunt.
translation_zh(译文): 熟悉的苹果花香。像一位温和而一本正经的姑母。
这已经是我的第三杯了！

source_text(原文): The nearest card-player calls out in a hoarse stage-whisper: 'Be careful! Linou always overcharges foreigners!'
translation_zh(译文): 最近的那位牌客哑着嗓子，以人人都听得见的耳语喊道：「当心！利努总是敲外国人的竹杠！」

source_text(原文): Monsieur must forgive Aristide's manners. He becomes foolish with his second glass.
translation_zh(译文): 先生还请原谅阿里斯蒂德的失礼。他喝到第二杯就犯起傻来。

source_text(原文): Do I sound like a foreigner?
That's it. 'American champagne', Aristide calls it.
translation_zh(译文): 正是。「美国香槟」，阿里斯蒂德是这么叫它的。

source_text(原文): Linou will be careful. She must understand that I am not easily deceived.
translation_zh(译文): 利努最好小心些。她得明白，我不是轻易能哄骗的。

source_text(原文): We are entirely tolerant, chez Felix.
translation_zh(译文): 在费利克斯之家，我们向来宽容。

source_text(原文): White, red, pastis, camomile. Or I have some bottles left of that Incorporate drink.
translation_zh(译文): 白的，红的，茴香酒，甘菊茶。或者，我还剩几瓶那种集团的饮料。

source_text(原文): [Smile disarmingly] It's rare to find a place like this, in these times. You must be proud.
translation_zh(译文): [令人卸下防备地笑] 这年头，像这样的地方可不多见。您一定很为它骄傲。

source_text(原文): Tastes like what it tastes like. But there is a power in it. Keeps the spidermist from you.
translation_zh(译文): 它是什么味道，就是什么味道。可这里面有股力量，能让蛛雾近不了你的身。

source_text(原文): Perhaps you'll have something, this time?
translation_zh(译文): 这一回，您或许会喝点什么？

source_text(原文): Then we will see you later. Perhaps.
I'm looking for a woman. [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation_zh(译文): 我在找一位女士。[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。

source_text(原文): We were? I remember that you mentioned this Lagasse. But I remember no discussion.
translation_zh(译文): 我们谈过？我记得您提起过这位拉加斯。可我不记得谈过什么。

source_text(原文): [The nearest card player snuffles merrily around his pipe.]
translation_zh(译文): [离得最近的牌客就着烟斗，快活地吸着鼻息。]

source_text(原文): I will hope for your reunion.

[Spencer's behaviour influences NPC Opinions. Sometimes, a very high Opinion will unlock hidden choices. More rarely, a very low Opinion will unlock hidden choices. Just this once, we've made one choice visible below.]
translation_zh(译文): [斯宾塞的举止会影响 NPC 对你的看法。有时，极高的看法会解锁隐藏选项；更罕见的是，极低的看法也会解锁隐藏选项。仅此一次，我们让一个选项在下方可见。]

source_text(原文): Do I need to worry about spidermist here? in Antibes?
translation_zh(译文): 在昂蒂布这儿，我该担心蛛雾吗？

source_text(原文): Coca-Cola, hm? You get many Americans here?
translation_zh(译文): 可口可乐，嗯？您这儿美国人来得多吗？

source_text(原文): Not if you drink your Coca-Cola. [Linou winks.]
translation_zh(译文): 只要您喝您的可口可乐，就不会。[利努眨了眨眼。]

source_text(原文): A round of drinks for my new friends over there.
translation_zh(译文): 给那边我新结识的朋友们来一轮酒。

source_text(原文): Red for Philomèle. Leopold and the idiot like their pastis. And a little of the good cognac for Jean-Bernard. One hundred francisques. For this one, it's best if you pay in advance.
translation_zh(译文): 红的给菲洛梅尔。利奥波德和那个呆子喝茴香酒。再给让-贝尔纳来点好干邑。一百枚法兰西斧币。这笔账，最好先付。

source_text(原文): Don't forget to overcharge him, Linou!
translation_zh(译文): 别忘了多收他的钱，利努！

source_text(原文): That's a little more than I was expecting.
[Pay, and watch while Linou populates a wooden tray with wine, pastis, brandy.]
translation_zh(译文): [付钱，看着利努往木托盘上摆满葡萄酒、茴香酒和白兰地。]

source_text(原文): And something for monsieur. [Linou adds a drink to the tray, and turns away.]
translation_zh(译文): 再给先生来一杯。[利努往托盘上添了一杯，转身走开。]

source_text(原文): Is there anything I might want to do with the drinks before I take them over?
translation_zh(译文): 在把酒端过去之前，我有没有什么想对这些酒做的事？

source_text(原文): [Touch their drinks with a giddy influence, to ensure they speak freely.]
translation_zh(译文): [用一缕令人醺然的影响轻触他们的酒杯，好让他们畅所欲言。]

source_text(原文): [Mme Zèlia asked me to blight Philomèle. This is my chance.]
translation_zh(译文): [泽莉亚夫人嘱我向菲洛梅尔施下诅咒。这正是我的机会。]

source_text(原文): [Nothing more to do here. Just take the drinks back over to the poet, the painter, and ...whatever the other two are.]
translation_zh(译文): [这里再无事可做。只管把酒端回诗人、画家，还有……另外那两个随便是什么的人那儿。]

source_text(原文): The work of moments to brush a little bewitchment around the rims of the glasses.
translation_zh(译文): 片刻工夫，一缕魅惑便已抹上各只杯沿。

source_text(原文): No. That was pretty bad. But it makes it easier when you can tell yourself they're being folded into the Light.
translation_zh(译文): 不。那的确很糟。但若你能告诉自己，他们正被折入光源，心里就会好受些。

source_text(原文): People die. Priests watch. That wasn't it.
translation_zh(译文): 人都会死。神父们在一旁看着。那不是原因。

source_text(原文): How are you on theology, Vincent?
translation_zh(译文): 文森特，你神学功底如何？

source_text(原文): What I'd been taught, and what I learnt, didn't fit together.
translation_zh(译文): 别人教我的，与我亲身领会的，对不上。

source_text(原文): Mathis says you used to be a priest. Why?
translation_zh(译文): 马蒂斯说你从前是神父。为什么？

source_text(原文): Thought so. Never mind. [Don't get into the theology of it.]
translation_zh(译文): 猜到了。算了。[别去深究其中的神学。]

source_text(原文): All right. Well... the Church teaches that the Sun is one element of a procession along the seira from the henad. [Get into the theology of it.]
translation_zh(译文): 好吧。唔……教会教导说，太阳是从太一沿赛拉而降的巡行中的一个环节。[讲讲其中的神学。]

source_text(原文): '[[Henad]]', is it. No, you've lost me. Father.
translation_zh(译文): “[[太一]]”，是吧。不，你把我绕晕了。神父大人。

source_text(原文): I mean: everything good - everything, really - is supposed to emanate from the Oneness. It comes down to us from the henads, which participate in the Oneness, along their seirai. And at points along its descent, it manifests as distinct things we perceive. Like the Sun, or the phenomenal Hours.
translation_zh(译文): 我的意思是：一切善——真的，是一切——都据称自至一流出。它从那些参与至一的太一处而来，沿它们的赛拉降临到我们身上。而在它下降途中的某些节点上，它显现为我们所感知的种种不同之物。比如太阳，或那些现象司辰。

source_text(原文): Like [Vincent gestures] the railway? And stations?
translation_zh(译文): 就像[文森特比划着]铁路？还有车站？
严格来说，我至今仍是神父。

source_text(原文): The phenomenal Hours - where the seirai touch the world - are downstream manifestations of the henades. You can call on them. But it doesn't do anything. You can't make them do anything, any more than they can make the henads do things. I'd be like...
translation_zh(译文): 现象司辰——赛拉触及世界之处——是太一下游的显现。你可以呼唤它们。但那无济于事。你无法让它们做任何事，正如它们也无法让太一做任何事。那就好比……

source_text(原文): That's what I learnt. I was very young. But then the War. One of the battlefield exorcists trained me as his assistant. Father Stanislav.
translation_zh(译文): 那便是我学到的一切。当时我还很年轻。但接着是那场战争。一位战地驱魔师把我训练成他的助手。斯坦尼斯拉夫神父。

source_text(原文): ...waving at a railway sleeper and expecting the station to change position.
translation_zh(译文): ……对着枕木挥手，却指望车站移动位置。

source_text(原文): ...expecting light to change colour when it shines on something different.
translation_zh(译文): ……指望光照在不同的东西上就会改变颜色。

source_text(原文): So what's the point of it?
... I don't know. It's unknowable. So I don't know.
translation_zh(译文): ……我不知道。它是不可知的。所以我不知道。

source_text(原文): The point is the point. It's a perfect eternal double motion of emanation and yearning.
translation_zh(译文): 意义就是意义本身。那是流溢与渴慕的完美永恒的双重运动。

source_text(原文): There is no point. There doesn't need to be. It's how things are.
translation_zh(译文): 没有意义。也不需要有意义。事情本就是如此。

source_text(原文): I didn't know. But I'm not surprised. So the exorcisms. They didn't work?
translation_zh(译文): 我不知道。但我并不意外。那么那些驱魔仪式呢？没有用？

source_text(原文): That's the problem. They worked very well indeed. I had a knack for it. The spirits came and went at my command. And...
translation_zh(译文): 问题就在这里。它们非但有用，而且灵验得很。我天生就有这本事。灵体随我号令来去自如。而且……

source_text(原文): I thought, I've been lied to. The eternal can be altered. It's not even that difficult.
translation_zh(译文): 我想：我被骗了。永恒之物是可以改变的。甚至并不怎么难。
[我踌躇片刻。文森特静静听着。]

source_text(原文): The power of it! Once you taste godhood -even a drop of it - you can't be just a note in the song.
translation_zh(译文): 那种力量！一旦你尝过神性——哪怕只是一滴——你就再不甘心做歌谣中的一个音符。

source_text(原文): When you see pain everywhere, but you understand it's just the shadow to the light, it's inevitable, then you resign yourself. But when you can make the shadow diminish, just by speaking with it - you start to ask questions.
translation_zh(译文): 当你处处看见痛苦，却明白那不过是光的影子，不可避免，你便会认命。可当你只需与它交谈，就能让影子缩小——你便会开始发问。

source_text(原文): I started to wonder. If this one thing is not as I've been taught - how deep do the differences go? How high?
translation_zh(译文): 我开始猜想。若这一件事并不如我所受的教导——那么差异究竟有多深？又有多高？

source_text(原文): You didn't act much like a priest, when we were out in Ghardaïa.
translation_zh(译文): 我们在加尔达亚那阵子，你可不像个神父。

source_text(原文): It all seemed... daft. All that so-called eternity. And Stanislav and me, emending it.
translation_zh(译文): 一切似乎都……荒诞。那所谓的永恒。而我和斯坦尼斯拉夫，竟在修正它。

source_text(原文): If I could change it - if it could be changed so easily - where was the perfection? How could it be intended? You start to ask questions.
translation_zh(译文): 若我能改变它——若它如此轻易就能被改变——那完美又在哪里？它又怎能是出自本意？你便会开始发问。

source_text(原文): I couldn't take it seriously any more. One little exorcist's assistant at the seiral terminus, chasing spirits round like butterflies.
translation_zh(译文): 我再也没法把它当回事了。一个赛拉末梢的小小驱魔师助手，追着灵体，像追蝴蝶一样。

source_text(原文): It was like when you raise your voice in a chorus, and then you begin to realise it's silence - you're singing alone.
translation_zh(译文): 就像你在合唱中提高嗓门，然后才发觉那是寂静——你一个人在唱。

source_text(原文): All the teachings had been so restrained. Cream and pale gold. And there was I, in a world of red.
translation_zh(译文): 所有教诲都那么克制。奶油白，浅金黄。而我，却身处一片红色世界。

source_text(原文): So it was too much death? In the end?
translation_zh(译文): 所以到头来，终究还是死的人太多？

source_text(原文): So what you're saying, Spence, is that your Church training was too effective?
translation_zh(译文): 那么你的意思是，斯宾塞，你的教会训练过于有效了？

source_text(原文): Only parts of it. It was -
No. I mean that when you're ordained, it kindles a light in the soul. Exalts the phost. That can't be undone. I can still perform sacraments. But I haven't, in... a long time. Almost thirty years.
translation_zh(译文): 不。我的意思是，受圣职之时，灵魂中会点起一缕光。使福斯特升华。这无法逆转。我依然能主持圣事。但我已经有……很久没有做了。将近三十年。

source_text(原文): [The train whisle blows. The conductor is walking down the carriage, wearily bellowing. 'Mimata' he cries as he passes our compartment.]
translation_zh(译文): [火车汽笛鸣响。列车员拖着步子沿车厢走来，疲惫地吆喝着。经过我们的隔间时，他喊出“米玛塔”。]

source_text(原文): IMPORTANT YES THIS IS THE OPPORTUNITY TO RESPOND TO PASSION CHOICES YES
translation_zh(译文): 重要 是的 这是回应激情抉择的机会 是的

source_text(原文): No. I mean that there's a formal process - retenebration - that returns me to the secular state. That has to come from Rome. I don't think it ever went through. As long as I don't present myself as a priest, they probably won't bother.
translation_zh(译文): 不。我是说，有一道正式程序——雷特内布拉西翁——能让我回归世俗之身。那必须由罗马颁下。我想它恐怕从未办成。只要我不以神父自居，他们大概也不会来追究。

source_text(原文): You're changing the subject... Father. [Vincent gives his chortling head-shake.] What changed?
translation_zh(译文): 你在岔开话题……神父大人。[文森特咯咯笑着摇了摇头。] 是什么变了？

source_text(原文): An array of buttons marked with enigmatic glyphs.
translation_zh(译文): 一排标着神秘符号的按钮。
小心翼翼地拨弄那些按钮。

source_text(原文): Examine the glyphs closely to determine their function.
translation_zh(译文): 仔细研究这些符号，弄清它们的用途。

source_text(原文): I have the sense that someone in Alexandria mentioned something like this...
translation_zh(译文): 我隐约觉得，在亚历山大港有人提起过类似的东西……

source_text(原文): This one changes the date... this switches to an unorthodox numbering schema... and this sets an alarm. Which might be useful.
translation_zh(译文): 这个按钮改日期……这个切换到一种非正统的计数法……而这个设闹钟。说不定用得上。

source_text(原文): The clock whirrs and whines. The numbers flip frantically to what might be a date or a message, before returning to the steady flipping. The mechanism is incomprehensible.
translation_zh(译文): 时钟嗡嗡作响，呜呜哀鸣。数字疯狂翻动，拼出某个也许是日期、也许是讯息的东西，然后才回到平稳的翻动。这机制实在无法理解。

source_text(原文): An unusual device displaying the current time in black glyphs on white tiles. As I watch, the two smaller tiles at the end flip regularly, updating the time display to the precise second.
translation_zh(译文): 一件不寻常的装置，白色字片上的黑色符号显示着当前时间。我注视之际，末端两枚较小的字片规律翻动，把时间显示精确更新到秒。

source_text(原文): These three are pretty clear, actually - they'll allow me to set an alarm to wake me.
translation_zh(译文): 其实这三个相当明白——它们能让我设定闹钟，到点叫醒我。

source_text(原文): [[Gwendolen]] had one. She enjoyed its intricacies and described its alarm function in unnerving detail.
translation_zh(译文): [[格温德琳]]也有过一个。她喜爱其中的精巧繁复，还把它的闹钟功能描述得细致到令人不安。

source_text(原文): ...but if they did, I've forgotten who and what.
translation_zh(译文): ……但就算有人提过，我也忘了是谁、说了什么。

source_text(原文): [Use the alarm clock before you sleep, if you want to wake in the middle of the night and prowl round the Sanitarium unobserved.]
translation_zh(译文): [若想在半夜醒来、神不知鬼不觉地巡游疗养院，请在睡前使用闹钟。]

source_text(原文): Set an alarm to wake in the middle of the night.
Switch off the alarm, to ensure a good night's sleep.
translation_zh(译文): 关掉闹钟，确保一夜好眠。

source_text(原文): If I sleep in this bed tonight, I'll wake at midnight, sacrificing a restful sleep for the ability to explore untroubled by busybodies.
translation_zh(译文): 若今晚我睡在这张床上，便会在午夜醒来——牺牲一夜安眠，换来不受多事之人打扰的探索之便。

source_text(原文): If I rest in this bed tonight, my sleep will remain undisturbed.
translation_zh(译文): 若今晚我歇在这张床上，我的睡眠将不受惊扰。

source_text(原文): Since the War in the [[Sun]], clocks in Europe usually run inconsistently, wind down, or break, sometimes in quite dangerous ways. But this [[Incorporate]]-manufactured device looks to be keeping good time.
translation_zh(译文): 自[[太阳]]之战以来，欧洲的钟表往往走时不准、越走越慢，甚至损坏，有时还坏得相当危险。但这台[[集团]]制造的装置，看来走得颇为精准。

source_text(原文): The effect is soothing - hypnotic, even - but not revelatory. Except of course that it reveals the future with every flip.
translation_zh(译文): 这效果令人安心——甚至催眠——却谈不上启示。当然，每一次翻动都在揭示未来，那又另当别论。

source_text(原文): Ready for all the little ceremonies of a gentleman's morning.
translation_zh(译文): 准备好迎接绅士清晨的各种小仪式。

source_text(原文): I can't get into bed - I'm still fully dressed. [In a room of your own, you can change clothes at any time. To sleep, change to your dressing gown.]
translation_zh(译文): 我没法上床——衣服还没换呢。[在自己房间里，你可以随时更换衣服。要睡觉，先换上睡袍。]

source_text(原文): Make the bed... as I had to in the seminary, long ago.
translation_zh(译文): 整理床铺……就像很久以前，在神学院里不得不做的那样。

source_text(原文): Leave a snowy swirl of disordered sheets. Someone else will make the bed.
translation_zh(译文): 留下一片雪白凌乱的床单。床，自会有人来铺。

source_text(原文): Tuck and straighten the bottom sheet...
Rise in the dark. [You won't gain the benefits of a restful night's sleep. When you've finished any nightstalking you want to do, return to your bed and sleep the last few hours.]
translation_zh(译文): 摸黑起身。[你得不到一夜安眠的益处。等做完你想做的夜游，再回到床上，把最后几个小时睡掉。]

source_text(原文): My mediations on light have taught me ways to wake when the sun is dark. [Wake at midnight.]
translation_zh(译文): 我对光的冥想，教我学会了在太阳晦暗时醒来的法子。[午夜醒来。]

source_text(原文): My study of silence has taught me ways to wake from sleep. [Wake at midnight.]
translation_zh(译文): 我对静默的研习，教我学会了自睡梦中醒来的法子。[午夜醒来。]

source_text(原文): Lie back, drift off; bring the day. [Return to unrestful sleep; wake in the morning.]
translation_zh(译文): 躺下，沉沉睡去；迎来天明。[回到不安稳的睡眠；清晨再醒。]

source_text(原文): At the proper hour, my eyes snap open. It takes me a moment to remember why.
translation_zh(译文): 到了时辰，我猛地睁开眼。片刻之后，才想起缘由。

source_text(原文): [The alarm clock is set to wake you in the night. Continue?]
translation_zh(译文): [闹钟已设定，会在夜里将你唤醒。继续？]

source_text(原文): Lie back, close eyes... whisper 'Sinombre' three times. [This won't be restful, and you won't lose Troubles.]
translation_zh(译文): 躺下，闭上眼……轻声念三次「西诺姆布尔」。[这一觉不会安稳，烦扰也不会消除。]

source_text(原文): [Nothing obvious happens. Eventually, I drift off to sleep.]
translation_zh(译文): [没有发生任何明显的事。最终，我迷迷糊糊睡了过去。]

source_text(原文): And I'm here, as I promised. I can't take your hand. Sinombre has passed beyond flesh. But now turn to my light and consider my voice, and we'll see what will open to you...
translation_zh(译文): 而我如约来了。我无法握住你的手——西诺姆布尔已超脱肉身。但现在，转向我的光，凝听我的声音，看看有什么会为你开启……

source_text(原文): I prepared Labrikon earlier. I'll use it to visit Aubière's dreams. [This won't be restful, and you won't lose Troubles.]
translation_zh(译文): 我之前准备了拉布里孔。我要用它进入奥比埃的梦境。[这一觉不会安稳，烦扰也不会消除。]

source_text(原文): A drop on each eyelid, in each ear, on the tip of the tongue. Sprinkle the rest around the room.
translation_zh(译文): 每只眼皮上一滴，每只耳朵里一滴，舌尖上一滴。剩下的洒在房间各处。

source_text(原文): The odour of Labrikon is grainy and dank - like cellar-stone, or the smell of the lower layers of the Mansus.
translation_zh(译文): 拉布里孔的气味粗粝而阴湿——像地窖的石头，像漫宿底层的味道。

source_text(原文): Lie back, close my eyes, wait for sleep.
translation_zh(译文): 躺下，闭上眼，等待睡意降临。

source_text(原文): I can't be bothered with all this. I'll leave the bed half-made.
translation_zh(译文): 我可没心思做这些。床就让它铺到一半吧。

source_text(原文): Goosedown mattress, plump pillows, warm blankets, kindly provided for by the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui.
translation_zh(译文): 鹅绒床垫、蓬松的枕头、温暖的毯子——承蒙今日疗养院慷慨照料。

source_text(原文): Lie down for a few minutes.
Busy thoughts... busy thoughts. [Sleep is possible once you have one Weariness, Pain, Dread or Fascination - or in some more unusual circumstances.]
translation_zh(译文): 思绪纷扰……思绪纷扰。[一旦你拥有倦怠、痛苦、恐惧或入迷中的任何一种——或在某些更不寻常的情形下——方可入睡。]

source_text(原文): Down, into the place beneath night and heart.
translation_zh(译文): 沉下去，进入夜与心之下的那片地方。

source_text(原文): [This will advance to the following morning, unless something wakes you in the night. Continue?]
translation_zh(译文): [这将推进到次日清晨，除非夜里有什么东西将你唤醒。继续？]

source_text(原文): Waking from Mansus-dreams is often painfully abrupt. Like falling from the sky - or being cast up on a cold shore under a cold sun.
translation_zh(译文): 从漫宿之梦中醒来，往往突兀得令人难受。如同自天空坠落——或被抛上一片冷岸，头顶悬着冷阳。

source_text(原文): I've set an alarm. But I'm not tired enough to sleep. [To sleep, gain at least one Trouble.]
translation_zh(译文): 我设了闹钟，却还困得不够，睡不着。[要入睡，需至少一种烦扰。]

source_text(原文): Wait! I haven't looked at the calendrier!
translation_zh(译文): 等等！我还没看过那本日历！

source_text(原文): [The calendrier should tell me where Nina is. I'll look in my inventory.]
translation_zh(译文): [那本日历应该会告诉我尼娜在哪里。我去背包里找找。]

source_text(原文): Azure day to indigo half-day to the silver-pricked cat-black of a Côte d'Azur night...
translation_zh(译文): 从碧蓝的白昼，到靛蓝的薄暮，再到缀满银星的猫黑之夜——这是蔚蓝海岸的夜色……

source_text(原文): A droning tone, like a sermonious and didactic bee, drags me from muddled dreams. My alarm has woken me.
translation_zh(译文): 一阵低沉的嗡嗡声——如同一只爱说教、好训人的蜜蜂——把我从纷乱的梦中拖了出来。是闹钟把我叫醒了。

source_text(原文): Yes, of course she needs to let Vincent through too, he's carrying the luggage. I'm his Grace's private secretary, not a valet! I don't carry luggage.
translation_zh(译文): 对,当然也得放文森特过去,行李是他拎着的。我是主教大人的私人秘书,不是贴身男仆!行李可不归我拎。

source_text(原文): Thank you, Madame. Come along, Vincent.
translation_zh(译文): 谢谢您,夫人。走吧,文森特。

source_text(原文): Madame is so kind. I'm sorry my valet is such a buffoon. Come along, Vincent, you buffoon.
translation_zh(译文): 夫人真是好心。抱歉,我的贴身男仆竟是个十足的蠢货。走吧,文森特,你这个蠢货。

source_text(原文): Well, you did keep dropping our tickets.
translation_zh(译文): 唔,你刚才可是不停地掉票。

source_text(原文): [Smile and clap him on the back.]
A passer-by takes shelter from the rain in the station hall. He glances casually across the station in the direction of the poinçonneuse.
translation_zh(译文): 一个路人走进车站大厅避雨。他漫不经心地越过车站,朝剪票员的方向瞥了一眼。

source_text(原文): The train's whistle shrieks with joy, and then its engines drive it forward, into the night between cities.
translation_zh(译文): 火车的汽笛欢快地尖啸,随后引擎驱动车身向前,驶入城与城之间的夜色。

source_text(原文): Is it really... Mireille? After all these years? Can it be?
translation_zh(译文): 真的是……米雷耶吗?这么多年了?会是她吗?

source_text(原文): In three heartbeats he's at her side. Her eyes widen. In a moment they're locked in a passionate kiss.
translation_zh(译文): 三个心跳的工夫,他已到了她身边。她睁大了眼睛。转眼间,两人便拥吻在一起。

source_text(原文): The crowd hoots and cheers as the two of them kiss. Her ticket-clipper falls from her hand as she grabs desperately at the small of his back, to press him closer...
translation_zh(译文): 两人亲吻时,人群又是起哄又是欢呼。她拼命抓着他后腰,想把他搂得更紧,剪票钳从她手中滑落……

source_text(原文): This is our chance. Come on, Vincent.
I'm more than just a medic, Vincent. You must be starting to understand that by now.
translation_zh(译文): 我可不只是个医生,文森特。到了现在,你总该开始明白了吧。

source_text(原文): I wanted to see what would happen.
translation_zh(译文): 我只是想看看会发生什么。

source_text(原文): Lean back and close my eyes, nestling into the plush. It's been too long.
translation_zh(译文): 靠回椅背,闭上眼睛,陷进柔软的垫子里。太久没有这样了。

source_text(原文): [But there are always ways to travel without a ticket.]
translation_zh(译文): [但总有不买车票也能上路的法子。]

source_text(原文): I came to Antibes for a reason. I can't leave yet.
translation_zh(译文): 我来昂蒂布是有原因的。我还不能走。

source_text(原文): Sit forward and watch the journey.
Someone's left a cigarette lighter on a chair in the waiting room...
translation_zh(译文): 候车室的椅子上,有人落下一个打火机……

source_text(原文): A minute. Two minutes. Three, and I can smell smoke. Four, five... and I hear shouts of alarm. A bell begins to clang. Someone's staggering to the waiting room, holding a bucket of sand. The poinçonneuse, delighted by the excitement, hurries from her post to help.
translation_zh(译文): 一分钟。两分钟。三分钟,我闻到了烟味。四分钟,五分钟……我听见惊慌的喊叫。铃铛开始当当作响。有人端着一桶沙,踉跄着奔向候车室。剪票员被这场骚动逗得高兴,离开岗位赶去帮忙。

source_text(原文): Lulled by the train's sway, I slip into a deep sleep...
translation_zh(译文): 被列车的摇晃催着,我沉入深深的睡眠……

source_text(原文): The pewtered surface of the Baie des Anges falls away. The rain slams the sky closed. The hills rise around us...
translation_zh(译文): 天使湾锡灰色的水面落在身后。大雨砰然阖上天空。山丘在我们四周隆起……

source_text(原文): Today's edition of The Sheaf lies on another chair. I could wad it into a ball, start a fire, take advantage of the commotion.
translation_zh(译文): 今天的《禾捆报》躺在另一张椅子上。我可以把它揉成一团,点起火来,趁乱行事。

source_text(原文): The poinçonneuse waits at the barrier, moodily clicking her ticket-clipper. Beyond the barrier, at the platform, the train gleams and growls.
translation_zh(译文): 剪票员守在栅栏口,闷闷地咔嗒着剪票钳。栅栏那边,站台上,列车泛着光,低声轰鸣。

source_text(原文): If there's no other option... so be it.
translation_zh(译文): 若是没有别的选择……那就这样吧。

source_text(原文): Wad the papers into a ball, touch the lighter to the ball, stuff it halfway down the side of the cushion.
translation_zh(译文): 把报纸揉成团,打火机凑上去点燃,然后塞进坐垫侧边的缝隙,塞到一半深。

source_text(原文): Walk calmly across to the other side of the station.
translation_zh(译文): 从容地穿过车站,走到另一头。
文森特不安地耸耸肩。「时局艰难。」

source_text(原文): Here: an unremarkable door with the Knock-glyph scratched into the black paint. The handle is cold. The corridor beyond is wintry.
translation_zh(译文): 就是这里:一扇不起眼的门,黑色的漆上刻着启之印记。门把冰冷。门后的走廊,冷得如同冬日。

source_text(原文): If such a door does exist here, then it's hidden from my sight.
translation_zh(译文): 如果这里真有这样的门,那它也避开了我的视线。

source_text(原文): [Buy tickets to Mimata for me and for Vincent.]
translation_zh(译文): [给我和文森特买去米玛塔的车票。]

source_text(原文): The Bishop of Nantes is about to board the train! He left his suitcase behind! Fortunately I, his private secretary, have the missing luggage and if the poinçonneuse will let me through, I can give it to her. No, I don't need a ticket, I'm staying here in Antibes to oversee certain investigations.
translation_zh(译文): 南特主教正要上车!他把手提箱落下了!幸好,我这个私人秘书替他拿着这件行李——只要剪票员放我过去,我就能把它交还给他。不,我不需要车票,我要留在昂蒂布,督办几桩调查。

source_text(原文): No, the poinçonneuse won't believe I'm the private secretary of the Bishop of Nantes. And no, she won't let me on to the platform to give his Grace an urgent letter.
translation_zh(译文): 不行,剪票员不会相信我是南特主教的私人秘书。也不会放我上站台,给主教大人送一封急信。

source_text(原文): Links that transcend time and memory...
translation_zh(译文): 超越时间与回忆的羁绊……

source_text(原文): She is a lonely and vigilant sentinel, it seems. If anyone here is connected to her... my little magics can't find a purchase on them.
translation_zh(译文): 看来,她是一位孤独而警觉的哨兵。这里若有人与她相连……我的小法术,在他们身上找不到可着力的地方。

source_text(原文): The station hall is almost deserted. Not so many visitors to the Riviera in these times.
translation_zh(译文): 车站大厅几乎空无一人。这个年头,来里维埃拉的游客不多了。

source_text(原文): I came to Antibes for a reason. I won't leave yet.
translation_zh(译文): 我来昂蒂布是有原因的。现在还不到离开的时候。

source_text(原文): The train runs to Mimata, and Mimata is where I'll find [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation_zh(译文): 列车驶往米玛塔,而我将在米玛塔找到[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。

source_text(原文): In some buildings, there are doors that appear on no plan, through which only the drunk or distracted ever pass. Is there one here?
translation_zh(译文): 有些建筑里,有这样一些门:任何图纸上都没有它们,只有醉汉或心不在焉的人才会穿过。这里也有这样一扇门吗?

source_text(原文): First class: two thousand francisques for two tickets, one thousand each.
translation_zh(译文): 一等座:两张票两千枚法兰西斧币,每张一千。

source_text(原文): Upholstery! Antimacassars! And slightly less chance of official interference.
translation_zh(译文): 软垫!椅背罩巾!而且被官方找麻烦的几率也小些。

source_text(原文): Second class: one thousand francisques for two tickets, five hundred each.
translation_zh(译文): 二等座:两张票一千枚法兰西斧币,每张五百。

source_text(原文): Less plush, but it'll still be a compartment, not an open carriage.
translation_zh(译文): 没那么软,但好歹是个包厢,不是敞开式的车厢。

source_text(原文): Third class: five hundred francisques for two tickets, two hundred and fifty each.
translation_zh(译文): 三等座:两张票五百枚法兰西斧币,每张二百五十。

source_text(原文): I travelled third class from Alexandria. Never again.
translation_zh(译文): 我从亚历山大港来时坐的就是三等座。绝不再坐了。

source_text(原文): I travelled third class from Alexandria. Slatted wooden benches and students bawling drinking-songs. Sometimes, cages of chickens. Just once, a small but desperately plaintive goat. I didn't get much sleep.
translation_zh(译文): 我从亚历山大港来时坐的就是三等座。条板木凳,学生们扯着嗓子唱酒歌。偶尔还有装鸡的笼子。只有一次,笼子里是一只小小的山羊,叫得凄惨至极。我没睡多少觉。

source_text(原文): Chef... I can make a contribution. Enough for a third-class ticket of my own.
translation_zh(译文): 头儿……我可以凑一份。够我买一张自己的三等座票。

source_text(原文): [Perhaps I could find a way to travel without a ticket.]
translation_zh(译文): [也许我能想个办法,不买车票也照样上路。]

source_text(原文): [Go back out into the rain.] It's a long way to Mimata, and I won't be able to return immediately to Antibes. Perhaps I have unfinished business here.
translation_zh(译文): [回到外面的雨中。]去米玛塔路途遥远,而且无法立刻返回昂蒂布。也许我在这里还有未了之事。

source_text(原文): [Third class] Needs must in hard times.
translation_zh(译文): [三等座]时世艰难,也只能如此。

source_text(原文): [First class] I've had it with compromises. No more compromises.
translation_zh(译文): [一等座]我受够将就了。不再将就。

source_text(原文): [Second class tickets] Spencer Hobson is not a third-class traveller.
translation_zh(译文): [二等座]斯宾塞·霍布森可不是坐三等座的人。

source_text(原文): And what are your feelings on travelling third class, Vincent?
translation_zh(译文): 文森特,你对坐三等座旅行有何感想?

source_text(原文): [We'll both travel in third class. Pay two hundred and fifty francisques. Vincent will pay for his own ticket.]
translation_zh(译文): [我们俩都坐三等座。付二百五十枚法兰西斧币,文森特自己付自己的票钱。]

source_text(原文): [Pay five hundred francisques, let Vincent go third class] I'll see you in Mimata.
translation_zh(译文): [付五百枚法兰西斧币,让文森特坐三等座]米玛塔见。

source_text(原文): [We'll both travel in second class. Pay seven hundred and fifty francisques. Vincent will pay towards his own ticket.]
translation_zh(译文): [我们俩都坐二等座。付七百五十枚法兰西斧币,文森特为他的票分担一部分。]

source_text(原文): Arrange a diversion. Someone here might have history with the poinçonneuse - an enemy, or a friend.
translation_zh(译文): 安排一场声东击西。这里也许有人与剪票员有过往——是仇人,或是老友。

source_text(原文): [We'll both travel in first class! Pay one thousand seven hundred and fifty francisques. Vincent will pay towards his own ticket.]
translation_zh(译文): [我们俩都坐一等座!付一千七百五十枚法兰西斧币,文森特为他的票分担一部分。]

source_text(原文): [Pay one thousand francisques, let Vincent go third class] I'll see you in Mimata.
translation_zh(译文): [付一千枚法兰西斧币,让文森特坐三等座]米玛塔见。

source_text(原文): Come on! We used to dig holes in the sand to sleep. If I wanted goosedown pillows, I'd never have left the Sanitarium.
translation_zh(译文): 得了吧!咱们当年不都是挖个沙坑就睡。我要是想要鹅绒枕头,当初就不会离开疗养院。

source_text(原文): One thousand each for first class, five hundred each for second, two hundred and fifty for third. Vincent will contribute two hundred and fifty francisques.
translation_zh(译文): 一等座每人一千,二等座每人五百,三等座每人二百五十。文森特会拿出二百五十枚法兰西斧币。

source_text(原文): The trains here are better than the desert express. Even after the Wars.
translation_zh(译文): 这儿的火车比沙漠快车好。哪怕在战事过后。
谢了,头儿。咱这是绅士的待遇!

source_text(原文): Ha ha, like proper aristocrats! Knew I'd do all right with you, Spencer.
translation_zh(译文): 哈哈,跟真正的贵族似的!我就知道跟着你斯宾塞,错不了。

source_text(原文): Together, down the platform to the waiting carriages.
translation_zh(译文): 两人一起,沿站台走向等候的车厢。

source_text(原文): And he's gone, hands in his pockets, whistling, mood instantly buoyant again.
translation_zh(译文): 而他已走远了,双手插在兜里,吹着口哨,情绪转眼又高涨起来。

source_text(原文): Lean back and close my eyes.
Lulled by the train's sway, I slip into a light doze...
translation_zh(译文): 被列车的摇晃催着,我打起盹来……
哦。你好。[试探着伸出手去。]

source_text(原文): Somehow, the cat from the Sanitarium is here, sitting upright on the floor, eyes like twin coins of bewildered rage.
translation_zh(译文): 不知怎么的,疗养院那只猫也在这儿,笔直地坐在地板上,一双眼睛像两枚困惑与怒火铸成的硬币。

source_text(原文): Cambronne! The cat from the Sanitarium? That thing really does get everywhere. I think it's possessed.
translation_zh(译文): 康布罗纳!疗养院那只猫?那家伙真是哪儿都去得。我觉得它被附身了。

source_text(原文): Yeah, well, it can like me somewhere else. I don't trust it. [He makes half-hearted shooing motions.]
translation_zh(译文): 得了吧,它爱喜欢谁就喜欢谁去。我可不信它。[他不情不愿地挥了挥手,作驱赶状。]

source_text(原文): The cat backs away, bristle-twitching with ineffectual martinet fury, and darts off down the train.
translation_zh(译文): 猫退了几步,毛根根竖起,带着一股徒劳的、教官式的怒火,然后窜出车厢,朝列车深处跑去。

source_text(原文): I remember. At the Sanitarium, they said you'd arrived with Nina, didn't they? Interesting. Let's take a look at you...
translation_zh(译文): 我记得。在疗养院,他们说你跟尼娜一起来的,对吧?有意思。让我好好瞧瞧你……

source_text(原文): This isn't the first time I've travelled without a ticket. Recruit Vincent to help me with the routine.
translation_zh(译文): 这又不是我第一次逃票乘车。把文森特拉进来,帮我搭把手演这出戏。

source_text(原文): Through the open windows, farther down the train, I hear a distant voice raised in song: Vincent's. An old Légion marching-song. After a moment, other voices join it.
translation_zh(译文): 透过开着的车窗,列车更深处传来一个远远的、唱歌的嗓音:是文森特。一首古老的军团行军歌。过了一会儿,别的嗓音也加了进来。

source_text(原文): With no valid ticket, our only realistic choice is third class, where inspections are more cursory and distractions are plentiful.
translation_zh(译文): 没有有效的车票,我们现实的选择就只有三等座:查票更马虎,可乘之机也多。

source_text(原文): Frost glitters on the brick walls as we pass. The corridor grows narrower towards the end.
translation_zh(译文): 我们经过时,砖墙上的霜闪着光。走廊越到尽头越窄。
这是……我们这是到哪儿了,头儿?

source_text(原文): Good to be on the move again. I think I might have outstayed my welcome, here!
translation_zh(译文): 又能上路了,真好。我觉得自己在这儿怕是待得太久,讨人嫌了!
这个问题,我也常常好奇。

source_text(原文): We're on the platform. Behind us, a dark-furred stain on the brickwork, roughly rectangular, the height of the door, where a water-pipe has leaked.
translation_zh(译文): 我们站在站台上。我们身后,砖墙上有一道暗色的水渍,大致呈长方形,和门一般高,是水管漏水渗出来的。

source_text(原文): My ticket is here. Wait - no - it's here. Vincent must have our tickets. This is it! Oh, how clumsy. Yes there are others waiting, and I'm in the way. Vincent has his ticket! No, you saw my ticket a moment ago, remember?
