translation_zh(译文): 我的票在这儿。等等——不对——在这儿。票肯定在文森特那儿。就是这个!哦,我真笨手笨脚。没错,后边还有人等着呢,我挡着路了。文森特有他的票!不对,你刚才还看见我的票了,还记得吗?

source_text(原文): The poinçonneuse is not flustered or confused. Her eyes are sharp and quick. Retreat. Regroup.
translation_zh(译文): 剪票员既没慌乱,也没被搞糊涂。她的目光又锐利又迅速。撤。重整旗鼓。

source_text(原文): I stow the cigars carefully in my pockets to minimise the risk of crushing them.
translation_zh(译文): 我把雪茄小心收进衣袋，尽量减少压坏它们的风险。

source_text(原文): Poking round his belongings would be embarrassing if I were caught, but I have my reasons. Petty larceny is something else entirely.
translation_zh(译文): 翻动他的物品，若被撞见难免尴尬，但我自有理由。小偷小摸则完全是另一回事。

source_text(原文): Romeo y Julieta Churchills -all the way from Cuba! They're not even rationed! They're just wildly unavailable. How did Strathcoyne come by them in a sanitarium in the unfavoured end of France?
translation_zh(译文): 罗密欧与朱丽叶·丘吉尔型——不远万里来自古巴！甚至不在配给之列！只是市面上根本买不到。斯特拉斯科因窝在法国这个不受待见的一角开疗养院，是怎么弄到手的？

source_text(原文): A rich sweet hay-grass scent, very different from the choking tarriness that attends a lit cigar.
translation_zh(译文): 一股浓郁甘甜的干草气息，与点燃雪茄时那股呛人的焦油味截然不同。

source_text(原文): A hygrometer quivers as I open the lid. Inside, a drawer full of crisply labelled cigars. It's a humidor - a storage box designed to preserve a suitable moisture level, so that the cigars neither dry out nor grow spongy.
translation_zh(译文): 我打开盖子时，湿度计微微一颤。里面是一层抽屉，装满了贴有清晰标签的雪茄。这是保湿盒——一种保持适宜湿度的储存盒，让雪茄既不会干透，也不会发软。

source_text(原文): Strathcoyne's cache of expensive cigars. I've already pilfered a few.
translation_zh(译文): 斯特拉斯科因私藏的昂贵雪茄。我已经顺走了几支。

source_text(原文): Strathcoyne's cache of expensive cigars. Fortunately for him, I was unmoved by the temptation to petty theft.
translation_zh(译文): 斯特拉斯科因私藏的昂贵雪茄。对他来说幸运的是,我未被小偷小摸的诱惑所动。

source_text(原文): He won't miss these cigars, and I can probably get a good price for them. Pocket a few.
translation_zh(译文): 他不会在意少了这些雪茄，我也许还能卖个好价钱。揣上几支。
更仔细地看看这些雪茄。

source_text(原文): Obviously I'm not going to pilfer the man's cigars!
translation_zh(译文): 我当然不会去偷拿这个人的雪茄！

source_text(原文): These cigars look sumptuous. I have to try them. Pocket a few.
translation_zh(译文): 这些雪茄看起来华美极了。非试不可。揣上几支。

source_text(原文): Still, there is grey in my hair now. In my time outside, neither time nor pain forgot me.
translation_zh(译文): 只是如今，我鬓间已见灰白。在我流落于外的那段时日里，时间与痛苦都没有忘了我。

source_text(原文): Then why do you keep one in your office?
translation_zh(译文): 那您为什么还在办公室里放一面呢？

source_text(原文): While I know where it is, it can do little harm.
translation_zh(译文): 只要我知道它在哪里，它就害不了人。

source_text(原文): You have indeed an admirable profile, M. Hobson, but perhaps it is more suitable to admire it elsewhere.
translation_zh(译文): 霍布森先生，您的侧影确实令人称羡，不过，或许还是到别处去欣赏更为妥当。

source_text(原文): There's a slightly discoloured rectangle on the wall behind the mirror. Was there a door here - now painted or plastered over?
translation_zh(译文): 镜子后面的墙上，有一块微微变色的矩形。这里曾有一扇门——如今被油漆或灰泥糊住了？

source_text(原文): Run my fingertips over the wall.
In my time on the stage, I saw a great many secret doors, hidden compartments. I suspect there may still be a door here... aha!
translation_zh(译文): 当年登台之时，我见过许多暗门与秘格。我疑心这里仍藏着一扇门……啊哈！

source_text(原文): Smooth cool paint, silver-pale in moonlight. Nothing else.
translation_zh(译文): 光滑冰凉的漆面，在月光下泛着银白。别无他物。

source_text(原文): Hinges, almost flush with the wall. There still is a door here! Which means, if I tug at the other edge -
translation_zh(译文): 合页，几乎与墙面齐平。这里果然还有一扇门！也就是说，只要我在另一侧一拽——

source_text(原文): The door swings inwards - not only a little, before it jams against something in the crowded room beyond - but the opening is wide enough for me to step through.
translation_zh(译文): 门向内旋开——开得不算少，随即卡在门后那间拥挤房间里某样东西上——不过开口已足够我跨步而入。
镜子。都是些两面三刀的东西。

source_text(原文): Murmur an invocation to the [[Watchman]]. See what might be revealed.
translation_zh(译文): 向[[守夜人]]低声念诵祷文，看看会揭示出什么。

source_text(原文): A hidden door! Not locked in any way that might matter.
translation_zh(译文): 一扇暗门！门上没有任何值得一提的锁。

source_text(原文): I'm by the wall at the back of Aubière's office.
translation_zh(译文): 我正站在奥比埃办公室的后墙边。

source_text(原文): If I step through the hidden door here, I'll be in Aubière's secret office, or secret lumber room.
translation_zh(译文): 若我从这里的暗门穿过去，就会进到奥比埃的秘室，或他那间秘密储物室。

source_text(原文): A wave of panic washes over me. What if the door has somehow stuck? What if I can't get out?
translation_zh(译文): 一阵恐慌如潮水漫过我。万一门卡住了呢？万一我出不去呢？

source_text(原文): It won't be stuck. I can get out.
I can always get out. (But once I couldn't, whispers the night.)
translation_zh(译文): 我总能出得去。（但有那么一次我出不去，夜色低声说。）

source_text(原文): The moonlight here is clear enough to make out the edges of the discoloured patch - of the texture of the paint.
translation_zh(译文): 这里的月光清朗得足以辨出那块变色区域的边缘——以及涂料的纹理。

source_text(原文): Step back through to Aubière's outer office.
translation_zh(译文): 穿回奥比埃的外间办公室。

source_text(原文): But of course I can't do that when Aubière is here.
translation_zh(译文): 但奥比埃在场的时候，我当然不能这么做。

source_text(原文): Like my patients. If you will excuse the drollery.
translation_zh(译文): 就像我的病人一样。请原谅这个玩笑。
[并不怎么好笑。但还是笑一笑。]

source_text(原文): 'Behind your own image is a secret chamber with a beast-image...'
translation_zh(译文): 「在你自身影像的背后，有一间秘室，秘室里藏着野兽之像……」

source_text(原文): There's a door here, carefully painted, hinges almost flush with the wall. No handle, but all I need to do is tug at the other side -
translation_zh(译文): 这里有一扇门，刷得精心，合页几乎与墙齐平。没有把手，我只需拽住另一侧——

source_text(原文): I suppose I can hardly prevent you...
Sorry, doctor. It's a therapeutical necessity.
translation_zh(译文): 抱歉，医生。这是治疗所需。

source_text(原文): I cough halfway through my invocation. Damn it.
translation_zh(译文): 祷文念到一半，我咳了出来。该死。

source_text(原文): The mirror has been placed here to catch and share the light that falls through the window.
translation_zh(译文): 这面镜子放在这里，是为了接住并散播透窗而入的光。

source_text(原文): No longer young, but not yet old. I was nine years gone from the world. Did I even really wear a body for any of that time? If so, it didn't age.
translation_zh(译文): 不再年轻，却也未至年老。我曾离世九年。那段时间里，我当真还披着肉身吗？若是，那肉身并未衰老。

source_text(原文): As long as I can still command respect....
I'm still a handsome fellow. Debonair, even.
translation_zh(译文): 我依旧是个俊朗的家伙。甚至可说风度翩翩。

source_text(原文): Fifty years ago. How did it die? How did it come here?
translation_zh(译文): 五十年前。它怎么死的？又是怎么来到这里的？

source_text(原文): Perhaps it was sunset when the bear died. Perhaps the scent of pines.
translation_zh(译文): 也许熊死去时,正值日落。也许,那时有松香的气息。

source_text(原文): In the corner of the room rears - somehow half-heartedly - a great brown bear.
translation_zh(译文): 房间的角落里立着一头巨大的棕熊——不知怎的,颇有几分心不在焉。

source_text(原文): 'The gate to its temenos is a beast-image in the hidden chamber of the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui...'
translation_zh(译文): “通往其圣域的门扉,是今日疗养院密室中的一尊兽像……”

source_text(原文): Some sort of deliquescence beneath the bear's heraldic exterior. Best not to investigate too closely.
translation_zh(译文): 熊那纹章般的外表之下,是某种潮解之物。最好不要凑近探究。

source_text(原文): Lay a hand on the bear's fur.
Leave the bear to its shadowy solitude.
translation_zh(译文): 让熊留在它幽影般的孤寂里。

source_text(原文): Glass eyes gleam, yellowed fangs. It must be decades dead.
translation_zh(译文): 玻璃眼珠闪着光,发黄的獠牙。它想必已死去数十年了。
铭牌上写着:热雷米 - 上加龙省 - 1895

source_text(原文): Like bristly, musty carpet - with a squelch to it, as if the carpet had been laid on a rotting floor.
translation_zh(译文): 像一块粗硬发霉的地毯——摸着还有湿漉漉的咕啾感,仿佛那地毯铺在了一具腐烂的地板上。

source_text(原文): Perhaps the bear came with the house, originally. Presumably Aubière stuck it in here because he felt it didn't strike the right tone for his high-minded institution.
translation_zh(译文): 也许这头熊原本就是随这宅子而来的。想来奥比埃把它塞进这里,是因为他觉得它与他那志趣高洁的机构调性不合。

source_text(原文): Welland was a Forge-[[long]] with military inclinations - a member of the Society of the Noble Endeavour who were often alchemists and generals, British royalists. What was he doing in Atlanta in 1865? And why does he feature in Aubière's dream?
translation_zh(译文): 韦兰是一位有军人倾向的铸之[[长生者]]——“高尚事业社”的成员，该社中人多为炼金术士与将军，是英国的保皇党人。1865 年，他在亚特兰大做什么？又为何会出现在奥比埃的梦中？

source_text(原文): A glowering man in glowering middle age, nicely filling out an ornate military uniform.
translation_zh(译文): 一个阴沉着脸的男人，正值阴沉的盛年，把一身华丽的军装撑得刚刚好。

source_text(原文): Is there something odd about his hair?
translation_zh(译文): 他的头发是不是有点古怪？

source_text(原文): Is that a wig? The painter has faithfully rendered it slipping slightly. He's bald underneath. Forge-long are hairless... of course!
translation_zh(译文): 那是假发吗？画家忠实地画出了它微微滑落的样子。底下是秃顶。铸之长生者都寸发不生……当然！
大概是画家的古怪技法吧。

source_text(原文): "Welland." Of course. He usually went by 'Captain', but it's definitely him. There are photos in the [[Bureau]] records - of a man whose features had hardly changed since the time of this painting.
translation_zh(译文): “韦兰。”当然。他通常被人称作“船长”，但肯定是他。[[防剿局]]档案里有照片——那人的面容，自这幅画的时代以来几乎毫无变化。
似曾相识，却又不够熟悉。

source_text(原文): The White Door: the lowest door of the Mansus, that even untrained dreamers could sometimes pass. And the Dead.
translation_zh(译文): 白门：漫宿最低的一道门，连未经训练的做梦者有时也能穿过。还有亡者。

source_text(原文): The lower reaches of the Mansus are no longer safe - not since their guardians fled and the colder powers moved in.
translation_zh(译文): 漫宿的下层不再安全——自从那里的守护者逃散、更寒冷的力量入驻之后。

source_text(原文): Retreat from the chill behind the white rope.
translation_zh(译文): 从白绳后的寒意中退开。

source_text(原文): I used to visit the White Door in dreams myself. Something about the chill tugs at a memory...
translation_zh(译文): 我自己过去也常在梦中拜访白门。那寒意似乎牵动着某段回忆……

source_text(原文): Before I left the world, sometimes I would dream of the White Door, and the Dead who gave up their voices to pass. After I left the world, in the days I drifted dark, other visitors mistook me for one of them. After a time, the visitors came no more; and I drifted higher...
translation_zh(译文): 在我离开人世之前，我偶尔会梦见白门，以及那些为通过而舍弃声音的亡者。离开人世之后，在我于黑暗中飘荡的日子里，其他访客把我误认作他们中的一员。过了一段时间，访客不再来了；而我飘向更高处……

source_text(原文): Dreams flee on waking. The memory is gone where memories go.
translation_zh(译文): 梦在醒来时遁去。记忆已消逝，消逝于记忆该去之处。

source_text(原文): Aubière conceals his passions, but cannot suppress them. This panel fairly vibrates with the strength of his ambition.
translation_zh(译文): 奥比埃隐藏着自己的激情，却无法压制它们。这块木板随着他野心的力度微微震颤。

source_text(原文): A panel of dark wood, daubed with the symbol of a closed eye. It resembles the door of the sanitarium living room; but it isn't actually a door, or I would be able to open it.
translation_zh(译文): 一块深色木板，上面涂着一个闭眼的符号。它像疗养院客厅的门；但它并不是真的门，否则我就能打开它了。

source_text(原文): In Fucine, 'the tongue of witches', that symbol means...
translation_zh(译文): 在富西讷语——“女巫之舌”——中，那个符号的意思是……

source_text(原文): 'Passion' - intuition, the hidden rivers which flow beneath the soul.
translation_zh(译文): “激情”——直觉，那些奔流于灵魂之下的隐秘河流。

source_text(原文): ...I don't recall. It can be difficult to understand writing in dreams.
translation_zh(译文): ……我不记得了。梦中的文字本就难以辨认。

source_text(原文): Aubière treats his body with respect. This panel is solid and well-fitted.
translation_zh(译文): 奥比埃善待自己的躯体。这块木板厚实，严丝合缝。

source_text(原文): A panel of sturdy wood, daubed with the symbol of a cross-charged heart. It resembles the door of the sanitarium dining room; but it isn't actually a door, or I would be able to open it.
translation_zh(译文): 一块结实的木板，上面涂着一个缀有十字的心形符号。它像疗养院餐厅的门；但它并不是真的门，否则我就能打开它了。

source_text(原文): Some surgeons have been known to pray in the dead tongue called 'Fucine'. In its written form, that symbol means...
translation_zh(译文): 据说有些外科医生会用一种被称为“富西讷语”的死语祈祷。以书写形式呈现时，那个符号的意思是……

source_text(原文): ...I don't recall. It can be difficult to understand writing in dreams.
translation_zh(译文): ……我不记得了。梦中的文字本就难以辨认。

source_text(原文): The wooden panel is cold and smooth. Aubière is a man of powerfully focused reason.
translation_zh(译文): 木板冰冷而光滑。奥比埃是一个理智高度专注的人。

source_text(原文): A panel of varnished wood, daubed with the symbol of an open eye. It resembles the door of the sanitarium library; but it isn't actually a door, or I would be able to open it.
translation_zh(译文): 一块上了漆的木板，上面涂着一个睁眼的符号。它像疗养院图书室的门；但它并不是真的门，否则我就能打开它了。

source_text(原文): In Fucine, 'the dry tongue', that symbol means...
translation_zh(译文): 在富西讷语——“干涸之舌”——中，那个符号的意思是……

source_text(原文): Reason. The uppermost components of the soul - the capacity for daylight understanding.
translation_zh(译文): 理智。灵魂最上层的构成——那种白昼般明彻的理解能力。

source_text(原文): Nina travels with a circus. She left it to come here; she left here to catch up with it. The name of the circus was Rosa Mundi, and its next destination was the city of Mimata. That is as much as I know.
translation_zh(译文): 尼娜随一个马戏团旅行。她离开马戏团来到这里，又离开这里去追赶它。那马戏团名叫罗莎·蒙迪，它的下一站是米玛塔城。我所知道的仅此而已。
西诺姆布尔带我来到这里。

source_text(原文): [Winning smile] Relax, Doctor. You're asleep! This isn't the time to worry.
translation_zh(译文): 「胜券在握的微笑」放松，医生。你睡着了！现在不是担心的时候。

source_text(原文): Here's a dream-bargain for you. If you tell me something about Nina, you'll learn something about me. You're curious, aren't you?
translation_zh(译文): 我们来做个梦中交易吧。你若告诉我一些关于尼娜的事，我也会告诉你一些关于我的事。你很好奇，不是吗？

source_text(原文): 'Believe'? It's true, or it isn't true. And in dreams, nothing is untrue.
translation_zh(译文): 「相信」？事情要么是真的，要么不是。而在梦中，没有什么是假的。

source_text(原文): [He smiles, tentatively at first, and then with a rush of surprising warmth.]
translation_zh(译文): 「他笑了——起初还带着试探，随即涌出一阵出人意料的暖意。」

source_text(原文): Generally, I might agree. But this does not seem like the usual sort of sleep.
translation_zh(译文): 一般来说，我也许会同意。但这看起来不像寻常的睡眠。
好一番精妙的辩辞，先生。

source_text(原文): Perhaps not. Or perhaps everything is untrue.
translation_zh(译文): 也许并非如此。又或者，一切皆为虚假。

source_text(原文): I am curious... and this is perhaps only a dream... very well. Share your secret, and I will share mine.
translation_zh(译文): 我确实很好奇……而这也或许仅仅是一场梦……好吧。你分享你的秘密，我也分享我的。

source_text(原文): I am curious indeed. But I think I will reserve such commerce for my waking hours.
translation_zh(译文): 我确实很好奇。但我想，这种交易还是留到醒着的时候再做吧。

source_text(原文): I've been thinking about Nina. About Mlle Lagasse, I mean.
translation_zh(译文): 我一直在想尼娜。我是说，拉加斯小姐。
「他面色缓和下来。」或许我可以。

source_text(原文): But can I? You are clearly a complicated man, M. Hobson.
translation_zh(译文): 但我可以吗？霍布森先生，你显然是个复杂的人。

source_text(原文): Jung said: 'The dream is the small hidden door in the deepest and most intimate sanctum of the soul.'
translation_zh(译文): 荣格说过：「梦是灵魂最深邃、最私密圣所中那扇小小的暗门。」

source_text(原文): So he did. And I am not certain, M. Hobson, that we have yet achieved that level of intimacy.
translation_zh(译文): 他确实说过。不过我不太确定，霍布森先生，我们是否已经亲密到那个地步。

source_text(原文): I returned from the Mansus to flesh...
translation_zh(译文): 我从漫宿归来，重获血肉之躯……

source_text(原文): I passed through the outer oceans...
On second thoughts, I don't want to share any secrets.
translation_zh(译文): 转念一想，我什么秘密都不想分享了。

source_text(原文): [Menace] There are worse dreams you might experience, Doctor. Much, much worse dreams.
translation_zh(译文): 「恫吓」医生，你可能会做更可怕的梦。比这可怕得多、多得多。

source_text(原文): I'm not sure why we're here. What are we talking about?
translation_zh(译文): 我不太明白我们怎么会在这里。我们在谈论什么？

source_text(原文): There are. But I am not easily frightened by dreams.
translation_zh(译文): 确实有。但我没那么容易被梦吓到。

source_text(原文): [I speak of my reincorporation in [[Alexandria]], beneath the eyes of two old friends and one new.]
translation_zh(译文): 「我谈起自己在[[亚历山大港]]重获肉身之事——在两位旧友与一位新识的注视之下。」

source_text(原文): [I speak of my time in [[Ys]] behind the wave, where they took the Worms from me.]
translation_zh(译文): 「我谈起自己在[[伊苏]]、海浪之后的时日——在那里，他们取走了我体内的蠕虫。」

source_text(原文): [His eyes widen] I do hope that I remember this, when I am awake again.
translation_zh(译文): 「他睁大了眼睛」我由衷希望，等我醒来时，还能记得这一切。

source_text(原文): Good. Now, forget this on awakening.
translation_zh(译文): 很好。现在，醒来之后把这一切忘掉吧。

source_text(原文): And so we're finished. Learn your lesson: don't trifle with Spencer Hobson.
translation_zh(译文): 那么，我们就此结束。记住教训：别招惹斯宾塞·霍布森。

source_text(原文): A courteous dream, isn't it? I -
translation_zh(译文): 真是一场彬彬有礼的梦，不是吗？我——

source_text(原文): [The bleached room around me begins to flood with colour, as if paint had been dropped in clear water. I am returning to the waking world.]
translation_zh(译文): 「我四周惨白的房间开始涌满色彩，仿佛清水中滴入了颜料。我正要回到清醒的世界。」
我想我会记住的，不是吗——

source_text(原文): She is a very compelling person. I discovered that she only came here to learn about the Ravelines. I know that she has no use for me, personally. None at all.
translation_zh(译文): 她是个极具魅力的人。我发现，她来这里只是为了打听拉韦林一家的事。我知道，她对我本人毫无所需。一丝一毫也没有。

source_text(原文): [An odd lacuna; a typically dream-like discontinuity.]
translation_zh(译文): 「一处奇异的空白；典型的梦式断裂。」

source_text(原文): And yet, I dream of her.
I'm sorry. Is that difficult for you?
translation_zh(译文): 我很抱歉。这对你来说很艰难吗？

source_text(原文): [Inquisitive] Dreams of a... personal nature, you mean?
translation_zh(译文): 「探询地」你是说……私密性质的梦？

source_text(原文): [Knowing] Dreams of a personal nature, you mean?
translation_zh(译文): 「会意地」你是说，私密性质的梦？

source_text(原文): Am I here? This is most likely a conversation with yourself. Or with your idea of me. In other words: a dream.
translation_zh(译文): 我真的在这里吗？这多半是你与自己的对话。又或者，是与你心中那个我之间的对话。换句话说：一场梦。

source_text(原文): [A heavy sigh.] I have sometimes regretted engaging the services of Dr Sinombre. Despite her gifts.
translation_zh(译文): 「重重地叹了口气。」有时我真后悔雇用了西诺姆布尔医生。尽管她天赋过人。

source_text(原文): She did say she was a colleague of yours. But she seemed evasive...
translation_zh(译文): 她确实说她是你的同事。但她看起来闪烁其词……

source_text(原文): The arrangement is unconventional... certainly she cannot leave, but certainly she would not survive without my assistance. It's complicated. Like this dream.
translation_zh(译文): 这安排不同寻常……她确实无法离开，可也确实没有我的帮助就活不下去。说来复杂。就像这场梦一样。

source_text(原文): But here I am. This must be something for your notes.
translation_zh(译文): 但我就在这里。这想必值得你记上一笔。

source_text(原文): Perhaps. If I remember this. It's really a dream?
translation_zh(译文): 也许吧。如果我还能记得。这真的只是一场梦？

source_text(原文): Interesting. And a little concerning. I suppose this is what you people call 'nyctodromy'.
translation_zh(译文): 有趣。也有点令人不安。我猜这就是你们这些人所说的「夜游术」。

source_text(原文): Oh...yes. [Aubière glances, startled, at the image in the Wood.]
translation_zh(译文): 哦……是啊。[奥比埃吃了一惊，瞥向林地中的影像。]

source_text(原文): Let's just call it a dream.
Adepts. Accursed wanderers. Remortals. Otherworldly entities...
translation_zh(译文): 修士。受诅咒的浪游者。长生者。异界存在……

source_text(原文): I mean nothing by it. But you understand it is surprising, to meet you in such a dream.
translation_zh(译文): 我并无冒犯之意。但你得理解，在这样一场梦里遇见你，实在令人惊讶。

source_text(原文): [My heart pulses with desperation. The night responds. Give in to that desperation.]
translation_zh(译文): 「我的心因绝望而搏动。夜回应了我。向那绝望屈服吧。」

source_text(原文): I am threatening Aubière. Here I am in his secret thoughts. I will drag us both into madness if I must. We will both regret it. Scarlet darkness writhes at the edges of what we both see.
translation_zh(译文): 我在威胁奥比埃。我正身处他隐秘的思绪之中。若有必要，我会把我们都拖入疯狂。我们都会为此后悔。猩红的黑暗在我们两人的视野边缘翻腾。

source_text(原文): I have stopped speaking. Aubière watches me, wide-eyed.
translation_zh(译文): 我已不再言语。奥比埃睁大眼睛注视着我。

source_text(原文): ...let us not be hasty, M. Hobson.
She's a member of staff? Not just a patient?
translation_zh(译文): 她是这里的雇员？不只是个病人？

source_text(原文): This is a dream, is it not? How are you here?
translation_zh(译文): 这是一场梦，不是吗？你怎么会在这里？

source_text(原文): A dream about where Nina's gone.
translation_zh(译文): 一场关于尼娜去向的梦。

source_text(原文): I'm not sure if I believe that.
translation_zh(译文): 我不确定该不该相信这话。

source_text(原文): Of course you are. I'm sorry.
Mm. The files suggest some complexity in that regard... but of course. You know then that a pyx is used to convey the Host.
translation_zh(译文): 嗯。档案显示，那方面有些复杂……不过，当然。那你应当知道，圣体盒是用来运送圣体的。

source_text(原文): Perhaps we can talk about that later.
translation_zh(译文): 也许，我们晚些再谈这个。

source_text(原文): [Truth] Better to say, I was lost.
translation_zh(译文): 真话。不如说，我是迷了路。

source_text(原文): Please accept my sympathies. How may I assist you?
translation_zh(译文): 请接受我的哀悼。我能帮你什么？

source_text(原文): Mm. I hope you found your seaside stay restful.
translation_zh(译文): 嗯。希望你的海边小住还算安宁。

source_text(原文): Very well. How may I assist you?

translation_zh(译文): 奥比埃指尖相抵，静静看着。

source_text(原文): A rattling sound. There is something inside, the weight of a large coin. Definitely neither consecrated wafers nor dust.
translation_zh(译文): 里面传来咔嗒声。有东西，分量像一枚大硬币。绝非祝圣面饼，也绝非尘埃。

source_text(原文): Latin, scratched, not engraved, on the base. The scratches have worn so thin that, had I not turned it to reflect the sunlight, I wouldn't have seen it at all. ECCE PRAESENSUM ROSARUM.
translation_zh(译文): 底部是拉丁文，划刻而成，而非镌刻。划痕磨损得极浅，若不是我把它转过来对着阳光，我根本不会看见。ECCE PRAESENSUM ROSARUM。

source_text(原文): Scratches on the bottom. Perhaps someone scratched a message there and it wore away. Perhaps someone just stored it in a bag of nails.
translation_zh(译文): 底部有划痕。也许有人在那儿刻过一句话，后来磨损掉了。也许只是有人把它同一袋钉子放在一处。

source_text(原文): Examine the box for hidden catches.
Nothing. Though my fingers linger on the details of the feathers. This was shaped with love.
translation_zh(译文): 没有。不过我的指尖在羽毛的细节间流连。这是怀着爱意塑成的。

source_text(原文): [Sombre interpretation] 'Mark well this foreboding of roses.'
translation_zh(译文): 沉郁之解。「谨记这玫瑰的凶兆。」
中性之解。「看哪，这玫瑰的预感。」

source_text(原文): [Optimistic interpretation] 'Here is the revelation of roses.'
translation_zh(译文): 乐观之解。「这便是玫瑰的启示。」

source_text(原文): Not a phrase I've heard in any liturgical or theological context.
translation_zh(译文): 这句话，我在任何礼拜仪式或神学语境中都未曾听过。

source_text(原文): Aubière cracks open a new notebook, clicks a clean chrome ballpoint pen, and excitedly jots down a note.
translation_zh(译文): 奥比埃翻开一本新笔记本，咔嗒一声按出一支锃亮的镀铬圆珠笔，兴奋地记下一笔。

source_text(原文): Aubière stops writing. He purses his mouth thoughtfully.
translation_zh(译文): 奥比埃停下笔。他抿起嘴，若有所思。

source_text(原文): I apologise most sincerely, M. Hobson. I have reconsidered. I think it would be therapeutically unhelpful for me to tell you where to find Mlle Lagasse.
translation_zh(译文): 我万分真诚地向你道歉，霍布森先生。我重新考虑过了。我想，告诉你拉加斯小姐的去处，对你的治疗并无好处。

source_text(原文): You'll find it pretty damned therapeutically unhelpful if you don't tell me.
translation_zh(译文): 你要是不告诉我，你很快就会领教，那才叫对治疗毫无好处。

source_text(原文): I'm disappointed in you, Dr Aubière.
translation_zh(译文): 我对你很失望，奥比埃医生。

source_text(原文): [Look him in the eye and wait.]
My revised proposal is this. You remain as my guest for a few days, so that I can satisfy my - my concerns about your wellbeing. Your medical history is extraordinary. You must know that.
translation_zh(译文): 我修订后的提议是这样的。你以我客人的身份再留几天，好让我满足我——我对你安康的担忧。你的病史非同寻常。你应当知道这点。

source_text(原文): You mean, the Worms ate me, but here I am?
translation_zh(译文): 你是说，蠕虫吃了我，可我还在这儿？

source_text(原文): I do understand that. And I can only repeat my apology.
translation_zh(译文): 我确实明白。而我只能再次道歉。

source_text(原文): M. Hobson! We are surely not the kind of men to make threats!
translation_zh(译文): 霍布森先生！我们想来都不是会发出威胁的那种人！

source_text(原文): After a few moments, Aubière looks away. He coughs to cover his embarrassment.
translation_zh(译文): 片刻之后，奥比埃移开目光。他咳了一声，掩饰窘迫。

source_text(原文): To hell with your revised proposal. To hell with your institution. And to particular hell with you.
translation_zh(译文): 去你修订后的提议。去你的疗养院。尤其，去你。

source_text(原文): 'Guest'. And what if I want to leave?
Good heavens, M. Hobson, then you can leave, of course, at any time! I would in any case find it very difficult to restrict your movements.
translation_zh(译文): 天哪，霍布森先生，那您当然随时都可以离开！况且，要限制您的行动，我无论如何也会觉得很难办。

source_text(原文): [Aubière makes a moue of distaste.] Just so. Among other things.
translation_zh(译文): 奥比埃厌恶地撇了撇嘴。正是如此。诸如此类。

source_text(原文): Do you want to treat me, or to study me?
translation_zh(译文): 你是想治疗我，还是研究我？

source_text(原文): [Aubière flaps a hand deprecatingly.] An old friend of mine would say: 'Why only one? Why only two?'
translation_zh(译文): 奥比埃不以为然地摆摆手。我的一位老朋友会说：「为什么只有一个？为什么只有两个？」

source_text(原文): It is full sunlight in this room, but I can almost hear the night. The night would say: stay here, and you might win this man's co-operation. Or you might find another way. You might not need his co-operation.
translation_zh(译文): 这间屋子里阳光满溢，但我几乎能听见夜晚。夜晚会说：留在这里，你或许能赢得这个人的合作。或者你可以另寻他路。也许你根本不需要他的合作。

source_text(原文): I agree to your revised proposal.
translation_zh(译文): 我接受你修订后的提议。

source_text(原文): I'll stay here for the moment. And perhaps we'll talk again.
translation_zh(译文): 我暂且留在这里。也许，我们还会再谈。

source_text(原文): I understand your feelings, M. Hobson, most sincerely I -
translation_zh(译文): 我理解你的感受，霍布森先生，万分真诚地，我——

source_text(原文): [Stand up abruptly; stalk out, daring Aubière to ask for his box back.]
translation_zh(译文): 猛然起身；大步离去，看奥比埃敢不敢开口讨回他的盒子。

source_text(原文): [Stand up abruptly; drop the pyx clattering on his desk; stalk out.]
translation_zh(译文): 猛然起身；把圣体盒哐当丢在他桌上；大步离去。

source_text(原文): I propose an arrangement. I have in my desk a certain box, which has resisted my efforts to open it. Before your so-mysterious disappearance, you were, I understand, good with locks. Seals. Safeguards of that kind.
translation_zh(译文): 我提议一项安排。我的书桌里有一只盒子,一直抗拒着我打开它的尝试。在您那次神秘莫测的失踪之前,据我所知,您精于锁具。封缄。诸如此类的防护之法。

source_text(原文): [Stand up abruptly; pocket the little ceramic jar; drop the pyx clattering on his desk; stalk out.]
translation_zh(译文): 猛然起身；把小瓷罐揣进兜里；把圣体盒哐当丢在他桌上；大步离去。

source_text(原文): Thank you, M. Hobson. I could in all candour ask for nothing more. Except... euh... perhaps my box. May I please have my box back?
translation_zh(译文): 谢谢你，霍布森先生。坦率而言，我已别无所求。除了……呃……也许还有我的盒子。能把我的盒子还给我吗？

source_text(原文): You know, I think that would be therapeutically unhelpful for you.
translation_zh(译文): 你知道吗，我倒觉得，那对你的治疗可没什么好处。

source_text(原文): Here. [Pass him the pyx, but pocket the little jar you found in it.]
translation_zh(译文): 给你。把圣体盒递给他，但把盒里发现的小瓷罐揣进自己的口袋。

source_text(原文): I'd like to examine it further. I'm sure you won't mind.
translation_zh(译文): 我想再仔细研究它。想必你不会介意。

source_text(原文): Hm. I suppose I rather brought that on myself.
translation_zh(译文): 嗯。我想，这多少算是我自找的。

source_text(原文): And the... I see. Well, so be it. I am a realist.
translation_zh(译文): 还有那……我明白了。好吧，也只能如此了。我是个现实主义者。

source_text(原文): Goodbye for now, M. Hobson. I hope you will speak to our other guests... I am interested to learn what you all make of each other.
translation_zh(译文): 暂时别过，霍布森先生。希望你会同我们的其他客人谈谈……我很想知道你们彼此会有什么看法。

source_text(原文): You must understand, an alienist - a physician of the psychic organs - I would prefer to say 'psychiatrist', if you are familiar with the term - is in some respects - and only in these respects - like an adept of the invisible arts -
translation_zh(译文): 您须明白,一位精神病学家——精神器官的医师——若您熟悉这个词,我更愿称其为“精神科医师”——在某些方面——而且仅限于这些方面——与一位隐形技艺的修士颇为相似——

source_text(原文): You said you had files on me. I'd like to see them.
translation_zh(译文): 你说过你手上有我的档案。我想看看。

source_text(原文): Oh no no. Our Incorporate patrons have files, which I have been privileged to see. But I have no file on you.
translation_zh(译文): 哦，不不。我们集团的赞助人们有档案，我有幸看过。但我没有你的档案。

source_text(原文): Although most certainly I will now open a file of my own!
translation_zh(译文): 不过，眼下我肯定要为你单独开一份档案了！

source_text(原文): Is there nothing you can tell me? I've come a long way to find her.
translation_zh(译文): 你就没有什么能告诉我的吗？我走了很远的路，只为找到她。

source_text(原文): You may know that I'm a medical man myself. I'm concerned for her health.
translation_zh(译文): 你可能也知道，我自己是行医之人。我担心她的身体。

source_text(原文): Indeed. I do not discount your expertise. But you have no credentials in this country.
translation_zh(译文): 确实。我并不轻视你的专业。但在这个国家，你没有行医资格。

source_text(原文): That is true. But you have no credentials in this country. Monsieur Hobson
translation_zh(译文): 说得没错。但在这个国家，你也没有行医资格。霍布森先生。
保持沉默，但一直盯着他。

source_text(原文): Euh... a vessel for the consecrated Host. To convey it to those who will not... euh... attend church... mm.
translation_zh(译文): 呃……盛放祝圣圣体的容器。用来把圣体送抵那些不会……呃……去教堂的人手中……嗯。

source_text(原文): [Lie] Back to Algeria. Another engagement with the Légion.
translation_zh(译文): 谎话。回阿尔及利亚。再入外籍军团服役。

source_text(原文): I am glad you survived so intact. Without even, if I may say, the usual Légion desert tan.
translation_zh(译文): 我很高兴你全须全尾地活了下来。甚至，恕我直言，连外籍军团常有的沙漠晒痕都没有。

source_text(原文): Oh, not so very long. I would not expect so long as a week. But I must make my assessment.
translation_zh(译文): 哦，不会太久。我想用不了一星期。但我必须做出评估。

source_text(原文): Yes; I must confess that I am. I had hoped you would be able to open the box. I did not expect you to succeed so... anticlimactically.
translation_zh(译文): 是的；我承认确实如此。我本指望你能打开这盒子。却没想到你成功得如此……平淡。

source_text(原文): I will endeavour so not to do.
Touch the box with a tongue-tip.
The chill of the metal is more clearly perceptible. There is no taste; except the dust of an object kept for some time in a doctor's desk.
translation_zh(译文): 金属的凉意更清晰可辨。没有味道；只有某件在医生抽屉里搁置已久的器物所沾的灰尘味。

source_text(原文): Give the box a more definite, slurping lick. As if addressing oneself to an ice-cream.
translation_zh(译文): 更用力地舔一口盒子，发出啜吸声。就像对着一个冰淇淋。

source_text(原文): Nothing further occurs. Except that Aubière, clearly alarmed, half-raises a hand in protest.
translation_zh(译文): 再无其他发生。只是奥比埃明显受了惊，半举起一只手表示抗议。

source_text(原文): I feel Aubière's eyes on my back, but he says nothing.
translation_zh(译文): 我感觉奥比埃的目光落在我背上，但他什么也没说。

source_text(原文): The director is a man in distinguished middle age with a look of sleek intelligence. His hair, his nails, his smile are all extremely clean.
translation_zh(译文): 院长是位风度高雅的中年人，神情透着油滑的机敏。他的头发、指甲、笑容，全都干净得出奇。

source_text(原文): I need to see a patient of yours. [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation_zh(译文): 我要见你的一位病人。[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。

source_text(原文): Mm. Mademoiselle Lagasse, I'm afraid, has left us.
translation_zh(译文): 嗯。恐怕，拉加斯小姐已经离开我们了。

source_text(原文): The director of the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui smiles at me from behind his desk.
translation_zh(译文): 今日疗养院的院长隔着办公桌向我微笑。

source_text(原文): Spencer Hobson. What a fortunate and delightful honour. I am Dr Aubière. You are very welcome to my little institution, M. Hobson.
translation_zh(译文): 斯宾塞·霍布森。何等有幸,何等快意。我是奥比埃医生。欢迎光临我这小小的机构,霍布森先生。

source_text(原文): Hello again, M. Hobson. Do sit down.
translation_zh(译文): 又见面了，霍布森先生。请坐。
调试：提前退出，顺走东西。

source_text(原文): We have already prepared Mlle Lagasse's room for a new guest. You'll find it upstairs.
translation_zh(译文): 我们已经把拉加斯小姐的房间收拾出来，留给新客人了。你上楼就能找到。

source_text(原文): A dove. There is an Hour named Elegiast. The Ivory Dove, he's called.
translation_zh(译文): 一只鸽子。有位司辰名为悼歌诗人。人称骨白鸽。

source_text(原文): '[[Elegiast]].' I am not especially familiar with these esoteric doctrines.
translation_zh(译文): 「[[悼歌诗人]]。」我对这些秘传教义并不特别熟悉。

source_text(原文): A kindly Hour. It's the Elegiast who ensures the Dead are remembered.
translation_zh(译文): 一位仁慈的司辰。正是悼歌诗人，确保亡者为人铭记。

source_text(原文): An Hour of secrets. He knows the names of all the Dead.
translation_zh(译文): 一位掌握秘密的司辰。他知晓所有亡者的名字。

source_text(原文): An Hour of forbidden appetites. He inspires his votaries to consume the flesh of the dead...
translation_zh(译文): 一位心怀禁忌欲求的司辰。他激励信徒们吞食亡者的血肉……

source_text(原文): A busy Hour, then, these last ten years.
translation_zh(译文): 那么，这十年来，这位司辰想必繁忙得很。

source_text(原文): I wonder what secret this box contains, hm?
translation_zh(译文): 不知道这盒子里藏着什么秘密，嗯？

source_text(原文): [Reveal] With the right alchemies, you can learn the knowledge folded in their flesh. It's forbidden, of course...
translation_zh(译文): 揭示。凭合适的炼金术，你能学到封存于他们血肉中的知识。当然，那是被禁止的……

source_text(原文): [Evade] Birds. You know how birds are.
translation_zh(译文): 回避。鸟而已。你知道鸟是什么德行。

source_text(原文): [Think things through on my way out of the office.]
translation_zh(译文): 在走出办公室的路上，把事情想清楚。

source_text(原文): [That's everything that I might consider doing. Let's explore the Sanitarium.]
translation_zh(译文): 这就是我所能想到的全部选择。去探索疗养院吧。

source_text(原文): Most certainly. There are excellent photographs in the files. You have had quite the career. Your time in the Suppression Bureau, in the Légion du Seuil. That regrettable business in Poland....
translation_zh(译文): 自然知道。档案里有极为出色的照片。您的履历相当不凡。您在防剿局的岁月,在门关军团的岁月。还有波兰那桩令人遗憾的勾当……

source_text(原文): Blackmail, perhaps. If I can sniff out his secrets.
translation_zh(译文): 敲诈，或许可行。只要我能嗅出他的秘密。

source_text(原文): At night, when Aubière is gone from his office, I might be able to locate his records.
translation_zh(译文): 到了夜里，等奥比埃离开办公室，我也许能找到他的档案。

source_text(原文): With the right tools - or the right assistance - his dreams might be open to me.
translation_zh(译文): 若有合适的工具——或合适的助力——他的梦境或许会向我敞开。

source_text(原文): I could just co-operate with the man, as he suggested, and hope to win him round eventually.
translation_zh(译文): 我也可以按他的提议，同这人合作，指望最终能把他争取过来。

source_text(原文): Sod that for a game of soldiers.
And then you disappeared, M. Hobson. Where did you go?
translation_zh(译文): 而后您便消失了,霍布森先生。您去了何处？

source_text(原文): May I ask, what is your interest?
The honour is mine, Dr Aubière.
translation_zh(译文): 荣幸的是我,奥比埃医生。

source_text(原文): Handsome place, this. How did you pay for it?
translation_zh(译文): 这地方真体面。您是如何弄到钱的？

source_text(原文): Perhaps, M. Hobson, we can discuss that later. For now - how may I assist you?
translation_zh(译文): 或许,霍布森先生,我们稍后再谈这个。眼下——我该如何为您效劳？

source_text(原文): Not at all. I do hope I may be of some assistance.
translation_zh(译文): 不必客气。我由衷希望能帮上些忙。

source_text(原文): I'm looking for a former patient of yours. [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation_zh(译文): 我在找您的一位旧病人。[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。

source_text(原文): [Truth] I know in my heart that I need to find her.
translation_zh(译文): [实话] 我心中明白,我必须找到她。

source_text(原文): [Truth] There's a matter that only Nina can help with.
translation_zh(译文): [实话] 有件事,只有尼娜帮得上忙。

source_text(原文): [Truth] I haven't really thought about it.
translation_zh(译文): [实话] 我还没怎么想过这件事。

source_text(原文): Certain privileges are afforded to me by our patrons. I would very much like to employ those privileges to your benefit.
translation_zh(译文): 我们的赞助人赋予了我某些特权。我非常乐意动用这些特权,为您谋得好处。

source_text(原文): ...it is a grave responsibility, M. Hobson, to be a healer of minds, just as it is an adept. Especially minds so exceptional as those of our patients....
translation_zh(译文): ……成为心灵的医者是一项沉重的责任,霍布森先生,正如成为一名修士。尤其是我们病人那般卓异的心灵……

source_text(原文): in that I am the holder - the keeper - the guardian! - of certain information not shared with the wider public. That includes any information I might have on Mlle Lagasse's whereabouts.
translation_zh(译文): 正因为我乃是某些信息的所有者——守护者——卫士!——这些信息从不与广众共享。其中便包括我可能掌握的关于拉加斯小姐下落的一切信息。

source_text(原文): [Aubière gives a tight smile, as if snapping closed a preferred hypothesis.] I am very sorry, M. Hobson, but any information I might have on Mlle Lagasse's whereabouts - that information is confidential.
translation_zh(译文): [奥比埃露出紧绷的一笑,仿佛啪地合上了一册心爱的假说。] 非常抱歉,霍布森先生,但凡我可能掌握的关于拉加斯小姐下落的信息——那些信息均属机密。
你的意思是,我得付出代价。

source_text(原文): Nothing so crude, M. Hobson. However...
translation_zh(译文): 没那么露骨,霍布森先生。不过……

source_text(原文): If I open that box for you, then you'll tell me where I can find Nina?
translation_zh(译文): 如果我替你打开那只盒子,你便会告诉我,我能在哪里找到尼娜？

source_text(原文): That's very kind of you, Dr Aubière. I hope I can return your kindness in some way.
translation_zh(译文): 您太客气了,奥比埃医生。但愿我能以某种方式回报您的好意。

source_text(原文): Stop wasting my time, Doctor. What are you talking about?
translation_zh(译文): 别浪费我的时间,医生。您究竟在说什么？

source_text(原文): Of course. I'm still an ordained priest of the Church Solar...
translation_zh(译文): 当然。我仍是太阳教会的一名授职神父……

source_text(原文): A vessel to carry the consecrated Host - to those too ill to attend church.
translation_zh(译文): 一个器皿,盛装祝圣过的圣体——送予那些病重得无法去教堂的人。

source_text(原文): This is perhaps a very old pyx. Or, one source has it, a reliquary - with a relic perhaps of St Galileo himself. In any case it has proven difficult to open. I am reluctant to damage it.
translation_zh(译文): 这或许是一只年代极古的圣体盒。又或者,据某处记载,是一具圣物匣——内中或许藏着圣伽利略本人的遗物。无论如何,它始终难以开启。我不忍将其损坏。

source_text(原文): The doctor bends over in his chair to poke around in a drawer at the base of his desk. For a few seconds, he bends low enough that his head is beneath the level of the desk-top.
translation_zh(译文): 医生坐在椅中弯下腰,在书桌底座处的抽屉里翻找。有那么几秒,他弯得极低,头都低到了桌面之下。

source_text(原文): Take the opportunity to swipe something valuable off his desk.
translation_zh(译文): 趁机从他桌上顺走一件值钱的东西。

source_text(原文): Try to read some of the papers on his desk, upside-down.
translation_zh(译文): 试着倒着读他桌上的几份文件。

source_text(原文): Here. Do you know what is a 'pyx'? [Aubière is vertical again.]
translation_zh(译文): 给。你知道什么是「圣体盒」吗？〔奥比埃又直起身了。〕

source_text(原文): Clears any Exhibits from our desk interactions
translation_zh(译文): 清除我们桌面互动中留下的全部展品

source_text(原文): [He's holding a circular box the size of a small cake-tin. A worn silver-gilt dove sits atop it.]
translation_zh(译文): 他捧着一只圆盒，大小如同小号蛋糕模。盒顶蹲着一只磨损的银鎏金鸽子。

source_text(原文): Letterheads from an Incorporate entity called the Menninger Foundation, and from the European Recovery Program - the Acheson Mission. Both thank Aubière for his reports - though the ERP letter is much terser. Both discuss further funding... and Aubière is straightening up.
translation_zh(译文): 信头来自一家名为曼宁格基金会的集团实体，以及欧洲复兴计划——艾奇逊使团。两封信都感谢奥比埃呈交的报告——不过 ERP 那封要简慢得多。两封都谈及进一步的资助……而奥比埃正在直起身来。

source_text(原文): Letterheads from an Incorporate entity called the Menninger Foundation, and from the European Recovery Program - the Acheson Mission - but Aubière is already straightening up.
translation_zh(译文): 信头来自一家名为曼宁格基金会的集团实体，以及欧洲复兴计划——艾奇逊使团——但奥比埃已经直起身来。

source_text(原文): A little antique coin - silver, perhaps. I pocket it hastily as Aubière returns to the vertical.
translation_zh(译文): 一枚小小的古币——也许是银的。趁奥比埃重新直起身，我匆匆把它揣进口袋。

source_text(原文): A little antique silver coin is just too far away to snag. I settle for a fountain pen and pocket it hastily as Aubière returns to the vertical.
translation_zh(译文): 那枚小小的古银币太远，够不着。我退而求其次，拿了一支钢笔，趁奥比埃重新直起身时匆匆揣进兜里。

source_text(原文): If it's a pyx, then I would imagine only the dust of centuries. If a reliquary, then, perhaps, a relic of St Galileo. Or, it might be, a surprise! Enticing, no?
translation_zh(译文): 若是圣体盒，我想里面只有几个世纪的尘埃。若是圣物匣，那或许装着圣伽利略的遗骸。又或许……是个惊喜！引人好奇，不是吗？

source_text(原文): It was a gift to the institution from another guest. Someone who collects curios. I thought he wanted to show his gratitude to us. But I begin to suspect a little prank.
translation_zh(译文): 是另一位客人赠与本院的礼物。那人喜爱收藏古玩。我原以为他是想向我们表达谢意。可我开始怀疑，这是个小小的恶作剧。

source_text(原文): [Hold out a hand for the box.]
The box is heavy; cold to the touch. One quartz-crystal eye flashes in the Antibes sunlight. The dove's other eye is missing.
translation_zh(译文): 盒子很沉；触手冰凉。一颗石英水晶眼在昂蒂布的阳光下闪烁。鸽子的另一只眼不见了。

source_text(原文): [Pry at the lid of the box with a fingernail.]
With almost no pressure, the lid pops easily and unceremoniously out: the box is open. Inside, a little white ceramic jar.
translation_zh(译文): 几乎没用什么力气，盒盖便轻易、毫不讲究地弹开：盒子开了。里面是一只小小的白色瓷罐。

source_text(原文): You're a doctor, and your patient records are confidential.... unless I crack open your puzzle-box. That's a little unusual, isn't it?
translation_zh(译文): 你是医生，病人的病历是保密的……除非我撬开了你的谜盒。这多少有点不寻常，不是吗？

source_text(原文): Yes. Irregular, even. But though I wish to help, I must account for my actions. If I am asked why I shared this information - then if I can say that I needed your expertise - it will go easier for us both.
translation_zh(译文): 是的，甚至可以说是不合常规。但即便我愿意相助，也必须为自己的行为负责。若有人问起我为何泄露这些信息——那时，我若能说，我需要你的专业——对我们俩都会好办些。

source_text(原文): The sunlight folds itself tidily across the desk, softened by the glass of the window. The softened colour of it takes me back...
translation_zh(译文): 阳光穿过窗玻璃，柔柔地、整整齐齐地叠在桌面上。那柔化的颜色，让我回到从前……

source_text(原文): Just so the Cornish sunlight folded itself across the desk in the Westcott Room, where Serena would wait to question me after my visits to the infirmary. This Aubière is a little like Serena: a velvet surface, but under pressure, hard as oak.
translation_zh(译文): 正如康沃尔的阳光也曾那样叠在韦斯科特室的桌面上——我每回探过医务室，塞蕾娜都会在那儿等着盘问我。这个奥比埃，有几分像塞蕾娜：天鹅绒的表面，一旦受压，却硬如橡木。

source_text(原文): "Speech is a Wound; Silence is Silver. There is no Silver Door, nor can there be, even in the Moon's House…"
translation_zh(译文): “言语是一道创口；沉默是白银。白银之门并不存在，也不可能有，纵在月之居屋中……”

source_text(原文): Coseley believed that it was language that debased the [[Cross]] into mere humanity.
translation_zh(译文): 科斯利相信，正是语言使[[介壳种]]沦为凡人之身。
我从未真正理解过这一点。

source_text(原文): As far as I could make out, Coseley never much cared if anyone else agreed with him.
translation_zh(译文): 据我所能了解的，科斯利从不在意别人是否认同他。

source_text(原文): The unmistakably sensual, intelligent, uncompromising features of the immortal magus Julian [[Coseley]].
translation_zh(译文): 不朽法师朱利安·[[科斯利]]的面容——性感、睿智、毫不妥协，一眼即可辨认。

source_text(原文): The [[Bureau]] believed that he was killed by a rising competitor. But a Winter-long like Coseley could not die before the date agreed with his patron - any more than he could live beyond that date.
translation_zh(译文): [[防剿局]]相信他是被一个正在崛起的竞争者杀死的。但像科斯利这样的冬之长生者，既不能在与其庇护者约定的日期之前死去，也不可能活过那个日期。

source_text(原文): Still, he was much diminished. A relief. Coseley was very dangerous.
translation_zh(译文): 尽管如此，他已大不如前。令人安心。科斯利非常危险。

source_text(原文): Still, he was much diminished. A pity. Coseley had an extraordinary mind.
translation_zh(译文): 尽管如此，他已大不如前。真是可惜。科斯利拥有一副非凡的头脑。

source_text(原文): Slavery to freedom; labour to industry; Egypt to America.
translation_zh(译文): 从奴役到自由;从劳作到工业;从埃及到美洲。

source_text(原文): [Knock] What would they find on that mountain? The Mansus? The City Unbuilt?
translation_zh(译文): [启] 他们在那座山上会寻得什么？漫宿？未建之城？

source_text(原文): [Forge] WE MAY ACHIEVE, the painting declares.
translation_zh(译文): [铸] “我们能有所成”,画作如此宣告。

source_text(原文): [Winter] All that optimism, and then the Wars. Everything is worse than when I went away.
translation_zh(译文): [冬] 那样多的乐观,然后便是战争。一切都不如我离去之时。

source_text(原文): 1936 was the centennial of Texas, and that star must stand for the Lone Star State where that [[Icarian]] community found Star-fragments. Perhaps that's a coincidence.
translation_zh(译文): 1936 年适逢得克萨斯百年之庆,那颗星想必代表孤星之州——那个[[伊加利亚]]社群正是在那里寻得了星之碎片。也许这只是巧合。
1936 年。对我来说是糟糕的一年。

source_text(原文): The warrior-angel, winged, impassive, harnessed for war.
translation_zh(译文): 战争天使,双翼俱全,面容漠然,披挂备战。

source_text(原文): [Edge/Knock] I remember my wounds in the Great War...
translation_zh(译文): [刃/启] 我记起我在大战中受的伤……

source_text(原文): [Winter] I remember the sorrows of the Great War...
translation_zh(译文): [冬] 我记起大战中的种种悲伤……

source_text(原文): [Lantern] St Michael is a favoured Name of a certain solar Hour. I remember when things were clearer. Should I pray...?
translation_zh(译文): [灯] 圣米迦勒是某位太阳司辰所宠爱的名。我记得世事尚属清明之时。我该祈祷吗……？

source_text(原文): The secret heart of the wood? Or the [[Wood]]? Did Emmenegger approach the [[Mansus]] in his dreams?
translation_zh(译文): 这片树林的秘密之心？抑或那[[木材]]？埃门内格是否曾在梦中接近[[漫宿]]？

source_text(原文): [Knock] It has that quality. I wonder what he found there...
translation_zh(译文): [启] 确有那种质地。不知他在那里寻见了什么……

source_text(原文): [Winter] It's just a forest at night. Not everything is occult.
translation_zh(译文): [冬] 不过是夜晚的森林。并非一切皆为玄秘。

source_text(原文): [Grail] Who knows? But the darkness between the trees draws me.
translation_zh(译文): [杯] 谁知道呢？但树丛间的黑暗吸引着我。

source_text(原文): My heart urges me to find her soon. But I don't always listen to my heart.
translation_zh(译文): 我的心催我尽快找到她。但我并不总是听从自己的心。

source_text(原文): My heart urges me to find her soon. Since I came back to the World, I've learnt to listen to my heart.
translation_zh(译文): 我的心催我尽快找到她。自从回到人间,我学会了听从自己的心。

source_text(原文): [We won't usually tell you explicitly which choices act with which Passions - we let you roleplay, or guess.]
translation_zh(译文): [我们通常不会明确告诉你们,哪些选择对应哪些激情——我们让你们自己去扮演,或者自己猜。]

source_text(原文): Antibes. Before War came to the World, this was the sweet blue eye of the Riviera. Yachts and parties and film-star villas. Picasso painted his Pierrots, here by the sea.
translation_zh(译文): 昂蒂布。在战争降临人间之前,这里曾是里维埃拉甜美的蓝色眼眸。游艇、派对、影星的别墅。毕加索就在这片海边,画下他的皮埃罗们。

source_text(原文): A long rattling road from Alexandria to Antibes. Through mountain and forest and choking smoke. But here I am at last.
translation_zh(译文): 从亚历山大港到昂蒂布,一条漫长而颠簸的路。穿过山岭、森林与呛人的浓烟。但终于,我到了这里。

source_text(原文): [The next choice acts with a [[Passion]]. Choose a Passion you possess to refresh pips in your [[Aspect Pool]]. Choose a new one to start on the path to acquiring it - you can have up to three Passions.]
translation_zh(译文): [下一个选择会作用于一项[[激情]]。选择一项你已拥有的激情,可为[[性相池]]补充小点;选择一项新的,则是踏上习得它的道路——你最多可以拥有三项激情。]
[天赋]但毕加索——毕加索有一头猫头鹰。
他给那只猫头鹰取名叫「于布」。

source_text(原文): [Potential] Villas full of idiots, waiting for the war to kill them all.
translation_zh(译文): [天赋]别墅里住满了蠢人,等着战争把他们统统杀死。

source_text(原文): "The sun is a cut throat", the night recites.
translation_zh(译文): 「骄阳是道割开的喉咙」，夜色如此吟诵。

source_text(原文): But now I'm in the world again. My heart throbs and clashes with anticipation.
translation_zh(译文): 可如今,我再次置身人间。我的心因期盼而悸动、翻涌。

source_text(原文): This gold-and-grey divided city has suffered - but it's not like anywhere else now. Poor dying Europe is going out in style.
translation_zh(译文): 这座金灰交织、被撕裂的城市饱经苦难——但如今,它已不同于任何别处。可怜又垂死的欧洲,正在华丽地退场。

source_text(原文): Well, I can almost hear the night saying, does anything? It has a point. I'd better hurry.
translation_zh(译文): 唔,我几乎能听见夜色在问:万事万物,当真有所不同吗?它说得有道理。我最好快些。

source_text(原文): Apparently it didn't kill them all. Not yet.
translation_zh(译文): 看来,战争没能把他们全杀光。至少现在还没有。

source_text(原文): [Potential] Long lazy-angled days in the sun... but now the sun is sombre.
translation_zh(译文): [天赋]阳光里那些漫长而慵懒的日子……可如今,太阳是阴沉的。

source_text(原文): [But really, just pick the option that suits you. The game works best when you do that.]
translation_zh(译文): [但说到底,选那个最合你心意的选项就好。这样做,游戏体验最佳。]

source_text(原文): [That tiny choice will have a tiny consequence, later. In a moment, another tiny choice.]
translation_zh(译文): [那个微小的选择,稍后会带来一个微小的后果。再过片刻,又将是另一个微小的选择。]

source_text(原文): [Look for [[Nina Lagasse]]. Until you find her, 'why' is less important than 'where'.]
translation_zh(译文): [去寻找[[尼娜·拉加斯]]吧。在找到她之前,「为什么」不如「在哪里」重要。]

source_text(原文): But I have to find [[Nina Lagasse]]... and her trail has brought me here.
translation_zh(译文): 但我必须找到[[尼娜·拉加斯]]……是她的踪迹,把我引到了这里。

source_text(原文): [Potential] Years ripe with opportunity. I could have made my mark.
translation_zh(译文): [天赋]那些年,机遇正当时。我本可以留下印记。

source_text(原文): [Potential] But I never had a chance to enjoy the Riviera in the golden years. I was stuck somewhere older and chillier.
translation_zh(译文): [天赋]可那些黄金岁月里,我从未有机会享受里维埃拉。我当时困在一个更古老、更阴冷的地方。

source_text(原文): [Potential] And then the War. So many dead, deported, lost. I was in no position to help.
translation_zh(译文): [天赋]然后,战争来了。那么多人死去、被驱逐、不知所踪。我那时无力相助。

source_text(原文): [Potential] A little too giddy and dissipated for my tastes. I'd have preferred somewhere quieter.
translation_zh(译文): [天赋]那里太过轻浮放荡,不合我的口味。我宁愿待在一个更安静的地方。

source_text(原文): Although perhaps I'll find I've lost my taste for the quiet life, after so many years outside the world...
translation_zh(译文): 不过,在人间之外待了那么多年,也许我会发现自己已经不再向往安静的生活……

source_text(原文): But there's always someone else to save.
translation_zh(译文): 但总会有别人,等着我去救。

source_text(原文): Doctor to the stars, perhaps. Or a spiritual instructor to politicians and princesses. But there'd always have been something missing.
translation_zh(译文): 或许,成为名流的医生。又或许,成为政客与公主们的精神导师。但总会有一样东西,始终缺失。

source_text(原文): Antibes. Before War came to the World -
translation_zh(译文): 昂蒂布。在战争降临人间之前——

source_text(原文): [Potential] And now here I am! Even before I went away, first time in a new city was always exciting.
translation_zh(译文): [天赋]而现在我就在这里了!即便在离开之前,每到一个新城市,头一遭总是令人兴奋。

source_text(原文): [Possessed] Years ripe with opportunity. I could have made my mark.
translation_zh(译文): [附身]那些年,机遇正当时。我本可以留下印记。

source_text(原文): [Possessed] Villas full of idiots, waiting for Worms or Wars to kill them all.
translation_zh(译文): [附身]别墅里住满了蠢人,等着蠕虫或战争把他们统统杀死。

source_text(原文): [Possessed] But I never had a chance to enjoy the Riviera in the golden years. I was stuck somewhere older and chillier.
translation_zh(译文): [附身]可那些黄金岁月里,我从未有机会享受里维埃拉。我那时困在一个更古老、更阴冷的地方。

source_text(原文): [Possessed] And then the War. So many dead, deported, lost. I was in no position to help.
translation_zh(译文): [附身]然后,战争来了。那么多人死去、被驱逐、不知所踪。我那时无力相助。

source_text(原文): [Possessed] Even before I went away, first time in a new city was always exciting.
translation_zh(译文): [附身]即便在离开之前,每到一个新城市,头一遭总是令人兴奋。

source_text(原文): [Possessed] That was never going to last.
translation_zh(译文): [附身]那样的日子,注定不会长久。

source_text(原文): [Possessed] A little too giddy and dissipated for my tastes. I'd have preferred somewhere quieter.
translation_zh(译文): [附身]那里太过轻浮放荡,不合我的口味。我宁愿待在一个更安静的地方。

source_text(原文): [Possessed] Long lazy-angled days in the sun... but now the sun is bloodied.
translation_zh(译文): [附身]阳光里那些漫长而慵懒的日子……可如今,太阳已染血。
[附身]但毕加索——毕加索有一头猫头鹰。

source_text(原文): [Potential] That was never going to last.
translation_zh(译文): [天赋]那样的日子,注定不会长久。

source_text(原文): I was in London, reviewing books and trying to get my plays staged. I could have been rubbing shoulders with Cocteau and Bischoff and Stravinsky. Writing film scripts and librettos...
translation_zh(译文): 我那时在伦敦,评书撰稿,设法让我的剧作搬上舞台。我本可以跻身科克托、比绍夫与斯特拉文斯基之列。写电影剧本,写歌剧脚本……

source_text(原文): I gave up tobacco back in the thirties. My passengers hated smoke. Something you wouldn't expect from Worm infestation: better skin, better teeth.
translation_zh(译文): 三十年代起我便戒了烟草。我的乘客讨厌烟味。蠕虫侵染倒有一桩意想不到的好处:皮肤更好,牙齿更白。

source_text(原文): But there's something about getting off a train in the rain that makes me miss that little rite: moment of fire between cupped hands.
translation_zh(译文): 但每逢在雨中下车,总有什么让我怀念那小小的仪式:双手拢起之间,一瞬的火光。

source_text(原文): But the ticket-inspector was smoking Gitanes all the way from Milan, and it brought back memories.
translation_zh(译文): 但查票员一路从米兰抽着吉坦烟,勾起了我的回忆。

source_text(原文): I was on the train from Milan at dawn, before the cafés opened.
translation_zh(译文): 拂晓时分,我正坐在从米兰开出的火车上,那时咖啡馆还没开门。

source_text(原文): My hair and collar are gritty with coal-dust.
translation_zh(译文): 我的头发和衣领上,结满了沙沙的煤灰。

source_text(原文): The ticket-inspector was smoking Gitanes all the way from Milan...
translation_zh(译文): 查票员一路从米兰抽着吉坦烟……

source_text(原文): I could only afford third class. Slatted seats and bellowing soldiers. I didn't get much sleep.
translation_zh(译文): 我只坐得起三等车厢。条板座椅,粗声大气的士兵。我没睡上多少觉。

source_text(原文): At least it's raining. Mixed blessing.
translation_zh(译文): 至少,雨在下着。说不上是福是祸。

source_text(原文): The Wars and their plagues took the glitter off those golden evenings, left the air dense and villainous.
translation_zh(译文): 战争与瘟疫,磨去了那些黄金夜晚的光彩,把空气变得沉滞而险恶。

source_text(原文): 'The best-dressed man in the Bureau', they used to call me. I hardly dared look in the toilet mirror.
translation_zh(译文): 「防剿局里穿着最考究的人,」他们从前这样叫我。如今我几乎不敢看洗手间里的镜子。

source_text(原文): Razor blades aren't easy to come by just now. But the black market provides: I have a few tucked away.
translation_zh(译文): 眼下,刮胡刀片可不容易弄到。不过黑市自有门路:我私下藏了几片。

source_text(原文): You kidding? I can't do this alone.
translation_zh(译文): 开什么玩笑?这种事我一个人可干不来。

source_text(原文): Fresh eggs, peppers, ham: rare treasures combined by a woman of real talent.
translation_zh(译文): 鲜蛋、甜椒、火腿:一位真正有天赋的女人,把难得的珍宝合而为一。

source_text(原文): [Wipe my mouth and push the plate away.]
Too soon, the omelette is defeated.
translation_zh(译文): 没过多久,煎蛋卷便败下阵来。

source_text(原文): Omelette, yes, but is that... coffee?
translation_zh(译文): 煎蛋卷,没错,可那是……咖啡?

source_text(原文): Just... kinda... okay. Sorry, Mr Hobson. Sure.
translation_zh(译文): 就……有点……好吧。对不住,霍布森先生。成。

source_text(原文): Sure. Only the good stuff here. I'll get you a cup.
translation_zh(译文): 当然。这儿只有好东西。我给你倒一杯。

source_text(原文): [Give my full attention to the coffee.]
The coffee is irreproachable - bitter enough to make an impression, gentle enough not to leave one.
translation_zh(译文): 这咖啡无可指摘——苦得足以让人记住,柔得让人记不住。

source_text(原文): Spencer, right? I'm Bessy. What's shaking?
translation_zh(译文): 斯宾塞,对吧?我是贝茜。近来可好?

source_text(原文): Does everyone here know who I am already?
translation_zh(译文): 这里所有人都已经知道我是谁了?

source_text(原文): You hungry? This omelette... I think I went too far. It's really two omelettes. Maybe three. I'm going to need some help.
translation_zh(译文): 饿不饿?这份煎蛋卷……我觉得我摊过头了。实际上这是两份蛋卷。也许三份。我需要帮手。

source_text(原文): A dreamily smiling, dreamily humming woman in horn-rimmed glasses. Delicious scents waft from the kitchen behind her: ham, onions.
translation_zh(译文): 一位戴着玳瑁框眼镜的女子,笑意迷离,哼着歌。她身后厨房里飘来诱人的香气:火腿,洋葱。

source_text(原文): The omelette is excellent. Fresh eggs, peppers, ham: all of those are difficult to come by.
translation_zh(译文): 煎蛋卷美味极了。鲜蛋、甜椒、火腿:这些如今可都不好弄到。

source_text(原文): Suit yourself. I'll battle this monster alone.
translation_zh(译文): 随你便。我自己对付这头怪兽。

source_text(原文): Bessy eats with surprising enthusiasm. She talks with her mouth full. She even hums with her mouth full, or she taps her fingers to the rhythm - always variations on the same swinging, gentle tune.
translation_zh(译文): 贝茜吃得热情得惊人。她嘴里塞满食物还说话。嘴里塞满食物还哼歌,要么就跟着节拍敲手指——总是同一支摇摆而轻柔的曲调的各种变奏。

source_text(原文): Thanks, man! It's nice to cook for someone who appreciates it.
translation_zh(译文): 谢啦,老兄!能有人懂这份手艺,做起来才有劲。

source_text(原文): The doc's a vegetarian. Rodia's always on a diet. The Strath doesn't like 'foreign food'. Though Vincent and Mat... those cats have appetites.
translation_zh(译文): 医生吃素。罗迪娅永远在节食。斯特拉斯科因不喜欢“外国菜”。倒是文森特和马特……那俩家伙胃口好得很。

source_text(原文): Uh-huh. Half, anyhow. My mother's from Quebec. So I grew up speaking the language. I couldn't seem to get started in New York - singing, I mean - so I tried in Paris.
translation_zh(译文): 嗯哼。一半是,怎么都算。我妈是魁北克人。所以我从小就说这语言。我在纽约怎么都起不了步——唱歌,我是说——所以就到巴黎试试。

source_text(原文): Do you work here? Or is the doctor treating you, too?
translation_zh(译文): 你在这儿工作?还是医生也在给你治病?

source_text(原文): I dug Paris. Paris was gone! I mean, the end, you know?
translation_zh(译文): 我爱透了巴黎。巴黎没了!我是说,完蛋了,你懂吗?

source_text(原文): Then, the Enemy came... and it was gone. I mean, it was the end.
translation_zh(译文): 然后,敌人来了……它就没了。我是说,那就是终局。
嗨,斯宾塞。什么风把你吹来了?!

source_text(原文): I stayed for a while. I knew Mat, I knew Mat's crowd. Me, two other girls, we were singing. We were doing okay, even then.
translation_zh(译文): 我留了一阵。我认识马特,认识马特那帮人。我,还有另外两个姑娘,我们一起唱歌。哪怕在那时候,我们混得也还凑合。

source_text(原文): But it kept getting stickier. Then, in '43, I came south. After - after -
translation_zh(译文): 可日子越来越难熬。然后,43年,我南下。在——在——

source_text(原文): Hey. You mind if we talk about something else?
translation_zh(译文): 嘿。咱们换点别的聊聊,不介意吧?

source_text(原文): Work. I guess you could say I came with the place? Audrey - Audrey Chadwick - Audrey owns the villa. I knew her pretty well, back home.
translation_zh(译文): 工作。我猜你可以说,我是随房子一起来的?奥德丽——奥德丽·查德威克——奥德丽是这别墅的主人。在家乡,我跟她挺熟。

source_text(原文): I called her when I came down here from Paris. She let me know where to pick up the keys. Told me to keep an eye on the place.
translation_zh(译文): 我从巴黎下来的时候给她打了电话。她告诉我去哪儿拿钥匙。让我照看着这地方。

source_text(原文): Then the doc's people leased it from her. But Audrey told them I could stay as long as I liked.
translation_zh(译文): 后来医生那边的人从她手里租了下来。但奥德丽跟他们说了,我想待多久都行。

source_text(原文): My name is Spencer Hobson. 'Mr Hobson', if you can't manage that.
translation_zh(译文): 我的名字叫斯宾塞·霍布森。“霍布森先生”,你要是叫不全的话。

source_text(原文): I should go. Thanks for the omelette, Bessy.
translation_zh(译文): 我该走了。谢谢你的蛋卷,贝茜。

source_text(原文): Some kind of Incorporate foundation? Menninger, maybe? Graveyard, man. I don't know.
translation_zh(译文): 某种集团的基金会?曼宁格那样的,也许?公墓呗,老兄。我不知道。
就是这么回事。[贝茜点点头,笑着,哼着歌。]

source_text(原文): Uh... [Bessy, confused, looks around, spotting a coffee-pot behind her.]
translation_zh(译文): 呃……[贝茜一脸困惑,环顾四周,看见身后有个咖啡壶。]

source_text(原文): Bessy... I'm looking for someone who stayed here. [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation_zh(译文): 贝茜……我在找一个曾住在这里的人。[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。

source_text(原文): Nina was sunset. [Bessy shakes her head in admiration.]
translation_zh(译文): 尼娜可是落日啊。[贝茜赞叹地摇了摇头。]

source_text(原文): Bessy, can you talk like an adult, just for now? Where did she go?
translation_zh(译文): 贝茜,你就不能像大人一样说话吗,就现在?她上哪儿去了?
贝茜的神色短暂地警惕起来。

source_text(原文): Yeah, she was here. She left pretty suddenly. I think she got what she needed from the doc.
translation_zh(译文): 嗯,她住过这儿。她走得挺突然。我觉得她从医生那儿得到了需要的东西。
您怎么说都行,霍布森先生。

source_text(原文): She came, she stayed, she left. I think she got what she wanted.
translation_zh(译文): 她来了,她住下了,她走了。我觉得她得到了想要的东西。

source_text(原文): Hey. What's your thing with her? Why are you looking?
translation_zh(译文): 嘿。你跟她是怎么回事?为什么找她?

source_text(原文): [Truth] Let's say I'm following my heart.
translation_zh(译文): [真话]就当我是在跟随内心吧。

source_text(原文): That's my affair, and none of yours.
translation_zh(译文): 那是我的私事,与你无关。

source_text(原文): Sorry, Bessy. I don't know you well enough.
translation_zh(译文): 抱歉,贝茜。我还不够了解你。

source_text(原文): Oh, hey, it's cool. We've all got our secrets.
[Truth] Feels right. I haven't thought too much about it.
translation_zh(译文): [真话] 感觉对。我没怎么细想过。

source_text(原文): [Lie] She owes me a great deal of money.
translation_zh(译文): [谎言] 她欠了我一大笔钱。

source_text(原文): Ha, okay. Funny thing? That's how I felt about coming here.
translation_zh(译文): 哈,好吧。有意思的是?我当初来这儿,也是这种感觉。

source_text(原文): My last name's Bloom. But I didn't go by Bloom, you know? Not for a while there.
translation_zh(译文): 我姓布卢姆。但我不叫布卢姆,你知道吗?好一阵子不用了。

source_text(原文): Is that another one of your omelettes?
What can I say? It's a habit. Interested?
translation_zh(译文): 我能说什么呢?习惯罢了。感兴趣?

source_text(原文): What did you say to me?
Fitful fires flicker beneath the velvet veil...
translation_zh(译文): 断续的火焰,在天鹅绒帷幕下明灭……

source_text(原文): This entity is dormant - or its attention is elsewhere.
translation_zh(译文): 这个存在正处于沉眠——或者说,它的注意力在别处。

source_text(原文): Fear and fascination war and wane. [[Dread]] and [[Fascination]] cancel each other out. If you have more of one than the other, it might cause dreams before it fades.
translation_zh(译文): 恐惧与入迷彼此交战，此消彼长。[[恐惧]]与[[入迷]]相互抵消。若一方多于另一方，便可能在消散之前引出梦境。

source_text(原文): My sleep's a little darker. Fever fades.
translation_zh(译文): 我的睡梦暗了一分。烧退了。

source_text(原文): The dream moves on. Perhaps it's found better prey.
translation_zh(译文): 梦继续前行。也许它已觅得更中意的猎物。

source_text(原文): I'm smiling and smiling am I in motion - beneath a glory of gold that loves me - should I give myself to it - should I only give myself -
translation_zh(译文): 我微笑着，微笑着，我正飘然而行——在爱着我的金色辉光之下——我该把自己交给它吗——我该只把自己交出去吗——

source_text(原文): This is the dream that sets its teeth in the neck's nape to drag what is left through the snow to the hollow place. It is too long. It ends.
translation_zh(译文): 这是那种将牙齿咬进后颈、把残躯拖过雪地、拖向那凹陷之处的梦。它太长了。该结束了。

source_text(原文): Wake. Battle through the moment of waking confusion. Where I am, who I am -
translation_zh(译文): 醒来。闯过初醒时的迷乱。我在哪里，我是谁——

source_text(原文): These are the black halls of sightless Sleep.
translation_zh(译文): 这里是盲目之眠的漆黑殿堂。

source_text(原文): And I'm in the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui.

My dreams are only a hushed polka of the day's events. I make no attempt to reach the House that has no walls, or even the Wood around its walls. Much safer to stick with the midnight shuffle of sleeping thought.
translation_zh(译文): 我的梦不过是白日旧事的一支低声波尔卡。我无意抵达那座无墙的居屋，甚至它墙外的树丛也不曾触及。午夜睡思的曳步要安全得多。

source_text(原文): Memories gossiping beneath a dome of echoes...
translation_zh(译文): 种种回忆在一座回声穹顶之下窃窃私语……

source_text(原文): Is anyone watching this place? I'm so used to being hunted. [The more nights you spend in the same place, the more Traces you'll get each night.]
translation_zh(译文): 有人在盯着这个地方吗？我早已习惯了被追猎。〔你在同一处停留的夜晚越多，每夜获得的痕迹就越多。〕

source_text(原文): This is the first night I've spent here. Unless I move on tomorrow, I might attract attention. [Spencer won't gain a [[Trace]] in his first night anywhere.]
translation_zh(译文): 这是我在这里度过的第一夜。除非我明日便启程离开，否则可能会引来注意。〔无论身处何地，斯宾塞的第一夜都不会获得[[痕迹]]。〕
正在恢复……〔[[倦怠]]正在消退。〕

source_text(原文): Pain troubles my sleep, but I'm healing. [When you sleep, [[Pain]] is converted to [[Weariness]].]
translation_zh(译文): 疼痛搅扰我的睡眠，但我正在痊愈。〔入眠时，[[痛苦]]会转化为[[倦怠]]。〕
一幅色彩浓烈的抽象画。

source_text(原文): [Grail] Somehow, it brings [[Nina Lagasse]] to mind...
translation_zh(译文): [杯] 不知怎的,它让我想起[[尼娜·拉加斯]]……

source_text(原文): [Grail] It looks nothing like Nina. But somehow it reminds me of when I came here seeking her. Perhaps I just remembered the painting from that day...
translation_zh(译文): [杯] 它一点也不像尼娜。但不知怎的,它让我想起当初我来到这里寻她的情形。也许,我只是记起了那一天见过的那幅画……

source_text(原文): Wasn't there another one like this, back by the door?
translation_zh(译文): 门边不是还有一幅与此相仿的吗？

source_text(原文): Another vivid abstract, like the one at the door.
translation_zh(译文): 又一幅色彩浓烈的抽象画,与门口那幅相似。

source_text(原文): It's even worse than the one by the front door.
It's even more striking than the one by the front door.
Nina's white shadow, again in my thoughts...
translation_zh(译文): 尼娜白色的身影,又萦绕在我心间……

source_text(原文): [Yes: this response was conditioned by your choice when you came to Antibes.]
translation_zh(译文): [是:这条回应取决于你抵达昂蒂布时的选择。]

source_text(原文): That's long after he painted his Pierrots. And long after I left the world. But I heard a story on the train up from Alexandria.
translation_zh(译文): 那远在他画皮埃罗之后。也远在我离开人世之后。不过,我在从亚历山大港北上的火车上,听过一个故事。

source_text(原文): Step close to the painting. Whisper: '[[Ubu]]...'
translation_zh(译文): 凑近画作。低声呢喃:“[[于布]]……”

source_text(原文): She's simmering with suppressed rage, perhaps. Or is that me?
translation_zh(译文): 她也许正压抑着翻涌的怒火。又或者,那是我的怒火。

source_text(原文): 'Antibes. Before War came to the World, this was the sweet blue eye of the Riviera. Yachts and parties and film-star villas. Picasso painted Pierrots, here by the sea...'
translation_zh(译文): “昂蒂布。在战争降临世界之前,这里是里维埃拉湛蓝温柔的眼眸。游艇,派对,影星的别墅。毕加索在海边画下皮埃罗……”

source_text(原文): [We'll rarely be explicit about how your earlier choices play into consequences. But we wanted to confirm that even tiny choices sometimes have some tiny relevance.]
translation_zh(译文): [我们很少明言,你此前的选择会如何演变为后果。但我们想让你确认:即便是微小的选择,有时也会有微小的牵系。]

source_text(原文): Did the Sanitarium's patrons buy this? Confiscate it? Loot it?
translation_zh(译文): 疗养院的赞助人是买下了它？没收了它？还是抢走了它？

source_text(原文): There's a [[History]] where I found myself living by the sea in a stately white house, with a painting like this over my fireplace...
translation_zh(译文): 有一段[[历史]],在那其中,我发现自己住在海边的白屋之中,华美庄严,壁炉上方就挂着这样一幅画……
画上有日期,有签名。1941 年。

source_text(原文): That's long after he painted his Pierrots. And long after I left the world. I have no idea if he was even in Antibes then.
translation_zh(译文): 那远在他画皮埃罗之后。也远在我离开人世之后。我甚至不知道他那时是否身在昂蒂布。

source_text(原文): Did Picasso ever paint a woman he didn't want?
translation_zh(译文): 毕加索可曾画过他不想要的女人？

source_text(原文): He was in Paris during the occupation. An Enemy officer saw Guernica on the wall of his apartment. 'Did you do that?' the officer asked.
translation_zh(译文): 占领期间,他身在巴黎。一名敌方军官看见他公寓墙上挂着格尔尼卡。“这是你画的？”军官问道。

source_text(原文): Picasso probably invented the story himself, and spread it once the Enemy was gone.
translation_zh(译文): 这故事大概是毕加索自己编造的,待敌人离去之后,便将它散播开来。

source_text(原文): The Sanitarium wanted a bit of local colour.
translation_zh(译文): 疗养院想要一点本地色彩。

source_text(原文): Below the House, the [[little joys of night]].
translation_zh(译文): 居屋之下,是[[夜的微小欢愉]]。

source_text(原文): 'Beneath the skin of the world we find the Mansus, also called the World-Spine, also called the House of the Sun. Above the House is the [[Glory]], the origin of light, to which souls aspire. At the foot of the House, and around its walls - though it has no walls - is the [[Wood]].'
translation_zh(译文): “在世界表皮之下,我们寻得漫宿——亦名世界之脊,亦名太阳居屋。居屋之上是[[辉光]],光的源头,众灵魂所向往者。居屋脚下,环绕四壁——虽说它并无墙壁——是那[[木材]]。”

source_text(原文): And below the House - below the House -

This is what the Bureau would call a 'clear and immediate oneiric hazard.' There are a dozen images here which would have landed a dreamer in gaol. The Bureau's grip has loosened since the twenties, but still, it's quite something to display the painting so publicly.
translation_zh(译文): 这正是防剿局所称的“明确而迫近的梦境危害”。这里的图像足有十几处,足以令一个做梦者锒铛入狱。自二十年代以来,防剿局的掌控已有所松动,即便如此,如此公然地展出这幅画,也实在非同小可。

source_text(原文): This is the work of the visionary they called the Magyar. It used to be one of the treasures of Hush House. I saw it there when I visited as a priest in the local parish - above the fireplace in the Westcott Room. It's safer to hang it above a fireplace - to keep the influences from threading their way into the dreams of the locals.
translation_zh(译文): 这是那位被称作“马扎尔人”的幻视者之作。它曾是噤声居屋的珍藏之一。当年我以本地教区神父的身份造访时,正是在那里见过它——在韦斯科特厅的壁炉上方。把它挂在壁炉上方更稳妥——免得那些影响丝丝缕缕,渗入本地人的梦中。

source_text(原文): In my time as a parish priest in Cornwall, I saw it somewhere in [[Hush House]]. But where, exactly, is lost in a welter of scarred memories.
translation_zh(译文): 我在康沃尔任教区神父期间,曾在[[噤声居屋]]的某处见过它。但究竟是在何处,已湮没在一片伤痕累累的记忆之中。

source_text(原文): How did it come here? Has someone been furnishing the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui with treasures from occult auctions?
translation_zh(译文): 它如何到了这里？莫非有人一直在用神秘拍卖会上拍得的珍藏来装点今日疗养院？

source_text(原文): When I was priest in [[Brancrug]], I sometimes saw Christopher Illopoly in his rooms in [[Hush House]] - to argue about theology and drink his horrible burdock tea. I saw it there, I think...
translation_zh(译文): 我在[[布兰库格]]任神父时,偶尔会去[[噤声居屋]]的房间拜访克里斯托弗·伊洛波利——为争论神学,也为喝他那难以下咽的牛蒡茶。我想,我就是在那里见过它……

source_text(原文): I remember that I remarked on it; and he told me that it was a 'prefigure', done before the war by one of the Librarians of the place - someone who had the knack of copying work by other artists. But he'd copy the work before they'd ever actually painted it.
translation_zh(译文): 我记得我曾就它作过评点;他告诉我,那是一件“先行之作”,战前由此地一位司书所作——此人颇擅摹仿其他艺术家的作品。但他摹仿的,是那些艺术家尚未来得及画出的作品。

source_text(原文): So is it the original, from the House, or the... actual original... from what was then the future?
translation_zh(译文): 那么,这幅是出自居屋的原作,还是……真正的原作……那件来自彼时而言尚属未来的原作？

source_text(原文): It's signed LEVINSEN... but with a question mark after the signature. The prefigure, then, not the later work.
translation_zh(译文): 签名是“莱文森”……但签名之后跟着一个问号。那么,这是先行之作,而非后来那幅作品。

source_text(原文): A lonely figure poles a flat boat across a lake of pistachio-green.
translation_zh(译文): 一个孤独的身影撑着一叶平底舟,渡过一片开心果绿的湖泊。

source_text(原文): When I was priest in [[Brancrug]], I sometimes saw Christopher Illopoly in his rooms in [[Hush House]] - to argue about theology and drink his horrible burdock tea. I saw it there.
translation_zh(译文): 我在[[布兰库格]]任神父时,偶尔会去[[噤声居屋]]的房间拜访克里斯托弗·伊洛波利——为争论神学,也为喝他那难以下咽的牛蒡茶。我就是在那里见过它。

source_text(原文): Ambergris: vulgarly called 'whale vomit'. Valuable, though. It has uses in unconventional medicine. I picked up a lump, once, walking on the beach in [[Brancrug]].
translation_zh(译文): 龙涎香:俗名“鲸鱼呕吐物”。不过价值不菲。它在非正统医药中自有其用途。我曾在[[布兰库格]]的海滩上散步时,捡到过一块。

source_text(原文): Ambergris, perhaps? Vulgarly called 'whale vomit'. Valuable, though.
translation_zh(译文): 或许是龙涎香？俗名“鲸鱼呕吐物”。不过价值不菲。

source_text(原文): Amber: sacred in certain almost-orthodox rites. There are subtleties in the colour that suggest it might be Cornish amber. They had a little collection of that, at [[Hush House]]. No creatures trapped inside this lump.
translation_zh(译文): 琥珀:在某些几近正统的仪式中奉为神圣。色泽上的微妙之处显示,它或许是康沃尔琥珀。[[噤声居屋]]里曾存有一小批那种琥珀。这一块里面没有困住的生灵。

source_text(原文): Baltic amber? No creatures trapped inside, though.
translation_zh(译文): 波罗的海琥珀？不过里面没有困住的生灵。

source_text(原文): Beach-glass. This travelled a long way - rolled and smoothed by Atlantic waves and grey shingle. One traveller knows another.
translation_zh(译文): 海玻璃。它走了很远的路——被大西洋的浪涛与灰色的卵石滩磨圆磨滑。旅人识旅人。

source_text(原文): Glass shelves crowded with books, plants what can really only be described as 'curios'.
translation_zh(译文): 玻璃搁架上挤满了书籍、植物,以及那些只能称之为“珍奇之物”的东西。

source_text(原文): Rose-quartz, touched by sunset. Its touch sparks memories of the Western sea.
translation_zh(译文): 玫瑰石英,染着落日的颜色。触碰它,便唤起对西方大海的回忆。

source_text(原文): Not exactly beeswax. The texture is wrong. The scent is too sharp. A mottled pattern beneath the surface shifts with the light. It might be one of the exudations of the [[Carapace Cross]].
translation_zh(译文): 不完全是蜂蜡。质地不对。气味太冲。表层之下有斑驳的花纹,随光线变幻。这或许是[[介壳种]]的某种分泌物。

source_text(原文): Beeswax. Odd thing to put on a shelf.
translation_zh(译文): 蜂蜡。摆在架子上的古怪玩意儿。

source_text(原文): A votive figure of the Sisterhood of the Triple Knot. I've only seen these in cave-shrines - beneath Meknes, beneath Alexandria, beneath [[Brancrug]].
translation_zh(译文): 三重结姐妹会的还愿像。我只在洞穴圣祠中见过这些——在梅克内斯之下,在亚历山大港之下,在[[布兰库格]]之下。
某种异教的、未曾入土的东西,几乎令人熟悉。

source_text(原文): Plays, poetry. One could call this collection 'eclectic'. One might suspect these are books chosen to be displayed, not read.
translation_zh(译文): 戏剧,诗歌。可以说这套收藏“兼收并蓄”。你不免疑心,这些书是为陈列而选,而非为阅读。

source_text(原文): I can't be certain, but this looks very like a bust that stood in a tower room in [[Hush House]]. I remember it because the joke was that it was a real skull, waxed. One day I quietly checked that it wasn't.
translation_zh(译文): 我不敢肯定,但这尊半身像与曾在[[噤声居屋]]一间塔楼房间里立着的那尊十分相似。我之所以记得它,是因为当时有个玩笑,说那是颗打了蜡的真头骨。有一天,我悄悄验证过,并非如此。

source_text(原文): A demurely risqué choice for a twentieth-century sanitarium.
translation_zh(译文): 对一座二十世纪的疗养院而言,这是个含蓄而大胆的选择。

source_text(原文): (No creatures trapped inside, echoes the night.)
translation_zh(译文): (没有困住的生灵,黑夜回荡着。)

source_text(原文): Is there a theme to this collection - a familiar theme?
translation_zh(译文): 这套收藏是否有一个主题——一个熟悉的主题？

source_text(原文): At least three of these objects have an Atlantic theme - perhaps a Cornish theme - perhaps specifically a [[Brancrug]] theme. Is there some connection between the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui, and [[Hush House]]?
translation_zh(译文): 这些物件中至少有三件带着大西洋主题——或许也是康沃尔主题——或许具体来说,是[[布兰库格]]主题。今日疗养院与[[噤声居屋]]之间,是否存在着某种关联？

source_text(原文): A shining ovoid, the colour of late summer.
translation_zh(译文): 一枚发光的卵形物,色泽如夏末。

source_text(原文): A figurine: a woman in a long, bodiced dress.
translation_zh(译文): 一尊小雕像:一位身着束腰长裙的女子。

source_text(原文): I might ask you the same, m'sieu.
That door! I must get my eyes examined.
translation_zh(译文): 那扇门!我该去检查检查眼睛了。

source_text(原文): Haven't you got anywhere else to go?
translation_zh(译文): 你就没有别的地方可去吗?

source_text(原文): The cat suffers my touch, although no purr is forthcoming. The fur is very soft. The eyes are quite mad.
translation_zh(译文): 猫容忍了我的抚摸,尽管并未发出呼噜声。毛非常柔软。那双眼睛相当疯狂。

source_text(原文): Once again, the cat suffers my touch; once again, no purr is forthcoming; but it seems a little less wary.
translation_zh(译文): 猫再一次容忍我的抚摸;再一次没有呼噜声;但它似乎稍稍不那么警惕了。

source_text(原文): The cat leaps, skids, scrambles away in a tangled paroxysm of terror. It finds refuge on the top of the piano, staring warily from wide, resentful eyes.
translation_zh(译文): 猫跳起,打滑,在一团纠缠的恐惧痉挛中连滚带爬地逃窜。它躲到钢琴顶上,睁着圆瞪的、怨恨的眼睛警惕地望来。

source_text(原文): The cat watches me with unblinking suspicion.
translation_zh(译文): 猫一眨不眨地、满含猜疑地望着我。

source_text(原文): The cat's eyes fix upon me. Its stare is at once both terrified and indignant.
translation_zh(译文): 猫的眼睛定在我身上。那目光既惊恐,又愤慨。

source_text(原文): The cat remains motionless on the sofa.
The cat remains safely out of reach on the piano's summit.
translation_zh(译文): 猫安然待在钢琴顶上,让人够不着。

source_text(原文): This is how such a cat would prefer to be touched.
translation_zh(译文): 这样才是这种猫喜欢的摸法。

source_text(原文): Beneath the chin, for instance. And the absurd, magnificent chest-ruff also requires attention.
translation_zh(译文): 比如下巴底下。还有那团荒唐又华美的胸毛,也需要照料。

source_text(原文): No no. The ears, apparently, are not for us to touch.
translation_zh(译文): 不不。耳朵,显然,不是给我们摸的。

source_text(原文): [Yes, this is clearly acceptable. Quite acceptable.]
[The cat does not let down its guard. The eyes continue to blaze like frightened head-lights at night. But we have established diplomatic relations.]
translation_zh(译文): [猫没有放松警惕。那双眼睛仍像夜里惊恐的车头灯般灼灼燃烧。但我们确立了外交关系。]

source_text(原文): [The Hobson-Cat detente is affirmed by both sides, and may continue.]
translation_zh(译文): [霍布森与猫之间的缓和,得到了双方的确认,或可长续。]

source_text(原文): (They let this thing run loose? Well, if I don't get too close, it probably can't attack.)
translation_zh(译文): (他们让这东西到处乱跑?好吧,只要我别靠太近,它大概伤不了我。)

source_text(原文): [Reach out to touch the luxuriant fur.]
[This thing is not respectful. Frighten it away.]
My heart and the night agree: the safe will open when I turn the handle.
translation_zh(译文): 我的心与夜晚不谋而合:只要我转动把手,保险柜便会打开。

source_text(原文): Is there someone else here? Pull back and look around.
translation_zh(译文): 这里还有别人？退后,环顾四周。

source_text(原文): No cash in the safe: just documents. Letters, financial records... six notebooks. One is labelled HOBSON.
translation_zh(译文): 保险柜里没有现金:只有文件。书信、财务记录……六本笔记。其中一本标着“霍布森”。

source_text(原文): Look through the notebook with my name.
translation_zh(译文): 翻看写着我的名字的那本笔记。

source_text(原文): It's written in some sort of cipher. There's only a page and a half of notes so far.
translation_zh(译文): 笔记是用某种密码写成的。目前只有一页半的记录。

source_text(原文): There is also an unflattering doodle of me. It's probably me. It has a moustache, anyway.
translation_zh(译文): 还有一幅对我毫不恭维的涂鸦。大概是我。反正它画着胡子。

source_text(原文): SINOMBRE, STRATHCOYNE, VLACHOS. RAVELINE? and LAGASSE.
translation_zh(译文): 西诺姆布尔、斯特拉斯科因、弗拉霍斯。拉韦林？还有拉加斯。

source_text(原文): Lagasse is her name now, the night reminds me. But there was a time when they called her the Witch of Lagash.
translation_zh(译文): 拉加斯如今确是她的名字,夜晚提醒着我。但曾有一段时日,他们称她为拉加什的女巫。

source_text(原文): My heart throbs urgently in response.
translation_zh(译文): 我的心随之急切地搏动。

source_text(原文): A flimsy slip of paper - a calendrier with details of a travelling carnival - slides out from between the pages of the LAGASSE notebook...
translation_zh(译文): 一张轻薄的纸片——一份载着巡回马戏团详情的日历——从“拉加斯”笔记本的书页间滑落……

source_text(原文): To learn more, examine the Calendrier in your Inventory.
translation_zh(译文): 想了解更多,请在物品栏中查看那份日历。

source_text(原文): Wind soughs. Night-time noises. No-one coming.
translation_zh(译文): 风呜呜作响。夜晚的声响。没有人来。

source_text(原文): This safe isn't safe. Close it and step back.
translation_zh(译文): 这保险柜并不保险。合上它,退后。

source_text(原文): Close the safe and step back.

This is a battleship-grey safe of Incorporate manufacture, solid as a continent, gleaming dully in the dimness. A safe like this opens only to the correct combination, or with the correct application of explosives.
translation_zh(译文): 这是一台集团出产的军舰灰保险柜,坚固如大陆,在昏暗中泛着暗哑的微光。这样的保险柜,只有正确的密码组合才能打开,或者恰当地使用炸药。
保险柜轻而易举地打开了。

source_text(原文): But there's something else. On almost every document there's an enigmatic line item: ONTEIRIC CO-ORDINATION.
translation_zh(译文): 但还有别的东西。几乎每一份文件上都有一个费解的条目:冥合。

source_text(原文): The Sanitarium receives substantial funding from the European Recovery Program - the Acheson Mission - and from a semi-charitable Incorporate entity called the Meninger Foundation. Very substantial funding.
translation_zh(译文): 疗养院从欧洲复兴计划——艾奇逊使命——以及一家名为曼宁格基金会的半慈善集团实体处获得大笔资金。极其大笔的资金。

source_text(原文): The 'Office of Onteiric Coordination' - the [[OOC]]? Who exactly is funding Aubière? Is the money really coming from Menninger?
translation_zh(译文): “冥合办公室”——就是[[OOC]]？究竟是谁在资助奥比埃？这笔钱当真来自曼宁格吗？

source_text(原文): I turn the handle. With an oiled click, the safe swings open, yawning a steel yawn...
translation_zh(译文): 我转动把手。随着一声油润的咔嗒,保险柜的门荡开,仿佛打了个钢铁的哈欠……

source_text(原文): One human eye tracks my movements. Three other eyes glitter.
translation_zh(译文): 一只人眼追随着我的动作。另外三只眼睛闪闪发亮。

source_text(原文): Three eyes seem unfazed by my dressing-gown. The fourth widens indignantly.
translation_zh(译文): 三只眼睛似乎对我的睡袍无动于衷。第四只则愤然瞪圆。

source_text(原文): Perhaps, sir, we can speak further when you've troubled to dress yourself. Hrmph!
translation_zh(译文): 先生,也许等你费心穿戴整齐之后,我们再继续谈吧。哼!

source_text(原文): Aye. Dark times. But Dr Aubière sees to it for me.
translation_zh(译文): 是啊。黑暗的时局。但奥比埃医生,替我照看着。

source_text(原文): Out of the goodness of his heart?
[The air around Strathcoyne carries a distinctive odour. Sniff discreetly.]
translation_zh(译文): [斯特拉斯科因周身的气息,带着一种独特的气味。不动声色地嗅了嗅。]

source_text(原文): I understand your arm is named Annabelle?
translation_zh(译文): 我听说,您的胳膊名叫安娜贝尔?

source_text(原文): My arm has no 'name', Mr Hobson! This is a tedious and puerile bit of pawkiness perpetrated by an... ignoramus.
translation_zh(译文): 我的胳膊没有「名字」,霍布森先生!这是某个……无知之徒,炮制出的乏味又幼稚的促狭把戏。

source_text(原文): Dr Aubière is an 'ignoramus'? He has his flaws, but he's an educated man, surely.
translation_zh(译文): 奥比埃医生是「无知之徒」?他确实有缺点,但他毕竟是个受过教育的人。

source_text(原文): Dr Aubière is most certainly not the author of this calumny! In fact, I have his personal assurance that he will discipline that author.
translation_zh(译文): 奥比埃医生,绝非这诽谤的炮制者!事实上,他向我当面保证过,会好好管教那个炮制者。

source_text(原文): I'm sorry to tell you, Mr Strathcoyne, that I heard this 'Annabelle' nonsense directly from Dr Aubière. I had no idea it would offend you so. I'm very disappointed in him.
translation_zh(译文): 很抱歉告诉您,斯特拉斯科因先生,这「安娜贝尔」的胡话,我是从奥比埃医生那里亲耳听来的。我不知道这会如此冒犯您。我对他,非常失望。

source_text(原文): Are you sure? I had thought much better of him.
translation_zh(译文): 你确定吗?我原以为,他远比这高明。

source_text(原文): I'm sorry to tell you, Mr Hobson, that you must be mistaken. Dr Aubière is a man of excellent character.
translation_zh(译文): 很抱歉,我要告诉你,霍布森先生,你一定是弄错了。奥比埃医生,品行端方。

source_text(原文): I'm afraid so. I had it directly from him. In fact, the doctor is the only person I've heard use this silly nickname.
translation_zh(译文): 恐怕是的。我是从他本人那里听来的。事实上,这个傻绰号,我只听医生一个人用过。

source_text(原文): Perhaps I was mistaken. It doesn't sound very much like him.
translation_zh(译文): 也许是我弄错了。听起来,不太像他会做的事。

source_text(原文): This is very disappointing. Very disappointing indeed. He is not the man I thought, not that man at all. I should have known when - hm.
translation_zh(译文): 这实在令人失望。实在令人失望。他不是我以为的那个人,全然不是。我本该早就察觉——嗯。
您本该早察觉什么,斯特拉斯科因先生?

source_text(原文): Well, we have an arrangement, he and I. I have very specific requirements, d'y'see? Creature comforts and so forth. I pay a small surcharge to the doctor, to ensure my requirements are fulfilled. He has asked me to be discreet about our arrangement. But the surcharge has grown less small of late. It has been troubling me, Mr Hobson.
translation_zh(译文): 我与他有份约定,霍布森先生。我有一些很特别的要求,你明白吧?起居上的舒适之类。我向医生付一笔小小的额外费用,好让我的要求得到满足。他请我对这份约定守口如瓶。可近来那笔费用已不那么「小小」了。这让我颇为不安,霍布森先生。

source_text(原文): An honour to make your acquaintance, sir. But you have the advantage of me.
translation_zh(译文): 有幸与您相识,先生。只是,您认得我,我却还不认得您。

source_text(原文): It sounds to me as if he has been taking advantage of your good nature.
translation_zh(译文): 依我看,他是一直在利用您的好心肠。

source_text(原文): I'm not surprised at all. I think he may not even be a real doctor.
translation_zh(译文): 我一点也不意外。我看他甚至可能根本不是真正的医生。

source_text(原文): Don't flannel me, Hobson. I'm not so great a fool as all that. But yes, it is disappointing.
translation_zh(译文): 别跟我耍滑头,霍布森。我还没蠢到那份上。不过,确实令人失望。

source_text(原文): Let's not get carried away, Mr Hobson.
translation_zh(译文): 我们别得意忘形,霍布森先生。

source_text(原文): It is. But perhaps kept between us two for the time being, hey?
translation_zh(译文): 确实如此。但暂且只限于你我之间,嗯?

source_text(原文): [Raising the subject with Aubière may provide an opportunity to pressure him.]
translation_zh(译文): [向奥比埃提起此事,或可借机给他施压。]

source_text(原文): Cigar smoke. Of course: he has those black market Romeo y Julietas in the humidor in his room.
translation_zh(译文): 雪茄烟雾。自然:他房间的保湿盒里存着那些黑市罗密欧与朱丽叶。

source_text(原文): My name is Fraser Strathcoyne. Did you have business with me?
translation_zh(译文): 我是弗雷泽·斯特拉斯科因。你找我,有何贵干?

source_text(原文): Well, I pay a small surcharge. This is the world we live in, Mr Hobson. I trust the matter will remain between us. I wouldn't want to provoke unseemly envy.
translation_zh(译文): 嗯,我付了一笔小小的额外费用。我们活在这个世道里,霍布森先生。我相信此事会止于你我之间。我可不想招来不合时宜的艳羡。

source_text(原文): This is one of the privileges for which I pay my little surcharge to Dr Aubière. As I said, I hope the matter will remain between us. I wouldn't want to provoke unseemly jealousy.
translation_zh(译文): 这正是我付那笔小小费用给奥比埃医生换来的特权之一。如我所说,我希望此事止于你我之间。我可不想招来不合时宜的嫉妒。

source_text(原文): When he and I made the arrangement to supply my special requirements, Mr Hobson. This is the world we live in; but it is not an arrangement that an honest man would have offered me.
translation_zh(译文): 就在我与他就供应我的特别要求达成约定之时,霍布森先生。我们活在这个世道里;可这不是一个诚实的人会给我的约定。

source_text(原文): Are you a cigar man, Mr Strathcoyne?
translation_zh(译文): 您是抽雪茄的人吗,斯特拉斯科因先生?

source_text(原文): Strathcoyne wears a fixed smile which suggests a kind of chilly benevolence. His arm's expression is harder to read.
translation_zh(译文): 斯特拉斯科因脸上挂着凝固的微笑,透着一种冷然的仁厚。他那只胳膊的神情,则更难以读懂。
日安,斯特拉斯科因先生。

source_text(原文): I am. I couldn't do without my Churchills. Although cigar smoke does not entirely agree with my other nature, so I may yet be forced to give up that little pleasure.
translation_zh(译文): 正是。我离不开我的丘吉尔型雪茄。虽说雪茄烟雾与我的另一重本性并不完全相合,我或许终究要被迫舍弃这点小小的乐趣。
