source_text(原文): My condolences on your condition, Mr Strathcoyne.
translation_zh(译文): 斯特拉斯科因先生,对您的状况,我深表同情。

source_text(原文): Churchills? Cuban cigars? I haven't seen those in France since the war.
translation_zh(译文): 丘吉尔型?古巴雪茄?战后我在法国就没再见过这种东西。

source_text(原文): How do you know my name?
You were a Bureau man, were you not? I used to make it my business to keep abreast of Bureau matters.
translation_zh(译文): 你曾是防剿局的人,对不对?从前,打探防剿局的事务是我的本分。

source_text(原文): When the Bureau still mattered a damn.
translation_zh(译文): 在防剿局还值得一提的那个年头。

source_text(原文): Really just a social call, Mr Strathcoyne. But if I might impose on you to answer a few questions -
translation_zh(译文): 真的只是登门拜访,斯特拉斯科因先生。不过,若我斗胆劳烦您回答几个问题——

source_text(原文): Yes. I have questions that need answering.
translation_zh(译文): 是的。我有几个问题需要答案。

source_text(原文): Strathcoyne waits. His arm twiches now and then, but its eyes never move.
translation_zh(译文): 斯特拉斯科因等待着。他的胳膊不时抽动,可它上面的眼睛却一动不动。

source_text(原文): You have something - something on - [Brush significantly at your own arm.]
translation_zh(译文): 您身上有什么——有什么——[意味深长地掸掸自己的胳膊。]

source_text(原文): What on Earth is going on with your arm?
translation_zh(译文): 您的胳膊到底是怎么回事?

source_text(原文): What? The [[Cross]]-change? Pray do not distress yourself, Mr Hobson. I have waited a great many years for it to begin.
translation_zh(译文): 什么?[[介壳种]]蜕变?请不要为此不安,霍布森先生。我等它开始,已经等了漫长的岁月。

source_text(原文): The [[Cross]]-change, Mr Hobson. A final personal advancement. The efflorescence of a long-held secret.
translation_zh(译文): 介壳种之变,霍布森先生。一次最终的个人进阶。一桩久藏秘密的绽放。

source_text(原文): And there is only a very little pain.
You are speaking of the [[Cross]]-change, I suppose, Mr Hobson? What an amusing fellow you are. Perhaps you should consider a career on the stage.
translation_zh(译文): 你说的想必是介壳种之变吧,霍布森先生?你可真是个有趣的人。也许你该考虑去舞台上谋个前程。

source_text(原文): I've seen Cross-touched humans, and Cross-relics in the wild places. Never anything quite like this. It's clearly the Cross-change. But...
translation_zh(译文): 我见过受介壳种沾染的人,也在荒野之地见过介壳种遗物。从未见过与此相似的景象。这显然是介壳种之变。但是……

source_text(原文): I've seen Cross-touched humans, and Cross-relics in the wild places. Never anything quite like this. But it's clearly the Cross-change.
translation_zh(译文): 我见过受介壳种沾染的人,也在荒野之地见过介壳种遗物。从未见过与此相似的景象。但显然,这是介壳种之变。

source_text(原文): Is the Change why you're in the Sanitarium?
translation_zh(译文): 您来疗养院,是因为这场变化吗?

source_text(原文): It is a pleasant enough dallying-place. I'll remain here until my translation to the Incorporate territories is arranged. I have important business in the West.
translation_zh(译文): 这里是个足够宜人的逗留之所。我会在此待到前往集团领土的行程安排妥当。我在西方有要事在身。

source_text(原文): For a time. When I return, I'll take my place in one of my kind's new cities. They should be well in progress by that time.
translation_zh(译文): 待上一段时间。我回来后,便会在同类的某座新城市中安身。到那时,那些城市应该已经颇具规模了。

source_text(原文): Too early to speak of, Mr Hobson. Put it from your mind.
translation_zh(译文): 说来尚早,霍布森先生。把这事从脑子里赶走吧。

source_text(原文): [Nod. Pull a coin out of Strathcoyne's ear and offer it to him.]
translation_zh(译文): [点头。从斯特拉斯科因先生的耳朵里变出一枚硬币,递给他。]

source_text(原文): I apologise for my flippancy, Mr Strathcoyne.
translation_zh(译文): 我为自己的轻浮致歉,斯特拉斯科因先生。

source_text(原文): Strathcoyne's eyes pop. He takes the coin, examines it for a second, and then - apparently to his own surprise - guffaws.
translation_zh(译文): 斯特拉斯科因瞪大了眼。他接过硬币,端详片刻,然后——显然连他自己都没想到——放声大笑。

source_text(原文): Unfortunately, Strathcoyne's arm interprets my sudden movement as an attack. It rears up, hissing, and Strathcoyne recoils.
translation_zh(译文): 可惜,斯特拉斯科因的胳膊把我这突然的动作当作袭击。它竖了起来,嘶嘶作响,斯特拉斯科因也随之退避。

source_text(原文): There's a rather grim scholarly debate on whether the Cross-changed actually become the end product, or are consumed by the Cross-seed within them. Strathcoyne's arm moves with unsettling independence.
translation_zh(译文): 学界有一场颇为阴森的争论:经介壳种之变者,究竟是真正成为最终的产物,还是被体内的介壳种子所吞噬。斯特拉斯科因的胳膊正以令人不安的独立性自行活动着。

source_text(原文): It may be that he won't enjoy the Change as much as he expects. The night is amused.
translation_zh(译文): 或许他并不会如自己所愿那般享受这场变化。夜色为之窃喜。

source_text(原文): It would be cruel to point that out.
It will gain me nothing to point that out.
translation_zh(译文): 点破此事对我毫无益处。

source_text(原文): What is she to you, Hobson?
translation_zh(译文): 她与你有什么关系,霍布森?

source_text(原文): We've never met. But she has information I need.
translation_zh(译文): 我们素未谋面。但她握有我需要的情报。

source_text(原文): I'm afraid I'm not at liberty to say.
The woman is a white carrion crow, Hobson. A baleful nidus of betrayals! If you know what's good for you, you'll stay well away.
translation_zh(译文): 那女人是只白色的食腐乌鸦,霍布森。一个不祥的背叛之巢!你若明白什么对你有好处,就离她远远的。

source_text(原文): That is all I have to say on the matter.
I have already made my feelings very clear on that... icy villainess.
translation_zh(译文): 对于那个……冰冷的恶妇,我的态度已经表达得很清楚了。

source_text(原文): Even the station's dim lights are brighter than the murk of Mimata town.
translation_zh(译文): 就连车站昏暗的灯光，也比米玛塔镇的晦暗更亮。

source_text(原文): Nina Lagasse is here somewhere. Leave before I find her? My heart shudders at the thought of it.
translation_zh(译文): 尼娜·拉加斯就在这里的某处。趁我还没找到她，就此离开？一想到此，我的心便阵阵战栗。

source_text(原文): Nina Lagasse is here somewhere. 'In the woods'...
translation_zh(译文): 尼娜·拉加斯就在这里的某处。「在树林里」……

source_text(原文): When I've convinced Nina to help me... then I can leave.
translation_zh(译文): 等我劝动尼娜来帮我……那时我才能离开。

source_text(原文): I'll be leaving with the Rosa Mundi circus.
translation_zh(译文): 我将随罗莎·蒙迪马戏团一同离开。

source_text(原文): [Complete the 'Rosa Mundi: Welcome' Plan before leaving.]
translation_zh(译文): [离开前，完成「罗莎·蒙迪：欢迎」计划。]

source_text(原文): WE are Weather Factory - Lottie Bevan and Alexis Kennedy - and we look forward very much to bringing you the whole game.
translation_zh(译文): 我们，是天气工厂——洛蒂·贝文与亚历克西·肯尼迪——我们万分期待把完整的游戏带到你面前。

source_text(原文): What was that bit with the cat?
The train's roar fades into the distance. Its echoes follow like beggar-children. A clinging, loamy silence falls.
translation_zh(译文): 火车的轰鸣渐渐远去。它的回声如乞儿般追随其后。一片黏稠的、泥壤般的寂静降临。

source_text(原文): Not quite silent. Bird-song, leaf-rustle. And off from behind the post office, the faint strains of a melodeon.
translation_zh(译文): 并非全然寂静。鸟鸣，叶响。邮局背后，隐隐传来手风琴的乐声。

source_text(原文): A flash of unexpected colour above the post office - flags rippling lazily in the dank air of the valley.
translation_zh(译文): 邮局上方掠过一抹出人意料的色彩——旗帜在谷地阴湿的空气中懒洋洋地翻卷。

source_text(原文): YOU are Spencer Hobson, Sylvain Hussier, Father Brass, hollow of spirit and brazen of heart.
translation_zh(译文): 你，就是斯宾塞·霍布森，西尔万·韦西耶，黄铜神父——魂魄空洞，心肠如铜。

source_text(原文): THIS has been the Travelling at Night demo.
translation_zh(译文): 这便是Travelling at Night的试玩版。

source_text(原文): Commedia del Sole.' Comedy of the Sun'?
As much theatre as anything. They're not advertising any booth shows, or beasts, or acrobats.
translation_zh(译文): 与其说是马戏,不如说是戏剧。他们没有为任何摊位表演、猛兽或杂技做宣传。

source_text(原文): What exactly is Nina's connection with the circus?
translation_zh(译文): 尼娜与这马戏团究竟有何关联?

source_text(原文): Again, the current manageress is identified as 'Mlle [[Nina Lagasse]].'
translation_zh(译文): 现任女班主的署名依旧是 '[[尼娜·拉加斯]]小姐'。

source_text(原文): Nina isn't mentioned by name. The current manageress is identified as 'Mme Medea Japaridze.'
translation_zh(译文): 传单上并未提及尼娜的名字。现任女班主的署名是 '梅德亚·贾帕里泽夫人'。

source_text(原文): The current manageress is identified as 'Mlle [[Nina Lagasse]].'
translation_zh(译文): 现任女班主的署名是 '[[尼娜·拉加斯]]小姐'。

source_text(原文): As I already knew - Mimata is where I will find [[Nina Lagasse]].
translation_zh(译文): 正如我早已知道的那样——我将在米玛塔找到[[尼娜·拉加斯]]。

source_text(原文): White text on smudgy black: upcoming times, dates, locations of performances of the circus 'Rosa Mundi'.
translation_zh(译文): 脏污的黑色纸面上印着白字:马戏团 '罗莎·蒙迪' 即将演出的时间、日期与地点。

source_text(原文): The circus came west from Genoa to the Côte d'Azur - which must have been when Nina stopped in at the Sanitarium.  Its route goes on along the coast through Marseille, Montpellier, Béziers. Then north into wilder regions. I've missed most of the dates, but it's due in the city of Mimata, in the mountains of Lozère. There should still be time to catch it there.
translation_zh(译文): 马戏团自热那亚西行至蔚蓝海岸——想必就是那时,尼娜顺道去了疗养院。其路线沿海岸继续延伸,途经马赛、蒙彼利埃、贝济耶,然后北上进入更为蛮荒的地带。大部分日期我已错过,不过下一场演出定在洛泽尔群山中的米玛塔城。赶到那里,应当还来得及。

source_text(原文): West from Genoa to the Côte d'Azur, then to Marseille, Montpellier, Béziers. It's due next in the city of Mimata, in the wild mountains of Lozère.
translation_zh(译文): 自热那亚向西至蔚蓝海岸,再到马赛、蒙彼利埃、贝济耶。下一场演出定在洛泽尔蛮荒群山中的米玛塔城。

source_text(原文): To Mimata, then. My heart surges urgently.
translation_zh(译文): 那就去米玛塔吧。我的心急切地涌动着。

source_text(原文): Where and when is it performing?
What kind of circus is it?
Commedia del Sole.' Comedy of the Sun'? Perhaps something derived from commedia del'arte - the Italian-French tradition with its masks, slapstick, satire.
translation_zh(译文): 太阳喜剧。'太阳的喜剧'?或许是脱胎于即兴喜剧——那种戴着面具、插科打诨、辛辣讽刺的意法传统。

source_text(原文): For whatever reason, this is incomprehensible to me.
translation_zh(译文): 不知为何,这对我而言无法理解。

source_text(原文): Antibes Light,Breakfast in the Ruins,The Incorporates
translation_zh(译文): 昂蒂布之光,废墟中的早餐,集团
黑暗中的晚餐,奥西曼提斯,绿意

source_text(原文): Failing a Skill challenge gives you Troubles, but also additional Experiences.
translation_zh(译文): 技艺挑战失败会带给你烦扰，但也会带来额外的经验。

source_text(原文): Smoking in post-Wars Europe is common; but not everyone enjoys the smell of tobacco.
translation_zh(译文): 在战后的欧洲，抽烟司空见惯；但并非人人都喜欢烟草的气味。

source_text(原文): Hateful to the Nose, Harmful to the Brain
They used to call Spencer 'the best-dressed man in the Suppression Bureau'.
translation_zh(译文): 他们过去称斯宾塞为「防剿局里穿着最讲究的人」。

source_text(原文): Influences are essential for crafting, but don't travel well. Preserve them by making Memories.
translation_zh(译文): 影响是炼制不可或缺之物，却不便随行。把它们制成回忆，便可长久保存。

source_text(原文): The first time Spencer was dismissed from the Suppression Bureau, it was wretched. The second time was worse.
translation_zh(译文): 斯宾塞第一次被防剿局开除时,那滋味糟透了。第二次更糟。

source_text(原文): Sharing secrets with strangers can be illuminating. It can also generate Traces.
translation_zh(译文): 与陌生人分享秘密,或可带来启发,也可能生成痕迹。

source_text(原文): If One Of Them Is Dead
Hold the Highlight key (Z by default) to find things more easily.
translation_zh(译文): 按住高亮键(默认 Z),可以更轻松地找到物品。

source_text(原文): In every history, Spencer was priest, conjurer, writer, investigator, physician, legionnaire... but you choose which one of those he felt most comfortable as.
translation_zh(译文): 在每一段历史中，斯宾塞都曾是神父、术士、作家、探员、医生、军团兵……但由你决定，其中哪一种身份让他最为自在。

source_text(原文): Generally, people are more likely to help you if their Opinion of you is good. But occasionally, annoying them will pay off.
translation_zh(译文): 一般而言，人们对你看法越好，就越愿意帮你。但偶尔，惹恼他们也会有回报。

source_text(原文): Spencer is a hollow man. His Passions aren't deeply rooted yet. If your idea of him changes, you can sometimes evolve your Passions to different ones.
translation_zh(译文): 斯宾塞是个空心人。他的激情还扎根不深。若你对他的想法变了，有时也可以把激情演化为不同的激情。

source_text(原文): Europe is probably dying. But it's going out in style.
translation_zh(译文): 欧洲大概正在死去。但它在以体面的方式谢幕。

source_text(原文): Unworldly Skills - the Nine Arts - can create single-use tools which unlock otherwise impossible conversation options.
translation_zh(译文): 世俗之外的技艺——九艺——能造出一次性工具，解锁原本不可能的对话选项。

source_text(原文): Acting in character is the best way to refresh your Aspect Pool.
translation_zh(译文): 以本色行事，是补充性相池的最佳方式。

source_text(原文): Spencer upset a lot of people before he went away. Some of them are still alive. Don't stay in one place too long.
translation_zh(译文): 斯宾塞离开之前得罪过不少人。他们中有些人还活着。别在一处停留太久。

source_text(原文): History forked, and so did France.
translation_zh(译文): 历史分了岔，法兰西也随之分岔。

source_text(原文): Choosing the right outfit can quietly and significantly affect NPC reactions. People who appreciate Raffish outfits rarely like Respectable ones.
translation_zh(译文): 选对行头，会悄然而显著地影响旁人的反应。欣赏花哨浪荡行头的人，很少会喜欢体面的行头。

source_text(原文): The sea does not regret the tide, and after the tide withdraws, something always remains, which we call memory.
translation_zh(译文): 大海不会为潮汐而悔恨,潮水退去之后,总有些什么留存下来,我们称之为回忆。

source_text(原文): 'But we must use the knife,' said the Lion-Throned One, 'the noose, the flame, the Waking Word, against those who have passed the Three-Valved Door. And so none may pass: that is our Law, and the Law of the Sun.'
translation_zh(译文): 「但我们必须动用刀锋,」狮座者说,「用绞索、烈焰与唤醒之言,来对付那些已穿过三重门扉者。因此无人得以通过:那是我们的律法,也是太阳的律法。」

source_text(原文): 'God save us always,' I said, 'from the innocent and the good.'
translation_zh(译文): 「愿上帝永远保佑我们,」我说,「远离那些天真无辜与良善之人。」

source_text(原文): The world breaks everyone and afterward many are strong at the broken places. But those that will not break it kills. It kills the very good and the very gentle and the very brave impartially. If you are none of these you can be sure it will kill you too but there will be no special hurry.
translation_zh(译文): 世界击碎每一个人,此后许多人在破碎之处变得坚强。但那些不肯破碎的人,它便杀死。它毫无偏袒地杀死极善良、极温柔、极勇敢的人。如果你三者都不是,大可放心它终会杀死你,只是不会特别着急。
霍科巴尔德,菲茨亨利勋爵

source_text(原文): Certainly, since the consummation of that particular delight, I have undergone alterations. Only one far less wise than I would deny it. But those with half my wisdom must recognise the elegance and the inevitability of those alterations. Who is the fire, and who the fuel? I was too great to be the one. So I must be the other.
translation_zh(译文): 诚然,自那场特别的欢愉圆满之后,我已历尽变化。只有远比我愚钝之人才会否认这一点。但拥有我一半智慧者,必能认出这些变化的优雅与必然。谁是火焰,谁是燃料?我太过伟大,做不了前者。所以我必是后者。

source_text(原文): My Deeds, My Powers, My Achievements and the Injustices Perpetrated Against Me
translation_zh(译文): 《我的功业、我的权能、我的成就,以及强加于我的不义》

source_text(原文): To reach the Stag Door, I believe that all you really need is to want something enough. But I've never wanted anything that much, except of course Baldomera, and I'm very much afraid that the knot in the story is this: what Baldomera wants is the Stag Door.
translation_zh(译文): 要抵达牡鹿之门,我相信你真正需要的只是足够强烈的渴望。但我从未那样渴望过任何东西——当然,巴尔多梅拉除外——而我非常担心,故事的症结正在于此:巴尔多梅拉想要的,正是牡鹿之门。

source_text(原文):
‘With us of the River,’ Sulinor volunteered, ‘we say: “I sleep; presently I row again.”’

‘Ah! At our end of the world we cry: “Gods, judge me not as a God, but a man whom the Ocean has broken.”’ Baeticus looked at Quabil, who answered, raising his cup: ‘We Sidonians say, “Mother of Carthage, I return my oar!” But it all comes to the one in the end.’
translation_zh(译文):
「我们这些河上之人,」苏利诺主动说道,「常说:『我睡去;不久我便再次摇桨。』」

「啊!在我们那世界的尽头,我们高呼:『众神啊,莫以神的标准审判我,只当我是被大洋击碎的一个凡人。』」拜提库斯望向夸比尔,后者举起酒杯答道:「我们西顿人会说,『迦太基之母,我归还我的船桨!』但归根结底,说来说去终归是一回事。」

source_text(原文): Where the Chandler has passed, the understandings of the Colonel and the Lionsmith will wrench open truth. Where the Chandler will pass, Moth will pass before him.
translation_zh(译文): 制烛人走过之处,上校与狮匠的领会将撬开真理。制烛人将行之处,蛾会先他而行。

source_text(原文):
I am on a street corner
Where I shouldn’t be.
Alone and coatless
I have gone out to look
For a black dog who answers to my whistle.
I have a kind of Halloween mask
Which I am afraid to put on.
translation_zh(译文):
我站在一个街角
一个我不该在的地方。
孤身一人,没穿外套
我出门来寻找
一条应我口哨声而来的黑狗。
我有一张万圣节面具
却害怕戴上它。

source_text(原文): But the chandler's witness brought a candle seventy-seven years old: every month, the chandler had bought the old stumps, returned their matter to the vat, and used them in his wares, so that each newest candle was also the oldest. Perhaps there's always a way.
translation_zh(译文): 但制烛人的证人带来了一支七十七岁的蜡烛:每个月,制烛人都会买回那些旧烛头,把它们的原料回炉入缸,再用于自己的货品,于是每一支最新的蜡烛同时也是最古老的。也许,总有办法存在。

source_text(原文): You go away for a long time and return a different person - you never come all the way back.
translation_zh(译文): 你离开很久,回来时已是另一个人——你永远不会完全归来。

source_text(原文): Darkness and Light divide the Course of Time, and until that Course is Run, Eternity remains History's Bed-Fellow. Sorrow then is Sense's final Solvent, and even a Tear, should it fall enow, might destroy a Stone…
translation_zh(译文): 黑暗与光明分割时间的进程,而在那进程走完之前,永恒始终是历史的同床者。悲伤于是成为知觉的最终溶剂,甚至一滴眼泪,若落得足够,也能毁掉一块石头……

source_text(原文): Sometimes it seemed to me like they were just trees, but sometimes it seemed like we were walking over a broken stone floor inside a big, big building with columns all around us, rows and rows of columns that stretched off into the night one hell of a lot farther than I could see.
translation_zh(译文): 有时在我看来它们不过是树,但有时又似乎我们正行走在一座巨大建筑的破碎石地板上,四周环绕着廊柱,一排又一排的廊柱伸入夜色,延伸之远远远超出我目力所及。

source_text(原文):
“Are we dead yet?” someone would ask.
Then with a plastic toothpick
I’d draw blood from my little finger
to prove we were still among the living.
translation_zh(译文):
「我们死了吗?」总有人会问。
然后我会用一根塑料牙签
从小指上刺出血来
证明我们依然活在人间。

source_text(原文): Time. I used to think it was a Wheel. But my family always said that it's a flame - coolest at its heart - wildest at its edges.
translation_zh(译文): 时间。我以前以为它是一个轮子。但我的家人总是说,它是一团火焰——焰心最凉,焰缘最烈。

source_text(原文):
He whispered, “And a river lies
Between the dusk and dawning skies,
And hours are distance, measured wide
Along that transnocturnal tide – "
translation_zh(译文):
他低语道:「有一条河横卧
在暮色与破晓的天色之间,
时辰皆是距离,度量悠远
循着那横渡长夜的潮线——」

source_text(原文): The Twelve Hours of the Night

We've been watching you over the garden wall
For hours.
The sky is darkening like a stain,
Something is going to fall like rain
And it won't be flowers.
translation_zh(译文):
我们越过花园围墙注视你
已有多时。
天空正像污渍一样变暗,
有什么东西要像雨一样落下
而那不会是花朵。

source_text(原文):
Lose something every day. Accept the fluster
of lost door keys, the hour badly spent.
The art of losing isn’t hard to master.

Then practice losing farther, losing faster:
places, and names, and where it was you meant
to travel. None of these will bring disaster.
translation_zh(译文):
每天失去点什么。接受丢失门钥匙
时的慌乱,那虚掷的时光。
失去的艺术并不难掌握。

再练习失去得更远、失去得更快:
失去地方,失去名字,失去你原打算
去往的远方。这些都不会带来灾祸。

source_text(原文):
The war was lost
		The treaty signed
		I was not caught
		I crossed the line
		I was not caught
		Though many tried
		I live among you, well-disguised
translation_zh(译文):
战争已败
		条约已签
		我未被捕
		我越过了线
		我未被捕
		尽管许多人在尝试
		我活在你们中间,伪装良好

source_text(原文): Speech is a Wound; Silence is Silver. There is no Silver Door, nor can there be, even in the Moon's House…
translation_zh(译文): 言语是创口;沉默是白银。没有白银之门,也不可能有,即使在月之居屋中亦复如是……

source_text(原文):
A token of the old order of Heaven - or of [[Corona]], which claims to be its inheritor.  An Incorporate dollar is the easiest option, but there are ways to craft a token in the absence of greenbacks.

[Since the Wars, the currency of Corona is used for the Bright Arts - but you can create an Eye of Authority as a substitute.]
translation_zh(译文):
旧天堂秩序的凭证——或属于自称其继承者的[[冕]]。一张集团美元是最省事的选项,但即使没有美钞,也有办法制出这样的凭证。

[大战之后,冕的货币用于光之技艺——但你可以制作一枚权威之眼作为替代。]

source_text(原文): The skeleton of a commedia scenario.

In the West, legitimate merchants accept local currency, Incorporate dollars, sometimes pounds sterling.

In the East, the only official medium of exchange is the dolya, the quasi-miraculous bill of exchange valued in productive labour and guaranteed by the Stars themselves. Using it in the West will get you arrested. 

Only two currencies are widely accepted on both sides of the line by everyone - Swiss francs, and cigarettes.

Black market traders on both sides of the line will also accept payment in dollars and sterling - sometimes other currencies if you're lucky.
translation_zh(译文):
在西方,正经商贩接受本地货币、集团美元,有时也收英镑。

在东方,唯一官方的交换媒介是多利亚——那种近乎奇迹的汇票,以生产劳动为价值,由星辰自身担保。在西方使用它,你会被捕。

只有两种货币在分界线两侧人人通用——瑞士法郎,还有香烟。

分界线两侧的黑市商贩也接受美元和英镑付款——运气好的话,有时也收别的货币。

source_text(原文): Works of the [[Bright Arts]], emblems of the [[Sun]].

'Whatever is ephemeral is only a metaphor' - Goethe

[Whenever you travel, each stack of Ephemeral items will lose one item]
translation_zh(译文):
「一切易逝之物,不过是譬喻」——歌德

[每次旅行时,每叠易逝之物都会失去一件。]

source_text(原文): An echo, a resonance, an alignment. Influences are used with occult skills in crafting. They fade when travelling - except for Memories, which endure.
translation_zh(译文): 一种回声,一种共振,一种契合。炼制时,影响与秘术技艺搭配使用。旅行时它们会消散——唯有回忆例外,它们长存。

source_text(原文): Cigars, coffee, good soap. Rarities in the Europe of 1948.
translation_zh(译文): 雪茄、咖啡、好肥皂。1948 年的欧洲难得之物。

source_text(原文): A token of the fundamental necessity that underlies the world. A Ministries dolya will work - but it's also possible to craft such a token. [Since the Wars, the currency of Gleam is used for the Night Arts - but you can create a Mark of Necessity as a substitute.]
translation_zh(译文): 一枚支撑世界之根本必需的凭证。一张联盟的多利亚可用——但也可以炼制出这样的凭证。 [大战之后,烁的货币用于夜之技艺——但你可以制作一枚必需之印迹作为替代。]

source_text(原文): A pinch of transformation, intoxication, or subversion. Effective as a gift, or when used to treat food and drink.
translation_zh(译文): 一小撮转化、迷醉或颠覆之物。作为礼物有效,用于处理食物与饮品时同样有效。

source_text(原文): Conjoin; bring together; wed. The Sister-and-Witch, the Witch-and-Sister.
translation_zh(译文): 结合;汇聚;缔姻。双生女巫,女巫与双生。

source_text(原文): Separate; excise; banish. The Horned-Axe's purpose.
translation_zh(译文): 分离;切除;放逐。角斧之职。

source_text(原文): Command spirits with the inherited authority of the old Sun.
translation_zh(译文): 以旧太阳承袭而来的权威号令精魂。
使之鲜活,使之振奋,使之苏醒。

source_text(原文): Cross forbidden boundaries; transgress inconvenient prohibitions.
translation_zh(译文): 跨越禁忌的边界;违犯不便的禁令。

source_text(原文): Blight, undermine, torment. Effective when left in someone's home or clothing, or when used to treat food and drink.
translation_zh(译文): 凋萎,侵蚀,折磨。留在某人家里或衣物中时有效,用于处理食物与饮品时同样有效。

source_text(原文): The kind of thing that rattles around in a drawer until, one day, you really need it.
translation_zh(译文): 那种在抽屉里叮当作响、直到某一天你真需要它的东西。

source_text(原文):
With time and travel, good things become bad things: sandwiches, soufflé, flower arrangements.

[All Perishable items will disappear when you travel.]
translation_zh(译文):
随着时间与旅途,好东西会变成坏东西:三明治、舒芙蕾、插花。

[旅行时,所有易腐物品都会消失。]

source_text(原文): Essential markers of elegance or wealth.
translation_zh(译文): 优雅或富贵的标志性物件。

source_text(原文): Bandages, patent medicines, antiseptic; folk cures, witchy tangles, herb-mixes.
translation_zh(译文): 绷带、成药、消毒剂;民间偏方、巫术缠结、草药合剂。

source_text(原文): The sombre, the sinister, the suspicious. Works of the [[Night Arts]] and criminal instruments.
translation_zh(译文): 阴沉、险恶、可疑之物。[[夜之技艺]]之作,与犯罪工具。

source_text(原文):
'The green wealth in the world's veins, the tiny price of the old redder lower Sun, the bursting Grail-joy: all these are blood.'

Some rites of the [[Arts Unconsidered]] require the shedding of blood with an instrument that has never before tasted blood. In another age, this is one reason that adepts continued to use flint rather than iron.
translation_zh(译文):
「世界脉络中的绿色财富,旧日那位更红、更低的太阳的微薄代价,迸发的杯之欢愉:这些都是血。」

[[未识技艺]]的某些仪式,须用一件从未尝过血的器具来放血。在另一个年代,这正是修士们始终用燧石而不用铁器的原因之一。

source_text(原文): Little precious things: jewellery, time-pieces, semi-precious knick-knacks.
translation_zh(译文): 小巧的珍物:珠宝、钟表、半宝石小玩意儿。

source_text(原文):
Something that only a priest would wear - or should wear.

Religiously inclined characters will respond positively, unless they come to believe you're not entitled to wear the outfit.
translation_zh(译文):
只有教士才会穿——或应当穿——的衣物。

有宗教倾向的角色会作出积极回应,除非他们开始相信你没有资格穿这身行头。

source_text(原文): This just isn't something most people would wear in public. Most people will be bemused, though a few odd bods will like it.
translation_zh(译文): 这不是大多数人会穿出门的东西。大多数人会摸不着头脑,不过少数怪人会喜欢它。

source_text(原文): Only when you really need to dress up. Outside appropriate situations, only a few very old-fashioned characters will react favourably
translation_zh(译文): 只在真正需要盛装打扮时。在合适的场合之外,只有少数非常守旧的角色会作出好感回应。

source_text(原文): Good in summer, bad in winter, and won't slow you down. A socially neutral aspect.
translation_zh(译文): 夏季合宜,冬季不宜,而且不会拖慢你的脚步。一个社交中性的性相。

source_text(原文):
Appropriate only for the most relaxed circumstances. Like bed.

Most people will react disfavourably to a Louche outfit, though a few will enjoy it.
translation_zh(译文):
只适合最松弛的场合。比如床上。

大多数人会对放浪的行头作出负面反应,不过少数人会乐在其中。

source_text(原文): A military uniform - or something that strongly suggests such a connection. Other soldiers and ex-soldiers will approve. In 1948, very few would object.
translation_zh(译文): 军装——或任何强烈暗示这种联系的衣物。其他军人和退伍军人会认可。在 1948 年,几乎没有人会反对。
时新、时髦,大概还是美国货。

source_text(原文): Stylish, unconventional, flashy. Likely to provoke a positive or negative reaction in most characters.
translation_zh(译文): 时髦、不循常规、招摇。多半会在大多数角色身上激起或好或坏的反应。

source_text(原文): Conventional, conservative, unremarkable. A safe option, although more unconventional souls will be put off.
translation_zh(译文): 传统、保守、毫不起眼。稳妥的选择,不过那些更不循常规的灵魂会被劝退。

source_text(原文): Suitable for a cold climate; but bulky, and uncomfortable in the heat. A socially neutral aspect.
translation_zh(译文): 适合寒冷气候;但笨重,天热时也不舒服。一个社交中性的性相。

source_text(原文):
All conquest occurs at the Edge. One who dwelt there was blind. Another was strong. Of the third, we did not speak.

Edge is the [[Principle]] of battle and of struggle. Colonel, Lionsmith, Wolf-Divided were its Hours, but they are Uncounted now, and strife feeds on strife.
translation_zh(译文):
一切征服都发生在刃上。曾居其中者,一位目盲。另一位强壮。至于第三位,我们从不言说。

刃是战斗与抗争的[[准则]]。上校、狮子匠、裂分之狼曾是它的司辰,但如今它们已除名,而纷争以纷争为食。

source_text(原文):
'Fire,' I read once, 'is the winter that warms and the spring that consumes.`

The Hour we called the Forge of Days is Uncounted now, but Forge is still the  [[Principle]] that transforms and destroys.
translation_zh(译文):
「火,」我曾读到,「是温暖的冬天,是吞噬的春天。」

我们称之为白日铸炉的那位司辰如今已除名,但铸仍是那转化与毁灭的[[准则]]。

source_text(原文):
Hunger, lust, the drowning waters.

The [[Hour]] we named for it is [[Uncounted]] now. The Grail-[[Principle]] once honoured equally the birth and the feast. Perhaps it does still.
translation_zh(译文):
饥饿,欲望,灭顶之水。

我们以它为名的那位[[司辰]]如今已[[除名]]。杯之[[准则]]曾同等地尊奉诞生与盛宴。或许如今依然。

source_text(原文): Heart is the [[Principle]] that continues and preserves. But the Heart Relentless, the Hour that once protected the skin of the world we understand - the Heart Relentless has fallen silent.
translation_zh(译文): 心是延续与保存的[[准则]]。但不息之心——那位曾守护我们所知世界的皮囊的司辰——不息之心已然沉寂。

source_text(原文):
The Knock permits no seal and no isolation. It is the [[Principle]] that thrusts us gleefully out of the safety of ignorance. 

The Hour that unsealed and unseamed is Uncounted now. Another Hour stood at every threshold: perhaps it persists.
translation_zh(译文):
启不容封缄,不容隔绝。它是那将我们欣悦地推出无知之安全的[[准则]]。

那位开封解缝的司辰如今已除名。曾有另一位司辰伫立于每一道门槛:或许它仍在。

source_text(原文): Lucent intellect, merciless revelation, aureate clarity. Lantern is the principle of the secret place sometimes called the House of the Sun, or the [[Mansus]], and of the light above it. It is [[Corona]] and [[Gleam]], now, the West and the East, and the eyes of its [[Hours]] are closed.
translation_zh(译文): 澄澈的智性,无情的揭示,金色的清明。灯是那隐秘之处的准则——那处有时被称为太阳居屋,或称[[漫宿]]——也是其上方光芒的准则。如今它是[[冕]]与[[烁]],是西方与东方,而它诸[[司辰]]的眼睛已然闭合。

source_text(原文):
'I knew a man who captured moths in a bell-jar. On nights like this, he would release them one by one to die in the candle.'

 Moth is the wild and perilous  [[Principle]] of chaos and yearning. Are its [[Hours]] [[Uncounted]], or only altered? Moth is not to be expected.
translation_zh(译文):
「我认识一个人,把飞蛾捉进钟形罐。在这样的夜晚,他会把它们一只一只放出来,任其死在烛火里。」

蛾是混沌与渴望的[[准则]],狂野而危险。它的[[司辰]]们已[[除名]],抑或只是改变了?蛾不可预料。

source_text(原文): A  [[Principle]] of exploration - enlightenment - hope? Nine directions to new horizons. Here are [[Hours]] that wingèd rise.
translation_zh(译文): 探索的[[准则]]——启迪——希望?九个朝向新地平线的方向。此处有展翅升起的[[司辰]]。

source_text(原文): Winter is the [[Principle]] of silence, of endings, and of those things that are not quite dead.
translation_zh(译文): 冬是寂静、终结、以及那些尚未完全死去之物的[[准则]]。

source_text(原文): Andrée, proprietor of the Librarie des Heures near the station,  is not only a bookseller.
translation_zh(译文): 车站附近的时辰书店店主安德烈,不只是一位书商。

source_text(原文): can bewitch as well as wither!
can wither as well as bewitch!
Transparently consume requested drinks, only if they haven't been doctored
translation_zh(译文): 不动声色地喝掉所点的饮品,只要它们没被动过手脚。
费利克斯之家:宾客之礼

source_text(原文): The management situation at the Rosa Mundi circus.
translation_zh(译文): 罗莎·蒙迪马戏团的经营状况。

source_text(原文): In Europe now, the seasons often follow weather, not the other way around.
translation_zh(译文): 如今的欧洲,季节常常跟着天气走,而不是反过来。

source_text(原文): I've located a hidden space behind Aubière's office.
translation_zh(译文): 我找到了奥比埃办公室后面的一个隐蔽空间。

source_text(原文): Bessy cooks these hearty and sustaining marvels as a perpetual habit.
translation_zh(译文): 烹制这些丰盛又耐饿的美味,是贝茜雷打不动的习惯。
这鬼祟的生灵身在何处?

source_text(原文): What was the destiny of Strathcoyne's cigars?
translation_zh(译文): 斯特拉斯科因的雪茄,命运如何?

source_text(原文): I've been catching up with Vincent Chraibi.
translation_zh(译文): 我一直在与文森特·沙莱比叙旧。

source_text(原文): Tracks what the player last ordered, for inconspicuous callback
translation_zh(译文): 记录玩家上次所点的饮品,以便日后不着痕迹地提及。

source_text(原文): Father Jaume prays to a many-named saint, who told him to expect a visitor who might open her eyes: me.
translation_zh(译文): 若梅神父向一位名号众多的圣人祈祷;圣人告诉他,将有一位访客到来,她也许会睁开双眼——那人就是我。

source_text(原文): Milicien Léon has promised me a small payment for the name of each malcontent.
translation_zh(译文): 民兵莱昂向我许诺:每供上一个心怀不满者的名字,就付我一小笔报酬。

source_text(原文): Zèlia, in the park, performed a cruel little ritual, hoping to summon assistance for her revenge. She offered a substantial cash payment.
translation_zh(译文): 泽莉亚在公园里施行了一个残忍的小小仪式,指望召来助力,以报她的仇。她开出了一笔可观的现金报酬。

source_text(原文): Mme Zèlia has asked me to find her husband, who ran off with - or was taken by - another woman to another city. Beyond that, details seem scarce.
translation_zh(译文): 泽莉亚夫人请我寻找她的丈夫——他随另一个女人去了另一座城市,又或许是被那女人带走的。除此之外,细节似乎寥寥无几。

source_text(原文): To advance another Plan, I could use an item that has the [[Wither]] aspect. A Midnight Mark would be perfect.
translation_zh(译文): 要推进另一项计划,我需要一件带有[[凋零]]性相的物品。午夜印记再合适不过。

source_text(原文): To advance another Plan, I could use an item with the [[Unveil]] or [[Hallow]] aspect. A Wakeful Eye has both.
translation_zh(译文): 要推进另一项计划,我需要一件带有[[揭示]]或[[祝圣]]性相的物品。警醒之眼两者兼具。

source_text(原文): To advance another Plan, I could use an item that has the [[Bewitch]] aspect. A Witch's Knot would be perfect.
translation_zh(译文): 要推进另一项计划,我需要一件带有[[蛊惑]]性相的物品。女巫结再合适不过。

source_text(原文): I set out to disinter the Signs of the dead Hours. Why?
translation_zh(译文): 我动身去掘出那些死去司辰的印记。为什么?

source_text(原文): I must find Nina Lagasse. My heart's been very clear about that since the day I returned to the world. Nina, as they say, knows where the bodies are buried.
translation_zh(译文): 我必须找到尼娜·拉加斯。自我重返世间那天起,我的心对此便一清二楚。正如人们所说,尼娜知道那些尸体埋在何处。

source_text(原文): Nina's invited me to travel with the Rosa Mundi circus. This will allow me to travel safety, and to get the help I need from the Rosa Mundi troupe.
translation_zh(译文): 尼娜邀请我与罗莎·蒙迪马戏团同行。这样我就能安全旅行,也能从罗莎·蒙迪的团员那里得到我需要的帮助。

source_text(原文): If I can't win Dr Aubière's co-operation... perhaps I can compel it.
translation_zh(译文): 若我无法赢得奥比埃医生的配合……也许我能迫使它发生。

source_text(原文): Give up this plan. No-op once the plan has concluded, so a won plan is never undone.
translation_zh(译文): 放弃这项计划。计划一旦结束即不再起效,因此赢下的计划永远不会被推翻。

source_text(原文): Dr Aubière keeps close the secret of where to find Nina Lagasse. But in dreams, it's difficult to keep secrets.

source_text(原文): What I saw as an exorcist's assistant, and then the priest of an unusual parish, led me to question my faith - and I left the [[Church]] shortly afterwards. translation_zh(译文): 我从未修完医学学位,不过我学到的已经足够接骨、退烧。是医学背后那片秘术地带分了我的心。 1927 年,斯宾塞受防剿局资助学医。1930 年,这项安排破裂之后,他在[[门关军团]]应征为军医,为期五年。

source_text(原文): What else can an educated man with no useful skills do for a living? Investigative journalism; book reviews; pseudonymous fiction; plays no one would perform. translation_zh(译文): 倦怠只剩 [q=Weariness]:好多了。不再筋疲力尽,只是慵懒。

source_text(原文): Only [q=Weariness] Weariness - I'm no longer Exhausted, just Drowsy.
translation_zh(译文): 倦怠只剩 [q=Weariness]——我不再筋疲力尽,只是困倦。

source_text(原文): [q=Weariness] Weariness is enough to make me Languorous.
At [q=Weariness] Weariness, my Languor has gone.
translation_zh(译文): 当倦怠为 [q=Weariness] 时,我的慵懒已然消退。

1-3 Weariness: "I'm not at my best."

translation_zh(译文):
1-3 点倦怠:“我不在最佳状态。”

translation_zh(译文): [q=Weariness] 倦怠足以把我从慵懒推向困倦。

source_text(原文): I've gone too long without sleep - for a moment there, I lost consciousness.
translation_zh(译文): 我太久没有睡觉了——方才那一刻,我失去了意识。

source_text(原文): Republican stronghold crushed in the Caudillo's grasp
translation_zh(译文): 共和派重镇,在考迪罗掌中被碾碎

source_text(原文): Shattered by war, divided now between the Powers
translation_zh(译文): 为战争所摧毁,如今被列强瓜分

source_text(原文): Isolated fishing hamlet with a great and secret library-fortress
translation_zh(译文): 与世隔绝的渔村,藏着一座宏伟而隐秘的图书馆堡垒

source_text(原文): The new heart of Europe... not quite as broken as we might expect
translation_zh(译文): 欧洲的新心脏……并不像我们预想的那般破碎

source_text(原文): Skeleton-strewn, [[Gleam]]-gifted; but memories linger of the second capital of the Dual Monarchy
translation_zh(译文): 骸骨遍野,禀[[烁]]之赐;但关于二元君主国第二都城的记忆,仍在徘徊

source_text(原文): The devastated city where the New King fell in battle - and its coastal lifeline
translation_zh(译文): 新王战殁于斯的废墟之城,连同它的海岸生命线

source_text(原文): City of old ghosts and new candle-light
The risen Smok, the seething Nest, the fallen Star
translation_zh(译文): 复生的斯莫克,沸腾的巢穴,坠落的星辰

source_text(原文): Pulverised city, Incorporate hub, jazz scene
translation_zh(译文): 化为齑粉的都市,集团的枢纽,爵士乐的天地

source_text(原文): New concrete, old bones, thin rations, thinner refugees
translation_zh(译文): 新的混凝土,旧的骸骨,微薄的配给,更瘦的难民

source_text(原文): Grey little resort town oddly popular with adepts
translation_zh(译文): 灰蒙蒙的小度假镇,却古怪地深得修士们的青睐

source_text(原文): Bombweed and fog; bright Queen Alexandra in her brighter palace
translation_zh(译文): 炸弹草与浓雾;明亮的女王亚历山德拉,端坐在更明亮的宫殿中

source_text(原文): Real ghosts, fictional memories, severed souls, and the trains keep running.
translation_zh(译文): 真实的鬼魂,虚构的记忆,被割裂的灵魂,而火车仍在运行

source_text(原文): The high city running hungry under the arrowed yoke
translation_zh(译文): 高城在缀箭之轭下忍饥前行

source_text(原文): The amber town adrift on consolation's tides far from the rush of the world
translation_zh(译文): 琥珀色的小镇,漂荡在慰藉的潮汐之上,远离尘世的奔忙

source_text(原文): Steam and steel and the long shadow of the Hanged Man
translation_zh(译文): 蒸汽与钢铁,以及倒吊人的长影

source_text(原文): The town in the forest is the forest in the town, now
translation_zh(译文): 林中之镇,如今已是镇中之林

source_text(原文): The only town of any size in Graustark; the seat of the von Nagelsburgs since the 1500s
translation_zh(译文): 格劳斯塔克唯一略具规模的小镇;自 16 世纪起便是冯·纳格尔斯堡家族的驻地

source_text(原文): Ravaged by the Enemy, smashed by the Allies, scoured by the trials of collaborators
translation_zh(译文): 遭敌人蹂躏,被盟军砸碎,再经通敌者的审判荡涤

source_text(原文): Oxford never changes; Oxford is changing now
translation_zh(译文): 牛津从未改变;牛津正在改变

source_text(原文): 'The City of Light', they called it, before the war
Walled and wooded town aboil now with revolution
translation_zh(译文): 城墙环绕、林木葱茏的小城,如今正因革命而沸腾

source_text(原文): Empty ghetto, silver sky, rising Hives. Step away from the window.
translation_zh(译文): 空荡的隔都,银色的天空,升起的蜂巢。离那扇窗远些。

source_text(原文): 'In the secrecy of the polling booth, Heaven sees you -  the Advisor doesn't.' The Eternal City has chosen Corona, not Gleam... for now.
translation_zh(译文): 「在投票间的隐秘之中,天堂看得见你——顾问却看不见。」永恒之城选择了冕,而非烁……至少目前如此。

source_text(原文): The Oath of Kufra is fulfilled; above the scarred Cathedral, three colours glow
translation_zh(译文): 库夫拉之誓已然履行;在伤痕累累的大教堂上方,三色光芒闪耀

source_text(原文): City of the north wind, gateway to the sea
translation_zh(译文): 北风之城,通往大海的门户

source_text(原文): The fascists are gone, the Biennale is back, and the Comedy of the Sun is welcome
translation_zh(译文): 法西斯已经离去,双年展重新开幕,太阳喜剧备受欢迎

source_text(原文): In the wasteland of stones, the coffeehouse lamps glimmer again
translation_zh(译文): 在石头的荒原之中,咖啡馆的灯火再次闪烁

source_text(原文): An ocean of ruins. Saith the Enemy: The city must completely disappear from the surface of the earth and serve only as a transport station. No stone can remain standing. But now saith the architects in the smashed ruins: The entire nation builds its capital.
translation_zh(译文): 一片废墟的海洋。敌人如是说:这座城市必须从地表彻底消失,只用作一座运输站。任何石头都不得矗立。但如今,在粉碎的废墟中,建筑师们如是说:整个民族正在建造自己的首都。

source_text(原文):
Europe awaits --- Mimata, where the red nuns look down on the beasts of the town --- Caen, where the New King's catafalque smoulders --- Mahaggony, under its amber --- Berlin red-litten --- Prague, Cross-hived, with its stairway ever down --- and at last, your final destination.

You are the one who passes every door. CONJURE your new self. CONFESS your schemes. And just when they think they have the measure of you --- DISAPPEAR.

translation_zh(译文):
欧洲在前方等候——米玛塔,红衣修女俯瞰镇中群兽之地——卡昂,新王的灵柩台仍在阴燃——马哈戈尼,琥珀之下——柏林,红灯映照——布拉格,蜂巢密布,阶梯永远向下——最后,是你最终的归宿。

Spencer has lef tthe Sanitarium. Europe awaits -- Mimata, where the red nuns look down on the town-beasts -- Caen, where the New King's catafalque smoulders -- Mahaggony, under its amber - Berlin red-litten - Prague, Cross-hived, with its stairway ever down.

斯宾塞已经离开疗养院。欧洲在前方等候——米玛塔,红衣修女俯瞰镇兽之地——卡昂,新王的灵柩台仍在阴燃——马哈戈尼,琥珀之下——柏林,红灯映照——布拉格,蜂巢密布,阶梯永远向下。

source_text(原文):
"Flint is gone; but her facets echoed each a separate Star. When the Forge is ashes, Flint shreds what remains." - attr. Thomas Dewulf

What's left of Spencer has surrendered to the night. Perhaps he'll descend into Nowhere. Perhaps he'll close his eyes and open the gates of his spirit. Whatever his hollow flesh does next, it won't be our story.

This is not a positive ending.
translation_zh(译文):
「燧石已逝;但她的每一道棱面都曾各自回响着一颗独立的星辰。当铸炉化为灰烬,燧石便撕碎残存的一切。」——归于托马斯·德伍尔夫

斯宾塞残余的部分已向黑夜投降。也许他会坠入虚无之地。也许他会闭上双眼,打开灵魂之门。无论他那空空的躯壳接下来会做什么,那都不再是我们的故事。

这不是一个好结局。

source_text(原文):
"The Stars are pinpricks. The Sun is a wound. Behind them, above them, Eternity." - Sereno Blackwood

What's left of Spencer has surrendered to the light. Perhaps he'll cross the Sea to the great radiances of joyous commerce. Perhaps he'll dry into rags and rise flapping like a kite into the Sun. Whatever his hollow flesh does next, it won't be our story.

This is not a positive ending.
translation_zh(译文):
「群星不过是针孔。太阳是一道伤口。在它们之后,在它们之上,是永恒。」——塞蕾娜·布莱克伍德

斯宾塞残余的部分已向光芒投降。也许他会渡过大海,前往喜乐贸易的煌煌光辉。也许他会干枯成破布,像风筝一般拍打着升入太阳。无论他那空空的躯壳接下来会做什么,那都不再是我们的故事。

这不是一个好结局。

source_text(原文):
Spencer's body - scarred and fragile flesh, gnawed and hollowed, sustained by the pulse of his brazen internal interloper - Spencer's body has failed. It's astonishing that it lasted this long.

Spencer is dead.

This is not a positive ending.
translation_zh(译文):
斯宾塞的身体——伤痕累累、脆弱易碎的肉体,被啃蚀,被掏空,仅靠他体内那黄铜色闯入者的搏动维系——斯宾塞的身体终于衰竭了。它能撑这么久,实在令人惊讶。

斯宾塞死了。

这不是一个好结局。

source_text(原文): Without the [[Incorporates]] to unite their efforts, they might still have lost.
translation_zh(译文): 若不是[[集团]]统合各自的努力，他们或许仍然会输。

source_text(原文): Without the [[Ministries]] to fight the hardest battles, they might still have lost.
translation_zh(译文): 若不是[[联盟]]打了最艰苦的仗，他们或许仍然会输。

source_text(原文): If they hadn't joined their powers, there would have been nothing left of the [[Histories]] at all.
translation_zh(译文): 倘若他们不曾联合同心，[[历史]]恐怕什么也不会留下。
那些与[[敌人]]作战的国家。

source_text(原文): Easier to forward when we burn something behind us.
translation_zh(译文): 在身后烧掉些什么，向前便更容易。

source_text(原文): There's always more pips where those pips came from.
translation_zh(译文): 点数总有来处，永远还会有更多。

source_text(原文): There's always a way forward. If I run out of pips, I'll find something else.
translation_zh(译文): 总有路可走。若点数用尽，我会另寻他法。

source_text(原文):
Through your [[Signs]] and [[Passions]], you express the fundamental [[Principles]] underlying all things... which in practical terms means you can spend pips from your Pool to force a success on a [[Skill]] test that you fail.

You can only do this with [[Skills]] that match the [[Aspect]] points you're using.

If your Aspect Pool is depleted, then acting with the grain of a [[Sign]] or [[Passion]] will refresh one or more matching pips.
translation_zh(译文):
通过你的[[印记]]与[[激情]]，你表达着万物之下的根本[[准则]]……而在实际操作上，这意味着你可以消耗性相池中的点数，在[[技艺]]检定失败时强行使其成功。

你只能对与所用[[性相]]相符的[[技艺]]这样做。

若你的性相池已耗尽，那么顺应[[印记]]或[[激情]]行事，将补充一个或多个相应的点数。

source_text(原文): I've been priest, conjuror, writer, physician, and more. When circumstances demand change, I change with them. Perhaps I'll focus on breadth of skills.
translation_zh(译文): 我做过司祭、术士、作家、医生，还有更多。当境况要求改变时，我便随之而变。也许我会专注于技艺的广度。

source_text(原文): I've been many things, but I've learnt what I do best. Perhaps I'll focus on depth of skills.
translation_zh(译文): 我做过许多行当，但我知道自己最擅长什么。也许我会专注于技艺的深度。

source_text(原文): Who knows what I'll do? Even I generally don't.
translation_zh(译文): 谁知道我会做什么？连我自己通常也不知道。

source_text(原文):
Spencer has had many careers, but there's one where he felt he belonged. Through the long years of his hollowing in the dark, all his [[Skills]], decayed - but the ones from that career decayed slowest.

Any other [[Skill]] can be acquired or increased with [[Experiences]] later - but increasing a Career Skill only costs half as much.
translation_zh(译文):
斯宾塞做过许多职业，但只有一份让他感到归属。在他于黑暗中空洞化的漫长岁月里，他所有的[[技艺]]都在衰朽——但源于那份职业的技艺，衰朽得最慢。

任何其他[[技艺]]日后都可以用[[经验]]获得或提升——但提升职业技艺的耗费只有一半。

source_text(原文): The Church of the Unconquerable [[Sun]] acknowledges four [[Horae]] Canonicae, but its outer rites and doctrines present a humanised, comfortable version of each. The earliest church councils resolved that the inner mysteries of the Hours are much too dangerous to be approached directly. They're right, of course - most of all, about the mysteries of one particular Hour.
translation_zh(译文): 不可征服之太阳的教会承认四种[[时序女神]]正时，但其外部仪式与教义呈现的是每种正时人性化、令人安适的版本。最早的教会公会议认定，司辰的内层奥秘太过危险，不可直接触及。他们当然是对的——尤其是关于某一位司辰的奥秘。

source_text(原文): The [[Sun]] still glows, and Corona is only his latest blessing.
translation_zh(译文): [[太阳]]仍在发光，冕不过是他最新的恩赐。

source_text(原文): The USA has always been a hotbed of [[Crucian]] heresy. This is some new permutation. Good?
translation_zh(译文): 美国一直是[[十字派]]异端的温床。这是某种新的变体。好事？

source_text(原文): The blessing of the [[Incorporates]]. Everything gets better.
A golden and novel [[Principle]] which brings both visionary wisdom and material prosperity.
translation_zh(译文): 一条崭新而金灿的[[准则]]，既带来洞见的智慧，也带来物质的繁荣。

source_text(原文): If only the Church could have remained whole.
translation_zh(译文): 要是教会能保持完整就好了。

source_text(原文): The heresy of choice in the New World, where dissenters fled the [[Church]]'s light. Its iconography includes doves, lambs, and the Crucian Form on which they assert the Shepherd-Illuminate was executed by the Roman authorities - empty, to symbolise his Illumination and ascent.
translation_zh(译文): 新大陆备受青睐的异端，异议者逃离[[教会]]之光后所皈依的信仰。其图像学包括鸽子、羔羊，以及十字形态——他们断言启明之牧者被罗马当局处死于其上，而那形态是空的，象征他的启明与升天。

source_text(原文): The murderous regime whose crimes broke the continent; whose weapons soured the sun. So much for their dreams of conquest and purification. Even the night is against them now.
translation_zh(译文): 那个嗜杀的政权，其罪行撕裂了整片大陆；其武器使太阳变色。他们的征服与净化之梦，算是完了。如今连夜晚也站在他们的对立面。

source_text(原文): An early lesson still haunts me.
translation_zh(译文): 早年的一课至今仍萦绕着我。

source_text(原文): An early lesson still pains me.
translation_zh(译文): 早年的一课至今仍刺痛着我。

source_text(原文): An early lesson still delights me.
translation_zh(译文): 早年的一课至今仍使我愉悦。

source_text(原文): Experiences can be used to improve existing [[Skills]], or learn new ones. You'll need Experiences that match at least one [[Aspect]] on the relevant [[Skill]].
translation_zh(译文): 经验可用于提升已有的[[技艺]]，或学习新的技艺。你需要与目标[[技艺]]至少一项[[性相]]相符的经验。

source_text(原文):
If only life came with [[Footnotes]]!


Once you've viewed a [[Footnote]], you can always find it by searching for its name via Footnote search - which you're looking at now, because that's the only way to get here.


Most [[Footnotes]] come with opportunities for reflection, self-expression, or angst, allowing you to choose an [[Experience]]. You don't have to make the choice straight away - the Footnotes finder will track and remind you of [[Footnotes]] with incomplete choices.
translation_zh(译文):
要是人生也附有[[脚注]]就好了！


查看过一条[[脚注]]之后，你随时可以通过脚注搜索按名称找到它——你现在正在看的正是这种搜索，因为这是到达这里的唯一途径。


大多数[[脚注]]附带着沉思、自我表达或忧惧的机会，让你可以选择一种[[经验]]。你不必立刻做出选择——脚注查找器会追踪并提醒你那些尚有选择未完成的[[脚注]]。

source_text(原文): Gwendolen Farouk, an Alexandrian scholar and engineer of unusual heritage, who provided the finishing touch that my two other friends needed, before they could return me to the world with my heart intact.
translation_zh(译文): 格温德琳·法鲁克，亚历山大城的学者与工程师，出身不凡。在我那两位朋友能带着完好无损的心将我送回人世之前，正是她补上了最后关键的一环。

source_text(原文): Everyone calls me Spencer, but I wonder sometimes if it'll ever feel quite right.
translation_zh(译文): 大家都叫我斯宾塞，但我有时会想，这个名字会不会永远没法完全合身。

source_text(原文): I've changed so much since those days...
translation_zh(译文): 自那些日子以来，我变了太多……

source_text(原文): Interesting people always have more than one name.
translation_zh(译文): 有趣的人永远不止一个名字。

source_text(原文): Sylvain Huissier is the name I was christened under, back in the Paris orphanage. It's the name on my old Third Republic passport.
translation_zh(译文): 西尔万·韦西耶是我在巴黎孤儿院受洗时用的名字。它写在我旧时第三共和国护照上。

source_text(原文): A place of peace and healing near the Cornish village of [[Brancrug]]. One of the seven great libraries of the [[Watchman's Tree]].
translation_zh(译文): 康沃尔郡[[布兰库格]]村附近的一处平和疗愈之所。[[守夜人之树]]的七座伟大图书馆之一。

source_text(原文): The touch of [[Corona]] reliably destroys individuals, but it can be safely (or 'safely') manifested through a corporation with suitably sacred founding documents, whose officers and representatives are visibly exalted. The United States are now, in some senses, the Incorporate States.
translation_zh(译文): [[冕]]的触碰必然摧毁个体，但可以经由一家拥有恰当神圣创始文件的法人实体安全地（或者说『安全地』）显化，其高管与代表明显受到尊崇。在某种意义上，美利坚合众国如今已是集团合众国。

source_text(原文): I saw what happened to people who passed that door. Not all of them. But enough of them. So I never really made the attempt.
translation_zh(译文): 我见过穿过那扇门的人会怎样。不是所有人。但足够多的人。所以，我从未真正做出尝试。

source_text(原文): I saw what happened to people who passed that door. I'm confident it would have been different for me. But I never did answer Ghirbi's riddle.
translation_zh(译文): 我见过穿过那扇门的人会怎样。我确信换成我会不一样。但我始终没有答出吉比尔的谜语。

source_text(原文):
Mortals who've answered a dream-riddle and entered the [[Mansus]] through the [[Stag Door]]. (And returned: otherwise they probably don't count as mortal any more.)

Initiation into the ranks of the Know once allowed initiates to learn secrets that the [[Hours]] kept from most mortals. Since the wars, these secrets are often dropped carelessly in the world, like coins in roadside mud.
translation_zh(译文):
凡答对了梦中谜语、经由[[牡鹿之门]]进入[[漫宿]]的凡人。（并且回来了：否则，他们恐怕已不能算作凡人。）

获准加入知者之列，曾使入门者得以学习[[司辰]]秘不示人的秘密。战争之后，这些秘密常常被漫不经心地散落在世间，像硬币掉在路边的泥里。

source_text(原文): I briefly aspired to join the ranks of the Lantern-long, until I learnt that they devoured minds as part of their ascension.
translation_zh(译文): 我曾一度渴望加入灯之长生者的行列，直到我得知，他们飞升的一部分便是吞噬心智。

source_text(原文): I briefly aspired to join the ranks of the Forge-long. But I learnt how brutally they crushed their competition.
translation_zh(译文): 我曾一度渴望加入铸之长生者的行列。但我得知了他们碾压竞争者时有多残酷。

source_text(原文): I found something romantic in the notion of Edge-long - each a dyad of two dearest enemies, each contending eternally down the ages of the world - but I never loved or hated anyone near half enough.
translation_zh(译文): 我在刃之长生者的理念里找到某种浪漫——每一位都是一对最亲密的宿敌，成双成对，在世界诸纪元间永恒争战——但我对任何人的爱与恨，都远远到不了那份程度的一半。

source_text(原文):
"Hours don't dream. Long try not to."

Mortals who gained immortality through devotion to a [[Principle]], in service to an [[Hour]], are called Long. Most were formerly counted among the [[Know]]. Possibly some were never mortal.

Few remain. Those with dead or [[Uncounted]] patron [[Hours]] are now '[[remortals]]'.
translation_zh(译文):
「司辰不做梦。长生者努力不做。」

因信奉某项[[准则]]、侍奉某位[[司辰]]而获得永生的凡人，被称为长生者。他们大多曾被视为[[知者]]之列。也许有些从来就不是凡人。

如今所剩无几。那些庇护[[司辰]]已死或被[[除名]]的，如今是『[[长生者]]』。

source_text(原文): The wonderful radiance we call the [[Glory]].
translation_zh(译文): 我们称之为[[辉光]]的奇妙光辉。
我们称之为[[虚无]]的迷人恐惧。

source_text(原文): The lovely chaos we call the [[Wood]].
translation_zh(译文): 我们称之为[[木材]]的可爱混沌。

source_text(原文):
The 'house without walls', the 'house behind the world', which has always (always?) been the dwelling-place of most of the [[Hours]] (and the [[Names]], many inhuman spirits, and some among the Dead): accessible in dreams to sufficiently knowledgeable mortals, and to very unlucky ones. It is not as it was.

When I think of the Mansus, I think first of...
translation_zh(译文):
『无墙之屋』，『世界背后的屋宅』，大多数[[司辰]]（以及[[尊名]]、许多非人的灵体，还有一些亡者）一直（一直？）栖居于此：足够博识的凡人在梦中可以抵达，非常不幸的凡人也可以。它已不复旧观。

想到漫宿，我首先想到的是……

source_text(原文):
"When the Sun-in-Splendour was divided, its Names fractured too." 

The Names of the [[Hours]], are their major servants, or aspects, or emanations. Some, perhaps all, Names were previously [[Long]].

[[Mansus]]-spirits often like to tell gullible mortals they're Names. Who's going to quibble?
translation_zh(译文):
「当骄阳被分割，它的尊名也随之碎裂。」

[[司辰]]的尊名，是它们主要的仆从、面向或流溢。有些尊名——也许全部——先前都是[[长生者]]。

[[漫宿]]的灵体常常喜欢对轻信的凡人自称尊名。谁会去计较呢？

source_text(原文): My Outfits protect me. Not from a bullet, but from subtler dangers. Like embarrassment, or possession.
translation_zh(译文): 我的行头保护我。不是挡住子弹，而是挡住更微妙的东西。比如窘迫，比如被占据。

source_text(原文): My Outfits exalt me and delight others.
translation_zh(译文): 我的行头使我受到尊崇，也取悦他人。

source_text(原文): I change my clothes less frequently than I change my skin, more frequently than I change my mind.
translation_zh(译文): 我换衣服不如换皮勤快，但比换主意勤快。

source_text(原文):
Spencer Hobson, once called 'the best-dressed man in the Suppression Bureau', prefers clothes tailored for him personally, not garments haphazardly collected from cupboards. Have new Outfits made at tailors and sent on to you - or relocate items from your past.

Outfits have Aspects which suit them for the right climate, or which provoke positive and negative reactions from NPCs. Don't wear a Light outfit in the snow. Don't wear a Raffish outfit to speak to a Ministry commissar. And don't wear your dressing-gown to breakfast.

Most Oufits also provide small bonuses to [[Skills]]. Unlike bonuses from active items, Outfit bonuses are additive - they always apply on top of other bonuses.

Spencer can (or, perhaps. will) only change his Outfit in Wardrobe Areas - places where he can disrobe discreetly, and might keep a change of clothes. Any room where he sleeps will count.
translation_zh(译文):
斯宾塞·霍布森，曾被称作『防剿局衣着最讲究的男人』，只穿为他量身定做的衣服，而不是随手从衣橱里攒来的衣裳。让裁缝为你做新行头送来——或者从你的过去里寻回旧物。

行头带有性相，有的适合特定气候，有的会激起 NPC 好或坏的反应。别在雪地里穿轻便行头。别穿着花哨浪荡的行头去见联盟的政委。也别穿着睡袍吃早饭。

大多数行头还会为[[技艺]]提供小幅加成。与已激活物品的加成不同，行头的加成是叠加的——它们总是与其他加成累加生效。

斯宾塞只能（或者说，也许，将会）在更衣区域更换行头——那些他可以谨慎地宽衣、或许会放一身替换衣服的地方。任何他睡觉的房间都算。

source_text(原文):
Driving qualities that help you decide your goals. You start with one - you can develop another two.

Increase your Passions with [[Experiences]], and they'll add more pips to your [[Aspect Pool]]. Whenever you act with a Passion, it'll refresh a pip of every relevant [[Aspect]] in your Pool. To put it simply: increasing your Passions, and acting with them, helps you pass checks on skills which match the Passion.

But people change. That's called character development; trauma; disillusionment; experience.

So if your actions recently have drifted another way, you can spend your [[Experiences]] to evolve one Passion into another when you level it up.
translation_zh(译文):
驱动你决定目标的特质。你起初有一种——还可以再养成两种。

用[[经验]]提升你的[[激情]]，它们会为你的[[性相池]]增添更多点数。每当你顺应一项激情行事，它便会为你池中每一项相关的[[性相]]补充一点。简单来说：提升你的激情并顺应它们行事，有助于你通过与之相符的技艺检定。

但人是会变的。那叫作性格成长；创伤；幻灭；阅历。

所以，如果你近来的行事已偏向另一条路，你可以在升级时花费[[经验]]，把一项激情转化为另一项。

source_text(原文): The most fundamental elements of reality; or, the various natures of the [[Hours]]; or, words tumbled in [[Eternity]]'s echoes; or, abstruse occult categories obsessively argued over by obsessives.
translation_zh(译文): 现实最根本的元素；或者，[[司辰]]的种种本性；或者，在[[永恒]]的余响中翻滚的词句；或者，被痴迷者痴迷争论的晦涩秘学范畴。

source_text(原文): [[Long]] whose patrons are dead or [[Uncounted]]. Their strength ebbs. Old age waits for them, if death doesn't find them first.
translation_zh(译文): 庇护[[司辰]]已死或被[[除名]]的[[长生者]]。他们的力量正在衰退。即便死亡不先找上他们，衰老也在等着他们。

source_text(原文): Serena [[Blackwood]], who was Librarian of [[Hush House]] in the days when I served as priest in [[Brancrug]], but Librarian these many years at the [[Invisible Serapeum]]. She helped return me to the world.
translation_zh(译文): 塞蕾娜·[[布莱克伍德]]，我在[[布兰库格]]任司祭时她是[[噤声居屋]]的馆员，而这许多年来一直担任[[隐形的塞拉皮雍]]的馆员。她帮助我回到了人世。

source_text(原文):
A Sign is an unusual right, condition, wound, or nature that adds pips to your [[Aspect Pool]], and perhaps has other effects.

You begin with one Sign. Hollowed out as you are, you have room for more.

It's useful to have a [[Passion]] whose [[Aspects]] matches a Sign - then acting with the [[Passion]] will refresh the Sign pips as well.
translation_zh(译文):
印记是一种异样的权柄、境况、创伤或天性，为你的[[性相池]]增添点数，或许还有其他效力。

你起初拥有一个印记。你已被掏空，正因如此，你还有容纳更多的余地。

让一项[[激情]]拥有与印记相符的[[性相]]是很有用的——这样顺应[[激情]]行事，也会补充印记的点数。

source_text(原文): 'One has no talent. I have no talent. It's just a question of working, of being willing to put in the time.' - Graham Greene Every Skill is linked to three Aspects. This tells you something about the Skill and the world. It also allows you to use matching points from your [[Aspect Pool]] to get a better outcome when use of a Skill goes badly. Passing a Skill check will give you matching [[Experiences]]. Failing a Skill check gives you more experiences - but also a matching [[Trouble]]. You can improve Skills with those [[Experiences]]. A virtuous circle, though not a perfect one.
translation_zh(译文): 『人没有天赋。我没有天赋。问题只在于肯不肯下功夫、愿不愿意投入时间。』——格雷厄姆·格林 每项技艺都与三种性相相关联。这能让你了解这项技艺，也了解这个世界。它还允许你使用[[性相池]]中相符的点数，在技艺发挥不利时获得更好的结果。 通过技艺检定会给予你相符的[[经验]]。技艺检定失败则给予你更多经验——但也会带来一项相符的[[烦扰]]。 你可以用这些[[经验]]提升技艺。一个良性循环，尽管并不完美。

source_text(原文): I remember a night when Ghirbi was talkative. He spoke in his siege-engine voice of the [[histories]] he'd overheard in the waking world. I listened, until his stories tailed off again into weeping.
translation_zh(译文): 我记得一个夜晚，吉比尔话很多。他用那攻城机械般的嗓音讲起他在醒时世界偷听到的[[历史]]。我听着，直到他的故事又渐渐消隐成呜咽。

source_text(原文): I remember a night when Ghirbi spoke of the Door. 'Our company it was that shattered it. Before the [[Gods-who-were-flesh]], the House was forbidden to mortals. We were the first [[Know]]. I wish that we had not. I wish I had died in the world...'
translation_zh(译文): 我记得一个夜晚，吉比尔说起那扇门。『是我们一伙人砸碎了它。在[[肉源之神]]之前，居屋对凡人是不许进入的。我们是最早的[[知者]]。我但愿我们不曾那样做。我但愿我当年就死在人间……』

source_text(原文): I remember a night when Ghirbi wept again. I scooped up his tears of molten brass in my cupped palm. In the dream, my skin peeled and blistered, but only in the dream.
translation_zh(译文): 我记得一个夜晚，吉比尔又哭了。我捧起手掌，接住他熔铜般滚烫的眼泪。在梦里，我的皮肤剥落、起泡，但只是梦里。

source_text(原文):
'A ridged barrier of blood-streaked horn, huge enough for a ship to pass. It was broken long ago, and even now the scars are not quite healed.'

The Stag Door is the Adept's Gate. To pass it is to be <link="Know">initiated</link> into the first true mystery of the <link="Mansus">House of the Sun</link>.

I used to go there, in my higher dreams, when I was younger. And then again, when I was away from the world. I got to know its guardian pretty well.
translation_zh(译文):
『一道由染血兽角构成的棱脊屏障，大得足以容一艘船通过。它早已被打碎，即便如今，那些伤疤也尚未完全愈合。』

牡鹿之门是学徒之门。通过它，便是被<link="Know">接引</link>进<link="Mansus">太阳居屋</link>的第一个真正奥秘。

我年轻时，常在更高的梦境里去那里。后来，当我离开人世的时候，又去过。我同它的守护者相当熟稔。

source_text(原文): Father Stanislav John Schaller, unorthodox but kind. I served as his assistant in the [[Great War]] when he was the Exorcist-in-Ordinary to the Dorsetshire Regiment. He recommended me to the Bishop for my skill with 'subtler work' winning me the appointment as parish priest in [[Brancrug]]. And he helped return me to the world.
translation_zh(译文): 斯坦尼斯拉夫·约翰·沙勒神父，作风不拘一格，却心地仁慈。[[大战]]期间他是[[多塞特团]]的常任驱魔司祭，我担任他的助手。他因我『更隐微的工作』之能把我举荐给主教，使我获任[[布兰库格]]的堂区司祭。他还帮助我回到了人世。

source_text(原文): The Mansion of Heaven, worshipped singly and severally as its constituent [[Hours]]. Since the War which raged among its elements, it is visibly troubled every day - by signs, by shadows, by a curling tint of blood.
translation_zh(译文): 天穹之宅邸，人们以其组成[[司辰]]分别或共同礼拜之。自从那场在其诸元素间肆虐的战争以来，它每日都显露出不安——经由征兆、阴影、一缕盘曲的血色。

source_text(原文):
An Active Item gives a [[Skill]] modifier when you have it ready to use. You can keep up to four Items Active, but the modifiers won't sum - only the best one applies. Four hammers are not more effective than one hammer.

Some items are cumbersome, dangerous, or embarrassing, and apply negative modifiers. The good news is that, because the best modifier always applies, any bonus will cancel out any number of penalties. So if an item gives an negative modifier to a [[Skill]], any positive modifier will counteract all negatives.
translation_zh(译文):
当你把一件已激活物品备好待用时，它会为[[技艺]]提供修正。你最多可保持四件物品处于激活状态，但修正不会叠加——只取最优者。四把锤子不会比一把锤子更有效。

有些物品笨重、危险或令人难堪，会带来负面修正。好消息是，由于始终只取最优修正，任何一项加成都能抵消任意数量的惩罚。所以，如果一件物品给[[技艺]]带来负面修正，任何正面修正都能抵消全部负面。
来自已激活物品的技艺修正

source_text(原文):
If you fail a [[Skill]] challenge, you can try to force a success by using any points in your Aspect Pool that match the [[Skill]] [[Aspects]].

If you've got enough, click to assign them, then Succeed.

Though sometimes you'll Concede, even if you have enough. Perhaps you're worried you won't have enough Pool points for a later challenge.
translation_zh(译文):
若你在[[技艺]]挑战中失败，你可以尝试消耗性相池中与该技艺[[性相]]相符的点数，强行换取成功。

若你的点数足够，点击分配它们，然后成功。

不过有时，即使点数足够，你也会认输。也许你担心自己留下的点数不足以应对之后的挑战。

source_text(原文): Travelling's hard, but what if I'd never gone away?
translation_zh(译文): 旅行很艰难，可要是我从未离开呢？

source_text(原文): Travelling's hard. If I'd had somewhere to call home...
translation_zh(译文): 旅行很艰难。若我有一处可以称之为家的地方……

source_text(原文): "But surely it would have been a pity not to have seen the trees along this road, really exaggerated in their beauty... —Never to have studied history in the weak calligraphy of songbirds' cages." - Elizabeth Bishop, 'Questions of Travel' Visit a travel zone - at a station - to move to a neighbouring city. Things to bear in mind: - Travelling is a good way to shed [[Traces]]. - Traces remain on the route you used, but fade as I travel further. - To cross national frontiers, I'll need travel documents. Acquiring them is an important part of progressing the story. - A few inaccessible-seeming destinations can be reached by other means.
translation_zh(译文): 「但若未曾看过这条路旁的树木， 那可真是桩憾事， 它们的美丽被夸大到过分…… ——从未在 鸣禽笼中纤弱的笔迹里研读历史。」 ——伊丽莎白·毕肖普，《旅行的问题》 前往旅行区域——在车站——即可移动到邻近城市。几点须知： - 旅行是甩掉[[痕迹]]的好办法。 - 痕迹会留存在你所走的路线之上，但随着我走得越远而逐渐淡去。 - 要跨越国境，我需要旅行证件。弄到它们，是推进故事的重要一环。 - 一些看似无法抵达的目的地，可以用别的方式到达。

source_text(原文): Departed, consumed by the [[Cross]], imprisoned, in hiding, still at war in the Sun? for one reason or another not manifesting their natures. Of course any uncounted [[Hour]] who isn't dead might return unexpectedly at any time.
translation_zh(译文): 已离去的、被[[介壳种]]吞噬的、被囚禁的、隐遁的、仍在太阳中交战的——出于这样那样的缘故，不再显化其本性。当然，任何并未死去却被除名的[[司辰]]，都可能在任何时刻出人意料地归来。

source_text(原文): Salt air and spices, cane chairs and cotton. Tram-rattle, jazz, Arabic and Italian and Greek... perhaps I'll go back some day.
translation_zh(译文): 咸腥的海风与香料，藤椅与棉花。电车哐当，爵士乐，阿拉伯语、意大利语和希腊语……也许有一天我会回去。

source_text(原文): 'Reincorporation is essentially impossible', [[Stanislav]] warned me. It was so unpleasant that I found myself wishing it was entirely impossible.
translation_zh(译文): 『[[复归]]在本质上是不可能的』，[[斯坦尼斯拉夫]]警告我。那过程难受得让我几乎盼望它彻底不可能。

source_text(原文): Perhaps I'll see them again. Though the night tells me I never will.
translation_zh(译文): 也许我还会再见到他们。尽管夜晚告诉我，再也不会了。

source_text(原文): Alexandria is where I came back to the world, thanks to [[Stanislav]] and [[Serena]] and her clever protegée - where I caught the midnight train along the coast when my heart's demands became too urgent to ignore.
translation_zh(译文): 亚历山大是我回到人世的所在——多亏[[斯坦尼斯拉夫]]、[[塞蕾娜]]和她那位聪慧的门生。我正是在那里搭上沿海岸行驶的午夜列车，当时我内心的渴求已经迫切得无法忽视。

source_text(原文): A nature that something might possess. Some Aspects are grand occult [[Principles]] like Forge or Lantern. Others are more practical qualities - an outfit might be Warm or Formal. And others touch both worlds - esoteric tools have Aspects like Quell or Entwine, which unlock new choices.
translation_zh(译文): 某种事物可能具备的天性。有些性相是宏伟的秘学[[准则]]，如铸或灯。另一些是更实际的品质——一件行头可以是温暖或正式。还有些同时触及两个世界——秘学器物带有[[镇伏]]或[[缠绕]]之类的性相，能解锁新的选项。

source_text(原文): 'It is better to be both loved and feared.'
translation_zh(译文): 『既被爱又被畏惧，才是更好的。』

source_text(原文): 'It is better to be feared than loved, if you cannot be both.'
translation_zh(译文): 『若不能两者兼得，被畏惧好过被爱。』

source_text(原文): The most significant characters that you've met appear here. Examine them to remind yourself who they are... and how glad they'll be to see you.
translation_zh(译文): 你遇见过的那些最重要的人物会出现在这里。检视他们，提醒自己他们是谁……以及见到你时他们会多么高兴。

source_text(原文): The Austrian government under Figl has more leeway in the western than the eastern zone - but it still operates under the veto of the Allied Council.
translation_zh(译文): 菲格尔领导下的奥地利政府在西部占领区比东部有更大的回旋余地——但它仍须在盟军委员会的否决权之下行事。

source_text(原文): The [[Ministries]] tread more lightly in Austria. Chancellor Figl came alive through Dachau and Malthausen, and found his way back into a coalition government. The Republic of Austria is free of the [[Enemy]], and may yet steer its own course between the greater powers. But the Stars are always watching.
translation_zh(译文): [[联盟]]在奥地利更为克制。总理菲格尔从达豪和毛特豪森生还，设法回到了联合政府之中。奥地利共和国已摆脱[[敌人]]，或许仍能在列强之间把握自己的航向。但[[群星]]始终注视着。

source_text(原文): In [[Alexandria]], I was relieved to learn that the Aviforms weathered the War in the [[Sun]] much better than most.
translation_zh(译文): 在[[亚历山大港]]，得知鸟形诸司辰在太阳中的战争中比大多数司辰过得都好，我松了一口气。

source_text(原文): My heart recalls some matter of the [[lark]] - but that's not an Aviform [[Hour]] I recognise.
translation_zh(译文): 我的心隐约记得与[[百灵鸟]]有关的一桩旧事——但那不是我认识的鸟形[[司辰]]。

source_text(原文): When I was young and foolish, I tried to find the Roost where the Aviforms exchanged their secret gossip. I'm very glad I failed.
translation_zh(译文): 我年轻时又笨又莽，曾试图找到鸟形诸司辰交换秘闻的栖木。我很庆幸自己失败了。

source_text(原文): The Aviform [[Hours]] wear the shapes of birds: twin funeral kites, laughingthrush, dove, crow. My heart would add a magpie to their number. The night would suggest a seventh.
translation_zh(译文): 鸟形[[司辰]]披着鸟的形态：孪生的葬礼鸢、笑鸫、鸽子、乌鸦。我的心会为它们再添一只喜鹊。夜晚则会提议第七位。

source_text(原文):
Zachary Wakefield. Quiet, courteous, tenacious.  In those days, he was an atheist and I was not, but he would ask me to sit with him when the storms shook Hush House in autumn. They reminded him too much of artillery-fire.

Later, we were in the Suppression Bureau together. Much later, I learnt that something had invaded him, though I learnt, too, that he kept it in check better than I ever managed.

Wakefield was never a happy man. The night often reminds me gleefully how much Wakefield and I have in common.
translation_zh(译文):
扎卡里·韦克菲尔德。沉静、有礼、坚韧。那些年月里他是无神论者，我不是，但秋天风暴撼动[[噤声居屋]]时，他会请我陪他坐着。那风暴让他想起太多炮火。

后来，我们一起在防剿局任职。再后来，我得知有什么东西侵入了他，不过我也得知，他把它压制得比我强得多。

韦克菲尔德从来不是个快活的人。夜晚常常幸灾乐祸地提醒我，韦克菲尔德与我有多少共同之处。

source_text(原文): Before I'd ever left the seminary, Christopher Illopoly had already abandoned a theology degree in Perugia, published two worryingly successful underground books on the invisible arts, and been wounded at the Battle of the Somme. He had recovered by then and was informally employed by the staff of the House. He seemed so much older and wiser, back then. We used to argue about theology, and about his ridiculous partiality with burdock tea.
translation_zh(译文): 在我离开神学院之前，克里斯托弗·伊洛波利就已经放弃了佩鲁贾的神学学位，出版了两本关于无形之术的、成功得令人担忧的地下著作，并在索姆河战役中受了伤。那时他已康复，非正式地受雇于噤声居屋的馆员们。当年他显得那么年长而睿智。我们常常争论神学，也争论他对牛蒡茶那荒唐的偏爱。

source_text(原文):
It's difficult to explain Harvey Hattington to those who haven't met him.. He claimed to have consumed the only extant copy of the Fire-Circle Tantra, with butter and garlic. He claimed to have eavesdropped on the Roost of the [[Aviform]] Hours. He would go into the kitchen garden of the House and return with what he claimed were 'transcriptions' of his chats with the bees.

The only verifiable fact about Hattington was that he'd flown with the RFC, and been decorated after he came down behind enemy lines. But he never would talk about that.
translation_zh(译文):
要向没见过哈维·哈廷顿的人解释他，是件难事。他声称自己蘸着黄油和大蒜吃掉了《[[火环密续]]》仅存的一册。他声称自己偷听过[[鸟形]]诸司辰的栖木。他会走进噤声居屋的菜园，回来时带着他所声称的、与蜜蜂交谈的『转录稿』。

关于哈廷顿唯一可核实的事实是：他曾随皇家飞行队飞行，并在坠落在敌后之后获得勋章。但他从不肯谈这件事。

source_text(原文): To him belongs what is not possessed -
translation_zh(译文): 不属于任何人的，皆归他所有——

source_text(原文): who sees what is lost; who opens the earth; to whom belongs what is not possessed. Sometimes called the Beachcomber. Of all the [[Aviform]] [[Hours]], perhaps the most straightforward in his motivations - to unearth, and sometimes to keep, what is lost . But he's also the one of whom least is known for certain. He guards his secrets carefully, as the affair of the [[Lark]] recalls. His most acquisitive [[Name]], Crooky, likes to wear even the shapes that others abandon. [[Long]] who ascend under the Beach-Crow are misers, pirates, archaologists, philatelists, who achieved their estate by thieving treasures from their predecessors. 'Daws', they've been called, and 'grubbers'.
translation_zh(译文): 它看见失落之物； 它掘开大地； 不属于任何人的，皆归它所有。 有时也被称作拾滩鸦。在所有[[鸟形]][[司辰]]中，他的动机或许最直白——掘出失落之物，有时将其据为己有。但他也是人们对他的确知最少的一位。他小心守护着自己的秘密，[[百灵鸟]]那桩旧事便是明证。他最贪得的尊名克罗基，甚至喜欢披上别人抛弃的形态。 在滩鸦之下飞升的[[长生者]]，是守财奴、海盗、考古学家、集邮家，靠窃取前辈的珍宝而成就其家业。人们称他们为『寒鸦』和『掘土者』。

source_text(原文): In the Kingdom of Belgium, Charles of Flanders serves as regent. King Leopold III , accused of cowardice, of treason, and of improper marriage, is exiled and lost behind the frozen borders of Switzerland. Charles is temperate and competent. But he's very close to the British... and he caused a stir when he took his oath before the Combined Chambers in a candle-lit hemicycle.
translation_zh(译文): 在比利时王国，佛兰德的查理摄政。[[利奥波德三世]]国王，因怯懦、叛国与不当婚姻之罪被指控，遭到放逐，消失在瑞士冰冻的边境之后。查理温和而能干。但他与英国人走得太近……而且他在烛光半圆议事厅里、在联席议会面前宣誓就职时，引起了一场轰动。

source_text(原文): Coincidences cluster wherever the invisible arts are practiced. It's unlikely that any of these facts are related.
translation_zh(译文): 凡修行隐形技艺之处,巧合总是扎堆。这些事实之间,大概并无关联。

source_text(原文): 'Serena Blackwood' surely can't be her original name. But I never asked. I didn't want to reopen any old wounds.
translation_zh(译文): 「塞蕾娜·布莱克伍德」想必不是她的本名。但我从未问过。我不愿再揭开任何旧伤。

source_text(原文): 'The Serenity of the Black [[Wood]]' is an odd allegory about the [[Vagabond]] leading travellers part-way through a wood before she abandons them. That feels relevant
translation_zh(译文): 《黑[[木材]]之静》是一则古怪的寓言:[[浪游旅人]]领着旅人穿过林中一程,然后弃他们而去。这似乎与当下有些相干。

source_text(原文):
Blackwood is the name of a renowned English writer of ghost stories; the title of a scurrilously entertaining Scottish literary magazine; and, as 'Sereno Blackwood', a widely used occult alias.

[[Serena]] Blackwood is of course also the name of a former Librarian who's been good to me.
translation_zh(译文):
布莱克伍德是一位以鬼故事闻名的英国作家的姓氏；是一本诙谐得令人莞尔的苏格兰文学杂志的刊名；而『塞蕾诺·布莱克伍德』，是一个被广泛使用的秘学化名。

当然，[[塞蕾娜]]·布莱克伍德也是那位待我很好的前馆员的名字。

source_text(原文): The miners in my congregation came filthy as worms from under the earth, but they were spotless every Sunday in church.
translation_zh(译文): 我堂区的矿工们从地底钻出来时,污秽得像蠕虫,可每逢礼拜日走进教堂,总是纤尘不染。

source_text(原文): The light in Cornwall was famous. When I saw a strange face, it was usually a painter.
translation_zh(译文): 康沃尔的光,远近闻名。每当我见到陌生的面孔,那多半是位画家。

source_text(原文): Not many young men left in Brancrug after the war.
translation_zh(译文): 战后,布兰库格已没有多少年轻男子。

source_text(原文):
Brancrug the village, and Brancrug Isle, which sits in a hollow of the Cornish coast like a pupil in an eye. [[Hush House]] stands there: a secret library, a hidden hospital, a sanctuary of peace and healing.

I was the parish priest of Brancrug for almost three years. I didn't exactly lose my faith.
translation_zh(译文):
布兰库格村,还有布兰库格岛——它栖于康沃尔海岸的一处凹湾中,如同眼中的瞳仁。[[噤声居屋]]矗立其上:一座秘藏的图书馆,一所隐没的医院,一处安宁与疗愈的庇护所。

我曾担任布兰库格的堂区牧师近三年。我也并非真的失去了信仰。

source_text(原文): I learnt a great deal that day.

translation_zh(译文): 我们付出了惨重的代价。

source_text(原文): But when at last we came back to Cambray in '19... we won.
translation_zh(译文): 但当我们在 19 年终于回到康布雷时……我们赢了。

source_text(原文): The Second Battle of Cambray, 1919. My first battle, where we almost - almost - broke through. It hung on a knife-edge. Had we broken through, the [[Great War]] might have been over a year earlier. The books will tell you the Germans rallied. But I remember what we found in the church there, and why the Dorsetshires drew back, leaving ten thousand of our own lying dead in the ashes.
translation_zh(译文): 1919 年的第二次康布雷战役。我的第一场战役,我们几乎——几乎——就要突破。胜负悬于一线。若当时突破了,[[大战]]或许能提前一年结束。史书会告诉你,德国人重整了旗鼓。但我记得我们在那里的教堂中发现了什么,也记得多塞特团为何后撤,抛下我们一万名弟兄,倒毙于灰烬之中。

source_text(原文): Says the organism with an alimentary canal. Gaugh.
translation_zh(译文): 这话出自一个长着消化道的生物之口。呕。

source_text(原文): Yes, darling. Tailed life with a ridged nervous highway down your backs. Fish, birds, lions, you. In Ys, a tail is a novelty.
translation_zh(译文): 是的,亲爱的。有尾的生命,背脊上贯着一条隆起的神经大道。鱼、鸟、狮子,还有你。在伊苏,尾巴可是新奇之物。

source_text(原文): Well, anything can be made interesting.
translation_zh(译文): 唔,任何事都能变得有趣。

source_text(原文): Not significant enough to be a Plan, not menacing enough to be a Threat: just things that have changed in the world that you might want to know about.
translation_zh(译文): 还不够格称为计划,也还不够格称为威胁:只是世上已经发生变化、而你或许想要了解的事。

source_text(原文): For centuries he strove to bring down the established order, of the world, of the [[Hours]].
translation_zh(译文): 几个世纪以来,他致力于推翻既有的秩序——世间的秩序,[[司辰]]的秩序。

source_text(原文): He was close to [[Nina Lagasse]]. She was even rumoured to have tutored him. Though they were never allies.
translation_zh(译文): 他与[[尼娜·拉加斯]]交情甚笃。甚至有传言说她曾指点过他。尽管他们从未结为盟友。

source_text(原文): Coseley valued freedom above anything: even life.
translation_zh(译文): 科斯利把自由看得比什么都重:甚至重过性命。

source_text(原文): Towards the end, he was said to have changed his views, to something less nihilistic, though no less abstruse...
translation_zh(译文): 据说临近终局时,他改变了自己的看法,转向不那么虚无的东西,尽管依旧同样晦涩……

source_text(原文): Julian Coseley - perhaps the most notorious Winter-[[long]] ever to trouble the [[Bureau]]. Winter-long cannot die before (or after) their appointed time, but Coseley was vanquished by a rising competitor, and since that time has been seen only in the strangest seasons.
translation_zh(译文): 朱利安·科斯利——恐怕是历来最叫[[防剿局]]头疼的冬之[[长生者]]。冬之长生者只能在命定时刻死去,在此之前或之后都不能;但科斯利败给了一位后起之秀,自那以后,便只会在最怪异的季节里被人看见。

source_text(原文):
It nearly went the other way. A year ago, the [[Icarians]] were in coalition with the Realists, and he nation was ready to accept reconstruction help from the Acheson Mission. But the Advisory Entity didn't like that at all, and the Icarians started their purges.

The Realists tried to fight. But Beneš, the dying Realist leader, went Crossways to restore his health; and the [[Cross]] in Prague are good [[Icarians]]. Now it's the People's Republic of Czechoslovakia in all but name.
translation_zh(译文):
事情几乎朝另一个方向去了。一年前,[[伊加利亚人]]还与现实主义者结盟,而这个国家也已准备好接受艾奇逊使团的重建援助。但顾问实体对此极为不满,伊加利亚人便开始了他们的清洗。

现实主义者试图反抗。但贝奈斯,那位垂死的现实主义者领袖,前往介壳种之路以恢复健康;而布拉格的[[介壳种]]都是忠实的[[伊加利亚人]]。如今,除名义之外,它已是捷克斯洛伐克人民共和国。

source_text(原文):
The mortal and immortal institutions, like the [[Bureau]], that from time immemorial kept the hidden world from intruding into the everyday.

All seems a bit pointless now, really.
translation_zh(译文):
那些凡人与不朽的机构,如[[防剿局]],自亘古以来守护着隐匿的世界,不让它侵入日常。

如今,这一切似乎都有点徒劳了,真的。

source_text(原文): [[Moth]] is drawn to the light; but look to the [[Cross]], children of difference, for [[History]].
translation_zh(译文): [[蛾]]为光所吸引;但若想寻得[[历史]],当看向[[介壳种]]——他们是差异之子。
终有一日,万物皆为[[辉光]]。

source_text(原文):
'O sages standing in God's holy fire 
As in the gold mosaic of a wall,
Come from the holy fire, perne in a gyre,
And be the singing-masters of my soul.'
- Yeats


How do we feel about hierarchy? About consistency? About splendour? Think about perfection. All the [[Hours]] touch Eternity, but no Hour has embraced it, because In Eternity, all [[Histories]] are flattened to a single truth, forever.
translation_zh(译文):
「啊,圣贤们,伫立于上帝的神圣之火中,
如金色壁面上的镶嵌画,
自圣火中降临,盘旋入旋涡,
做我灵魂的歌唱之师。」
——叶芝


我们如何看待层级?如何看待始终如一?如何看待辉煌?想想完美吧。所有[[司辰]]都触及永恒,却没有一位司辰拥抱过它,因为在永恒之中,一切[[历史]]都被压平为唯一的真理,直至永远。

source_text(原文): who cannot harm you; who cannot find you; who always has what you desire. The Flowermaker, born from the sparks of delight of the [[Forge of Days]], fallen like seeds into shadowed soil. The Flowermaker offered us the glittering prizes we most desired - even when our desires were concealed from us. A dead [[Hour]]; dead and buried.
translation_zh(译文): 无法伤害你者; 无法寻见你者; 始终拥有你所渴求之物者。 制花人,诞生于[[白日铸炉]]的欢愉火花,如种子般落入阴影之土。制花人曾将我们最渴望的璀璨奖品奉上——即便那些渴望,对我们自己也秘而不宣。 一位已死的[[司辰]];死去了,也埋葬了。

source_text(原文): I don't like to miss anything.

Subtle [[Footnotes]] only appear in dialogue until you've viewed them, and resolved any choices they offer you. Then they stop bothering you unless you actually search for them. This is our recommended approach. We don't want to patronise you, or badger you with information you already know. But if you're really worried about missing a Footnote, you can turn Subtle Footnotes off, and they'll always appear in dialogue no matter how many times you've viewed them.
translation_zh(译文): 含蓄[[脚注]]只会出现在对话中,直到你查看过它们,并处理了它们给出的选择。之后,它们便不再打扰你,除非你真的去找它们。这是我们推荐的做法。我们不想居高临下地对待你,也不愿拿你已知的信息烦扰你。 但如果你实在担心错过脚注,可以关掉含蓄脚注,那样它们便会一直出现在对话中,无论你已查看过多少次。

source_text(原文): who remakes with fire; who ends what will not change; who ends all nights
translation_zh(译文): 以火重塑者; 终结不变之物者; 终结所有夜晚者

source_text(原文): Poisoned by the Enemy's works, shattered by the Allies' revenges. The Western zone is under Allied military government - which for most purposes means Incorporate influence - and the Acheson Mission is closing some of the wounds in the world. But it's not a nation in the way it used to be. It's barely even a place.
translation_zh(译文): 为敌人的造物所毒,被盟友的复仇击碎。西区处于盟军军政府治下——在大多数情况下,这意味着[[集团]]的影响——而艾奇逊使团正在弥合这世上的一些伤口。但它已不是昔日意义上的国家了。它甚至几乎称不上一个地方。

source_text(原文): The Acheson Mission was launched to rebuild Europe... under a Coronal paradigm. The [[Ministries]] are having none of that. Their most recent response is to blockade Berlin. Anyone from the West trying to reach the capital - even the Allied sector - will need sympathetic intervention or a very unusual plan.
translation_zh(译文): 艾奇逊使团的成立,是为了重建欧洲……奉行冕之范式。[[联盟]]对此绝不买账。他们最近的回应,是封锁柏林。任何试图从西方抵达首都的人——哪怕是盟军管区——都需要善意的干预,或一个极不寻常的计划。

source_text(原文): The gift the Stars brought the [[Ministries]]. Something like [[Lantern]], but not.
translation_zh(译文): 群星赠予[[联盟]]的礼物。有几分像[[灯]],却又不尽相同。

source_text(原文): Those [[Hours]] who were born into the world as mortals, before they begain their long fierce rise to become the engines of [[Eternity]]'s encroachment.
translation_zh(译文): 那些以凡人之躯降生于世的[[司辰]],在开启漫长而炽烈的攀升、成为[[永恒]]侵蚀之引擎之前,曾是血肉之躯。

source_text(原文): Not quite two hundred square miles forests,不到两百平方英里——森林、山峦、一座小巧迷人的湖:奥地利人、匈牙利人、布尔根兰的克罗地亚人,还有来自边境的无法归类者,一锅杂烩。格劳斯塔克的伯爵们,在哈布斯堡鹰翼的阴影下,守着自家的法律,守着自家的邦议会。即使在二十年代共和国废除贵族之时,变革也未曾触及奥地利的这一隅。在苏联人治下,这光景不会长久,但就眼下而言,此地仍未远离 1880 年代。 而自始至终,达格玛·冯·纳格尔斯堡都在她小小的城堡里,行着小小的宫廷。当地人耸耸肩说:「伯爵夫人保养得不错」。 And through all that time, Dagmar von Nagelsburg has held tiny court in her tiny castle. 'Die Gräfin hat sich gut gehalten' the locals say shruggingly.
translation_zh(译文): 不到两百平方英里——森林、山峦、一座小巧迷人的湖:奥地利人、匈牙利人、布尔根兰的克罗地亚人,还有来自边界之地的无法归类者,一锅杂烩。格劳斯塔克的伯爵们,在哈布斯堡鹰翼的阴影下,守着自家的法律,守着自家的邦议会。即使在二十年代共和国废除贵族之时,变革也未曾触及奥地利的这一隅。在苏联人治下,这光景不会长久,但就眼下而言,此地仍未远离 1880 年代。 而自始至终,达格玛·冯·纳格尔斯堡都在她小小的城堡里,行着小小的宫廷。当地人耸耸肩说:「伯爵夫人保养得不错」。
欧洲,被砸成闹鬼的废墟……

source_text(原文): The order of the [[Hours]] had its flaws, but they upheld time, sense and symmetry...
translation_zh(译文): [[司辰]]的秩序自有其瑕疵,但他们维系着时间、意义与对称……

source_text(原文):
In 1919, the last year of the Great War, I left seminary and volunteered as a chaplain in the Dorsetshire Regiment, where [[Stanislav]] trained me as an exorcist.

The Great War; we really thought that was as bad as it would get. It took twenty years to learn how wrong we were. I'm not sorry I missed...
translation_zh(译文):
1919 年,大战的最后一年,我离开神学院,志愿加入多塞特团担任随军牧师,在那里,[[斯坦尼斯拉夫]]将我训练成一名驱魔师。

大战;我们当时真的以为,那已经是最坏的光景了。我们花了二十年,才明白自己错得有多离谱。我并不遗憾自己错过了……

source_text(原文): She surrendered her Edges to the newer [[Hours]] once. What happens now, when so many newer [[Hours]] are [[Uncounted]]?
translation_zh(译文): 她曾一度将她的刃交予更年轻的[[司辰]]。如今,那么多更年轻的[[司辰]]都已[[除名]],又会发生什么?

source_text(原文): ...or forbids it. Her purpose has always been to separate and distinguish... and so the [[Witch-and-Sister]] is her enemy.
translation_zh(译文): ……抑或禁止。她的职责从来都是分离与区分……因此,[[双生巫女]]是她的敌人。

source_text(原文): who bears two blades; who permits passage when passage is to be permitted; who waits at the threshold. No [[Hour]] is young, but the Horned-Axe is very old indeed. She's survived at least three wars in the [Sun].
translation_zh(译文): 身负双刃者; 于当放行之时放行; 守候在门槛之处。 没有哪位[[司辰]]年轻,但角斧确实年迈至极。她已在[太阳]中熬过了至少三场战争。

source_text(原文): Hungary is quiet beneath the steel blessings of the Stars. The old Republic aligns now with the paradigms of Gleam. But beneath Strigonium, a prince of the Church Solar still holds the Holy Crown. Until he's broken, not quite everything has changed.
translation_zh(译文): 在群星钢铁般的赐福之下,匈牙利一片寂静。旧共和国如今已与烁的范式同轨。但在斯特里戈尼乌姆之下,太阳教会的一位亲王仍握着圣冠。在他被粉碎之前,并非一切都已改变。

source_text(原文): "And the players were robed and their faces veiled, and the robes and veils were alike, and their names were Fate and Chance." - Lord Dunsany, Time and the Gods What's random, what's fair? If you roll a ten-sided die a hundred times and get a 1 every time, is that fair? Yes, says Chance; no, says Fate (or the other way around). You can roll a die a hundred times and get the same result every time. So Travelling doesn't use dice - it draws tokens, each numbered 1 to 10, from a bag. (Bone tokens, says one player; no, silver, says the other.) When the bag is empty, we put the tokens back in and shake the bag. There's more than one tile with each number, so you can get the same number a few times in a row. But your luck will always turn. "Then said Fate to Chance: "Let us play our old game again." And they played it again together, using the gods as pieces, as they had played it oft before. So that those things which have been shall all be again..." When you reload after a save, we always put all the tokens back in and shake it. This means, bluntly, that you can save-scum. It also means that if you keep reloading, everything will be a little more random. We might add a config switch to turn that off.
translation_zh(译文): 「棋手们身披长袍,面覆纱巾,长袍与纱巾别无二致,他们的名字,是命运与机缘。」——邓萨尼勋爵,《时间与众神》 什么是随机,什么是公平?你若把一枚十面骰掷上一百次,每次都掷出 1,这算公平吗?机缘说,公平;命运说,不(或者恰好相反)。 你确实可能连掷一百次骰子,而每次结果都一样。所以Travelling不用骰子——它从布袋里抽取筹码,每枚编号 1 至 10。(骨质筹码,一位玩家说;不,银质的,另一位说。)布袋空时,我们便把筹码放回去,摇一摇布袋。每个数字都不止一枚筹码,所以你有可能接连几次抽到同一个数字。但你的运气终会流转。 「命运于是对机缘说:『让我们再玩一次那旧日的游戏吧。』于是他们重又一同对弈,以诸神为棋子,一如从前无数次那样。于是,凡曾经存在过的事物,都将再度存在……」 每当你读取存档,我们总会把全部筹码放回去,再摇一摇。直白地说,这意味着你可以读档投机。这也意味着,如果你一直读档,一切都会变得更随机一些。我们或许会加一个配置开关,将其关闭。

source_text(原文): The Serapeum is in [[Alexandria]]. It's even harder to find than it sounds. But I managed it.
translation_zh(译文): 塞拉皮雍在[[亚历山大港]]。它比听上去还要难找。但我还是找到了。
[[塞蕾娜]][[布莱克伍德]]担任其馆长。
专精于[[铸]]之秘学与[[司辰学]]

source_text(原文): One of the seven great libraries of the [[Watchman's Tree]].
translation_zh(译文): [[守夜人之树]]的七座大图书馆之一。

source_text(原文): The newly-minted Italian Republic. The King is gone, the Julian March is lost, the Icarians were roundly defeated in this year's election. Everything is different. And this time, everything will be different.
translation_zh(译文): 新铸的意大利共和国。国王已去,尤利安边区已失,伊加利亚人在今年的选举中一败涂地。一切都不同了。而这一次,一切将会不同。

source_text(原文): The word was that he'd used secrets from the [[Aviform]] [[Hours]] in his work. That's what interested me most.
translation_zh(译文): 传闻说,他在作品中用到了[[鸟形]][[司辰]]的秘密。那正是我最感兴趣的。

source_text(原文): The word was that he'd used [[Ys]]-alloys in his work. That's what interested me most.
translation_zh(译文): 传闻说,他在作品中用到了[[伊苏]]合金。那正是我最感兴趣的。

source_text(原文): What interested me most? That a certain key component of the Lark came, at last, to [[Alexandria]], where [[Serena]] and her protegée put it to use.
translation_zh(译文): 我最感兴趣的是什么?是百灵鸟的某个关键部件,最终辗转到了[[亚历山大港]],被[[塞蕾娜]]和她的门生派上了用场。

source_text(原文): In the years before I went away, the sculptor-adept Zuthimalim Zidane built an abstract sculpture in Algiers that 'spoke with the voice of the desert lark'. He was killed for it.
translation_zh(译文): 在我离开之前的那些年里,雕刻家兼修士的祖蒂玛利姆·齐达内,在阿尔及尔建造了一座抽象雕塑,它「以沙漠百灵鸟的声音说话」。他为此丧命。

source_text(原文): The cold of the grave; the cold that comes before the dawn.
translation_zh(译文): 坟墓的寒冷;黎明之前的寒冷。
