source_text(原文): The heat of the forge; the heat that warms silver to gold.
translation_zh(译文): 锻炉的炽热;那将白银暖成黄金的炽热。

source_text(原文): who cannot be unbalanced; who quells and quiets; who comes before the Sun The [[Uncounted]] [[Hour]] who once appeared in [[Church]] iconography as the Radiant Lady, the Mater Solvens invoked when a corpse is committed to fire or earth.
translation_zh(译文): 不可撼动者; 镇伏且静默者; 先于太阳而来者 那位[[除名]]的[[司辰]],曾以辉耀圣母之姿出现在[[教会]]的图像中,当尸体交付火焰或大地之时,人们便向解缚圣母祈求。

source_text(原文): The debatable space at the edge of the waking world. One of the concerns of the [[Duties]]. Some authorities identify the Marches with the Bounds between the [[Wake]] and the [[Mansus]]. [[Legion]]
translation_zh(译文): 醒世边缘那片悬而未决的空间。[[职司]]所关切的事务之一。有权威人士认为
column4: 边境与[[醒世]]和[[漫宿]]之间的边界之地是同一处。[[军团]]

source_text(原文): The Church's version is much safer than the original. They were very clear about that in the seminary.
translation_zh(译文): 教会的版本比原版安全得多。神学院里,他们对此讲得非常明白。

source_text(原文): "What is within, without; what is without, within."
The Forge is often depicted as a mother, and the Meniscate isn't exactly that, but she carries a searing brightness in her womb.
translation_zh(译文): 铸炉常被描绘为一位母亲,而弧月并不完全如此,但她的腹中孕着灼人的光辉。

source_text(原文): from whom we do not turn; who is exposed; whose beauty is unmatched The [[Uncounted]] [[Hour]] who once appeared in [[Church]] iconography as the White Lady, the Glass Virgin that protects mothers. Sometimes described as the Sun's night-self.
translation_zh(译文): 我们不得背对者; 毫无遮掩者; 美艳无可匹敌者 那位[[除名]]的[[司辰]],曾以白衣圣母、护佑母亲的玻璃贞女之姿出现在[[教会]]的图像中。有时,她被描述为太阳的夜之身。

source_text(原文): The revolutionary [[Icarian]] workers' councils which drove the revolution in Russia have become more efficient, under the [[Gleam]]-light. The Stars accept and synthesise their decisions, beneath the avuncular and mighty gaze of Steel - the 'Advisory Entity to the Council of Ministers.' The Stars in turn pass their gifts to the Ministries, who enact those decisions. What could be better?
translation_zh(译文): 当年推动俄国革命的革命性[[伊加利亚]]工人委员会,在[[烁]]的照耀下变得愈发高效。群星在钢铁——「部长会议顾问实体」——亲切而威严的注视之下,接受并综合它们的决定。群星再将馈赠转交联盟,由联盟来执行那些决定。还能有比这更好的吗?

source_text(原文): Where there's rubble, there'll be steel; where there's shards of glass, there'll be mirrors. What's old is lost, what's new is coming. The Kingdom of the Netherlands is getting to work.
translation_zh(译文): 哪里有瓦砾,哪里就会有钢铁;哪里有碎玻璃,哪里就会有镜子。旧的已经逝去,新的正在到来。荷兰王国开始忙碌起来。

source_text(原文): A chilly soul. But she has no reputation for cruelty, either.
translation_zh(译文): 一个冷淡的灵魂。但她也并无残暴之名。

source_text(原文): Nina is always careful. It's how she survived this long.
translation_zh(译文): 尼娜总是谨慎。她能活到今天,靠的就是这个。
她总是让人印象深刻,那位拉加斯。

source_text(原文): Actress, artist, witch... Nina casts a long shadow. Every adept on the Continent knows her name. From the moment I woke in [[Alexandria]], my heart clamoured for me to find her. It would take me a while to understand why.
translation_zh(译文): 演员、艺术家、女巫……尼娜投下长长的影子。欧洲大陆上每一位修士都听过她的名字。自我在[[亚历山大港]]醒来的那一刻起,我的心便叫嚣着要我去寻她。我要过上一阵子,才会明白其中缘由。

source_text(原文): The [[Church]] calls it Hell, and won't speak of it. Adepts call it Nowhere, and won't speak of it where they can be heard. It is lit by lamps of black nephrite. It is where the Dead go, in the end. [[Worms]], and the worst [[Hours]], were found there, but now they're found in other places too.
translation_zh(译文): [[教会]]称之为地狱,而不愿谈及。修士们称之为虚无,也不愿在有人听得见的地方谈及。那里以黑色软玉之灯照明。那是亡者最终的去处。[[蠕虫]]与最恶劣的[[司辰]]曾在那里被发现,但如今,它们也在别处现身了。

source_text(原文): I'm a wanderer, not a pilgrim.
translation_zh(译文): 我是个漫游者,不是巡礼者。

source_text(原文): When I was last in the world, half the occult demimonde believed the [[Vagabond]] would soon rise in Pilgrimage to the [[Glory]]... but I knew well enough not to get involved.
translation_zh(译文): 我上一次在世时,隐秘的地下世界有半数人都相信,[[浪游旅人]]即将起身,踏上前往[[辉光]]的巡礼……但我心里清楚,不该卷进去。

source_text(原文): What you hope to achieve, and what your next steps are to achieve it. A guide to where to go and what to do.
translation_zh(译文): 你希望达成什么,以及为达成它而采取的下一步。一处指引——该去哪里,该做什么。

source_text(原文): Only the approved candidates get to stand in elections. The larger cities have Star-shards inset now. The Red Army is here on the ground, protecting supply lines to Germany and enforcing their order. But not everything is going the [[Ministries]]' way. There's a factional battle between the home-grown [[Icarians]] and the Advisory Entity's people. The Nest tendency of the [[Cross]] - feral and uncompromising - has manifested across the south. And the cursed soldiers in the forests have recovered a bloody Oath from the earth.
translation_zh(译文): 只有获得认可的候选人才能参选。大城市如今都镶入了星之碎片。红军驻扎在此,保护通往德国的补给线,维持他们的秩序。但并非一切都顺着[[联盟]]的心意。本土的[[伊加利亚人]]与顾问实体的人之间,正打着一场派系之战。[[介壳种]]的「巢」派倾向——野性而毫不妥协——已在南方各处显现。而森林里受诅咒的士兵们,从泥土中掘回了一份染血的誓言。

source_text(原文): In this place, at this time, if you fill the slots with the necessary ingredients, you can obtain something useful. Some ingredients are consumed - some just serve as catalysts. Look closely at  ingredient slots to learn more.
translation_zh(译文): 在此地,在此刻,若你用必要的原料填满槽位,便能得到某种有用的东西。有些原料会被消耗——有些只是充当催化剂。仔细看看原料槽位,了解更多。

source_text(原文): The Romanian People's Republic is an Icarian state... but there are no Star-fragments here. Though King Michael is gone, the other Michael, the Messenger who writes in invisible blood, the dead-guide for whom candles are lit - that Michael is seen every day in Cluj, in paintings, mirrors, chalk. A power walks that has nothing to do with Gleam.
translation_zh(译文): 罗马尼亚人民共和国是一个伊加利亚国家……但这里没有星之碎片。虽然米哈伊国王已经不在了,但另一位米哈伊——那位以隐形之血书写的信使,那位人们为他点烛的引魂者——这位米哈伊每天都在克卢日现身:在画作里,在镜子里,在粉笔痕迹里。有一股与烁毫无干系的权能,正在行走。

source_text(原文): A greeting and a parting in the tongue of Lagash; and the name of a spirit.
translation_zh(译文): 拉格什之语中的一声问候,与一声道别;也是一位灵的名字。

source_text(原文): Who are not as they were?
who are pearl who cannot be touched who cannot be separated An [[Aviform]] [[Hour]] bringing together what must be together. Sometimes, trusted. The enemy of division and separation.
translation_zh(译文): 身为珍珠者; 不可触碰者; 不可分离者 一位[[鸟形]][[司辰]],将必须同在之物聚合一处。有时,也受人信赖。是分裂与分离之敌。

source_text(原文):
Sleep cures [[Troubles]] - and is only possible when Spencer has at least one Trouble.

[[Pain]] becomes [[Weariness]].

Weariness fades.

[[Dread]], and [[Fascination]], cancel each other out. Any leftover Dread or Fascination will fade... but may cause dreams in the process.

[[Traces]] are the exception. Traces don't allow Sleep, and aren't cured by Sleep - in fact, Sleeping in the same place for more than one night creates a Trace.
translation_zh(译文):
睡眠能治愈[[烦扰]]——而且只有斯宾塞至少带着一项烦扰时,才有可能入睡。

[[痛苦]]化为[[倦怠]]。

倦怠会渐渐消退。

[[恐惧]]与[[入迷]]会相互抵消。残留的恐惧或入迷会慢慢消退……但过程中可能引发梦境。

[[痕迹]]是例外。痕迹不容入睡,也不为睡眠所愈——事实上,在同一处睡过不止一夜,便会留下一道痕迹。

source_text(原文):
"One, Great, and Free." The Caudillo in Madrid has made good on the first boast, but the other two are nowhere within reach. Still, things may be looking up for this kingless kingdom. The Darlan regime in the French [[State]] has opened the border again. The [[Incorporates]] are ready to overlook old sins in the fight against [[Icarianism]]. The  frost begins to thaw.

Spain stayed out of the Wars - it has less need of [[Gleam]] or [[Corona]] - and there is something else here - a high host that visits select doors in the deep night. The scent of burning wax goes before it.
translation_zh(译文):
「统一、伟大、自由。」马德里的考迪罗兑现了第一句豪言,但另外两句依旧遥不可及。不过,这个没有国王的王国,境况或许正在好转。法兰西[[邦国]]的达尔朗政权重新开放了边境。[[集团]]在对抗[[伊加利亚主义]]的战争中,愿意宽恕旧日的罪愆。霜冻开始消融。

西班牙置身于战争之外——它对[[烁]]或[[冕]]的需求较少——而这里还有别的什么:一支高贵的行列,在深夜里造访特定的门扉。燃烧的蜡香先它而至。

source_text(原文): ... again and again over the years. The isle remained a place of healing and learning.
translation_zh(译文): ……这些年来,一次又一次。这座岛始终是疗愈与学问之地。

source_text(原文): A wealthy mediaeval centre of learning, but a surprisingly obscure one - despite its notorious 'vivid book', its prophets and healers in exile, its Twin-visions, its allegedly poisonous nuns - right up until its dissolution. [[Hush House]] now occupies the old Abbey's site.
translation_zh(译文): 一座富庶的中世纪学问中心,却出奇地籍籍无名——尽管有那本声名狼藉的「鲜活之书」、流亡在外的先知与医者、它的双生幻象、据说身怀剧毒的修女们——直到它被解散为止。[[噤声居屋]]如今便占据了这座旧修道院的所在。

source_text(原文): which burns still; which is distant; which is not as it was.. The chilliest constituent of the [[Sun]]. The Sun-in-Rags, descending towards its final sunset, offered us its beautiful ending. Sometimes, as it did in the beginning, it would accept a very little of our blood. A dead [[Hour]]; dead and buried.
translation_zh(译文): 仍在燃烧者; 已然遥远者; 不复旧日模样者.. [[太阳]]最寒冷的部分。残阳,正坠向它最后的日落,将美丽的结局奉予我们。有时,一如最初那样,它会接受我们少许的鲜血。 一位已死的[[司辰]];死去了,也埋葬了。

source_text(原文): Is Trieste Italian, or Yugoslavian? The Free Territory is a temporary answer to that question, but it's proving less temporary than anyone wanted, The Ministries and the Incorporates can't agree on a governor. Stamps are printed in two languages. The unhappy compromise continues, but at least no-one's shooting.
translation_zh(译文): 的里雅斯特是意大利的,还是南斯拉夫的?自由区是对这个问题的一个临时回答,但它正被证明,比任何人所希望的都要持久。[[联盟]]与[[集团]]无法就总督人选达成一致。邮票用两种语言印制。这场不愉快的妥协仍在继续,但至少,没有人开枪。

source_text(原文):
If you lose control of your mind or soul; if your body betrays you; if a worldly power imprisons or executes you - if these things happen, the game will end.

The Threats section shows what you need to worry about, and how much you need to worry.
translation_zh(译文):
若你失去对心智或灵魂的掌控;若你的身体背叛你;若世间的权柄将你囚禁或处决——倘若这些事发生,游戏便会结束。

威胁栏目会告诉你,你需要担心什么,又需要担心到什么程度。

source_text(原文): who demands the dance; who cannot be stilled; who is beaten, like a drum. The Thunderskin, the Heart Relentless, the Vigilant Storm, which beat and was beaten to preserve the skin of the world. The mortal who loved the goddess; the flayed god sacrificed by its lover to itself. Without his ceaseless efforts, how long could the world have turned untorn? A dead [[Hour]]; dead and buried.
translation_zh(译文): 要求舞蹈者; 无法止息者; 被敲打者,如一面鼓。 轰雷之皮,不倦之心,警醒的风暴——为守护世界的皮膜而击打,亦被击打。那位爱上女神的凡人;那位被爱人剥去皮、由爱人献祭于己身的神。若没有他永不停歇的劳作,这世界又能完好地转动多久? 一位已死的[[司辰]];死去了,也埋葬了。

source_text(原文): Items in the Troubles section of your Inventory are intangible things that you probably don't want: [[Weariness]], [[Pain]], [[Dread]], [[Fascination]], or [[Traces]]. There are ways to remove any Trouble, and occasionally they can be useful.
translation_zh(译文): 你行囊里「烦扰」栏目下的条目,是些你多半不想要的无形之物:[[倦怠]]、[[痛苦]]、[[恐惧]]、[[入迷]],或[[痕迹]]。每种烦扰都有去除之法,而它们偶尔也能派上用场。

source_text(原文): It might be relevant. You never know.
translation_zh(译文): 它也许真有关联。谁也说不准。

source_text(原文): Everything will be forgotten. Ubu too.
translation_zh(译文): 一切都会被遗忘。乌布也一样。

source_text(原文):
Picasso's friend, Michel Sima, rescued a wounded owl during a trip to the Château Grimaldi, and Picasso adopted it. His lover Françoise Gilot would feed Ubu with mice that she trapped in the studio, but it never took to her. It took to Picasso, eventually, to the extent that it usually stopped biting him. 

Ubu served as a model in Picasso's paintings as war; as peace; as wisdom; perhaps as a model for a conjectured seventh [[Aviform]] [[Hour]]. But none of this is likely ever to be relevant.
translation_zh(译文):
毕加索的朋友米歇尔·西马在格里马尔迪城堡之行中救下一只受伤的猫头鹰，毕加索收养了它。他的情人弗朗索瓦丝·吉洛常用她在画室里捉到的老鼠喂乌布，可乌布始终不肯亲近她。它最终亲近了毕加索，以至于通常不再咬他。

乌布曾在毕加索的画作中充当模特：化作战争；化作和平；化作智慧；或许也是一位被推想出的第七位[[鸟形]][[司辰]]的模特。不过这些事，多半永远不会与任何事相干。

source_text(原文):
The New King gave his life at Caen in battle against the [[Enemy]] - as no Englishman will fail to remind you - but the Plantagenet line continues under Queen Alexandra.

The New King's golden age is gone with the Wars, but so is the febrile air that attended it. In the new quiet, there is the sense of waking from an eager dream. But Parliament still meets by candle-light.
translation_zh(译文):
新王在卡昂与[[敌人]]作战时殒命——这一点，不会有哪个英格兰人忘了提醒你——不过金雀花的血脉在亚历山德拉女王治下延续至今。

新王的黄金时代已随战争而去，随之而去的还有伴随它的那股亢奋气息。在新生的静谧中，有种从热切梦境里醒来的感觉。但议会仍在烛光下议事。

source_text(原文): She tells her tale to the willing and the unwilling -
translation_zh(译文): 她向甘愿者与不甘愿者讲述她的故事——

source_text(原文): Did she carry her artificial eye upwards, to the [[Glory]]?
translation_zh(译文): 她是否把那只义眼携向高处，送往[[辉光]]？

source_text(原文): who cannot be exhausted who cannot be stayed who tells her story to the willing and the unwilling The one [[Hour]] who was excluded from the [[Mansus]] - though before the war, many adepts expected to follow her there as one of seven [[Pilgrims]], and rise above. One of the [[Aviform]] Hours - she took the shape of a laughingthrush. [[Uncounted]] now. Perhaps.
translation_zh(译文): 不可被耗尽 不可被留住 向甘愿者与不甘愿者讲述她的故事 她是唯一一位被逐出[[漫宿]]的[[司辰]]——尽管战前，许多修士曾期望化作七位[[巡礼者]]之一随她而入，并超升其上。她是[[鸟形]]司辰之一——化作一只笑鸫的模样。如今已[[除名]]。也许。

source_text(原文): I favour the Bright Arts: so that's Holy Places above all, but sometimes also Quiet Places, Thresholds and Hearths.
translation_zh(译文): 我偏好光之技艺：因此以圣地为先，但也时常用到静谧之处、门阈与炉畔。

source_text(原文): I favour the Night Arts: so that's Wounds and Shadowed Places first, but sometimes also Quiet Places and Thresholds.
translation_zh(译文): 我偏好夜之技艺：因此以伤处与阴影之地为先，但也时常用到静谧之处与门阈。

source_text(原文): I favour the Arts Unconsidered - so that's Verdant Places above all, but also sometimes Shadowed Places, Hearths and Thresholds.
translation_zh(译文): 我偏好未识技艺：因此以翠绿之地为首，但也时常用到阴影之地、炉畔与门阈。

source_text(原文): Venues are hallowed, sinister, powerful or convenient locations where you can craft occult tools. Only a few Unworldly [[Skills]] can be used at each Venue - you'll quickly learn which Venues are most useful to you.
translation_zh(译文): 场所是神圣、凶险、强力或便捷的所在，你可以在其中炼制秘术器物。每处场所只能使用少数非尘世[[技艺]]——你很快会明白哪些场所对你最有用。

source_text(原文): If it exists, and if you can see it while you're not asleep, then you're in the Wake.
translation_zh(译文): 倘若它确实存在，而你在未入睡时也能看见它，那你便身在醒世。

source_text(原文): who navigates;,他引航； 他照明； 他无悲悯。 他本是[[除名]]的[[司辰]]，曾为甘愿者与不甘愿者照亮前路。他一度被称为「瞳中之门」。「看哪，我站在门外；虽不叩门，却正是在此，我方可被听见。」 who illuminates; who is not compassionate The [[Uncounted]] [[Hour]] who once lit the way for the willing and unwilling. He has been called the Door in the Eye. "Behold, I stand at the door, and though I do not knock, it is here I may be heard."
translation_zh(译文): 他引航； 他照明； 他无悲悯。 他本是[[除名]]的[[司辰]]，曾为甘愿者与不甘愿者照亮前路。他一度被称为「瞳中之门」。「看哪，我站在门前；虽不叩门，却正是在此，我方可被听见。」

source_text(原文): The name given to seven great libraries of the hidden world, where the [[Church]] and the [[Duties]] tolerate otherwise forbidden knowledge. Perhaps the result of an arrangement with the [[Watchman]], though that sounds unlike him.
translation_zh(译文): 这是隐世七座伟大图书馆共用的名号，在那里，[[教会]]与[[职司]]容忍着本应被禁的知识。或许是某次与[[守夜人]]达成安排的产物——尽管这听起来不像他的作风。

source_text(原文): 'Dreamers and the Dead pass the White Door, but they must abandon their shapt, that part of the soul which speaks - like a key in the door, or a sword outside a king's hall.' The White Door is the lowest point of access to the [[Mansus]]. When I was young, even uninitiated dreamers might visit it by accident. It is much too dangerous for that now.
translation_zh(译文): 「梦者与亡者皆可穿过白门，但他们必须舍弃自己的声魂——灵魂中会言语的那一部分——如同插在门上的钥匙，又如留在王殿门外的利剑。」 白门是通往[[漫宿]]的最低入口。我年轻时，连未经启蒙的梦者也可能在无意间造访那里。如今那已太过危险。

source_text(原文): who cannot be separated who cannot be touched who are pearl [[Aviform]] [[Hour]] uniting what is at rest. Born from two wombs. The enemy of disjunction and distinction.
translation_zh(译文): 不可被分开 不可被触及 她们是珍珠 [[鸟形]][[司辰]]，使安息者合而为一。生于两具子宫。是分离与区分之敌。

source_text(原文): When was there a time with neither agony nor rage?
translation_zh(译文): 可曾有哪个时代，既无剧痛亦无狂怒？

source_text(原文): It never sat right to me, giving teeth to the Sun.
translation_zh(译文): 给太阳装上利齿，我始终觉得不对劲。

source_text(原文): I've always wondered about a connection with the wolf-headed traveller-saint, Christopher Lycocephalus. He always seems likeable in the stories.
translation_zh(译文): 我一直琢磨着他与那位狼首的行旅圣徒克里斯托弗·吕科克法洛斯之间是否有所关联。故事里的他总是显得和善可亲。

source_text(原文): he unmaketh; he unmaketh; he unmaketh. When the [[Sun]] died, the [[Hour]] called Wolf Divided was born, in agony, to rage. But the Sun has not died only once; he's risen many times. When did the Wolf Divided come into the world? Any answer is a tangle of heresies. In worse times, you could be put to the question for naming a year. Even today, this is one of the fiercest differences between the Received and Sanctioned versions of the Book of Suns.
translation_zh(译文): 他拆解； 他拆解； 他拆解。 [[太阳]]死时，名为裂分之狼的[[司辰]]在剧痛与狂怒中降生。但太阳并非只死过一次；他已复活了许多回。裂分之狼究竟是何时降临此世的？ 任何回答都是一团异端乱麻。在更糟的年代，你哪怕只说一个年份，都可能被拖去受刑。即便今日，这也是《太阳之书》通行本与钦定本之间最激烈的分歧之一。

source_text(原文): The Wood has always been the place of [[Moth]] and his allied [[Hours]]. It doesn't have to make sense.
translation_zh(译文): 木材之地向来是[[蛾]]与其同盟[[司辰]]的领域。它不必讲得通。

source_text(原文): The relationship between the Wood and the Mansus isn't something anyone can express directly.
translation_zh(译文): 木材与漫宿之间的关系，没有人能够直陈。

source_text(原文):
'The Wood lies outside the walls of the [[Mansus]]. As any student of Histories knows, the Mansus has no walls.'

Christopher said that - Christopher Illopoly. He was always a little glib. But it does capture something about the Wood.
translation_zh(译文):
「木材位于[[漫宿]]的墙垣之外。凡研习历史者皆知，漫宿并无墙垣。」

这话是克里斯托弗说的——克里斯托弗·伊洛波利。他向来有几分油滑。不过，这话确实抓住了木材的某种特质。

source_text(原文): Worldly skills are essential in conversation, dealing with people and real situations. They don't need preparation.
translation_zh(译文): 世俗技艺在交谈、与人周旋和应对现实情境时不可或缺。它们无需预备。

source_text(原文): The Ysiens were not kind to me, but its amber-shining cobbles, its coral canals, its ice-temples - they have no equal anywhere this side of the wave.
translation_zh(译文): 伊苏人待我并不和善，但那里琥珀泛光的卵石街、珊瑚色的运河、冰砌的庙宇——浪的这一边，天下无可与之相比。

source_text(原文): Even after they drew the [[Worms]] from my soul-complexus, they kept me caged. But I am very difficult to cage.
translation_zh(译文): 即便他们从我的魂丛中抽出[[蠕虫]]，他们仍把我关在笼中。可我这样的人，很难被关得住。

source_text(原文): They invoked the [[Witch-and-Sister]] to help in drawing the [[Worms]] from me. Which is still strange. The Witch unites, not divides.
translation_zh(译文): 他们曾祈请[[双生巫女]]相助，把[[蠕虫]]从我体内抽出。这至今仍让我费解。女巫主合，不主分。

source_text(原文): No living man may come to Ys. So when I passed through [[Brancrug]] the final time, when I left the world behind... I drowned. Symbolically. Perhaps more than that.
translation_zh(译文): 活人无法抵达伊苏。因此，当我最后一次穿过[[布兰库格]]、将尘世抛在身后时……我淹死了。象征意义上的。也许不止于此。
文森特不在疗养院当值
制作次级未识技艺器物
制作次级光之技艺器物
制作次级夜之技艺器物

source_text(原文):
A SPINE-CHILLING tale of a RENEGADE PRIEST whose KNIFE IS THIRSTY FOR INNOCENT BLOOD.

I wrote this under the name 'Meredith Lux', but here is it under the name 'Spencer Hobson'. Spine-chilling is right. It's painful even to look at the cover. But at least as long as I have it, there's one fewer copy in circulation.
translation_zh(译文):
一个令人脊背发凉的恐怖故事：一位背教神父，他的刀渴望无辜者的鲜血。

这本书是我用「梅雷迪斯·勒克斯」这个笔名写的，可如今它却署着「斯宾塞·霍布森」的名字。脊背发凉，一点没错。光是看封面都令人难受。不过，只要这本书还在我手里，市面上就少一本流传。

source_text(原文): An unwise play I wrote in London in the twenties. That was the first time I ever ran across the [[Bureau]]. They shut down the production on opening night and pulped every copy.... or, it turns out, almost every copy.
translation_zh(译文): 二十年代我在伦敦写的一部不智之作。那是我头一回遇上[[防剿局]]。他们首演之夜就叫停了演出，把每一册存本都化成了纸浆……或者说，如后来所见的，几乎每一册。

source_text(原文): A leaflet printed in dramatic white text on black background, showing the upcoming route of a travelling carnival.
translation_zh(译文): 一张传单，黑底白字，印得醒目张扬，展示着一个巡游嘉年华接下来的行程路线。

source_text(原文): A State-sanctioned daily paper. The masthead: a wheat-sheaf gethered around the francisque axe of the state.
translation_zh(译文): 一份获邦国认可的日报。报头图案：一束麦捆环绕着邦国的那柄法兰西之斧。

source_text(原文): This envelope is heavily creased: I stuffed it down behind the seat cushion to ensure its contents weren't stolen while I napped.
translation_zh(译文): 这信封皱得厉害：我把它塞进座垫底下，免得打盹时里面的东西被人偷走。

source_text(原文): 'Spencer Hobson: multiple entries Italian Republic, Free Territory of Trieste'. A single sheet of paper, enlivened with the flaming-sword stamp of Supreme Headquarters Allied Expeditionary Force.
translation_zh(译文): 「斯宾塞·霍布森：可多次入境意大利共和国、的里雅斯特自由区」。一张单页纸，加盖着盟军远征军最高司令部的火剑印章，显得神气活现。
AMG 旅行通行证：意大利

source_text(原文): A permit for Sylvain Huissier to pass through the Allied zones of occupation in Germany, supposedly issues by the Commandement en chef français en Allemagne at Baden-Baden. A reasonably convincing forgery.
translation_zh(译文): 一张准许西尔万·韦西耶通行德国各盟军占领区的通行证，据称由巴登-巴登的法国驻德占领军总司令部签发。算得上相当足以乱真的赝品。

source_text(原文): CCFA Travel Permit: Germany, Allied Zone (Counterfeit)
translation_zh(译文): CCFA 旅行通行证：德国，盟军占领区（伪造）

source_text(原文): A cramped page of Cyrillic text and overlaid stamps, all in aniline purple of many shades from faded to fresh, and headed with a single silver Star. Most of the text is legible with careful attention to detail, but one layer artfully obscures the next, so that it's almost impossible to trace the detail back to the beginning.
translation_zh(译文): 一页挤满西里尔字母文字、叠满层层印章的纸，一律是深浅不一的苯胺紫，从褪色到簇新，页首以一颗银星为冠。用心细看，大部分文字尚可辨认，但一层巧妙地掩着下一层，几乎不可能将细节一路回溯到源头。
联盟签证（足以乱真的赝品）

source_text(原文): VSTUPNÍ VÍZUM. An official signature on an official stamp adorned by the two-tailed lion of Bohemia. Czechoslovakia is not yet, not quite, not quite yet, a People's Republic.
translation_zh(译文): 入境签证。一枚官方印章上落着官方签名，印章饰以波希米亚的双尾狮。捷克斯洛伐克尚未、还算不上、还远远算不上人民共和国。

source_text(原文): Officially known as the 'Identity Card No. 2', issued by tha Allied Council for movement across the four occupation zones in Austria.
translation_zh(译文): 正式名称为「第二号身份证」，由盟国对奥委员会签发，供人通行奥地利境内的四个占领区。

source_text(原文): BEUTAZÁSI VÍZUM. The aniline-ink stamp is still headed with St Stephen's Crown - no Stars yet.
translation_zh(译文): 入境签证。苯胺墨的印章页首仍是圣斯蒂芬之冠——还没有星。

source_text(原文): VISTO D'INGRESSO. The consul's signature adorns a stamp of vivid violet ink: oak, olive, cogwheel, five-pointed star. Valid for multiple entries to the Republic of Italy.
translation_zh(译文): 入境签证。领事的签名落在一枚艳紫墨印上：橡树、橄榄枝、齿轮、五角星。可多次入境意大利共和国。

source_text(原文): A little flecks of silvery metal bonded to black cardstock - supposedly a scrap of an actual Star. The Ministries occupation headquarters in Karlshorst issues these to political officers and senior civilians as badges of identification.
translation_zh(译文): 几缕银色的金属碎屑附着在黑色卡纸上——据称是一颗真星的残片。联盟设在卡尔斯霍斯特的占领军总部把这些发给政治军官与高级文职人员，作为身份徽记。

source_text(原文): Permission for an 'educational theatre company' to give performances throughout Ministries territory. This will get Rosa Mundi across every border behind the Iron Curtain. Issued by the All-Union Committee on Arts Affairs (under the Ministry of Cherries).
translation_zh(译文): 一份准许某个「教育剧团」在联盟全境演出的许可证。凭此，罗莎·蒙迪可以穿过铁幕之后的每一道边境。由全联盟艺术事务委员会签发（隶属樱桃部）。

source_text(原文): 'Spencer Hobson: multiple entries Germany, US Zone of Occupation'. A single sheet of paper, enlivened with the flaming-sword stamp.
translation_zh(译文): 「斯宾塞·霍布森：可多次入境德国美国占领区」。一张单页纸，加盖着那枚火剑印章，显得神气活现。

source_text(原文): OMGUS Travel Permit: Germany, US Zone of Occupation
translation_zh(译文): OMGUS 旅行通行证：德国，美国占领区

source_text(原文):
A pre-war passport in the name of Mr Spencer Hobson. My place of birth is given as Kerisham, in England.

It's a real passport, but the government's changed the law, and it might not be valid much longer.
translation_zh(译文):
一本战前护照，持有人为斯宾塞·霍布森先生。出生地一栏写的是英格兰的凯尔伊苏姆。

这是一本真护照，但政府已经改了法律，它也许再过不久就失效了。

source_text(原文): A passable counterfeit in the name of François Isnard. The name is clumsily printed and difficult for a lazy official to read accurately at a casual glance. It might draw the attention of a more scrupulous official.
translation_zh(译文): 一本署名弗朗索瓦·伊斯纳尔的赝品，足以乱真。名字印得笨拙，懒散的官员草草一瞥很难读准。若是遇上较真的官员，恐怕会引来注意。
法兰西邦国护照（足以乱真的赝品）

source_text(原文):
A pre-war passport in the name of M. Sylvain [[Huissier]]. My place of birth is given as Paris. That much is true, as far as I know, but it's not a name I often use. It can be convenient to travel as a Frenchman, but I can't legally be a citizen of both Britain and France.

It carries a consular stamp in purple aniline ink, confirming that the Fourth Republic recognises me as a citizen. Both the passport and the stamp are forgeries, but they're good ones. They'll get me across the Republic border unless I'm very unlucky.
translation_zh(译文):
一本战前护照，持有人为西尔万·[[韦西耶]]先生。出生地一栏写的是巴黎。就我所知，那部分属实，但这并非我常用的名字。以法国人的身份旅行有时颇为方便，可我无法合法地同时身为英国与法国的公民。

护照上有一枚紫色苯胺墨的领事印章，确认第四共和国承认我为公民。护照和印章都是伪造的，但都是上好的伪造。除非我倒霉到家，否则它们足以带我越过共和国的边境。
第三共和国护照（已签注）

source_text(原文):
A pre-war passport in the name of M. Sylvain [[Huissier]]. My place of birth is given as Paris. That much is true, as far as I know, but it's not a name I often use. It can be convenient to travel as a Frenchman, but I can't legally be a citizen of both Britain and France.

So the passport is a forgery - and the Republic has issued new ones anyway, leaving it invalid. Everything's changed since the Wars.
translation_zh(译文):
一本战前护照，持有人为西尔万·[[韦西耶]]先生。出生地一栏写的是巴黎。就我所知，那部分属实，但这并非我常用的名字。以法国人的身份旅行有时颇为方便，可我无法合法地同时身为英国与法国的公民。

所以这本护照是伪造的——何况共和国反正也换了新护照，它已经失效。自战争以来，一切都变了。
第三共和国护照（已失效）

source_text(原文): WIZA WJAZDOWA. The stamp is not aniline purple, but something vivid red, with the white eagle a pale shape at its core.
translation_zh(译文): 入境签证。印章不是苯胺紫，而是一种鲜亮的红，白鹰在正中凝成一抹淡影。

source_text(原文): VIZĂ DE INTRARE. The arms of the People's Republic of Romania: a tractor before three factory chimneys crowned with smudges of smoke. A Star rises behind the horizon - tinted with something silverier than the aniline violet of the stamp.
translation_zh(译文): 入境签证。罗马尼亚人民共和国的国徽：一台拖拉机，三根工厂烟囱立于其前，顶上笼着缕缕烟痕。一颗星自地平线后升起——染着比印章的苯胺紫更银亮的光泽。

source_text(原文): VISADO DE ENTRADA. The consul's signature adorns a stamp of vivid violet ink - yoke, arrows, eagle, and the Pillars of Hercules. Look close enough, and there's a tiny radiance at the top of each pillar, like a candle flame.
translation_zh(译文): 入境签证。领事的签名落在一枚艳紫墨印上——轭、箭、鹰，以及赫拉克勒斯之柱。凑近细看，每根柱顶都有一点微光，仿佛烛焰。

source_text(原文): The letter confirms that its bearer, Père Laiton, has the diocese's authorisation to pursue matters concerning the medical records of his one-time parishioner, Liliane Huissier. It carries the stamp of the episcopal chancery. It's easily good enough to convince someone who doesn't spend much time looking at episcopal chancery stamps.
translation_zh(译文): 这封信确认持信人黄铜神父获得教区授权，可处理其昔日教区居民莉莉安·韦西耶的医疗档案事宜。信上盖着主教府的公章。对不常细看主教府公章的人来说，它足以乱真。

source_text(原文): Forged Letter from Bishop of Nantes
A soggy mess of identity cards and mulched ration books, scavenged from the Dead of Kerisham beach.
translation_zh(译文): 一堆湿透的身份证件与沤烂成浆的配给簿，是从凯尔伊苏姆海滩的亡者身上捡来的。

source_text(原文): A letter from Maître Argant to Madame Zelia, in a slim sky-blue envelope that smells like Argant itself.
translation_zh(译文): 一封阿尔冈律师写给泽莉亚夫人的信，装在一个纤薄的天蓝色信封里，信封带着阿尔冈自身的气息。

source_text(原文): A letter from Maître Argant to Madame Zelia, folded in quarters and labelled ZIELA MY LOVE in Juliusz' barely-readable scrawl. He has adorned it with hearts, kisses, and little pictures of friendly wasps.
translation_zh(译文): 一封阿尔冈律师写给泽莉亚夫人的信，折成四折，尤利乌什以几乎认不出的潦草笔迹写着「吾爱泽莉亚」。他还在信上点缀了心形、亲吻记号，以及一幅幅友善黄蜂的小画。
尤利乌什致泽莉亚的信

source_text(原文): A letter from Max Mustermann to Madame Zelia, in a white envelope lettered with punctilious copperplate care.
translation_zh(译文): 一封马克斯·穆斯特曼写给泽莉亚夫人的信，装在一个白色信封里，信封上的字是一笔不苟的铜版体。

source_text(原文): A list of names once used by the missing and dead, recovered to apply to the Dead of Kerisham.
translation_zh(译文): 一份名单，收着失踪者与亡者生前用过的名字，如今被寻回，安到凯尔伊苏姆的亡者身上。

source_text(原文): A long list of carefully constructed names, each chosen for a face on the beach, with another dozen for latecomers. It'll literally n ever make any difference to anyone except me.
translation_zh(译文): 一长串精心构造的名字，海滩上的每张面孔都有一个，另备了一打给后来者。除了我，它永远不会对任何人产生任何影响——字面意义上的。

source_text(原文): A neatly wrapped parcel containing a new Outfit.
translation_zh(译文): 一份包装齐整的包裹，内有一件新行头。

source_text(原文): An order for a knitted vest, shirt and tie, practical and respectable, made to measure. [The package will appear in your inventory after you travel to another city.]
translation_zh(译文): 一份量身定做的订单：针织背心、衬衫与领带，实用且体面。[旅行到另一座城市后，包裹会出现在你的物品栏中。]

source_text(原文): My old Légion uniform, meticulously mended by the elder Janvier.
translation_zh(译文): 我昔日的军团制服，由年长的让维耶一针一线精心补缀而成。

source_text(原文): An order for a dark jacket and trousers, made to measure. [The package will appear in your inventory after you travel to another city.]
translation_zh(译文): 一份量身定做的订单：深色夹克与长裤。[旅行到另一座城市后，包裹会出现在你的物品栏中。]

source_text(原文): An order for a light summer blazer and trousers, made to measure. [The package will appear in your inventory after you travel to another city.]
translation_zh(译文): 一份量身定做的订单：轻薄的夏日西装外套与长裤。[旅行到另一座城市后，包裹会出现在你的物品栏中。]

source_text(原文): An order for warm winter clothing, made to measure. [The package will appear in your inventory after you travel to another city.]
translation_zh(译文): 一份量身定做的订单：保暖的冬装。[旅行到另一座城市后，包裹会出现在你的物品栏中。]

source_text(原文): An alchemical preparation used to purge and purify. It refreshes Edge and Lantern aspects, and is necessary for higher-level crafting recipes.
translation_zh(译文): 一种用于涤除与净化的炼金制剂。它能恢复刃与灯性相，也是更高阶炼制配方所必需。

source_text(原文):
An alchemical preparation with the double-edge power of the threshold. It refreshes Knock and Rose aspects, and is necessary for higher-level crafting recipes.

[Labrikon can also be used in some actions to open the way to liminal spaces like the edge of dream. Don't consume it if you plan to use it for that.]
translation_zh(译文):
一种具有门阈双刃之力的炼金制剂。它能恢复启与引性相，也是部分更高阶炼制配方所必需。

[在某些行动中，拉布里孔也可用来开辟通往阈限空间的道路，比如梦境边缘。若打算这样用，就不要服用它。]

source_text(原文):
An alchemical preparation intended to poison, to cure, or to stimulate. It refreshes Heart and Grail aspects, and is necessary for some higher-level crafting recipes.

[Pharmakon can also be used in some actions to drug or to cure others, if you have the skills. Don't consume it if you plan to use it for that.]
translation_zh(译文):
一种本可用于下毒、治病或催激的炼金制剂。它能恢复心与杯性相，也是部分更高阶炼制配方所必需。

[若你技艺足够，在某些行动中，法尔马孔也可用来迷倒或救治他人。若打算这样用，就不要服用它。]

source_text(原文): An alchemical preparation used to quieten or madden. It refreshes Moth and Winter aspects, and is necessary for some higher-level crafting recipes.
translation_zh(译文): 一种用于使人静默或使人疯狂的炼金制剂。它能恢复蛾与冬性相，也是部分更高阶炼制配方所必需。

source_text(原文):
The proud but ailing [[currency]] of the proud but failing Empire. Not as widely accepted as Incorporate dollars or Swiss francs. But better than francisques or ostmarks.

A pound's worth about four dollars.
translation_zh(译文):
骄傲却日渐衰颓的帝国那骄傲却病入膏肓的[[货币]]。不像集团美元或瑞士法郎那样广受欢迎。但比法兰西斧币或东德马克强些。

一英镑约值四美元。

source_text(原文): The Allies suddenly issued their new [[currency]]... and overnight the old Reichsmarks were useless outside the Eastern sector of Berlin. To stave off inflation, Ministry clerks sanctioned a limited number of Reichsmarks by attaching little Star-watched adhesive coupons, and these became the Eastern currency. It held the line against hyperinflation, but the Ostmark is only worth about half a D-Mark, and the coupons come off in the rain. The Stars may now agree to issue their onteiristically flawless dolya in East Berlin now. But that would be an escalation that might force the Incorporates' hand in turn. No-one is ready for a third war. Roughly six ostmarks to the dollar.
translation_zh(译文): 盟军忽然发行了他们的新[[货币]]……一夜之间，旧帝国马克在柏林东区之外统统成了废纸。为遏制通货膨胀，联盟的职员们给一批帝国马克贴上印有小星守望图样的附票予以认可，这批马克便成了东区货币。它守住了恶性通胀的堤线，但东德马克只值大约半个西德马克，而且附票一淋雨就会脱落。 群星如今或许会同意在东柏林发行他们那在梦境学意义上无懈可击的多利亚。但那将是升级之举，反过来可能逼得集团不得不摊牌。没有人准备好迎接第三次战争。 大约六东德马克兑一美元。

source_text(原文):
The [[currency]] of the French Republic, graced by the profile of Marianne, its personification. 'LIBERTY, EQUALITY, FRATERNITY.' Don't be caught with these in the French State. They're prickly about their currency down there.

The franc, like the francisque, trades at about two hundred to the dollar.
translation_zh(译文):
法兰西共和国的[[货币]]，币面饰有其拟人化身玛丽安娜的侧影。「自由、平等、博爱。」别在法兰西邦国境内被人搜出这些。那边的人对自己货币的事可计较得很。

法郎与法兰西斧币一样，约莫两百兑一美元。

source_text(原文):
The official [[Ministries]] currency - more than that, the currency of the Great Exchange, the mutual bank guaranteed by Stars themselves. Utterly reliable incarnation of Icarian-Proudhonist mutualism; onteiriologically perfect reflection of the value of labour; a means of exchange guaranteed not by gold or by silver, but by the fate-synthesis of the shining fellow-travellers from outside the sky. Universally accepted in the Soviet sphere, utterly forbidden in the West.

One dollar will get you four doli, if you can find someone to make the exchange.
translation_zh(译文):
[[联盟]]的官方货币——不止于此，它还是大汇兑所的货币，那家由群星亲自担保的互助银行。它是伊加利亚—蒲鲁东式互助主义绝无偏差的化身；是劳动价值的梦境学完美映照；是一种不以黄金或白银、而以天外闪耀的同路者们的命运合成为担保的交换媒介。在苏联势力范围内普受接纳，在西方则绝对禁止。

一美元能换四多利亚——前提是你能找到愿意做成这笔兑换的人。

source_text(原文):
The [[currency]] of the French State, named for the double-headed axe which serves the State as its symbol. 'WORK, FAMILY, HOMELAND.'

The francisque, like the franc, trades at about two hundred to the dollar.
translation_zh(译文):
法兰西邦国的[[货币]]，得名于那柄充当邦国象征的双头斧。「劳动、家庭、祖国。」

法兰西斧币与法郎一样，约莫两百兑一美元。

source_text(原文): Everyone in Europe knows that the unimpeachable value of their [[currency]]. Even on the eastern side of the Iron Curtain, even legitimate businesses will quietly accept payment in Swiss francs. It is odd that the Ministries permit use of a gold-backed currency in their mutualist paradise. But there has been something opaque happening in Switzerland, ever since the Alps grew colder. One Swiss franc is worth about one dollar.
translation_zh(译文): 欧洲人人都知道，他们的[[货币]]价值无可指摘。即使在铁幕东侧，即使是正当生意，也会默不作声地接受瑞士法郎付款。 联盟竟允许在其互助主义乐园中使用金本位货币，这确实奇怪。但自阿尔卑斯山变冷以来，瑞士境内一直有某种晦暗不明的事在发生。 一瑞士法郎约值一美元。

source_text(原文):
The Corona-touched [[currency]] of the United States, buttery smooth beneath the fingertips, faintly luminous even in darkness. Much valued in the wilder hinterlands of Europe as a talisman of onteirological stability. The new five dollar bill is sometimes nailed above doors to invoke the protection the one whose likeness it bears - Barkley, who is both President and Incorporate.

Every other currency's value is expressed in terms of the dollar. Heaven bless America.
translation_zh(译文):
美国那种被冕触及的[[货币]]，指尖抚过如奶油般滑顺，即使在黑暗中也会发出微光。在欧洲更蛮荒的内地，它作为梦境学稳定的护符而备受珍视。崭新的五美元钞票有时会被钉在门楣之上，以祈求钞票上那位形象的庇护——巴克利，他既是总统，也是集团成员。

所有其他货币的价值都以美元计。天佑美利坚。

source_text(原文): Crisp new Deutsche Mark - the [[currency]] printed under Incorporate aegis to succeed the tainted and inflated Reichsmark. Bane of the black market; seed of the Blockade; worth twice an ostmark, or about a third of a dollar.
translation_zh(译文): 崭新挺括的德国马克——在集团庇护下印制的[[货币]]，用以接替那已被玷污、通胀肆虐的帝国马克。它是黑市之灾；是封锁之种；价值抵两枚东马克，或约三分之一美元。

source_text(原文): A seven-inch cigar of the highest quality, painstakingly rolled in Havana by a master torcedor, ready to be incited by fire's touch to a choking cloud of smoke. Easily worth a dollar on the black market.
translation_zh(译文): 一支七英寸长的顶级雪茄，由哈瓦那的卷烟大师一丝不苟地卷成，只待火焰一触，便化作一团呛人的烟雾。在黑市上轻易能值一美元。
罗密欧与朱丽叶·丘吉尔型雪茄

source_text(原文): A genuine Incorporate cigarette. This far from the US, a dollar might get you ten cigarettes on the black market. In Europe, it's almost a [[currency]].
translation_zh(译文): 一支货真价实的集团香烟。在离美国这么远的地方，一美元在黑市上也许能换来十支香烟。在欧洲，它几乎就是一种[[货币]]。

source_text(原文):
'Socrates,, having walked about, when he said that his legs were growing heavy, lay down on his back... he said that when the poison reached his heart, he would leave us.'

In Europe, since the Wars, there's no shortage of deaths, but this is among the gentler ones.
translation_zh(译文):
『苏格拉底，走动一番之后，说他的双腿渐渐沉重，便仰面躺下……他说，当毒药抵达心脏时，他就要离开我们了。』

战争以来的欧洲从不缺少死亡，但这算是其中比较温和的一种。

source_text(原文): Intimations of anger; the storm-clouds of struggle.
translation_zh(译文): 愤怒的预兆；争斗的乌云。

source_text(原文): The possibility of sparks; a heat that alters.
translation_zh(译文): 火花萌生的可能；一种会改变的热。
更盛的渴望；更深的感受。

source_text(原文): Clouds part; wounds creak; doors strain.
translation_zh(译文): 云层分开；伤口吱嘎作响；门扉绷紧。

source_text(原文): Every colour is brighter, but the brightest colours bleed towards white.
translation_zh(译文): 每一种颜色都更加明亮，但最明亮的颜色都向白色渗去。

source_text(原文): Brains buzz; skins shift; passions part like leaves.
translation_zh(译文): 头脑嗡嗡作响；皮肤悄然变幻；激情如叶四散。

source_text(原文):
Choices prowled by possibility; a sense of horizons.

[Rose influences are the only influences that don't fade on Travel.]
translation_zh(译文):
被可能性蹑足环绕的选择；地平线的感觉。

[引的影响是唯一不会在旅行中消退的影响。]

source_text(原文): A deadening chill; an expectation of silence; the apprehension of frost.
translation_zh(译文): 令人死寂的寒意；对寂静的期许；对霜冻的预感。

source_text(原文): ''The oldest and strongest emotion of mankind is fear, and the oldest and strongest kind of fear is fear of the unknown.' - Lovecraft
translation_zh(译文): 『人类最古老、最强烈的情感是恐惧，而最古老、最强烈的恐惧，是对未知的恐惧。』——洛夫克拉夫特

source_text(原文): ''Wit's forge and fire-blast, meaning's press and screw.' - Coleridge, 'On Donne's Poetry'
translation_zh(译文): 『机智的锻炉与火风，意义的压机与螺钉。』——柯勒律治，《论多恩的诗》

source_text(原文): It doesn't exactly make sense - but I understand it anyway.
translation_zh(译文): 它说不太通——但我还是明白了。

source_text(原文): But it might mean nothing at all...
translation_zh(译文): 但它或许什么也不意味着……

source_text(原文): ''The Moth, the Grail, and the Egg Unhatching all tell different stories of the world's beginning. One of those stories is the oldest, but it may not be the first.' - Abbess Nonna, [[Abbey of St Brandan]]
translation_zh(译文): 『飞蛾、赤杯与逆孵之卵，对世界的开端各有各的讲述。其中一则故事最为古老，但它也许并非最先。』——诺娜院长，[[圣布伦丹修道院]]
每一个选择都有它的阴影。

source_text(原文): Some truths come to us from outside, or above - the Church would say, from the Hours of the Sun. Practical people write these truths down.
translation_zh(译文): 有些真理从外部、或从上方来到我们这里——教会会说，它们来自太阳诸司辰。务实的人会把这些真理写下来。

source_text(原文): Some appetites are easier to satisfy than others.
translation_zh(译文): 有些渴望比别的更容易满足。

source_text(原文): The wound is visible; the pain is not.
translation_zh(译文): 伤口看得见；疼痛看不见。

source_text(原文): Green scents recall rain. Stronger scents recall the ozone of storms.
translation_zh(译文): 青绿的气味让人想起雨水。更强烈的气味让人想起风暴的臭氧。

source_text(原文): Something overheard in dreams? Or just something that shouldn't really be in the Wake?
translation_zh(译文): 是在梦中偷听到的什么吗？还是某种本不该存在于醒世的什么？

source_text(原文): Craft is learnt through the tips of the fingers.
translation_zh(译文): 手艺是通过指尖学会的。

source_text(原文):
When the feast of the Sun's Resurrection came to Brancrug, the rectory was still cold - those old stone walls, thick as a castle's - and with no housekeeper, I had to lay my own fire... 

Recall <link="mypastanastasis">My Past: Anastasis, Brancrug, 1920</link>
translation_zh(译文):
太阳复活的庆典降临布兰库格时，牧师寓所仍透着寒气——那些古老的石墙，厚如城堡——又没有管家，我只得自己生火……

追忆 <link="mypastanastasis">我的过去：复活，布兰库格，1920年</link>

source_text(原文):
Temples of ice, cobbies gleaming amber, knives of nerveless acuteness, a cage of coral...

Recall <link="mypasteveofstdahutys1942">My Past: Eve of St Dahut, Ys, 1940 (?)</link>
translation_zh(译文):
冰的圣殿，泛着琥珀光泽的卵石，锋利得毫无知觉的刀，一座珊瑚的牢笼……

追忆 <link="mypasteveofstdahutys1942">我的过去：圣达于特节前夜，伊苏，1940年（？）</link>

source_text(原文): Memory: Eve of St Dahut, Ys, 1940 (?)
translation_zh(译文): 回忆：圣达于特节前夜，伊苏，1940年（？）

source_text(原文):
The campfire flames were bright as hair-ribbons, the night before we met the men of the Lion in battle, and the moon a scarred and naked knife... 

Recall <link="mypasteveofstjamesthegreater">My Past: Eve of St James the Greater, Khorasan, 1934</link>
translation_zh(译文):
营火的火焰亮如发带——那是我们与狮子的人马交战的前夜——月亮像一把伤痕累累、裸露无鞘的刀……

追忆 <link="mypasteveofstjamesthegreater">我的过去：圣大雅各节前夜，呼罗珊，1934年</link>

source_text(原文): Memory: Eve of St James the Greater, Khorasan, 1934
translation_zh(译文): 回忆：圣大雅各节前夜，呼罗珊，1934年

source_text(原文):
I'd been out drinking with Teresa and Christopher, and when I came back to my rooms, the quiet men of the [[Bureau]] were waiting... 

Recall <link="mypastlammastide">My Past: Lammastide, Camden Lock, 1925</link>
translation_zh(译文):
我和特蕾莎、克里斯托弗在外头喝了一夜的酒，回到住处时，[[防剿局]]那些沉默的人已经等着我了……

追忆 <link="mypastlammastide">我的过去：收获节，卡姆登船闸，1925年</link>
回忆：收获节，卡姆登船闸，1925年

source_text(原文):
My third and last Brancrug autumn, when the days shrank and the storms beat at the coast...

Recall  <link="mypastmichaelmas">My Past: Michaelmas, Brancrug, 1921</link>
translation_zh(译文):
我在布兰库格的第三个、也是最后一个秋天，白昼渐短，风暴拍打着海岸……

追忆 <link="mypastmichaelmas">我的过去：米迦勒节，布兰库格，1921年</link>
回忆：米迦勒节，布兰库格，1921年

source_text(原文):
I don't remember much of how it was, when the Worms were in me...

Recall  <link="mypaststagneseve">My Past: St Agnes' Eve, 1937 (?)</link>
translation_zh(译文):
蠕虫在我体内时是何种光景，我已记不太清……

追忆 <link="mypaststagneseve">我的过去：圣阿格尼丝节前夜，1937年（？）</link>
回忆：圣阿格尼丝节前夜，1937年（？）

source_text(原文):
I liked the painted nights on the stage, for the gasps of the audience and the absence of uncertainty.

Recall <link="mypaststbrazenseve">My Past: St Brazen's Eve, 1924</link>
translation_zh(译文):
我喜欢舞台上的彩绘之夜，为的是观众的惊叹，也为那份没有不确定性的时光。

追忆 <link="mypaststbrazenseve">我的过去：圣黄铜节前夜，1924年</link>

source_text(原文):
The first thing I saw, when I opened my new eyes in [[Alexandria]], was Stanislav's face.

Recall <link="mypaststcatherineseve">My Past: St Catherine's Eve, Alexandria, 1948</link>
translation_zh(译文):
在[[亚历山大港]]睁开我这双新眼睛时，我见到的第一样东西，是斯坦尼斯拉夫的脸。

追忆 <link="mypaststcatherineseve">我的过去：圣凯瑟琳节前夜，亚历山大港，1948年</link>
回忆：圣凯瑟琳节前夜，亚历山大港，1948年

source_text(原文):
Chez Bricktop: Coca-Cola and the Quintette du Hot Club like the world's heart pumping...

Recall <link="mypaststdjangoseve">My Past: St Django's Eve, Rue Pigalle, 1930</link>
translation_zh(译文):
布里克托普之家：可口可乐，还有热俱乐部五重奏，就像世界的心脏在搏动……

追忆 <link="mypaststdjangoseve">我的过去：圣姜戈节前夜，皮加勒街，1930年</link>

source_text(原文): Memory: St Django's Eve, Rue Pigalle, 1930
translation_zh(译文): 回忆：圣姜戈节前夜，皮加勒街，1930年

source_text(原文):
On nights of the new moon, sometimes I found myself back at the Ecdysis Club...

Recall <link="mypaststkallisteseve">My Past: St Kalliste's Eve, London, 1923</link>
translation_zh(译文):
新月之夜，我有时会发觉自己又回到了蜕皮俱乐部……

追忆 <link="mypaststkallisteseve">我的过去：圣卡利斯特节前夜，伦敦，1923年</link>

One summer Saturday, in my first year as parish priest...

我任堂区神父的第一年，某个夏日的周六……

[[布兰库格]]的十月，战前最后一年。暮紫色的石楠，灰蒙蒙低吼的海……

I left the Légion when my five years were done. I didn't think anything could be worse than the Rung Ma or Khorasan...

I had gone from the stinking dankness of the orphanage into the clean narrow chill of the minor seminary...

我从孤儿院那股发臭的潮闷中，走进小修院那干净、狭窄的寒意……

so|Item|resources.assets|28918|_description,A hand-picked bunch
column4: 一束手摘的玫瑰，用细绳松松扎着。

source_text(原文): A tiny cup of fierce black coffee beneath a whipped cream quiff.
translation_zh(译文): 一小杯浓烈的黑咖啡，顶着一撮翘起的奶油尖。

source_text(原文): Real eggs, not powdered, are hard to come by in these times. But here they are - and crunchy!
translation_zh(译文): 如今这些年头，真鸡蛋——不是蛋粉——可不易得。但它们就在这里——而且酥脆！

source_text(原文): Vanilla, custard, and meringue, landscaped and caramelled: a Claridge's speciality.
translation_zh(译文): 香草、蛋奶糊与蛋白霜，摆盘成景，再浇上焦糖：克拉里奇酒店的招牌甜点。

source_text(原文): A little jar of honey. Amber in some lights, golden in others. [Unlike many Refreshments, honey survives travel.]
translation_zh(译文): 一小罐蜂蜜。在某些光线下呈琥珀色，在另一些光线下呈金色。[与许多茶点不同，蜂蜜经得起旅行。]

source_text(原文): A wonderfully versatile dish favoured for breakfast by the sons of the lark, for supper by the daughters of the owl, and as a cold midnight snack by the children of the crow.
translation_zh(译文): 一种妙不可言的百搭菜肴：百灵鸟的儿子们爱用它作早餐，猫头鹰的女儿们爱用它作晚餐，乌鸦的孩子们则把它当作深夜的冷食。

source_text(原文): British manufacture. 'French' means it's cut with chicory - a reference to the coffee shortages of Napoleon's time.
translation_zh(译文): 英国制造。“法式”意味着它掺了菊苣——这是对拿破仑时代咖啡短缺的呼应。

source_text(原文): A sweet dish named (of course) to celebrate Offenbach's 1865 operetta La belle Hélène.
translation_zh(译文): 一道甜点，自然是为庆祝奥芬巴赫 1865 年的轻歌剧美丽的海伦而命名。

source_text(原文): A nice hot cup of strong black tea, softened with milk.
translation_zh(译文): 一杯滚烫的浓红茶，以牛奶调柔。

source_text(原文): A little white ceramic jar containing a small quantity of golden ink - uzult, one of the five encausta terminalia, the Great Inks in which interpretations of [[Histories]] can be recorded by the appointed few. [This is a precious substance. Use it only at need. You can sell it, but few in all Europe will appreciate its true price.]
translation_zh(译文): 一只小小的白色瓷罐，内盛少量金色墨水——乌祖尔特，五种终结彩墨之一，即那“大墨”：被选定的少数人能以之记录对[[历史]]的诠释。 [这是珍稀之物。只在必要时使用。你可以卖掉它，但全欧洲没有几个人懂得它真正的价值。]

source_text(原文): A little white ceramic jar from Aubière's box - the pyx, the reliquary, whatever it was.
translation_zh(译文): 奥比埃匣子里的一只小小的白色瓷罐——圣体盒也好，圣物匣也好，管它是什么。
一支黑金相间的钢笔，压着 'L.A.' 的花押。

source_text(原文): The sign of the half-human hill-child called bisclavret. The sign trembles with aguey vitality.
translation_zh(译文): 被称为比斯克拉弗雷的半人山野之子的印记。这印记带着寒热般的活力颤动着。

source_text(原文): A touchstone and talisman, worn as a good-luck piece until its owner became too closely acquainted with a howitzer shell at Remagen. The amulet survived the experience, so perhaps it assures its own good luck.
translation_zh(译文): 一枚试金石兼护身符，被当作辟邪吉物佩戴，直到它的主人在雷马根与一枚榴弹炮弹过于亲近。护符挺过了那场经历，所以也许它护佑的是自己的好运。

source_text(原文): A hand-made petrol-fueled lighter, painstakingly hammered out of a spent shell-casing. I had one rather like this, back in my Dorsetshire Regiment days. I threw it away after it took my eyebrows off. This one doesn't look much safer, but its provenance lends it power. And the maker thoughtfully lined the fuel chamber with wadded asbestos so it's less likely to explode.
translation_zh(译文): 一只手工打造的汽油打火机，由一枚用过的弹壳一丝不苟地锤制而成。多塞特团服役那会儿，我也有过一只跟它差不多的。它燎掉我的眉毛之后，我把它扔了。这一只看起来并不比那只安全多少，但它的来历赋予了它力量。而且制作者想得周到，在燃料舱里衬了填实的石棉，所以它不大可能爆炸。

source_text(原文): A black-enamelled hip flask of extremely modest dimensions - just enough to hold a small nip of spirits, but reassuringly inconspicuous, perhaps even to a body-search. 'Flat man', the German term means.
translation_zh(译文): 一只黑色珐琅的扁酒壶，尺寸极其克制——刚好容得下一小口烈酒，却小得令人安心，或许连搜身都能瞒过。德语词的意思是“扁平的人”。

source_text(原文): A warm red-purple tone on an open weave, like a smile across the lip of a raised wine glass.
translation_zh(译文): 疏织布上一抹暖调的红紫，像高擎酒杯时掠过杯沿的微笑。

source_text(原文): An intricate, beautiful pattern that's just brash enough to remain tasteful.
translation_zh(译文): 一个繁复美丽的图案，恰好张扬到依旧不失雅致。

source_text(原文): A tin medallion commemorating the wolf-headed patron of travelers, storms, and strength - an unfailingly popular and notoriously unsophisticated saint.
translation_zh(译文): 一枚锡质纪念章，纪念那位狼首的旅人、风暴与力量之主保——一位始终广受欢迎、出了名粗陋的圣人。
圣克里斯托弗·狼首纪念章

source_text(原文): The inattentive will see a pale grey handkerchief - the attentive, a subtle pattern for a subtle colour on a weave that grants it subtle life. 'Nothing dearer than the song of grey, where Precision joins Imprecision.'
translation_zh(译文): 不留心的人只看见一块浅灰的手帕——留心的人则看见：一种精巧的颜色，一个精巧的图案，织在一块赋予它们精巧生命的布上。“没有什么比灰色的歌更珍贵，在那里，精确与不精确交汇。”

source_text(原文): Pale Oyster Foulard Silk Twill Handkerchief
translation_zh(译文): 浅牡蛎色富拉尔绸斜纹手帕

source_text(原文): A circular silver-gilt box, adorned with an exquisitely modelled dove, also silver-gilt. A story associates it with St Galileo. It held something holy or otherwise powerful for long enough to acquire a little power of its own.
translation_zh(译文): 一只圆形镀金银盒，饰着一只同样镀金、做工精美的鸽子。有个传说将它和圣伽利略联系在一起。它盛放某种神圣或其他有力的东西已经够久，自身也攒下了一点力量。

source_text(原文):
A safety razor blade. In short supply since the Wars.

Notably useful for practitioners of the [[Arts Unconsidered]], who often need to shed blood with a tool that has never tasted blood.
translation_zh(译文):
一片安全剃须刀片。战争以来一直短缺。

对[[未识技艺]]的修行者尤其有用，他们常常需要用一件从未尝过血的工具来放血。

source_text(原文): Ignites on anything, burns with a clear and beautiful white flame. They don't make these any more, because the manufacturing process made the match-girls' jaws rot, then glow, then collapse. Except in the Vatican, for certain essential rights; and there, we are assured, the matches are produced so safely and carefully that phossy jaw is entirely unknown.
translation_zh(译文): 在任何东西上都能擦燃，燃起清澈美丽的白色火焰。这种火柴已经不再生产了，因为制造过程会让火柴女工的颌骨腐烂，继而发光，继而塌陷。只有梵蒂冈还在为某些必不可少的礼典生产；而在那里，我们得到保证，火柴生产得如此安全、如此小心，磷毒性颌骨坏死完全不为人知。

source_text(原文): Occult treasures are purchased with occult coin: spintriae. This one is silver. Its reverse displays a man and woman coupling. Their configuration implies enthusiasm, but what can be seen of their faces suggests boredom.
translation_zh(译文): 玄秘的珍宝要用玄秘的钱币来购：斯宾特里亚。这一枚是银的。它的背面绘着一男一女交合。他们的姿势透着热忱，但能看见的脸上却写着无聊。

source_text(原文): The bulky quartered-cross ornament sometimes worn by ordained priests of the [[Church]] of the Unconquered [[Sun]].
translation_zh(译文): 那种笨重的四分十字饰物，有时由[[教会]]中受圣职的司祭佩戴，侍奉不可征服之[[太阳]]。

source_text(原文): A pure white square of fine linen. Cambric; named for [[Cambray]] town…
translation_zh(译文): 一方纯白的细亚麻布。细棉布——因[[康布雷]]城得名……
洁白无瑕的细棉布手帕

source_text(原文): Linen, and chromic catgut; silk, and silkworm gut; instruments of ivory, silver, and steel.
translation_zh(译文): 亚麻线与铬制肠线；丝绸与蚕丝肠线；象牙、白银与钢铁的器械。

source_text(原文): How many ways can I take notes? Judiciously; briefly; threateningly - no-one's paying attention. But I'm paying attention to them.
translation_zh(译文): 我能用多少种方式记笔记？审慎地；简短地；威胁性地——没有人注意我。但我正注意着他们。

source_text(原文): Metaphorically, 'a mote of the Divided Sun'. Practically, an alchemical tool of considerable potency.
translation_zh(译文): 打个比方，它是“分裂之阳的一粒微尘”。实际上，它是一件效力相当可观的炼金工具。

source_text(原文): A little tangle of night-magics and serpent-tricks.
translation_zh(译文): 一小团夜之魔法与蛇术的纠缠。

source_text(原文): The powers of higher heaven might honour this request - or wink at an exception.
translation_zh(译文): 更高天界的力量也许会成全这一请求——或对某个例外睁一只眼闭一只眼。

source_text(原文): By this mark, we invoke the severest gaze of the powers of higher heaven.
translation_zh(译文): 凭此印记，我们唤起更高天界诸力量最严厉的注视。

source_text(原文): A web of subtle work to encourage peace, healing and a slow knitting-together of possibilities.
translation_zh(译文): 一张精巧织就的网，用以促成安宁、愈合，以及种种可能性的缓慢织合。

source_text(原文): A token invested with heavenly power, in defiance of Corona's claims of solar seignorage. Used for Bright Arts crafting recipes.
translation_zh(译文): 一件注入了天界力量的凭证，公然违抗冕对太阳铸币权的主张。用于光之技艺的炼制配方。

source_text(原文): Here is the promise we all make each night.
translation_zh(译文): 这就是我们每夜都会许下的承诺。

source_text(原文): Here is the solace confounded by light.
translation_zh(译文): 这就是被光搅乱的慰藉。

source_text(原文): A horrible tangle of potential Worms or Worm-traces, modelled after the scars left in a host's soul.
translation_zh(译文): 一团可怖的纠缠，内里是潜在的蠕虫或蠕虫之迹，仿照宿主灵魂上留下的伤疤而成。

source_text(原文): A bright token inhabited by a sharp spirit. Never allow anyone to look directly at it, or its power will instantly depart.
translation_zh(译文): 一件明亮的器物，内住着一位锐利的精灵。绝不可让任何人直视它，否则它的力量会立刻离去。

source_text(原文): The Church's older traditions have their roots in the Persian fire-cults.
translation_zh(译文): 教会更为古老的诸传统，可追溯至波斯的火神崇拜。

source_text(原文): No dawn knows only a single colour. No sky knows only a single dawn.
translation_zh(译文): 没有哪个黎明只识得一种颜色。没有哪片天空只识得一个黎明。

source_text(原文): A dark and syrupy liquor favoured in unnamed forest villages.
translation_zh(译文): 一种深色黏稠的烈酒，在无名的林间村落里备受青睐。

source_text(原文): A token invested with unearthly power, in defiance of Gleam's claims of cosmic prerogative. Used for Night Arts crafting.
translation_zh(译文): 一件注入了非尘世力量的凭证，公然违抗烁对宇宙特权的主张。用于夜之技艺的炼制。

source_text(原文): The proper use of this sombre sign silences restless spirits. Improper use can trouble the sleep and health of living human spirits.
translation_zh(译文): 正确使用这阴沉的印记，能让不安的亡魂归于沉寂。使用不当则会扰乱生者的睡眠与健康。

source_text(原文): Invokes the kindest of the Elegiast's Names.
translation_zh(译文): 唤起悼歌诗人最仁慈的尊名。

source_text(原文): Is the Hour named Velvet now Uncounted? Dead? How would we ever know?
translation_zh(译文): 那个名为丝毧的司辰，如今已除名了吗？死了吗？我们怎么会知道呢？

source_text(原文): An elegant little mark used in graveyard arts.
translation_zh(译文): 一种优雅的小印记，用于墓园之术。

source_text(原文): To be exiled - that is also a kind of freedom.
translation_zh(译文): 被放逐——那也是一种自由。

source_text(原文): A bright token vitrified to utmost purity.
translation_zh(译文): 一件玻璃化至极致纯净的明亮器物。

source_text(原文): The Witch-and-Sister are usually depicted on the sea-shore. In the gentler Limian tradition, the Salt-Skein is what the Sister has used to bind them together.
translation_zh(译文): 双生女巫通常被描绘在海滨。在较温和的利米安传统中，盐线团正是姊妹用来把她们绑在一起的东西。

source_text(原文): An impossibly thin, paradoxically heatless geometric segment of contained fire.
translation_zh(译文): 一截细得不可思议、悖论般毫无热力的几何线段,其中困着一团火。

source_text(原文): A clot of wood, leaves and feathers that sometimes used to draw the attention of minor Names like Knotwingknot.
translation_zh(译文): 一团结着木、叶与羽的乱块,昔时偶尔会引来诺特温克诺特这类次要尊名的注目。

source_text(原文): A sign of the authority granted to the Names of the Church-sanctioned Hours, and passed on by Names to the officers of the Church.
translation_zh(译文): 此印记承载着一种权威——授予教会认可的司辰之尊名,再由尊名传予教会的职官。

source_text(原文): A covenant of travel in silence. 'Twilight and evening bell / And after that the dark!'
translation_zh(译文): 一份于静默中行旅的盟约。「薄暮与晚钟,/而后便是黑暗!」

source_text(原文): Here are the forms and the roots and the sleight.
translation_zh(译文): 形体、根脉与巧技,尽在此中。

source_text(原文): The Watchman's vigilance is invoked to reveal, command or expel troublesome spirits.
translation_zh(译文): 召请守夜人的警觉,以揭露、号令或驱逐滋扰的鬼灵。

source_text(原文): Use this luminous token to unveil the hidden, or purify and exalt the tainted.
translation_zh(译文): 用这枚发光的凭证,揭开被隐匿之物,或涤净并超拔被玷污之物。

source_text(原文): A sigil deployed by  travelling healers and Bounds-wanderers.
translation_zh(译文): 行脚医者与边境漫游者所施用的符印。

source_text(原文): A trace of something that died tainted and returned corrupt.
translation_zh(译文): 某种污秽而亡、腐坏而归之物留下的痕迹。

source_text(原文): Here is the road long concealed from their sight.
translation_zh(译文): 这条久被遮蔽于他们视线之外的道路,就在此处。

source_text(原文): Used through centuries untold to bring lovers together, bless marriages, or make parties go with a swing.
translation_zh(译文): 无数世纪以来,人们用它撮合有情人、祝福婚姻,或令宴聚热闹尽兴。

source_text(原文): The soft and dusty grey-green of Highland hills. A fine accessory for an earl out to bag pheasants.
translation_zh(译文): 苏格兰高地丘陵那柔和而蒙尘的灰绿。对一位外出猎雉的伯爵而言,这是得体的配饰。

source_text(原文): Light - light leaks through the cracks...

Fear has its teeth in my hopes.

[As Dread increases, Spencer will suffer penalties. At Dread 10, misery will overwhelm him, ending the game. When Spencer rests, Fascination and Dread will cancel each other out, but anything left over may cause difficult dreams.]
translation_zh(译文):
恐惧的獠牙已没入我的希望。

[随着恐惧加深,斯宾塞将遭受惩罚。恐惧达到 10 时,悲苦将压垮他,游戏就此结束。斯宾塞休息时,入迷与恐惧会相互抵消,但残余的部分可能引发难安的梦境。]

source_text(原文):
The world grows thinner, the light brighter. It's dangerous to see too much of Eternity.

[As Fascination increases, Spencer will suffer penalties. At Fascination 10, he'll lose his mind, ending the game. When Spencer rests, Fascination and Dread will cancel each other out, but anything left over may cause difficult dreams.]
translation_zh(译文):
世界日渐稀薄,光芒愈发炽亮。窥见过多永恒,是危险的。

[随着入迷加深,斯宾塞将遭受惩罚。入迷达到 10 时,他将丧失心智,游戏就此结束。斯宾塞休息时,入迷与恐惧会相互抵消,但残余的部分可能引发难安的梦境。]

source_text(原文):
Wounds, illness, the other miseries of the body.

[As Pain increases, Spencer will suffer penalties. At Pain 10, he'll die.]
translation_zh(译文):
创伤、疾病,以及其他种种肉身之苦。

[随着痛苦加深,斯宾塞将遭受惩罚。痛苦达到 10 时,他将死去。]

source_text(原文):
A betraying clue.

As Traces accumulate, as my name gets around, I'm more likely to be recognised. Sometimes this might be good. I won't count on it being good.

[Spencer can gain Traces from truthfully sharing personal information, interacting with the authorities, or simply staying in one place too long. Sleeping in the same place for one night is safe - every night after that adds a Trace. Traveling to a new city removes Traces, as long as you don't keep travelling the same route.]
translation_zh(译文):
一条泄密的线索。

随着痕迹累积,我的名声渐渐传开,我被人认出的可能也随之增加。有时这或许是好事。但我不指望它是好事。

[斯宾塞可以通过如实吐露个人信息、与当局打交道,或仅仅在同一处久留来获得痕迹。在同一处安睡一夜是安全的——此后每多一夜,都会增添一条痕迹。只要不重复走同一条路线,前往一座新城市就会清除痕迹。]

source_text(原文):
Sleep's mother, the heart's warning.

[As Weariness increases, Spencer will gain penalties. If it reaches 10, he'll lose 3 Weariness and gain 3 Pain.]
translation_zh(译文):
睡眠之母,心之警讯。

[随着倦怠加深,斯宾塞将遭受惩罚。若倦怠达到 10,他将失去 3 点倦怠,并获得 3 点痛苦。]

source_text(原文): "'Our company it was that shattered it,' Ghirbi says suddenly. He begins again to weep his molten tears..." — Conversations at the Stag Door
translation_zh(译文): 「砸碎它的正是我们会社,」吉比尔突然说道。他再度流下熔融的泪水…… ——《牡鹿之门的闲谈》

source_text(原文): "There are common sentiments in every thunderclap. Let us acknowledge them." — A Thunderous Secret
translation_zh(译文): 「每一记雷霆之中都有共通的情感。让我们承认它们。」 ——《轰雷的秘密》

source_text(原文): "'Every key has its lock' sounds much grander than when we say that every spanner has its nut. But both remain true." — Serena Blackwood
translation_zh(译文): 「『每把钥匙都有它的锁』,听起来可比『每把扳手都有它的螺母』气派多了。但两者都依然成立。」 ——塞蕾娜·布莱克伍德

translation_zh(译文): 「盗目光之贼,掠王座之贼;犯边之贼,解结之贼;盗色彩之贼,盗骸骨之贼。」 ——《鸟形司辰的恶作剧》
