source_text(原文):
Once we've been to Mimata, the conversation will stop showing up.
Until we know she's with the Rosa Mundi, the conversation will bump us out.
Once we know she's with the Rosa Mundi, the conversation will fire, but then sequence us into the map.
translation_zh(译文):
一旦我们去过米玛塔,这段对话就不再出现。
在我们得知她与罗莎·蒙迪同行之前,对话会打断我们。
一旦我们得知她与罗莎·蒙迪同行,对话便会触发,但随后将我们送入地图。

source_text(原文): Goods that the French State might proscribe or tax, smuggled up the coast from Monaco.
translation_zh(译文): 法兰西邦国可能查禁或征税的货物,从摩纳哥沿岸一路走私而来。

source_text(原文): Through two mundane wars and one celestial, across at least five cities, this establishment has catered to discerning gentlemen.
translation_zh(译文): 历经两场凡世战争与一场天界战争,辗转至少五座城市,这家铺子始终侍奉着眼光挑剔的先生们。
汉斯·金德勒－罗萨里奥·布尔东

source_text(原文): When one's suitcase has been confiscated, tailor subverted, or laundry pre-empted...
translation_zh(译文): 当行李箱被没收、裁缝被策反，或者洗衣计划被别人抢先一步时……
保守而随意，一丝不苟地毫无威胁。

source_text(原文): All the swingest zazous hung at Le Pam-Pam. Sensass drinks, sensass style, sensass music! And best of all, Vichy hated it.
translation_zh(译文): 最会摇摆的扎祖青年都聚在帕姆-帕姆。绝赞的饮料，绝赞的风格，绝赞的音乐！最妙的是，维希恨透了这里。

source_text(原文): Bohemian, or burglar? Modern, minimal, dramatic.
translation_zh(译文): 波希米亚人，还是窃贼？现代、简洁、戏剧性。

source_text(原文): When you want to go punting, or conduct a swing band.
translation_zh(译文): 适合你想去撑篙划船，或者指挥一支摇摆乐队的时候。

source_text(原文): Fashionable, practical, and snug. An American style, but not an Incorporate one.
translation_zh(译文): 时髦、实用、暖和。美国风格，但并非集团风格。

source_text(原文): Authoritative, austere, armoured against colder climes.
translation_zh(译文): 威严、克制，像披甲一样抵御更寒冷的气候。

source_text(原文): Ready for a night at the opera.
translation_zh(译文): 已经准备好去歌剧院过一夜。

source_text(原文):
To strive, to achieve, to rise. A [[Passion]].

[Aspirational, confident, prideful, or arrogant choices are Ambitious.]
translation_zh(译文):
奋斗，成就，上升。一种[[激情]]。

[追求上进、自信、自豪或傲慢的选择，都属于「野心」。]

source_text(原文):
To avenge whatever I might suffer; to be feared.

A [[Passion]].

[Forceful, aggressive, or spiteful choices embody Anger. But Spencer isn't a violent man.]
translation_zh(译文):
为我遭受的一切复仇；让人畏惧我。

一种[[激情]]。

[强硬、攻击性或怀恨的选择体现「愤怒」。但斯宾塞并不是暴力的人。]

source_text(原文):
More of it, whatever it is. Avarice, lust, gluttony: all the fun ones.

A [[Passion]].
translation_zh(译文):
无论是什么，都还要更多。贪婪、色欲、暴食：全是好玩的那些。

一种[[激情]]。

source_text(原文):
'Only a million people can help a million people. But one person can help one person.'

A [[Passion]].

[Gentle or empathetic conversation choices often count as Compassionate.]
translation_zh(译文):
『一百万人只能由一百万人来帮助。但一个人可以帮助一个人。』

一种[[激情]]。

[温和或富有同理心的对话选择通常属于「悲悯」。]

source_text(原文):
There's always, always something more to know.

A [[Passion]].
translation_zh(译文):
永远，永远都有更多值得知道。

一种[[激情]]。

source_text(原文):
It is what it is.

A [[Passion]]. Though we might not feel like it counts as a Passion.

[Self-centred, or deceitful, or sceptical actions are all Cynical.]
translation_zh(译文):
事情就是这样。

一种[[激情]]。虽然我们可能觉得这根本算不上激情。

[自我中心、欺骗性或怀疑主义的行动都属于「犬儒」。]

source_text(原文):
There used to be more in me.

[An absence that might be filled with any Passion.]
translation_zh(译文):
我体内曾经有更多东西。

[一处可以被任意激情填满的空缺。]

source_text(原文):
Who you are is what you do when no-one's watching.

A [[Passion]].

[Honourable choices may involve self-discipline, honesty, or just courtesy.]
translation_zh(译文):
无人注视时你做什么，才决定你是谁。

一种[[激情]]。

[「荣誉」选择可能意味着自律、诚实，或者单纯的礼貌。]

source_text(原文):
Something's been cut out of me.

[An absence that might be filled with any Passion.]
translation_zh(译文):
我体内有某样东西被切走了。

[一处可以被任意激情填满的空缺。]

source_text(原文):
'Tho much abides... much is taken.'

A [[Passion]].

[Choices which acknowledge regret are Sorrowful. So, usually, is a choice to remain silent.]
translation_zh(译文):
『虽仍有许多留存……更多已被夺去。』

一种[[激情]]。

[承认遗憾的选择属于「悲伤」。通常，选择沉默也是。]

source_text(原文): Yes, I did. And what? A [[Passion]]. Whimsical choices are not often constructive.
translation_zh(译文): 是，我做过。 可做过什么？ 一种[[激情]]。「奇想」的选择通常不怎么有建设性。
耐心胜过蛮力；冬天会等。

source_text(原文): Use a Winter Influence to subvert two Edge Influences into a Winter Memory.
translation_zh(译文): 以一份冬之影响为催化，将两份刃之影响转化为一份冬之回忆。

source_text(原文): What is shaped, may be shattered, especially where battle has branded the skin of the world.
translation_zh(译文): 凡被塑成者，皆可被击碎，尤其在战斗已经烙伤世界皮肤的地方。

source_text(原文): Use an Edge Influence to subvert two Forge Influences into an Edge Memory.
translation_zh(译文): 以一份刃之影响为催化，将两份铸之影响转化为一份刃之回忆。

source_text(原文): If Grail is oldest, Moth is older.
translation_zh(译文): 若杯最古老，那么蛾比它更古老。

source_text(原文): Use a Moth Influence to subvert two Grail Influences into a Moth Memory.
translation_zh(译文): 以一份蛾之影响为催化，将两份杯之影响转化为一份蛾之回忆。

source_text(原文): Use a Grail Influence to subvert two Heart Influences into a Grail Memory.
translation_zh(译文): 以一份杯之影响为催化，将两份心之影响转化为一份杯之回忆。

source_text(原文): Use a Forge Influence to subvert two Lantern Influences into a Forge Memory.
translation_zh(译文): 以一份铸之影响为催化，将两份灯之影响转化为一份铸之回忆。

source_text(原文): The Glory is a question, and the Moth always answers, Yes.
translation_zh(译文): 辉光是一个问题，而蛾总会回答：「是。」

source_text(原文): Use a Lantern  Influence to subvert two Moth Influences into a Lantern Memory.
translation_zh(译文): 以一份灯之影响为催化，将两份蛾之影响转化为一份灯之回忆。

source_text(原文): The compass rose faces every direction from the circle's edge. Rose goes anywhere.
translation_zh(译文): 罗盘玫瑰从圆周边缘指向所有方向。引能去任何地方。

source_text(原文): With a Rose Memory as a catalyst, to convert any two other Influences to one random Memory.
translation_zh(译文): 以一份引之回忆为催化剂，将任意两份其他影响转化为一份随机回忆。

source_text(原文): Use a Heart Influence to subvert two Winter Influences into a Heart Memory.
translation_zh(译文): 以一份心之影响为催化，将两份冬之影响转化为一份心之回忆。

source_text(原文): When we open a thing, then we learn its nature. but its nature changes. Knock is the wound at the centre
translation_zh(译文): 当我们打开某物，便会知晓其本性。但它的本性也随之改变。启，是位于中心的伤口。

source_text(原文): Use a Knock Influence to subvert any two Influences into a Knock Memory.
translation_zh(译文): 以一份启之影响为催化，将任意两份影响转化为一份启之回忆。

source_text(原文): Since the war, Night Arts practitioners rely on the assertions of the Ministries dolya. If I won't, or can't, I can defiantly acknowledge necessity with a token of base metal backed by the older powers of night and bone. But it will rely on - and add to - that familiar half-cosmic Dread.
translation_zh(译文): 战争之后，夜之技艺的施术者依赖联盟多利亚的断言。若我不愿或不能如此，也可以用一枚贱金属信物，借夜与骨的旧权能，桀骜地「承认必然」。不过这依赖——并加深——那熟悉的、半属宇宙尺度的恐惧。

source_text(原文): Since the war, Bright Arts practitioners rely on the authority of the dollar. If I won't, or can't, I can mischievously assert authority with a token of paper and old light. But it will rely on - and add to - the dangerous dazzlement of Fascination.
translation_zh(译文): 战争之后，光之技艺的施术者依赖美元所代表的权威。若我不愿或不能如此，也可以用纸片与旧光制成一枚信物，恶作剧般「宣示权威」。不过这依赖危险的入迷眩光，也会让入迷加深。

source_text(原文): Hidden things might be revealed by the Eye. Dark things might be discouraged.
translation_zh(译文): 隐藏之物也许会被那只眼揭示。黑暗之物也许会因此退缩。

source_text(原文): Prick a one-dollar note ('bill', as the [[Incorporates]] would call it) in the correct pattern to awaken the Eye in the Pyramid. In lean times, use another sign of Authority. Needs a Lantern-aspected Memory, and a bill or a substitute.
translation_zh(译文): 按正确图案在一美元纸币（[[集团]]会称之为「钞票」）上扎孔，即可唤醒金字塔中的那只「眼」。拮据之时，也可使用另一种权威的印记。需要一份灯性相的回忆，以及一张纸币或替代之物。

source_text(原文): 'By Heaven, Sir, we shall have no Cigars in the Library, and yet we shall have no House without a Smoking-Room.'
translation_zh(译文): 『天哪，先生——图书馆里决不能有雪茄；可一座宅邸又怎能没有吸烟室。』

source_text(原文): Use Grail influence to reduce Dread. Cheerier than many Grail rites. That's Bancroft for you.
translation_zh(译文): 用杯之影响削减恐惧。与许多杯之仪式相比，这一式轻快得多。班克罗夫特就是这种人。

source_text(原文): With Edge influence, provoke a ghastly realisation to reduce Fascination. By Gristwood's usual appalling standards, this is quite a gentle rite, but it still provokes at least a little Dread.
translation_zh(译文): 用刃之影响激发一次可怕的领悟，从而削减入迷。按格里斯特伍德一贯骇人的标准，这已经是相当温和的仪式，但仍会至少激起少许恐惧。

source_text(原文): A root-rite performed to protect against fascination. Traditionally, one digs beneath the roots of a yew with one's fingernails, but Moth is forgiving. Or at least distractible.
translation_zh(译文): 一种用于抵御入迷的根系仪式。传统做法是用指甲在紫杉根下挖掘，不过蛾很宽容。或者至少很容易分心。

source_text(原文): The Ordo Limiae, later called the Obliviates, often used this rite to cover their tracks, despite its inherent risk of Fascination.
translation_zh(译文): 利米亚教团——后来被称作遗忘者——常用这一仪式掩盖行迹，尽管它天然带有引发入迷的风险。

source_text(原文): Use Lantern influence to reduce Dread. This rite invokes the Madrugad - or her departing remnants, at least - so it'll always increase Fascination to some degree.
translation_zh(译文): 用灯之影响削减恐惧。此仪式祈请昕旦——或者至少是祂正在消散的残余——因此总会在某种程度上增加入迷。

source_text(原文): The walls of the House are the size of starlight.
translation_zh(译文): 居屋的墙壁，尺度与星光相同。

source_text(原文): Move through the dark angles and near superficies of the Bounds.
translation_zh(译文): 沿着边境的黑暗角度与近邻表面移动。

source_text(原文): Thirza Blake, Seventh Librarian of Hush House, used this bracingly practical rite to ease her joint pains and the stomach cramps caused by her ceaseless enthusiasm for apples.
translation_zh(译文): 噤声居屋第七任馆长瑟莎·布莱克用这套极为实用、令人精神一振的仪式缓解关节疼痛，以及她因永不停歇地热爱苹果而造成的胃痉挛。

source_text(原文): The story is that Solomon Husher would use this rite when he wished to leave no footprints. Husher was not a man to fear the Dread this rite sometimes provokes.
translation_zh(译文): 传说所罗门·赫舍希望不留下脚印时便会使用这一仪式。赫舍并不是会害怕此仪式偶尔引发之恐惧的人。

source_text(原文): An effective cure for Weariness, but it always brings at least a little pain in its wake.
translation_zh(译文): 治疗倦怠十分有效，但之后总会带来至少一点疼痛。
看法 - 塞纳克尔修士
看法 - 启明警探摩尔
看法 - J.N.·西诺姆布尔医生
看法 - 斯特拉斯科因

source_text(原文): A heart condition. I picked it up at the [[Stag Door]], while I was away. My heart goes first one way, then another. It is not to be relied on.
translation_zh(译文): 一种心脏状况。我离开世界期间，在[[牡鹿之门]]染上的。我的心一会儿朝这边，一会儿朝那边，根本靠不住。

source_text(原文): A heart condition. I picked it up at the [[Stag Door]], while I was away. My heart trembles with half-guessed desires, but it keeps me warm at night.
translation_zh(译文): 一种心脏状况。我离开世界期间，在[[牡鹿之门]]染上的。我的心因半猜中的欲望而颤抖，但夜里它会让我保持温暖。

source_text(原文): A heart condition. I picked it up at the [[Stag Door]], while I was away. My heart is heavy, but it always keeps me warm at night.
translation_zh(译文): 一种心脏状况。我离开世界期间，在[[牡鹿之门]]染上的。我的心很沉重，但夜里总会让我保持温暖。

source_text(原文): A heart condition. I picked it up at the [[Stag Door]], while I was away. My heart thunders with reckless bravery; but it keeps me warm at night.
translation_zh(译文): 一种心疾。是我离家期间在[[牡鹿之门]]染上的。我的心因鲁莽的勇猛而轰鸣;但它在夜里让我保持温暖。

source_text(原文): A heart condition. I picked it up at the [[Stag Door]], while I was away. My heart yearns to rise. Sometimes I think it might leave me behind.
translation_zh(译文): 一种心疾。是我离家期间在[[牡鹿之门]]染上的。我的心渴望升起。有时我觉得,它也许会抛下我独自离去。

source_text(原文): A heart condition. I picked it up at the [[Stag Door]], while I was away. My heart is achingly alive to unexpected directions; but it keeps me warm at night.
translation_zh(译文): 一种心疾。是我离家期间在[[牡鹿之门]]染上的。我的心对意想不到的方向怀着痛楚般的敏锐;但它在夜里让我保持温暖。

source_text(原文): A heart condition. I picked it up at the [[Stag Door]], while I was away. Sometimes my heart falters. Sometimes I feel the sting of its tender opening.
translation_zh(译文): 一种心疾。是我离家期间在[[牡鹿之门]]染上的。有时我的心会踌躇。有时,我感觉到它温柔开合时的那一缕刺痛。

source_text(原文): A heart condition. I picked it up at the [[Stag Door]], while I was away. My heart is sullen, furious, though it keeps me warm at night.
translation_zh(译文): 一种心疾。是我离家期间在[[牡鹿之门]]染上的。我的心阴沉而暴怒,尽管它在夜里让我保持温暖。

source_text(原文): A heart condition. I picked it up at the [[Stag Door]], while I was away. My heart is like a window banging in the storm - restless, undedicated, unconfinable.
translation_zh(译文): 一种心疾。是我离家期间在[[牡鹿之门]]染上的。我的心像风暴中砰砰作响的窗——躁动,无定,难拘束。
对任何人而言几乎必成
几乎没有任何挑战的简单测试
只需最低水准能力的基础挑战
需要一定技艺的标准挑战
需要全力以赴的重大挑战
对技艺要求苛刻的考验
未受训练:几乎不可能(约 1%)

source_text(原文): Really hard unless you're really good
translation_zh(译文): 若非真正好手,当真难如登天

source_text(原文): Reserved for climactic moments or special scenarios
translation_zh(译文): 专为高潮时刻或特殊情境保留

source_text(原文): Beyond mortal capability under normal circumstances
translation_zh(译文): 正常情况下超出凡人之力

source_text(原文):
Music, riddles, miscellanea. Half-remembered conversations, the fruits of gossip and eavesdropping.

One of the [[Arts Unconsidered]]; it can be used at Thresholds and Verdant Places.
translation_zh(译文):
音乐、谜语与杂学。依稀记得的交谈,闲言与窃听的果实。

属[[未识技艺]]之一;可用于门关与翠绿之地。

source_text(原文): The lore of the primaeval wood; rarely written, often felt. One of the [[Arts Unconsidered]], used in Verdant and Shadowed Places.
translation_zh(译文): 太古之林的学问;罕有书载,多为亲觉。属[[未识技艺]]之一,用于翠绿与幽影之地。

source_text(原文): I have the knack of being liked; and people who like me will often do things for me. Charm can make lies more plausible and pleas more effective. It's less useful if your listener is hostile, wary or duty-bound. [A [[Worldly Skill]].]
translation_zh(译文): 我有讨人喜欢的本事;喜欢我的人,往往愿意为我做事。 魅力能让谎话更可信,恳求更奏效。若听者心怀敌意、满腹戒心,或职责在身,它的用处就要打些折扣。 [一项[[世俗技艺]]。]

source_text(原文):
I can project an air of authority and respectability. Something I learnt in my time as a priest and as a medic.

[A [[Worldly Skill]].]
translation_zh(译文):
我能摆出权威而体面的派头。这是我当神父与行医时学到的东西。

[一项[[世俗技艺]]。]

source_text(原文):
I'm good with words. This can be useful when I want to explain to someone why they might want to help - or at least ensure they'll enjoy listening. It can also be useful for speed-reading, or spotting details like word choice and subtext.

[A [[Worldly Skill]].]
translation_zh(译文):
我擅长言辞。当我想向某人解释他们为何应当帮忙——或至少确保他们听得入耳时,这很有用。它也能用于速读,或留意遣词与言外之意之类的细节。

[一项[[世俗技艺]]。]

source_text(原文): The laws and contentions of the Hours and their emanations. Covers Church doctrine and to some extent technique, although technique is more usually [[Illumination]]. Like Illumination, it's a [[Bright Art]]. Used at Thresholds and in Holy Places.
translation_zh(译文): 司辰及其流溢之物的律法与纷争。涵盖教会教义,也部分涉及技法,尽管技法通常更归于[[照明术]]。与照明术一样,它是一门[[光之技艺]]。用于门关与圣洁之地。

source_text(原文): Aesthetics, necromancy, silence. A [[Night Art]] for Quiet and Shadowed Places.
translation_zh(译文): 美学、亡灵术与静默。一门用于静谧与幽影之地的[[夜之技艺]]。

source_text(原文):
Mystical exercises to purify and illuminate the self and its surroundings, discouraging undesirable influences and inducing desirable revelations.. [[Church]] practice and some doctrine, although doctrine is usually more [[Horomachistry]]. 


One of the [[Bright Arts]], it can be used in Holy and Quiet places.
translation_zh(译文):
净化并照亮自我与周遭的神秘修行,驱退不当之影响,招致所望之启示。属[[教会]]修行,兼及部分教义,尽管教义通常更归于[[司辰学]]。


属[[光之技艺]]之一,可用于圣洁与静谧之地。

source_text(原文):
'The art that alters' - alchemy, pyrotechnics, metallurgy.

One of the [[Bright Arts]], used at Hearths and in Holy Places. Ithastry can be used for any alchemy recipe, although at a slightly higher difficulty level than more specialist skills.
translation_zh(译文):
'改变之艺'——炼金、烟火、冶金。

属[[光之技艺]]之一,用于炉边与圣洁之地。盗火术可用于任何炼金配方,尽管难度略高于更专门化的技艺。

source_text(原文):
'Travelling at night is neither faster nor safer. That's why we do it.' - Christopher Illopoly

Knowledge of the ways and byways of the transmundane. One of the [[Night Arts]], usable at Thresholds and Wounds.
translation_zh(译文):
'夜行既不更快,也不更安全。正因如此,我们才夜行。'——克里斯托弗·伊洛波利

关于界外之境的通途与僻径的学问。属[[夜之技艺]]之一,可用于门关与受创之地。

source_text(原文):
I notice details others don't.

[A [[Worldly Skill]].]
translation_zh(译文):
我能注意到旁人忽略的细节。

[一项[[世俗技艺]]。]

source_text(原文):
Healing, restoration, curation. The most benign uses of the invisible arts - often the place where those uses overlap with worldly medicine.

One of the [[Arts Unconsidered]], used at Hearths and in Verdant Places.
translation_zh(译文):
疗愈、复原与看护。无形之艺中最良善的用途——往往也是与世俗医术交叠之处。

属[[未识技艺]]之一,用于炉边与翠绿之地。

source_text(原文):
The study of things that should not be studied: Worms, earthquakes, sub-real interventions.

One of the [[Night Arts]]; it can be used at Wounds and Shadowed Places.
translation_zh(译文):
对不应研究之物的研究:蠕虫、地震、亚现实干预。

属[[夜之技艺]]之一;可用于受创之地与幽影之地。

source_text(原文):
Knowledge of art, culture, life's finer material pleasures. The ability to pick up subtle references, or make clever ones. Though what for, exactly?

[This is the least useful [[Worldly Skill]], although it will, among other things, give Spencer some ability with languages other than the ones he speaks fluently - English, French and German.]
translation_zh(译文):
关于艺术、文化与生活中更精微的物质乐趣的学识。能捕捉精妙的指涉,也能信手拈来。不过,究竟图什么呢?

[这是最没用的一项[[世俗技艺]],尽管除此之外,它也会让斯宾塞对英、法、德之外的其他语言稍具能力。]

source_text(原文): I've hung around with disreputable people doing disreputable things. I might be able to find goods on the black market, and if I had to do something criminal, I'd have a good start. [A [[Worldly Skill]].]
translation_zh(译文): 我曾与声名狼藉之人厮混,做些见不得光的事。我或许能在黑市上寻到些货;若我不得不做点什么违法的事,也算开了个好头。 [一项[[世俗技艺]]。]

source_text(原文):
Performer's presence; legerdemain and magician's tricks.

[A [[Worldly Skill]].]
translation_zh(译文):
表演者的气场;手彩与魔术师的把戏。

[一项[[世俗技艺]]。]

source_text(原文): I told her I would find her husband... free of charge.
translation_zh(译文): 我告诉她,我会找到她的丈夫……分文不取。

source_text(原文): I agreed to find her husband... for the price of ten thousand francisques.
translation_zh(译文): 我答应为她寻找丈夫……代价是一万枚法兰西斧币。

source_text(原文): Jean-Bernard rather wistfully asked me to remember him to the  bookseller Andrée, who sells other things than books.
translation_zh(译文): 让-贝尔纳带着几分怅然,请我代他向书商安德烈问好——她除了书,还卖些别的东西。

source_text(原文): I gave Zèlia the letter from Max Mustermann. She seems convinced he is, indeed, her missing husband. A happy ending.
translation_zh(译文): 我把马克斯·穆斯特曼的信交给了泽莉亚。她似乎相信,他确实就是她失踪的丈夫。一个美满的结局。

source_text(原文): I've helped Father Jaume open the eyes of St Reparata.
translation_zh(译文): 我已帮助若梅神父,为圣雷帕拉塔开启了双眼。

source_text(原文): There may be information that will compel Aubière's assistance. Perhaps someone else in the Sanitarum can help me.
translation_zh(译文): 也许有某些情报,能让奥比埃不得不相助。疗养院里或许还有别人能帮我。
文森特如今知道我是'斯宾塞·霍布森'。

source_text(原文): The Ministries have not yet taken an interest in me.
translation_zh(译文): 联盟尚未对我产生兴趣。

source_text(原文): I've found what I need in Aubière's private records.
translation_zh(译文): 我已在奥比埃的私人记录里,找到了所需的东西。

source_text(原文): ...but I'm not sleeping. [To return to the daylight world, find a bed and sleep the last few hours.]
translation_zh(译文): ……但我没有睡着。[要回到日光之下的世界,找一张床,睡掉最后的几个小时。]

source_text(原文): I've told Father Jaume I can't help him open the eyes of the saint. He seems untroubled.
translation_zh(译文): 我已告诉若梅神父,我无法帮他开启圣人之眼。他似乎并不介怀。

source_text(原文): I declined, once I'd heard more about it.
translation_zh(译文): 听完详情之后,我便拒绝了。

source_text(原文): A Plan in the Journal has hints on how to do this.
translation_zh(译文): 日记里的计划,有关于如何做到的提示。

source_text(原文):
I'll need two things: an Influence with the Grail aspect, and something Sharp to shed my blood (a razor blade would do).


I can craft it at a Verdant Place - also, with Bosk 5, at a Shadowed Place; with Birdsong 5, at a Threshold; or with Preservation 5, at a Hearth.
translation_zh(译文):
我需要两样东西:一样带杯性相的影响,以及一件锋利之物,用来割破我的血(剃刀片就行)。


我可以在翠绿之地炼制它——丛林学达到 5 时,也可在幽影之地炼制;鸟鸣学达到 5 时,可在门关炼制;保存术达到 5 时,可在炉边炼制。
我拒绝了。此事非我所长。

source_text(原文): I need to read the scenario,  and satisfy a sceptical Monica that I can do this.
translation_zh(译文): 我需要读一读剧本,再让满腹狐疑的莫妮卡相信,我能胜任。

source_text(原文): Vincent left the Sanitarium with me.
translation_zh(译文): 文森特与我一同离开了疗养院。
西诺姆布尔已向我开口求助。

source_text(原文): I deceived Zèlia into believing that I'd enacted her revenge on Philomèle. She seemed satisfied - though also a little confused about exactly whom she had been revenged upon. In any case, she paid me.
translation_zh(译文): 我骗泽莉亚相信,我已替她向菲洛梅尔报了仇。她似乎很满意——尽管也有点糊涂,自己究竟向谁报了仇。无论如何,她付了钱。

source_text(原文): I've learnt that Nina Lagasse has left the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui. Someone here will know where she went.
translation_zh(译文): 我得知尼娜·拉加斯已离开今日疗养院。这里总有人知道她去了哪里。

source_text(原文): Nina has left the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui. Someone here will know where she went.
translation_zh(译文): 尼娜已离开今日疗养院。这里总有人知道她去了哪里。

source_text(原文): Father Jaume expressed his gratitude for my opening the eyes of St Reparata.
translation_zh(译文): 若梅神父对我开启圣雷帕拉塔之眼一事,表达了谢意。

source_text(原文): The Mansus has fallen, but we still dream. Dr Aubière must go somewhere to dream. A sufficiently skilled nyctodromist might follow him there - or perhaps there's another way.
translation_zh(译文): 漫宿已倾颓,但我们仍在做梦。奥比埃医生必然去了某处做梦。技艺足够精湛的夜游者,或许能循他而去——也许还有别的路。

source_text(原文): I've learnt what I needed from Dr A in his dream.
translation_zh(译文): 我在他的梦中,从 A 医生那里得知了我所需的一切。

source_text(原文): I've set my alarm clock for midnight.
Where does Dr Aubière keep his records? There should be something in there about Nina.
translation_zh(译文): 奥比埃医生把记录放在哪里?里面应当会有关于尼娜的东西。

source_text(原文): Zèlia came to believe that I wasn't the one she had summoned. Perhaps she was right.
translation_zh(译文): 泽莉亚渐渐相信,我并非她所召唤的那个人。或许,她是对的。

source_text(原文): Apparently Strathcoyne's semi-independent appendage has been nicknamed 'Annabelle'. Strathcoyne really doesn't like that. He's been led to believe that Dr Aubière is responsible for the nickname. Let to believe by me, as it happens.
translation_zh(译文): 看来,斯特拉斯科因那条半独立的附属肢体,被人起了个绰号叫'安娜贝尔'。斯特拉斯科因对此大为不悦。他已被引导着相信,这绰号出自奥比埃医生之手。而引导他的人,恰好是我。

source_text(原文): Nina is absent from the circus. But she's here, somewhere. 'In the woods.'
translation_zh(译文): 尼娜不在马戏团。但她就在这里,某处。'在树林里。'

source_text(原文): I know how to get into the hidden space at night.
translation_zh(译文): 我知道如何在夜里进入那处隐秘的空间。

source_text(原文): I've learnt that Aubière is accepting inducements from his residents to provide black market goods. He probably wouldn't want this to come out.
translation_zh(译文): 我已得知,奥比埃收受住院者的好处,为他们提供黑市货物。他多半不愿此事败露。

source_text(原文): Vincent still remembers me as 'Honoré Robichon' - the name I was using when we met in the Légion.
translation_zh(译文): 文森特仍记得我是'奥诺雷·罗比雄'——我们在军团相识时,我用的正是这个名字。

source_text(原文): Zèlia was satisfied with her revenge on Philomèle, though she seemed a little confused about exactly whom she had been revenged upon. In any case, she paid me.
translation_zh(译文): 泽莉亚对向菲洛梅尔复仇一事感到满意,尽管她似乎有点糊涂,自己究竟向谁报了仇。无论如何,她付了钱。

source_text(原文): Nina's trail leads to the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui, just outside Antibes.
translation_zh(译文): 尼娜的踪迹指向今日疗养院,就在昂蒂布城外。

source_text(原文): Vincent's asked me to do 'reconnaissance' for the Chaima situation
translation_zh(译文): 文森特请我为柴玛的事做'侦察'

source_text(原文): I'm going on stage again. It's been a while.
translation_zh(译文): 我要再次登台了。已隔了好些时候。

source_text(原文): I've finished everything I need tto do before I travel with Rosa Mundi.
translation_zh(译文): 与罗莎·蒙迪同行之前需要做的种种,我都已办妥。

source_text(原文): I've reached Mimata, and I've found Rosa Mundi.
translation_zh(译文): 我已抵达米玛塔,并找到了罗莎·蒙迪。

source_text(原文): Bessy's cooked another omelette. She always does.
translation_zh(译文): 贝茜又做了一只煎蛋卷。她总是如此。

source_text(原文): I added something to wither Philomèle.
translation_zh(译文): 我添了些东西,好让菲洛梅尔凋零。

source_text(原文): I'll need two things: an Influence with the Moth aspect, and a token of Necessity (a Ministries doli would work). With Nyctodromy 5, I can craft it at a Wound or Threshold. With Skolekosophy 5, I can craft it at a Wound or Shadowed Place. With Hushery 5, I can craft it at a Shadowed or a Quiet Place.
translation_zh(译文): 我需要两样东西:一样带蛾性相的影响,以及一件'必然'的信物(联盟的诈符也行)。 夜游术达到 5 时,我可以在受创之地或门关炼制。 蠕虫学达到 5 时,我可以在受创之地或幽影之地炼制。 静默术达到 5 时,我可以在幽影之地或静谧之地炼制。

source_text(原文): Strathcoyne has access to black market cigars. Was Aubière involved in their provision?
translation_zh(译文): 斯特拉斯科因能弄到黑市雪茄。奥比埃是否也参与了供应?

source_text(原文): Arun can help me get my papers in order to enter the Republic. Once that's done, I'll be ready to travel.
translation_zh(译文): 阿伦能帮我办妥入境共和国的证件。办妥之后,我便随时可以上路。

source_text(原文): I added something to cheer them up, with something else to wither Philomèle.
translation_zh(译文): 我添了些让他们振作的东西,又添了别的,去使菲洛梅尔凋零。

source_text(原文): I blighted Philomèle, completing Zèlia's revenge. I should return to the park and collect my payment.
translation_zh(译文): 我已使菲洛梅尔凋零,完成了泽莉亚的复仇。我该回到公园,收取报酬了。
我已拒绝帮助西诺姆布尔。

source_text(原文): The presence that calls itself 'Dr Sinombre' has offered to convey me to Aubière's dream, if I meet its requirements.
translation_zh(译文): 那个自称'西诺姆布尔医生'的存在提出,只要我满足它的条件,便把我送进奥比埃的梦中。

source_text(原文): The card-players Chez Felix asked for drinks...
translation_zh(译文): 费利克斯之家的牌友们要了酒水……

source_text(原文): Sinombre hasn't yet asked for help.
translation_zh(译文): 西诺姆布尔尚未开口求助。

source_text(原文): Dr Aubière declares he will tell me where to find Nina Lagasse, if I stay a few days at the Sanitarium.
translation_zh(译文): 奥比埃医生宣称,只要我在疗养院小住几日,便告诉我尼娜·拉加斯在哪里。

source_text(原文): Dr Aubière declares he will tell me where to find Nina, if I stay a few days at the Sanitarium and attend sessions with him. Aubière, however, has already reneged on one arrangement. There are likely other possibilities at the Sanitarium to winkle the information out.
translation_zh(译文): 奥比埃医生宣称,只要我在疗养院住上几天、参加他的诊疗,他就告诉我尼娜的去向。然而,奥比埃已经食言过一次。疗养院里大概还有别的办法,能把消息撬出来。

source_text(原文): Nina agreed to introduce me to something that could tell me where to find the graves of the Hours... in exchange for a single unspecified future service.
translation_zh(译文): 尼娜答应引我去见一个能告诉我司辰之墓所在的东西……作为交换,是将来一桩尚未言明的效劳。

source_text(原文): Captain Torgue will tell me what I need to know.
translation_zh(译文): 托尔格船长会告诉我需要知道的事。

source_text(原文): I agreed to Zèlia's request. I could fulfil it - or try to deceive her
translation_zh(译文): 我答应了泽莉亚的请求。我既可以履行——也可以设法骗过她

source_text(原文):
I agreed to Zèlia's request. I could fulfil it - or try to deceive her.

[Create a Wither item with an Unworldly Art, and find an opportunity to taint Philomèle's food or drink. Or just speak with Philomèle, then return to Zèlia and pretend you did as she asked.]
translation_zh(译文):
我答应了泽莉亚的请求。我既可以履行——也可以设法骗过她。

[用一门非世之艺炼成一件凋零之物,再找个机会,在菲洛梅尔的食物或饮料里做手脚。或者,干脆与菲洛梅尔谈谈,然后回到泽莉亚面前,假装你已照她说的做了。]

source_text(原文): A Wakeful Eye can [[Hallow]] or [[Unveil]] - unlocking conversation choices that require those Aspects. It'll also give a bonus to Skills when placed in an Active slot. Be careful - whatever you do with it, it's a one-use item.
translation_zh(译文): 警醒之眼可以[[祝圣]]或[[揭示]]——解锁需要对应性相的对话选项。放入活跃栏位时,它还会为技艺提供加成。当心——无论你拿它做什么,这都是件一次性物品。

source_text(原文): Father Jaume has asked for my assistance in 'opening the eyes' of St Reparata.
translation_zh(译文): 若梅神父请我协助,为圣雷帕拉塔「睁开眼睛」。

source_text(原文): Apparently Strathcoyne's semi-independent appendage has been nicknamed 'Annabelle'.
translation_zh(译文): 显然,斯特拉斯科因那半独立的附属肢体,被起了个「安娜贝尔」的绰号。

source_text(原文): Apparently Strathcoyne's semi-independent appendage has been nicknamed 'Annabelle'. Strathcoyne really doesn't like that.
translation_zh(译文): 显然,斯特拉斯科因那半独立的附属肢体,被起了个「安娜贝尔」的绰号。斯特拉斯科因对此十分不悦。

source_text(原文): Dr Aubière keeps his records in a secret office behind the public one. I'll need to get in there after dark.
translation_zh(译文): 奥比埃医生把档案保存在公事办公室后面的密室里。我得在天黑之后溜进去。

source_text(原文): I repaid my debt to Sinombre.
translation_zh(译文): 我还清了欠西诺姆布尔的债。
偷走了斯特拉斯科因的一些丘吉尔型。

source_text(原文): I agreed to find her husband... for the price of one hundred THOUSAND francisques.
translation_zh(译文): 我答应替她寻找丈夫……代价是十万法兰西斧币。

source_text(原文): I gave Zèlia the letter from Topsy Juliusz. She seems convinced he is, indeed, her missing husband. A happy ending.
translation_zh(译文): 我把托普西·尤利乌什的信交给了泽莉亚。她似乎确信,他的确就是她失踪的丈夫。一个圆满的结局。

source_text(原文): I agreed to find her husband... for the price of one thousand francisques.
translation_zh(译文): 我答应替她寻找丈夫……代价是一千法兰西斧币。

source_text(原文): Everyone got what they merited, probably.
translation_zh(译文): 每个人都得到了应得的下场,大概吧。

source_text(原文): I gave Zèlia the letter from Maître Argant. She seems convinced it is, indeed, her missing husband. A happy ending.
translation_zh(译文): 我把阿尔冈大律师的信交给了泽莉亚。她似乎确信,那的确就是她失踪的丈夫。一个圆满的结局。

source_text(原文): I've managed to enter Aubière's secret office.
translation_zh(译文): 我成功潜入了奥比埃的密室。

source_text(原文): I added something to cheer them up.
translation_zh(译文): 我加了点东西,好让他们提提神。

source_text(原文): I told Aubière where he could put his offer. But I can probably find someone else here who can help me find Nina Lagasse.
translation_zh(译文): 我告诉奥比埃,他的提议该滚到哪儿去。但我大概还能在这里找到别人,帮我找到尼娜·拉加斯。

source_text(原文): Dr Aubière declared he would tell me where to find Nina, if I stayed a few days at the Sanitarium and attended sessions with him. Aubière, however, has already reneged on one arrangement, so I told him to go to hell. There are likely other possibilities at the Sanitarium to winkle the information out. Or I could meet with him anyway, and see what he might let slip
translation_zh(译文): 奥比埃医生声称,只要我在疗养院多留几天、陪他参加几次疗程,他就告诉我尼娜在哪里。然而,奥比埃已经背弃过一次约定,所以我叫他滚蛋。疗养院里大概还有别的法子,能把消息撬出来。或者,我也可以照旧去见他,看看他会漏出什么口风。

source_text(原文): I know where to find Nina Lagasse. I don't need to risk snooping around in Dr A's records.
translation_zh(译文): 我知道去哪里找尼娜·拉加斯了。不必再冒险翻查 A 医生的档案。

source_text(原文):
I'll need two things: an Influence with the Lantern aspect, and a token of Authority (an Incorporate dollar would do).


I can craft it at a Holy Place - also, with Horomachistry 5, at a Threshold; with Illumination 5, at a Quiet Place; or with Ithastry 5, at a Hearth.
translation_zh(译文):
我需要两样东西:一份带有灯性相的影响,以及一枚权威凭证(一枚集团美元就行)。


我可以在圣地炼制它——同样,司辰学 5 时可在门关,照明术 5 时可在幽静之地,盗火术 5 时可在炉边。

source_text(原文): I've completed my first performance with the Rosa Mundi! I should speak to Torgue again.
translation_zh(译文): 我与罗莎·蒙迪的首场演出已经完成!我该再去见托尔格一面。

source_text(原文): Nina Lagasse travels with a circus named 'Rosa Mundi.' They were due to perform in Mimata.
translation_zh(译文): 尼娜·拉加斯随一个名为「罗莎·蒙迪」的马戏团旅行。他们本该在米玛塔演出。

source_text(原文): She travels with a circus named 'Rosa Mundi.' They were due to perform in Mimata, among the mountains and gorges of Lozère.
translation_zh(译文): 她随一个名为「罗莎·蒙迪」的马戏团旅行。他们本该在米玛塔演出——就在洛泽尔的群山与峡谷之间。

source_text(原文): Linou suggested that I should mention her name to the bookseller Andrée, who sells other things than books.
translation_zh(译文): 利努建议我向书商安德烈提起她的名字——那位安德烈,除了书,还卖些别的东西。

source_text(原文): I've determined that I'll wake at midnight.
translation_zh(译文): 我已决定,自己会在午夜醒来。

source_text(原文): Philomèle asked me to convey her compliments to the bookseller Andrée, who sells other things than books.
translation_zh(译文): 菲洛梅尔托我向书商安德烈转达问候——那位安德烈,除了书,还卖些别的东西。

source_text(原文): The presence that calls itself 'Dr Sinombre' is ready to convey me to Dr Aubière's dream when I next sleep.
translation_zh(译文): 那个自称「西诺姆布尔医生」的存在已经准备好,待我下次入睡时,把我送入奥比埃医生的梦境。

source_text(原文): Nothing remains of this omelette, but there'll be another in time.
translation_zh(译文): 这份煎蛋卷已什么都不剩,但时候一到,还会有另一份。

source_text(原文): Come back to the Sanitarium after travelling, and there'll be another omelette. There's always another omelette.
translation_zh(译文): 旅行之后回到疗养院,就还会有另一份煎蛋卷。煎蛋卷总会有下一份。

source_text(原文): Leopold declared that his name will open the door to the bookseller Andrée's 'quieter business'.
translation_zh(译文): 莱奥波德宣称,他的名字能打开书商安德烈那「更安静的生意」之门。
满怀怨气地,搁在钢琴上。

source_text(原文): Torgue wants me to give Chaima the news about changed sleeping arrangements.
translation_zh(译文): 托尔格要我把睡觉安排有变的消息告诉柴玛。
经理:梅德亚·贾帕里泽夫人。

source_text(原文): I've used my nyctodromist's skills to enter Dr A's dream.
translation_zh(译文): 我运用夜游术士的技艺,进入了 A 医生的梦境。

source_text(原文): A Midnight Mark can [[Quell]] or [[Wither]] - unlocking conversation choices that require those Aspects. It'll also give a bonus to Skills when placed in an Active slot. Be careful - whatever you do with it, it's a one-use item.
translation_zh(译文): 午夜印记可以[[镇伏]]或[[凋零]]——解锁需要这些性相的对话选项。放入活跃栏位时,它还会为技艺提供加成。小心——无论你拿它做什么,它都是一次性物品。

source_text(原文): I've learnt where to look for Nina Lagasse. I have no need to pester Dr A in his dreams.
translation_zh(译文): 我已经知道该去哪里寻找尼娜·拉加斯了。没有必要再到梦里纠缠 A 医生。

source_text(原文): I already have the information I need about Nina. There is no reason to coerce Dr A.
translation_zh(译文): 关于尼娜,我需要的消息已经到手。没有理由再去逼迫 A 医生。

source_text(原文): I've followed Nina to the city of Antibes, in the French State - the southern half of divided France.
translation_zh(译文): 我一路跟随尼娜,来到法兰西邦国的昂蒂布城——分裂的法国,南边的那一半。

source_text(原文): Zèlia wants to know if I'm the 'signaire' she tried to summon.
translation_zh(译文): 泽莉亚想知道,我是不是她试图召唤的那个「符师」。

source_text(原文): I've made a useful connection with the bookseller Andrée, and can buy her other wares.
translation_zh(译文): 我与书商安德烈搭上了一条有用的门路,如今可以买她的其他货品了。
没动斯特拉斯科因的丘吉尔型。
舒舒服服地,搁在沙发上。

source_text(原文): A Witch's Knot can [[Bewitch]] or [[Entwine]] - unlocking conversation choices that require those Aspects. It'll also give a bonus to Skills when placed in an Active slot. Be careful - whatever you do with it, it's a one-use item.
translation_zh(译文): 女巫结可以[[蛊惑]]或[[缠绕]]——解锁需要这些性相的对话选项。放入活跃栏位时,它还会为技艺提供加成。小心——无论你拿它做什么,它都是一次性物品。

source_text(原文): I found Nina! She'll help me... if I bring her the name of the nun at the Couvent Saint-Mamert de Raveline who is with child.
translation_zh(译文): 我找到尼娜了!她会帮我……只要我带给她一个名字:拉韦林的圣马梅尔修道院里,那位怀有身孕的修女的名字。

source_text(原文):
I agreed to consider Zèlia's request. This means I could fulfil it, ignore it, or try to deceive her.

[Create a Wither item with an Unworldly Art, and find an opportunity to taint Philomèle's food or drink. Or speak with Philomèle, then return to Zèlia and pretend you did as she asked. Or just move on.]
translation_zh(译文):
我答应考虑泽莉亚的请求。这意味着,我可以成全它,可以无视它,也可以设法欺骗她。

[用一门非尘世技艺炼制一件凋零之物,再找个机会,在菲洛梅尔的食物或饮品里动手脚。或者,先与菲洛梅尔谈谈,再回到泽莉亚面前,假装已照她所托行事。或者,干脆就此作罢。]

source_text(原文): Aubière submitted to my blackmail - with surprising grace.
translation_zh(译文): 奥比埃屈从了我的敲诈——带着出人意料的从容。

source_text(原文): I could use my Unworldly skills to enter Aubière's dream and learn his secret. [Use Nyctodromy, Ithastry or Bosk to craft Labrikon, and take it to bed.]
translation_zh(译文): 我可以用非尘世技艺进入奥比埃的梦境,探知他的秘密。[用夜游术、盗火术或丛林学炼制拉布里孔,然后带着它入睡。]

source_text(原文): A gentleman does not go out into the street while wearing his dressing-gown unless the house is on fire. Even a dressing-gown as elegant as this dressing-gown.
translation_zh(译文): 一位绅士不会穿着晨衣上街,除非房子着了火。即便是这样一件优雅的晨衣,也不例外。

source_text(原文): In sorrowful spasms, the hands twitch backwards. Since the War in the Sun, few clocks in Europe keep meaningful time.
translation_zh(译文): 指针在哀恸的痉挛中向后抽动。自太阳之战以来,欧洲已少有钟表守着有意义的时间。

source_text(原文):
Everything too battered or difficult or unfashionable
to be seen in the sanitarium - it goes in here,
 tidied away so Aubière never has to think about it.
translation_zh(译文):
一切过于破旧、过于棘手、过于不时兴,
不便在疗养院示人的东西——都收进这里,
 拾掇停当,好让奥比埃永远不必再想起它们。

source_text(原文):
A cracked mirror, not discarded but kept here,
in this chamber of concealed business.
translation_zh(译文): 一面破裂的镜子,没有丢弃,而是收在这间藏着不可告人之事的密室里。

source_text(原文): A Matisse? Yes; it's signed. The subject is clearly someone he desired; or at least loved. Perhaps only someone he had to follow?
translation_zh(译文): 一幅马蒂斯?是的,上面有签名。画中人显然是他渴望过的什么人;至少,是他爱过的。也许,只是他不得不追随的什么人?

source_text(原文): An Aaron Douglas woodcut of O'Neill's 'Emperor Jones'. I remember the play. The rebels killed Jones with a silver bullet; but he'd been a rebel too, in the beginning.
translation_zh(译文): 亚伦·道格拉斯的一幅木刻版画,取材自奥尼尔的《琼斯皇》。我记得这出戏。叛军们用银子弹打死了琼斯;但最初,他也曾是个叛军。

source_text(原文): 'Frida Kahlo'. I hadn't heard of her. Is this a self-portrait? That face painted on her brow. Does he rule her? Or has she captured him?
translation_zh(译文): 「弗里达·卡罗」。我没听说过她。这是自画像吗?她眉间画着的那张脸。是他支配着她?还是她俘获了他?

source_text(原文): Adolph Gottlieb, 'Sleep Mask'. I remember a Bureau notice about Gottlieb, before the war. He was beginning to use the imagery of proscribed dreams.
translation_zh(译文): 阿道夫·戈特利布,《睡梦面具》。我记得战前防剿局有一份关于戈特利布的通报。他那时已开始运用被查禁之梦的意象。

source_text(原文): Deadeningly tasteful, visibly expensive. So that's how it is here.
translation_zh(译文): 沉闷乏味的雅致,明摆着的昂贵。原来这里是这样。

source_text(原文): The hands rotate lazily, like circling dragonflies. Since the Wars, clocks have grown unhelpful.
translation_zh(译文): 指针懒洋洋地转着,像盘旋的蜻蜓。战争之后,钟表已帮不上什么忙。

source_text(原文): Who lights a fire in weather like this? Does Strathcoyne need warmth since his changes began? Or has someone been disposing of evidence?
translation_zh(译文): 这样的天气,谁会生火?斯特拉斯科因的变化开始之后,他需要温暖了吗?抑或,是有人在销毁证据?

source_text(原文): The hands quiver desperately, as if trying to break free of this moment. Twelve division-marks watch hungrily. The Wars were hard on clocks.
translation_zh(译文): 指针绝望地颤抖着,仿佛要挣脱这一刻。十二道刻度贪婪地注视着。战争对钟表并不友善。

source_text(原文):
Night in Antibes. Nothing out there for me until morning. 
Except, if I were really unlucky, spidermist.
translation_zh(译文):
昂蒂布的夜晚。天亮之前,外面没有我要找的东西。
除非我当真倒霉,碰上蛛雾。

source_text(原文): Westergren, the Lantern-long that at the Bureau we used to call the Diarist. As I recall, we were hunting Westergren back in the Twenties - but someone else got to him first.
translation_zh(译文): 韦斯特格伦,那个灯之长生者,防剿局过去叫他「日记人」。我记得,二十年代我们就在追捕韦斯特格伦——但有人先一步得手了。

source_text(原文): Neatly made, but patched with undisturbed lichen. It must have been weeks at least since anyone slept in these sheets.
translation_zh(译文): 铺得整整齐齐,却打着无人惊扰的苔藓补丁。至少有好几个星期,没人睡过这床单了。

source_text(原文): An early Renoir? The scent of flowers also hangs in the hall...
translation_zh(译文): 一幅早期的雷诺阿?花香也在厅堂里萦绕……

source_text(原文): In every light the petals glow.
translation_zh(译文): 无论何种光线,花瓣都泛着微光。

source_text(原文): Fibres clogged with mud and vegetable matter.
translation_zh(译文): 纤维间塞满了泥浆与植物碎屑。

source_text(原文):
Jacob Lawrence.
Choking on they went
to iron future radiant
translation_zh(译文):
雅各布·劳伦斯。
他们呛咳着继续前行,
走向铁铸的灼亮未来

source_text(原文):
Louis Bellon.
Sunset-red roofs
above grape-bowed vines.
translation_zh(译文):
路易·贝隆。
落日绯红的屋顶,
悬于被葡萄压弯的藤蔓之上

source_text(原文):
Louis Bellon.
Golden hills watchful
through slow-sighing cypress.
translation_zh(译文):
路易·贝隆。
金色的山丘凝神守望,
透过缓缓叹息的柏树

source_text(原文):
Norman Lewis.
Everything and more
joys the arteries.
translation_zh(译文):
诺曼·刘易斯。
一切,乃至更多,
令血脉欢愉

source_text(原文): I've only seen these roses since the Wars. 'Magpie roses', I hear them called. 'The skewbald rose'. Or 'dappled'.
translation_zh(译文): 战争之后,我才见过这种玫瑰。我听人叫它们「喜鹊玫瑰」,或者「花斑玫瑰」、「斑驳玫瑰」。

source_text(原文):
An empty room - Nina's old room -
mine, now. I'm getting closer.
translation_zh(译文):
一间空荡荡的房间——尼娜从前的房间——
如今是我的了。我越来越近了。

source_text(原文): Whatever passes in front of this mirror, it displays only a shoulder of black rock between a scattering of snow. Sight, sense, and light are all sometime casualties of the Wars.
translation_zh(译文): 无论什么东西从这面镜子前经过,它都只映出散雪之间的一道黑岩山肩。视觉、感官与光,都曾是战争的罹难者。
格里斯特伍德立体小玩意儿

source_text(原文): The Church denies that the Forge of Days split the Sun. Most adepts reject their denial. Converts two Lantern Memories to one Forge Memory, with an existing Winter Memory as a catalyst.
translation_zh(译文): 教会否认白日铸炉劈裂了太阳。多数修士都不信教会的否认。 将两条灯之回忆转化为一条铸之回忆,以一条已有的冬之回忆作为催化。

source_text(原文): AK-COPY: Something went wrong — try again.
translation_zh(译文): AK-COPY:出了点差错——请再试一次。

source_text(原文): 'Our company it was that shattered it,' Ghirbi says suddenly. He begins again to weep his molten tears... -- Conversations at the Stag Door
translation_zh(译文): 「打碎它的,正是我们这一众,」吉比尔忽然说道。他再一次流下熔融的泪…… ——出自《牡鹿之门闲谈》
门关军团军医中尉(已退役)

source_text(原文): Increase Skills, or buy new ones, with Experiences that match Skill Aspects.
translation_zh(译文): 用与技艺性相匹配的经验来提升技艺,或购买新的技艺。

translation_zh(译文): AK-COPY: 将此游戏链接到你的历史

source_text(原文): AK-COPY: Histories isn't open yet — try again later.
translation_zh(译文): AK-COPY: 历史尚未开启——请稍后再试。

translation_zh(译文): 要更换行头,请寻找衣橱区域。
AK-COPY: 请在约 1 小时内输入。

translation_zh(译文): 入场要求:至少符合下列之一…
当前化名: 斯宾塞·霍布森先生

source_text(原文): Extremely dangerous quadruped, known for snortling, truffle- snouting and a billious dislike of cheese. “I am fond of pigs. Dogs look up to us. Cats look down on us. Pigs treat us as equals.” — Winston Churchill
translation_zh(译文): 极其危险的四足兽,以喷鼻息、拱掘松露和对奶酪的深恶痛绝而闻名。 「我喜欢猪。狗仰视我们,猫俯视我们,猪以平辈待我们。」——温斯顿·丘吉尔

source_text(原文): “Work, Family, Homeland.” When the Republic fell, the rump government in the south joined forces with the Enemy, preserving a kind of independence as l’Etat Francais. As the Enemy retreated, the State joined instead with the Allies, to preserve its indepennce again. And so poor France is sundered still, with Darlan and De Gaulle the bitterest enemies.
translation_zh(译文): 「劳动、家庭、祖国。」共和国倾覆后,南方残余政府与敌人联手,以法兰西国的名号保住了某种独立。敌人退却后,邦国又转而与盟友结盟,再次保住了自身的独立。于是可怜的法国至今仍被割裂,达尔朗与戴高乐成了最不共戴天的仇敌。

source_text(原文): Spend Experiences to increase Passions or gain new ones - as long as  your actions fit those Passions.
translation_zh(译文): 消耗经验以提升激情,或获得新的激情——只要你的行动契合这些激情即可。

source_text(原文): You are skilled enough for this recipe… but only with Hushery in a <sprite="VenueImages" name="quietplace"> Quiet Place or <sprite="VenueImages" name="shadowedplace"> Shadowed Place
translation_zh(译文): 你的技艺足以应付此配方……但只有身处<sprite="VenueImages" name="quietplace">安静之地或<sprite="VenueImages" name="shadowedplace">幽暗之地施展静默术时才可。

source_text(原文): AK-COPY: Get a code, then enter it on the website within ~1 hour.
translation_zh(译文): AK-COPY: 获取代码,然后在约 1 小时内于网站上输入。

translation_zh(译文): 将这些性相提供给性相池

source_text(原文): This is a good message. Spencer can enter the country because he is a nice boy.
translation_zh(译文): 这是一条好消息。斯宾塞可以入境,因为他是个好孩子。

source_text(原文): Spencer will gain +6 [IMG] travelling by this route.
translation_zh(译文): 斯宾塞将沿此路线旅行,获得 +6 [IMG]。

source_text(原文): Usually brief description that sometimes goes to  multiple lines
translation_zh(译文): 通常是简短的描述,有时会延续到多行。

translation_zh(译文): Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet foo bar lipseum oftem nah. 好莱坞又过了有趣的一年:死侍与金刚狼对决,布莱克·莱弗利和贾斯汀·巴尔多尼互相起诉,《头脑特工队 2》称霸票房,《小丑》续集连边都沾不上。
防剿局侦探兼司阍(已免职)

source_text(原文): Xhe travels with a carnival named 'Rosa Mundi'. They were due to perform in Mimata, among the mountains and gorges of Lozere. I've informally discharged myself from the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui, and I'm on my way there now.
translation_zh(译文): 她随一个名为「罗莎·蒙迪」的嘉年华同行。他们本应在米玛塔演出,那地方地处洛泽尔的群山与峡谷之间。我已非正式地从今日疗养院离院,如今正赶往那里。

source_text(原文): It is imperative that Thunderpigs are given the attention they deserve. In fact, they should be given so much attention that they can't even snootle about in a trough without someone livestreaming it to PigTok.
translation_zh(译文): 雷猪理应得到它们应得的关注,这一点至关重要。事实上,它们应当得到如此之多的关注,以至于连在水槽边拱来拱去都有人把它直播到猪抖上。

source_text(原文): Xs my heart's explained to me: I must find Nina Lagasse.
translation_zh(译文): 正如我的心向我解释的那样:我必须找到尼娜·拉加斯。

source_text(原文): Your Signs and Passions feed the Aspect Pool. Spend pips to force success on matching Skill tests. Regain them by acting with Passions.
translation_zh(译文): 你的印记与激情汇入性相池。消耗圆点,即可让相符的技艺检定必然成功。依激情行事,即可重新获得圆点。

source_text(原文): Thank you to everyone who helped us get here! Whether you wishlisted the game or left a nice comment somewhere or told a friend about Travelling, thank you. Super thank you to everyone who's helping us test the game and sending us feedback, too.
translation_zh(译文): 感谢每一位帮助我们走到今天的人！无论你是把游戏加入愿望单、在某个地方留下善意的评论，还是把 Travelling 推荐给朋友，谢谢你们。也特别感谢所有正在帮我们测试游戏、并把反馈寄给我们的人。

source_text(原文): GET THE NEWSLETTER - Subscribe for the invisible world in your inbox. Be the first to know about new lore and game releases.
translation_zh(译文): 订阅邮件——把隐形世界送进你的收件箱。抢先了解新秘闻与游戏动态。

source_text(原文): Subscribe for the invisible world in your inbox. Be the first to know about new lore and game releases.
translation_zh(译文): 订阅，把隐形世界送进你的收件箱。抢先了解新秘闻与游戏动态。

source_text(原文): Can we collect pseudonymised data about choices you make in the game? We'll use it to refine the game, and perhaps for Entertaining Blog Posts about choice statistics. By pseudonymised, we mean: there's a unique id for each install - but we don't do anything to tie it to a natural person (you) unless you let us link it to bug reports. [Change this at any time via Options]
translation_zh(译文): 我们可以收集你在游戏中做出的选择的假名化数据吗？我们会用这些数据来打磨游戏，或许还会用来写些关于选择统计的趣味博文。 所谓假名化，是指：每次安装都有一个唯一 ID——但我们不会做任何把它与某个自然人（你）关联起来的事，除非你允许我们把它与缺陷报告联系起来。 [随时可通过「选项」更改此设置]

source_text(原文):
Antibes, Alpes-Maritimes. November 1948; at least as far as anyone can tell any more.

	Twelve years ago, in Cracow, the Worms hollowed me out. For the next three years they steered me all round Europe, until at last I got away to a place where there was a kind of help... the Worms are gone now, but I've only begun to fill up the spaces they left.

	I was back with the Bureau again when the Worms took me. But I still think of myself, above all, as...
translation_zh(译文):
昂蒂布，滨海阿尔卑斯省。1948 年 11 月；至少就如今而言，没人能说清更多了。

	十二年前，在克拉科夫，蠕虫把我蛀空。此后三年，它们操纵我辗转欧洲各地，直到我终于逃到一处能寻得某种帮助的地方……如今蠕虫已经消失，但我才刚刚开始填补它们留下的空洞。

	蠕虫带走我时，我又回到了防剿局。但我依然首先把自己看作……

source_text(原文):
When I came back to Europe after the war, my heart told me I should seek out Nina Lagasse: actress, artist, witch. She'll know where I can find the things I need to fill my emptiness again.

	Nina is notoriously elusive, but I've followed her trail from Alexandria - where they brought me back - to Antibes - where I now arrive -
translation_zh(译文):
战争结束后我回到欧洲，我的心告诉我，应该去找尼娜·拉加斯：演员、艺术家、女巫。她会知道我在哪里能找到重新填补空虚的东西。

	尼娜素以行踪难觅著称，但我一路追着她的踪迹，从亚历山大港——他们把我送回的地方——追到昂蒂布——如今我抵达的地方——

source_text(原文): lorem ipsum dolor sit amet. This will be long. at least two paragraphs. A much softer version of the circus theme - perhaps just fragments that fade in and out. The idea is that you hear this when you're out and about in the main circus site, so you get a sense of pleasantly melancholy familiarity every time you come back to the circus - which serves as your base - but when you enter a tent, it can become focal.

The idea is that you hear this when you're out and about in the main circus site, so you get a sense of pleasantly melancholy familiarity every time you come back to the circus - which serves as your base - but when you enter a tent, it can become focal.

source_text(原文): “What kind of polyglot genius could ever hope to crack your impenetrable code?”
translation_zh(译文): 「什么样的多语天才，才敢奢望破解你那密不透风的密码？」

source_text(原文): It was the worst of times; it was the worst of times. Remind myself of that.
translation_zh(译文): 那是最坏的时代；那是最坏的时代。提醒自己记住这一点。

source_text(原文): I think sometimes that I will never look upon the sea without that memory surfacing like a shark - that memory of the knives of Ys.
translation_zh(译文): 我有时想，自己再也无法看海而不让那段记忆像鲨鱼一样浮出水面——那段关于伊苏之刀的回忆。

source_text(原文): A proud declaration of the State's struggle against immortality and corruption. Chez Feliz is the latest corrupt establishment to face the axe's edge.
translation_zh(译文): 邦国向长生与腐败宣战的自豪宣言。费利克斯之家是最近一个面临斧刃的腐败场所。

source_text(原文): Coronal grace whispers from the stone. An Incorporate has marked this place.
translation_zh(译文): 冕的恩典自石中低语。集团成员在此留下印迹。

source_text(原文): An unfamiliar model of Peugeot. Scrupulously clean, and empty as a showroom model.
translation_zh(译文): 一辆陌生的标致车型。一尘不染，空得像展厅里的展车。

source_text(原文): They've kept this cicatrix under control, but it doesn't look as if it's getting any better. Likely it discolours the wallpaper, inside. Residents often develop sympathetic marks of their own.
translation_zh(译文): 他们把这处疤痕控制住了，但它看起来并没有好转的迹象。屋里大约连墙纸都被染变了色。住户们身上往往也会长出相应的印记。

source_text(原文): A stately, gleaming Citroën. The Bureau used this model, back before the War. A fine lambswool scarf lies crumpled on the passenger seat.
translation_zh(译文): 一辆庄重锃亮的雪铁龙。战争之前，防剿局用的就是这款车。副驾驶座上，一条上好的羔羊毛围巾皱巴巴地堆着。

source_text(原文): One of those daft little Citroëns one sees everywhere now. In the back seat, an umbrella with a striking black-white plaid pattern.
translation_zh(译文): 如今到处都能见到的那种傻里傻气的小雪铁龙。后座上放着一把黑白格纹醒目扎眼的雨伞。

source_text(原文): Sweet scents do nothing to sweeten the mood of the woman sitting opposite.
translation_zh(译文): 甜腻的香气丝毫不能缓和对面那位女士的心情。

source_text(原文): The rain's perked up these flowers, at least.
translation_zh(译文): 至少，这场雨让这些花精神起来了。

source_text(原文): Saw this in '37, the year before I went away. The Worms gave me what you might call an afternoon off, and I sat in the cinema, watching our heroes cross the border into Switzerland... that's when I started to plan my own escape.
translation_zh(译文): 三十七年看过这部片子，那是我离开的前一年。蠕虫给了我一个可以称之为放假的下午，我坐在电影院里，看着我们的英雄越过边境进入瑞士……就在那时，我开始筹划自己的出逃。

source_text(原文): An optimist would say: Europe's still healing. Others would say: Europe's taking its time to die.
translation_zh(译文): 乐观者会说：欧洲仍在愈合。另一些人会说：欧洲正慢条斯理地走向死亡。

source_text(原文): Elegance. The other face of poise.

translation_zh(译文): 银色的水面，闪烁的日光。

source_text(原文): The rain's only half-erased the chalk. The bookshop owner must have re-lettered it just this morning. A determined soul.
translation_zh(译文): 雨水只擦掉了一半粉笔字。书店老板准是今天早上刚刚重新描过。真是个执着的人。

source_text(原文): A chilly stream of clear water competes against the rain. It's losing.
translation_zh(译文): 一道冰凉清澈的水流与雨水较劲。它正在输。

source_text(原文): Bright water in the Riviera sun. There's plashery afoot.
translation_zh(译文): 蔚蓝海岸阳光下波光粼粼的水。有人正在戏水。

source_text(原文): A NO PARKING sign directly between two parked cars. Darlan's grip is not irresistible.
translation_zh(译文): 一块「禁止停车」标牌，正夹在两辆停着的车之间。达尔朗的掌控并非无懈可击。

source_text(原文): Elegant ladies preen, elegant gentlemen cavort. More elegant ladies, some pulp Westerns, further elegant ladies, blood-drenched tales of Parisian crime, and one more particularly splendid lady with particularly splendid hair.
translation_zh(译文): 优雅的女士们搔首弄姿，优雅的先生们嬉笑玩闹。更多的优雅女士，一些廉价西部小说，再一些优雅女士，巴黎罪案的血腥故事，还有一位格外出众的女士，顶着一头格外出众的头发。

source_text(原文): Alexandria, Istanbul, Sofia, Belgrade, Trieste, Milan, Antibes... not an easy journey. They'd dynamited the pass at Ras en-Naqura, and I had to slip across the border at night in a gun-runner's jeep.
translation_zh(译文): 亚历山大港、伊斯坦布尔、索菲亚、贝尔格莱德、的里雅斯特、米兰、昂蒂布……不是一趟轻松的旅程。他们在纳库拉角炸毁了山口，我只好坐着一辆走私军火的吉普车，趁夜溜过边境。

source_text(原文): Poise. The other face of elegance.
'You can get quite a nice sandwich on the black market' was perhaps not the intended reading.
translation_zh(译文): 「你可以在黑市上买到一块相当不错的三明治」大概不是这句话的本意。
重大事件（悬停查看详情）

source_text(原文): This is the worst photograph never taken by a human being. It could be a boat. It could be a pig. It could be the inside of a pig. It could be the inside of a pig inside a boat. It could, in fact, be a photograph taken not by a human at all, but by a pig, perhaps from inside another pig.
translation_zh(译文): 这是从未被人类拍过的最糟糕的照片。它可能是一条船。可能是一头猪。可能是猪的肚子。可能是船里一头猪的肚子。事实上，它可能根本不是人类拍的，而是一头猪拍的，也许还是从另一头猪的肚子里拍的。

source_text(原文): The Rue Racine is deserted. The rain? A curfew? Or some nastier reason?
translation_zh(译文): 拉辛街空无一人。是雨？是宵禁？还是什么更糟的原因？

source_text(原文): I saw Bronek in this carriage, and also in the rear carriage. 'Dappled,'  he said when I asked.
translation_zh(译文): 我看见布罗内克在这节车厢里，也在后面那节车厢里。「斑驳，」我问他时，他这么回答。

source_text(原文): A brilliant spray of vivid red.
Sturdy, nutritious literature lairs gloweringly beneath a light topping of brightly coloured novels about people falling in things, falling off things, or inventing cocktail-mixing pianos.
translation_zh(译文): 结实而营养的书籍虎视眈眈地蛰伏在下面，上面薄薄地盖着一层色彩鲜艳的小说——讲的都是人们掉进什么东西里、从什么东西上掉下去，或者发明会调鸡尾酒的钢琴的故事。

source_text(原文):
Woman bites man. Man dies. Man faked death. Snake bites woman. Woman dies. Man resurrects woman. 
A love story.
translation_zh(译文):
女人咬了男人。男人死了。男人诈死。蛇咬了女人。女人死了。男人复活了女人。
一个爱情故事。

source_text(原文): It rained blood outside Cagnes-sur-Mer, but we've mostly wiped the windows clean now.
translation_zh(译文): 滨海卡涅外面下了血雨，不过我们大体上已把车窗擦干净了。

source_text(原文): 'They do their murdering - wrapped in the colours of OUR FLAG!'
translation_zh(译文): 「他们杀人——裹着我们国旗的颜色！」

source_text(原文): Right on the border between... autumn and spring? It must be exhausting, to be a flower in this world now.

- Stuff
- More stuff

source_text(原文): If you just close the Crafting menu without collecting what you've made, it'll go to your inventory anyway. But we find it satisfying to appreciate the results of our work.
translation_zh(译文): 如果你不收取做好的东西就直接关闭炼制菜单，成品反正也会进入你的行囊。不过，我们觉得欣赏自己劳动的成果是件令人满足的事。

source_text(原文): You've created something! Click to collect it. Any catalyst ingredients are also ready to be collected; any fuel ingredients have been consumed.
translation_zh(译文): 你制作出了某样东西！点击即可收取。催化原料也都可以收取；燃料原料则已被消耗。

source_text(原文): An ingredient needs to have all the [[Aspects]] specified below the slot. The picker shows everything from your Inventory that will fit..
translation_zh(译文): 原料必须拥有槽位下方指定的全部[[性相]]。选择器会显示你的行囊中所有符合条件的物品..

source_text(原文):
Spencer was never really an adept - and the [[Worms]] took much of his ability from him - but he can prepare tools to achieve a variety of supernatural effects in dialogue. As his Unworldly [[Skills]] increase, he'll be able to create more powerful tools.

You can look through Spencer's recipes whenever you like - but to make something, you'll need to find a crafting [[Venue]].
translation_zh(译文):
斯宾塞从来算不上真正的修士——[[蠕虫]]也从他身上夺走了大半本领——但他仍能备好工具，在对话中实现种种超自然效果。随着他世俗之外的[[技艺]]提升，他将能制作出更强大的工具。

你可以随时翻阅斯宾塞的配方——但若要制作某样东西，你需要先找到一个炼制[[场地]]。

source_text(原文):
Spencer was never really an adept - and the [[Worms]] took much of his ability from him - but he can prepare tools to achieve a variety of supernatural effects in dialogue. As his Unworldly [[Skills]] increase, he'll be able to create more powerful tools.

You need to be at at a crafting [[Venue]] to make anything - you're at one now - but you can look through Spencer's recipes whenever you like.
translation_zh(译文):
斯宾塞从来算不上真正的修士——[[蠕虫]]又夺走了他大半的本事——但他能备好工具，在对话中制造出种种超自然的效果。随着他的世俗之外的[[技艺]]提升，他将能造出更有力的工具。

想炼制任何东西，都得先身处炼制的[[场地]]——你现在就在一处——不过你随时都可以翻看斯宾塞的配方。

source_text(原文): You'll need an Ingredient for each open input slot - it has to possess all the [[Aspects]] below the slot. A flame icon means that the ingredient will be consumed as Fuel - if there's no flame, it's a Catalyst and you can reuse it.
translation_zh(译文): 每一个开启的输入槽位都需要一种[[原料]]——它必须拥有槽位下方列出的全部[[性相]]。火焰图标意味着该原料会被当作燃料消耗——若没有火焰，它便是催化剂，可以重复使用。

source_text(原文): This is a Rite. it works the same way as any other Recipe, but it'll reduce [[Troubles]] and provide a small random benefit. Some Rites are less safe and may increase other [[Troubles]]. The description will warn you.
translation_zh(译文): 这就是仪典。它的运作方式与其他配方并无二致，但会减少[[烦扰]]，并带来一点随机的益处。有些仪典不那么安全，可能会增加其他[[烦扰]]。描述里会提醒你。

source_text(原文): Every responsible practitioner knows not to invite unwanted influences. Before you start on your next recipe, click the results of your last recipe to collect them.
translation_zh(译文): 每一位负责任的修士都知道，不该招来不受欢迎的影响。开始下一个配方之前，先点击上一个配方的结果，把它们收好。

source_text(原文):
A clever practitioner might craft a [[Midnight Mark]] with Nyctodromy. A subtle one might use Hushery; a ruthless one, Skolekosophy.

For those different approaches, you'll work in different places. Nyctodromy can be used at a Wound or Threshold, but not at a Shadowed Place. Hushery can be used at a Shadowed or Quiet Place, but not at a Wound. And so on. This is why you find the most sinister adepts in graveyards, and the least fun ones in churches.
translation_zh(译文):
聪明的修士或许会用夜游术炼出一枚[[午夜印记]]。心思细腻的会用静默术；心狠手辣的，则会用蠕虫学。

不同的门路，要在不同的地方施展。夜游术可用于受创之处或门槛，但不能用于阴影之地。静默术可用于阴影之地或宁静之地，但不能用于受创之处。诸如此类。正因如此，最阴森的修士都在墓园里，最无趣的都在教堂中。

source_text(原文): The [[Skills]] this recipe needs can't be used at this [[Venue]].
translation_zh(译文): 这个配方所需的[[技艺]]，无法在此[[场地]]施展。

source_text(原文): If the toast alerts start to pile up, you can right-click to dismiss ALL alerts immediately.
translation_zh(译文): 若提示弹窗开始堆积，你可以右键点击，立即关闭全部提示。

source_text(原文): If a Skill check is way out of reach, or if your [[Aspect Pool]] has the wrong [[Aspects]], or if you've been using the Pool to rescue skill checks - you might not have enough juice to rescue a failure. The game will let you look at the Aspect Pool so you can see what's lacking.
translation_zh(译文): 若某次技艺检定的难度遥不可及，或你的[[性相池]]里没有对的[[性相]]，又或你一直在动用性相池去挽回技艺检定——你可能就没有足够的点数去挽回一次失败了。游戏会让你查看性相池，好让你看清缺了什么。

source_text(原文):
'Rescue' lets you use your [[Aspect Pool]] to snatch success from the jaws of failure.

Spending pips exhausts them, so you can't rescue every success -but pips refresh whenever you act with a matching [[Passion]].

It's easier to rescue a near miss than a bad failure!
translation_zh(译文):
「挽回」让你动用[[性相池]]，从失败的牙缝里夺回成功。

花掉点数，点数便会耗尽，所以你无法挽回每一次成功——但只要以相符的[[激情]]行事，点数就会恢复。

挽回一次差之毫厘的失败，总比挽回一次惨败容易！

source_text(原文):
Safely across war's wasteland. Good.

You don't have to enter a Destination when you arrive there - you can keep moving, if you have the right papers. But you'll usually want to enter. This first time, you certainly should.
translation_zh(译文):
平安穿过战争的废土。很好。

抵达目的地时，你不必进城——只要证件齐备，你可以继续赶路。但你通常都会想进城。这第一次，你当然应该进去。

source_text(原文): This is your first Companion; there are others. A Companion will follow you, providing (always) skill bonuses and (occasionally) opinions. Certain story options will increase the skill bonuses. Nothing will silence the opinions.
translation_zh(译文): 这是你的第一位同伴；以后还会有别人。同伴会跟随你，始终提供技艺加成，偶尔发表看法。某些剧情选项会提升技艺加成。但没有任何东西能封住他们的嘴。

source_text(原文):
Failure has its consolations and its consequences.

Consolations: Spencer gains more Experiences from Failure than from Success.

Consequences: When Spencer fails, he gains a Trouble.
translation_zh(译文):
失败自有它的安慰，也自有它的后果。

安慰：斯宾塞从失败中获得的经验，多于从成功中获得的。

后果：斯宾塞失败时，会增添一项烦扰。

source_text(原文): Spencer was hollowed out by Worms; he is much less than he was. But that's changing now. You know now that [[Experiences]] come in nine different flavours, and you can only use them to upgrade matching Skills and Passions. You could try to use Skills that offer the Experiences you need. Or you could just let Experiences guide you into developing Spencer in unexpected ways. See what you prefer.
translation_zh(译文): 斯宾塞曾被蠕虫掏空；他远不如从前了。但这一切正在改变。 你现在已经知道，[[经验]]有九种不同的味道，而你也只能用它们来提升相符的技艺与激情。你可以试着使用能提供所需经验的技艺；也可以干脆让经验引着你，把斯宾塞养成意想不到的样子。看看你更偏爱哪种。

source_text(原文):
Skills overlap. [[Sophistication]] and [[Hushery]] might both let you spot forged art. [[Bosk]] and [[Preservation]] are both relevant if you ever need to deliver a baby.

So you might see a dialogue choice with two [[Skill]] icons. In this case, you'll automatically use the Skill with the best chance of success. Hover over the choice for details about the other one.
translation_zh(译文):
技艺之间有所重叠。[[精致]]与[[静默术]]都能让你识破伪造的艺术品。[[丛林学]]与[[保存术]]则都与接生有关。

所以你可能会看到带有两个[[技艺]]图标的对话选项。这种情况下，你会自动使用成功机会最大的那门技艺。将光标悬停在选项上，可查看另一门技艺的详情。

source_text(原文): O wad some Pow'r the giftie gie us To see oursels as ithers see us! - Burns Done. You're welcome. Review the opinions of your Associates - characters of some importance in your life - at any time on this Journal page.
translation_zh(译文): 啊，但愿上天赐予我们这般天赋， 能像他人看待我们那样，看清我们自己！ ——彭斯 完毕。不客气。在这页日记上，你随时可以查看你的相识之人的看法——他们是你生活中颇为重要的人物。

source_text(原文):
A choice with a [[Skill]] icon needs a skill check. An invisible die is rolled*, added to your [[Skill]] level, and compared to the difficulty level of the check. The choice will give you your basic chance of success; hover your cursor for more details.

*technically, it's actually an invisible token being drawn from an [[invisible bag]].
translation_zh(译文):
带[[技艺]]图标的选项需要一次技艺检定。会掷出一枚隐形骰子*，加到你的[[技艺]]等级上，再与检定的难度一较高下。选项会告诉你基本的成功几率；将光标悬停，可查看详情。

*严格说来，其实是从[[隐形布袋]]里摸出一枚看不见的代币。

source_text(原文):
Take a moment to savour this first accomplishment, then look at the [[Experiences]] you've received. They'll always match the Skill you used. But every Skill has three [[Aspects]], so it'll cycle through the [[Aspects]] in turn.

If you don't know or care what that means, don't worry: it'll all be in the Footnotes for later.
translation_zh(译文):
花点时间品味这第一桩成就，然后看看你获得的[[经验]]。它们总会与你用过的技艺相符。不过每门技艺都有三个[[性相]]，所以它会依次在几个[[性相]]之间轮转。

若你不懂这意思，也不在乎，那别担心：日后这一切都会写进脚注里。

source_text(原文):
You've gained your first [[Trouble]]. This happens. Life in post-Wars Europe is awful.

[[Fascination]], [[Dread]], [[Weariness]] and [[Pain]] are reduced by sleep. You'll find somewhere to sleep in Antibes later. [[Traces]] will slowly creep up if you sleep in one place too long, but are reduced by travelling.

If you let a Trouble rise high enough, it'll start causing you problems. See the Footnote for the Trouble you just gained.

Mouse over the icons under your character portrait whenever you want to see how your Troubles are affecting you. You can also see your Trouble totals in your Inventory. (Why the Inventory? Because Troubles can also occasionally be used in Crafting.)
translation_zh(译文):
你获得了第一项[[烦扰]]。这种事在所难免。战后的欧洲，日子实在难熬。

[[入迷]]、[[恐惧]]、[[倦怠]]与[[痛苦]]都能靠睡眠消减。稍后你会在昂蒂布找到睡觉的地方。若在同一处睡得太久，[[痕迹]]会慢慢滋生，而旅行能消减它们。

若让某项烦扰涨得太高，它就会开始给你惹麻烦。看看你刚得的这项烦扰的脚注。

想查看你的烦扰正如何影响你时，把光标移到角色肖像下方的图标上即可。你也可以在行囊里查看烦扰的总数。（为什么在行囊里？因为烦扰偶尔也能用于炼制。）

source_text(原文): Expand a tooltip to keep it as a Footnote. Later, press F or click the Footnotes button to search and revisit Footnotes you've found. Here's a [[Footnote]] about Footnotes. 'Why does it disturb us that the map be included in the map and the thousand and one nights in the book of the Thousand and One Nights?' - Borges
translation_zh(译文): 展开一条悬浮提示，即可把它存为脚注。之后，按 F 键或点击脚注按钮，就能搜索并重温你找到的脚注。 这里有一条关于脚注的[[脚注]]。 「地图被绘入地图，一千零一夜被写进《一千零一夜》，这为何会令我们不安？」——博尔赫斯

source_text(原文): When you move the cursor over something interactable, it'll highlight. Or hold Z to highlight everything interactable on screen.
translation_zh(译文): 将光标移到可交互的物体上时，它会高亮。或者按住 Z 键，高亮屏幕上所有可交互之物。

source_text(原文): You're set this item as active. Active Items work slightly differently in Travelling at Night from equipped items in most games. Mouse over the ACTIVE ITEMS header to learn more.
translation_zh(译文): 你已将这件物品设为活跃。在Travelling at Night中，活跃物品的运作方式与大多数游戏里的已装备物品略有不同。将光标移到「活跃物品」标题上，可了解更多。

source_text(原文):
The Map becomes relevant once Spencer is ready to leave Antibes. Travel from a station to any adjoining city... if you have the relevant travel documents. Be careful: repeatedly traversing the same route will inflict [[Traces]].

More about [[travelling]] here.
translation_zh(译文):
等斯宾塞准备离开昂蒂布，地图就派上用场了。从车站出发，可以前往任何相邻的城市……前提是证件齐备。当心：反复走同一条路线，会招来[[痕迹]]。

关于[[旅行]]的更多内容，见此处。

source_text(原文): Agio, the fee charged for exchanging currency. Wonderfully, it's derived from the italian aggio, meaning 'comfort' or 'ease'. The merchant is charging a fee for your comfort and ease. Whenever you pay in a non-native currency, a merchant will charge you agio - about fifteen per cent, but they'll round down.
translation_zh(译文): 贴水，兑换货币时收取的费用。 妙得很，它源自意大利语的aggio，意为「舒适」或「安逸」。商人收取这笔费用，正是为了你的舒适与安逸。 每当你用非本地货币付款，商人都会收取贴水——大约百分之十五，不过他们会向下取整。

source_text(原文): This is embarrassing: you've sold so many items that the merchant has run out of cash! Rare, but it happens. If you travel to another city and return, they'll have refilled their till.
translation_zh(译文): 这就尴尬了：你卖掉了太多东西，商人的现金已经见底！不常见，但确实会发生。你若去另一座城市再回来，他们的钱箱已经重新填满。

source_text(原文): You don't have enough of the currently selected currency to cover this purchase. Use the picker at the top to select a currency you have more of - or offer items in barter, if you have anything the merchant will accept.
translation_zh(译文): 你手中目前所选货币的余额不足以支付这笔交易。用顶部的选择器换一种你更充裕的货币——或者拿出物品以物易物，只要你有商人愿意收的东西。

source_text(原文): You can pay in cash, or you can offer items for barter, if you have anything the merchant's interested in. But you'll often need to top up with cash - look at the total in the barter block.
translation_zh(译文): 你可以付现金，也可以拿出商人感兴趣的东西来以物易物。但很多时候，你还得用现金补足差额——看看易物栏里的总数。

source_text(原文): Notice your wallet at the bottom left - you've paid in the currency that you chose.
translation_zh(译文): 注意左下角的钱包——你已用自己选择的货币付了账。

source_text(原文): Notice your wallet at the bottom left - the merchant's paid you in their native currency.

source_text(原文): You wouldn't usually walk into a greengrocer and try to sell them apples... but things are different since the Wars, and merchants are usually up for bartering, as long as you're offering something they can use or sell. Mouse over the [[Aspects]] in the Merchant Buys... block. Janvier, for instance, will buy anything tagged as Luxuries or Refinements.
translation_zh(译文): 你通常不会走进果蔬店，试图把苹果卖给他们……但战争以后，世道不同了，只要你能拿出他们用得上或卖得掉的东西，商人们通常都乐意以物易物。将光标移到「商人收购……」栏中的[[性相]]上。比如让维耶，任何标注为奢侈品或精制品的物品，他都收。

source_text(原文):
Since the Wars, cash is king, barter is queen, and the black market is the power behind the throne.

Every merchant prefers to be paid in their local currency, and they'll only pay out in that currency. But they'll grudgingly accept a  range of others. Legitimate [[State]] merchants like Janvier, for instance, prefer the [[francisque]] but will usually accept dollars, sterling, or Swiss francs.

Harder currencies like the dollar are more widely accepted, but local politics are important. The [[State]] won't accept [[Republic]] currency, and dollars are unwelcome in [[Ministries]] territory. But if you can find a black market merchant, they'll often take all kinds of currency - even cigarettes.
translation_zh(译文):
战争以来，现金为王，易物为后，而黑市才是幕后真正的掌权者。

每位商人都偏爱本地货币，也只肯用那种货币付款。不过，他们也会勉强收下其他一些货币。比如让维耶这类正当的[[邦国]]商人，偏爱[[法兰西斧币]]，但通常也收美元、英镑或瑞士法郎。

美元这类硬通货更受欢迎，但地方政治也很要紧。[[邦国]]不收[[共和国]]货币，美元在[[联盟]]的地盘上不受欢迎。但若能找到黑市商人，他们往往什么货币都收——连香烟也要。

source_text(原文): Currencies in Travelling at Night are rounded up or down - merchants don't give change - so you'll generally overpay a little, but this is a big overpayment! Sometimes, in post-Wars Europe, that's just the breaks. But for generous overpayments, we always check that you're sure.
translation_zh(译文): 在Travelling at Night中，货币会向上或向下取整——商人不找零——所以通常你都会多付一点点，但这一笔可多付了不少！有时候，在战后的欧洲，世事就是这样。不过对于过于慷慨的多付，我们总会先确认你确实想这样。

source_text(原文): Use the arrow icons to change the quantity you're buying or selling, then Accept.
translation_zh(译文): 用箭头图标调整你要买入或卖出的数量，然后点「确定」。

source_text(原文):
It may be time to panic very slightly. One of [[Dread]], [[Pain]] or [[Fascination]] has reached 7. If it reaches 10, the game will end, and not in a good way.

But the situation merits only very slight panic. You still have time. Avoid situations that might increase the Trouble in question; sleep, or use a curative Rite; and you'll be fine.
translation_zh(译文):
也许是时候稍稍惊慌一下了。[[恐惧]]、[[痛苦]]或[[入迷]]之中，有一项已经涨到 7。若它涨到 10，游戏就会结束，而且是以不妙的方式。

不过，眼前的局势只配得到非常轻微的惊慌。你还有时间。避开可能加剧该项烦扰的处境；睡上一觉，或行一次治愈的仪典；你就会安然无事。

source_text(原文):
You can evolve an empty [[Passion]] into any Passion you've recently acted with, as long as you have enough of the right [[Experiences]]. You can evolve existing Passions, too, but only when appropriate - Anger can evolve to Honour or Ambition, but not Compassion or Whimsy.


Evolving a Passion levels it up, and Passions can't go above 9. So you can't evolve any Passion once it's reached the max. But by the time all three Passions are at 9, you'll have a very clear idea who your Spencer is.
translation_zh(译文):
只要拥有足够的相应[[经验]]，你就能把空置的[[激情]]演化为任何你近来以之行动的激情。已有的激情也可以演化，但只在恰当之时——愤怒可以演化为荣誉或野心，却不能演化为悲悯或奇想。


演化激情会使其升级，而激情不能超过 9 级。所以任何激情一旦到顶，便再也无法演化。但等到三项激情都到 9 时，你的斯宾塞是个什么样的人，你心里便一清二楚了。

Refreshments are, generally, delicious. Use them to restore pips in your [[Aspect Pool]].

source_text(原文): Soon, all Europe will open to you, as long as you can obtain the right documents. But right now, there's only one place you need to go.
translation_zh(译文): 很快，整个欧洲都会向你敞开，只要你弄到合适的证件。但现在，你只需要去一个地方。

source_text(原文):
You've found a private place to change [[Outfits]]. You start with two: the one you stepped off the train wearing, and your dressing gown.

You're probably exhausted by now - consider resting to heal [[Troubles]]. Switch to your dressing gown in your Outfits grid, and you'll be able to sleep.

You might want to switch back to your daytime Outfit before leaving your room, although the other residents of this place are reasonably relaxed about that sort of thing.
translation_zh(译文):
你找到了一处可以更换[[行头]]的私密之地。你一开始有两套：下火车时穿着的那套，以及你的睡袍。

你现在大概已经筋疲力尽——不妨歇一歇，好消解[[烦扰]]。在行头栏里换上睡袍，你就能睡觉了。

出门前，你或许还是换回白天穿的行头为好，虽说这地方的其他住客对这种事还算看得开。

source_text(原文): Set whenever we exit the map. Important for tracking how we got to a minor destination circus scene

source_text(原文): My unpaid tab, in francisques. Settlement will oblige.

translation_zh(译文): 斯宾塞已在同一处过了第四夜。最好继续赶路。

translation_zh(译文): 「光揭示一切，光令人目盲。」近两千年来，不败之日教会一直声称，自己是永恒之光的唯一真正阐释者。但即便是教会，也无法宣称自己能主宰视界。

source_text(原文): "Mercy," saith the [[Watchman]], "is found only in shadow." But he does not say that mercy is nowhere found; and shadows lie long here.
translation_zh(译文): 「仁慈，」守夜人言道，「唯在阴影之中方能寻得。」但他并未说仁慈无处可寻；而此地的阴影，绵长地铺展着。
供随侍诸力共处的中立之地。

translation_zh(译文): 一切生长之物，根皆扎于木材——那个不必借助光线也能看见色彩的地方。
